tei:div.tei:p: —‘ jidī tsā ne sa no sherke ni she ne tshozi phroṃ5rispyo4snye lū snyemusrispyo4r+shasnye spyo4snye bam̐ 5'a rkuri — ‘ dro ne ( spyopo 5ri'྾ 5snye sbyi tre—7ṭ+wāṃjing rdo/ ——rdodz+wa—༷r+sha3t+t+waṃr+ṣa/nirdaḍirdo — t+t+waṃhūṃrnod+ngha tre— d+ngha— —rnaṭ+wāṃ~X gidhe — — hū+oṃrjorjo rde —— —sdo— zhe ri— hūṃd+mo rdohūṃ ngh+ruḥsnge— rwa——— — — dz+nyod+ngha—k+ṣiṃdūdhe ༷— ca—5— —— — —ngh+rungh+ru ༷ smyo sdi tre — — —rwa sdo ram̐ tram̐ dhe—dhe wa rde byerde—du— waskreskre—wa— — — — ———— sh+lau+o byeX ༷ wa—༷/—tretrorwadūtre — d+ngha—rdaḍorngo sdo4 rderjo ngh+ru rdowa~Xshāwakwa wa——3— ———————————ngh+ru r+shapaṃt+t+waṃ rdobye —spre — wawawa—wawawawa wartehūṃ rte bye — wa pha—— jewa d+ngha wawatrewawarjo rjongh+ruji rngo tre hūṃwa mi rigs dpe skrunakhang / ciXji drorni sgrotā 5— — — tre ske — wa d+ngha—rdowatram̐ ngh+rutshotram̐rjo d+ngha
gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshan dpyod khru'u yis bsgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

——————khe——— snyeri ri sto rkabosnyer+yātrī’bosnye0rku5gle’snyeparkagasnyed+dhasnyerkajilhasnye4snyelhatrītrīphyelhasnyelaristserkutī5chaskyalitreskrusnyer+ṣazhu5trītrīske'ilasnyespyolispyo’losnye9’snye.oṃl4trīrmesnyerku5la sprolhalhardzispyo5snyelaskrusnyelha4grerku5trītrī0lhorirkusnyezu5d+ku0ri4risnyerkatho2r+ṣa4sdo2trītrītshesnyerkuthulasnyeñcasnye0r+ghaṃ5snyermo5spyolisnyekherku5snyerkarjelasnyemi5trītrīze5skyalilhasnyololosnyelasnye’0ji 0thu2snyespyo5trī( 0k+shi5snye’chasnyel lhasnye྾snyespyor+sha snyesperkasnyelhachulatrītrīsnye྾ṅkasgosnyergardzo྾ nyi shustseskenadug7ba— ske cho rdar+ṣawi0siglorjophyolir+sā.a+yosgoṅka'aswo —

dkar chaga'ajam mgon smra ba'i dbang bo rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba zhes bya ba'i tshig 'grel kun mkhyen mnyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/(1)bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ blo bzang/(43)ma thel dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling gi dkar chag dang dgon mtshan thogs tshul skor gleng ba/ rdoraphrug (66)'khor phyogs gsum gyi byed phyogs lag tu bstar nas skad yig slob khrid kyi rnam pa gsar pa zhig gtod dgos/ gdugs dkar skyabs/(72)bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ sgom pa bkra shis/(80)yig sgyur lag len khrod du gzhung lugs gsar pa nang 'dren byed dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ klu 'bumargyal/(100)‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ sangs rgyas mkhar/(116)tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 'dzigs med rgya mcho/(135)bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyad pa/ ngag dbang rgya mcho/(158)grangs rig slob khrid kyi gnad don bcos sgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char 'ga' gleng ba/ 'jigs byed/(169)

zlos gar gyi rnam bshad nyung bsdus/ lha mkhar che ring /(177)gna' rabs bod kyi dngul lor brje res skor mdo tsam gleng ba/ mgon po rnam rgyal/(183)rgya bod gtam dpe lo tsā'i tshad gzhi dngos dang de'i sgyur thabs skor gyi dpyad pa phran bu/ 'od can 'bum/(192)dge rgan gyi byang tshad mthor 'degs gtong ba'i thad kyi bsam gzhigs/ dpal chen rdo rje/(206)rgya bod skad gnyis lo tsā'i ngo bo gcig mtshon gyi tha snyad sgyur thabs rags tsam gleng ba/ lcagasathar/(213)sbal ti ba'i skad gdangs kyi khyad chos 'ga' gleng ba/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/(222)‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs don la brten nas mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod las don gsar 'byed byed dgos/sgrol ma 'cho/(234)mi rigs dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi cha byad nyams stabs tshad ldan du gtong dgos pa'i gnad mdor tsam brjod pa/ lha rgyal che ring /(243)skad gnyis slob khrid kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ dge 'dun/(254)nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ kun bzangagrol/(265)bya tshig gi sbyor tshul dang ming grub tshul la cung zad dpyad pa/ pad ma che brtan/(277)slob grwa'i mi don lam lugs kyi sgyur bcos gting zab tu spel dgos/ gdugs dkar 'cho/(289)

1༄ / / 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang bo rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba zhes bya ba'i tshig 'grel kun mkhyen mnyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bsetshang blobazang dpalaldan/na mo gu ru/ mkhyen rab 'od brgyas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor bcings/ / dmigs med snying rjes dus mtha'i 'gro rnams sgrol/ / rgyal ba'i mdzad skyong lha mi'i mgon po mchog / smra ba'i rgyal bo gang gis dge legs stsol/ / khyod yon chu shel nor bu'i me long dkyil/ / sgrib gnyis mun sel phan bde 'od dkar can/ / sa gsum yangs pa'i mkha' la rab 'phags pas/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgrengs/ / kha ba dkar bo'i mu khyud rab zlum par/ / 'gengs pa'i mkhas dgus 'bad kyang ma rnyed pa'i/ / gzhan stong lta ba'i legs bshad gdong lnga'i dbyangs/ / khyod mgrin g.yas 'khyil dung las snyan par sgrogs/ / pra phabs rang bzhin stong gzugs phyag rgya cher/ / mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bar snyoms zhugs pa/ / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim gnyis gnad/ / gsang chen rdo rje'i char chen 'dod par phabs/ / rtag brtan g.yung drung chos kyi gdan sa che/ / thub pa nyi ma stong gi 'od rlabs can/ / chos kyi dga' tshal 'og min gnyis pa'i zhing / /

2 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bskrun pas dge legs bye ba'i dog pa byin/ / kun yid dga' ba'i legs mdzad 'bum phrag gi/ / snying bo bsdus pa'i rgyal sras spyod pa can/ / dam pa'i zhal bzang pad ma'i dga' tshal las/ / tshig rgyan me tog gsar ba'i mdzes sdug bkra/ / de yi dgongs zab rin chen 'byung gnas klung / / blo chung ri bong rkyal bas brgal dka' yang / / lhag bsam rlung gis bskyod pa'i gru gzings las/ / skal bzang dpal du blo ldan dad pas 'jug / ces shis pa dang bstod pa'i tshig gis dge legs su byed pa'i bden tshig kun tu bzang bo'i me tog gi phreng ba sngon du btang ste/ dpal ldan yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje'i bstan pa'i snying bo phyogs mthar spel ba'i 'phrin las kyi mnga' bdag nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍita chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rje tā ra nā tha'am sgrol ba'i mgon po (rab byung bcu ba'i shing phag lor 'khrungs/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing khyi lor 'das )zhes shar chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad na mtshan gyi ba dan rab tu g.yo ba/rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba dang / rkang 'thung gi tshal na dpag bsam gyi shing bzhin du lhang nger grags pa de nyid kyis/ sa skyong mi'i dbang bo rin spungs pa dang / gtsang ba sde srid karma ba yab sras sogs dam pa'i zhal slob dang sbyin bdag rnams la zhal chems kyi tshul du bstsal pa'i 〈zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba 〉zhes bya ba 'di mdzad do/ /zhal gdams dpe rgyan so gnyis po 'di'i brjod bya ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang / don che ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang / ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal/ nges legs thar ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i phan yon sogs la sbyar nas gsungs te/ dkar bo dge ba'i phyogs su bskul pa'i zhal gdams don zab la tshig nyung ba'i legs bshad rmad du byung ba zhig yin zhing / blo rmongs bdag lta bu'i blo'i spyod yul du ga la 'gyur yang / deng dus mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa chen por skur bzhengs

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 3pa/ mkhan chen kun dga' thugs rje dpal ba mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar/rang gi bsod nams kyi dpal du bsam ste rjod par byed pa la/ thog mar/mchod par brjod pa dang bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo bshad par dam bcas pa'i tshig 'grel dang / gzhung don dngos kyi tshig 'grel brjod pa dang gnyis las/dang po ni/ oṃ ni sngags kyi thog ma dang / su sti ni dge legs sam/dge ba ste dge legs su gyur cig ces so/ / bdag lta so ldan dregs pa'i dgra/ / rgyal ba ri dwags dbang bo gang / / dpag yas yon tan 'byor ba yis/ / khengs pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags bzhin/ / gnyis med gsungs pa'i bstan pa la/ / gus pas blo ldan phyag 'tshal te/ / gdams pa'i sgron me rab sbar pas/ / snyan tshig ri mo'ang gsal bar bya/ / zhes byung ste/ / de yang / / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni bdag tu 'dzin pa yin te/ dpal chos kyi grags pas/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ / bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang / / 'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las/ / nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de lta bu'i bdag tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba de so ldan nam glang bo che dregs pa'i gzugs su bkod nas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa de'i dgra ste bdag 'dzin de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i bdag med pa'am zab mo stong ba nyid kyi chos ston pa po rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang bo ni/ ri dwags dbang bo ste seng ge'i gzugs su bkod nas/ ston pa thugs rje can gang nyid ni/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i shes bya'i yon tan ma lus pa'am dpag yas pa'i yon tan mtha' dag la dbang 'byor ba yis/ 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su ji ltar seng ge khengs pas gad rgyangs kyi sgra bsgrags pa bzhin/ zab zhi spros bral snang stong gnyis su med pa'i gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar bsgrags pa'i bstan

4 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mthodze+em ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa 'di la rab tu dad cing gus pa'i blo dang ldan pa bdag gis phyag 'tshal te/lus can thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'god par byed pa'i zhal gdams 'di ni/ mun pa'i nang du sgron me rab tu sbar ba'i gzugs su bkod de/ sgron me'i 'od kyis mun pa bsal nas phyi'i gzugs can gsal bar byed pa ltar/ gdams ngag 'di'i rjod byed snyan tshig gi ri mo'i lam nas brjod bya gang gdams bya'i don gsal bar bya zhes so/ /gnyis pa gzhung don dngos kyi dpe rgyan so so'i tshig 'grel tsam brjod pa la/ dpe rgyan so gnyis las/ dang bo chos dpe la sbyar ba ni/ 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pa'i lus/ / yid bzhin nor bu lta bur dkon/ / mi zad gter chen dam pa ltar/ / phun tshogs thams cad 'di las thob ces pa 'di ni chos kyi dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ de yang mgon po klu sgrub kyi bshes springs las/ / log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro dang / / yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba dang / / rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob tu/ / kla klo skye dang glen zhing lkugs pa nyid/ tshe ring lha dang gang yang rung bar ni/ /skye ba zhes bgyi mi khom skyon brgyad po/ / de dag dang bral khom pa rnyed pa ni/ / skye ba bzlog pa'i slad du 'bad par mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ngan song gsum dang / rgyal ba'i bka' med pa ste sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba dang / byon kyang chos kyi sgra mi thos pa'i yul mtha' 'khob kyi kla klor skye ba dang / yul dbus yin yang shin tu glen zhing lkugs pa nyid du skye ba dang / dge sdig dang / las 'bras/ thar pa sogs khas mi len zhing thar pa'i lam la bskur ba 'debs pa'i log lta can du skye ba dang / 'du shes med pa'i sems can te lha tshe ring bor skye ba sogs ni mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad de/ de dag las bzlog pa ni khom pa'am dal ba'i gnas yin pas na dal ba brgyad dang / mi nyid dbus skyes dbang bo tshang las mtha' ma

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 5log gnas la dad/ / ces rang 'byor lnga dang / sangs rgyas byon dang dam chos ston/ / bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug / gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o/ / zhes gzhan 'byor lnga ste/ dpe can dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ldan pa'i rten bzang ste rang cag rnams la da res tsam thob pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di lta bu shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ni/ dpe dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu shin tu dkon zhing rnyed par dka' ba dang mtshungs par sbyar zhing / yang dpe can dal 'byor thob pa don che ba ni/ dpe mi zad pa'i gter chen po dang mtshungs par sbyar te/ gter gyi phung bo de ni dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas kyi mchog gam dam pa yin pas/ de lag tu thob na ji bsam pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub pa ltar du rang cag rnams kyis rnyed pa'i dal 'byor gyi rten bzang bo 'di'i steng nas/ mngon mtho dang nges legs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sogs srid zhi'i phun tshogs thams cad bde blag tu 'grub cing / de yang dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che rnyed pa 'di la brten nas thob pa yin/ zhes dpe dang dpe can gyi chos dang chos can gnyis su phye ba'i chos kyi sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa yin/de ltar du slob springs las/ bder gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / / sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ / lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang / / mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi 'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di ni dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang don che ba'i tshul las brtsams pa'i dper brjod yin/gnyis pa dngos dpe ni/ lus 'di chu yi wu ba 'dra/ / dbugs kyang ston ka'i na bun bzhin/ / mtho ris 'byor ba'i dpal 'di yang / rmi lam ltad mo ji bzhin no/ / zhes pa 'di ni dngos po'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can rang cag rnams la stabs legs kyi dbang gis rnyed dka' zhing rnyed na

6 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/don che ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che lan gcig thob pa 'di yang /yun du mi gnas par nam 'chi la nges pa med pa ni/ dpe chu'i wu ba dang mtshungs par sbyar pa dang / yang dpe can nyin zhag rer nang gi srog dbugs 'byung rngub ste rlung gi rgyu ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re song bas nyin zhag gcig 'das/ nyin zhag sum cu song bas zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis song bas lo sogs rim bzhin 'dzad pas 'chi ba la thag je nyer 'gro ba/ dpe ston ka'i na bun nam char sprin ring du mi gnas pa dang mtshungs par tshe 'di yun du mi gnas shing nam 'chi cha med pa dang / yang / dpe can mtho ris kyi lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa la ci tsam longs spyad kyang snying bo med pa ni/ dpe rmi lam gyi ltad mo ji lta ba bzhin no zhes/ dpe dang dpe can gyi chos dang chos can gnyis las chos can gyi sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ 'dir srog dbugs zhes pa'i srog ni/ lus dang rnam shes kyi rten du gyur pa'i ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed rdzas grub cig yin par bye brag smra bas 'dod cing / mdo sde bas/ yid kyi rnam shes sa bon dang bcas pa ris mthun du gnas pa la srog gi dbang bo zhes 'dod pa dang / lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa bas/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang ris mthun par gnas pa de srog gi dbang bo zhes bshad/ 'grel ba 'dod 'jor/ srog ces bya ba rlung khams chen po'am dbugs rtag tu phyi rol dang nang du rgyu ba'i las byed pa ste/ 'tsho ba'i dus ji srid du phyi nang du 'gro ba'am srog gam snying gi rlung la 'jug par bshad pa sogs ngos 'dzin tshul mang / de ltar du rgya chen rol pa las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ / 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ / 'gro ba'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ / ri gzar 'bab chu lta bur myur mgyogs 'gro / zhes dang / kā ni ka'i spring yig las/ 'chi bdag su dang mi bshes pa/ / glo bur dag tu 'bab 'gyur

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 7bas/ / sang dag bya zhes ma bzhes par/ / dam pa'i chos la bsnyur te mdzod/ / ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa bzlog pa'i dpe ni/ zhun mar zad pa'i sgron me 'di/ / 'chi bdag gnas su chas pa yi/ / skyes bu'i srog ltar rkyen gzhan la/ / ltos pa med par 'jig pa nyid/ / ces pa 'di ni bzlog pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ tshe la snon pa med cing 'brid byed bar ma chad du yod pa dang / 'chi rkyen shin tu mang zhing gson rkyen nyung ba la/ dpe zhun mar zad pa'i sgron me sngon du bkod nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i dpe can 'chi bdag gi gnas su chas pa'i skye bo'i srog gam tshe 'di yun du mi gnas te/ gson pa'i rkyen nyung zhing 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bar ma zad nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa'i 'chi rkyen gzhan la ltos pa med par/ gson pa'i rkyen kha zas dang sman sogs kyang ma zhu ba'am ma 'phrod pa 'chi rkyen du 'gyur ba sogs tshe 'di mi rtag cing 'jig pa chos nyid do/ / zhes dpe dang dpe can sbyor tshul go bzlog nas don la mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ de ltar du tshoms las/ dper na thags ni brkyangs pa la/ spun ni gang dang gang bcug pa'i/ / spun gyi gting la gtugs pa ltar/ / mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ / dper na nges par gsad pa dag / gom pa gang dang gang bor bas/ / bsad pa'i drung du bsnyen pa ltar/ / mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ / zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa dang / rin chen phreng ba las kyang / 'chi bdag rkyen gyi nang gnas pa/ /rlung dmar nang 'dug mar me bzhin/ / zhes dang / 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste/ / gson pa yi ni nyung zad cig / ces gsungs pa dang / bshes springs las kyang / tshe ni gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ / chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ / dbugs rngub dbugs 'byung gnyid kyis log pa las/ / sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ / zhes mang du gsungs pa ltar ro/ /

8 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzhi pa phan tshun gyi dpe ni/ lang tsho dar ba'i lus 'di ni/ / mdzes kyang mi brtan 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / 'ja' tshon 'di yang lus bzhin du/ /'dus byas rnams kyi ngang tshul ston/ / ces pa 'di ni phan tshun dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ spyir 'dzam bu gling gi mi'i tshe la nges pa med pa ste/ dpe can byis pa skyes ma thag pa dang / la la gog tsam dang / la la yongs su rgyug pa dang / na gzhon dang / dar ma dang / rgan po sogs go rim med par 'chi ba dang /rgyal bo dang / 'bangs mi/ mkhas pa dang / blun po/ skyes pa dang / bud med lang tsho shin tu dar ba la bab pa sogs mdzes pa dang mi mdzes pa'i lus rten gang zhig blangs pa 'di dag kyang yun du mi brtan pa ni/ dpe nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin dang / nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'di yang 'dzam gling gi mi'i lus rten bzhin du yun du mi gnas shing mi rtag pa'i tshul 'dis 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi ngang tshul ston zhes/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis phan tshun dpe len res byas pas don gyis gnyis ka phan tshun mtshungs par bstan pa yin/ de ltar du tshoms las/ skyes pa bud med mang bo dang / / dar la bab pa'ang 'chi 'gyur na/ de la mi ni gzhon zhes te/ / gson pa'i gdeng drod ci zhig yod/ / kha cig mngal du 'chi bar 'gyur/ / de bzhin kha cig btsas pa'i sar/ / de bzhin kha cig gog tsam na/ / de bzhin kha cig yongs rgyug na/ / la la rgan dang la la gzhon/ / la la dar la bab pa'i mi/ / rim gyis rab tu 'gro 'gyur te/ / 'bras bu smin pa lhung ba bzhin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di ni 'chi ba mi rtag pa las brtsams pa'i dpe brjod yin/lnga pa nges pa'i dpe ni/ 'dod yon ri mo rab bkra bar/ / sems 'di rnam par g.yo ba ni/ / bung ba dug gi me tog la/ / rgyug par mtshungs kyi gzhan dang min/ / zhes pa 'di ni nges pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste zag bcas kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan ri mo ltar rab

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 9tu bkra ba de la yid chags pa'am sems rang dbang med par rnam par g.yo ba ni/ dpe bung ba dug gi me tog la 'dod pas rab tu rgyug pa dang mtshungs kyi/de las gzhan gyi dpe med par nges zhes/ dpe can de la dpe de gcig bu las gzhan med pas dpe gcig tu nges par brjod pa yin/ de yang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ri dwags glang bo phye ma leb dang nya/ / sbrang ma lnga bo lnga yis bcom gyur te/ / gcig gis 'joms na gang zhig lnga rnams ni/ /rtag tu bsten pa ci'i phyir 'joms mi 'gyur/ / zhes pas phye ma leb mar me'i gzugs la chags pa dang / ri dwags ni sgra snyan la chags pa dang / sbrang ma pad+ma'i dri la chags pa dang / nya ni dmar la dga' bas sha la sogs pa'i ro la chags pa dang / glang bo che glang mo'i reg bya la chags pas 'joms pa ste 'dod yon re re bsten pa'i nyes pa 'di 'dra na/ gang zag gcig gis 'dod yon lnga ka la chags te bsten na rang nyid ci'i phyir mi 'joms/ zhes zag bcas kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten pa'i nyes dmigs gsungs pa ltar dang /bshes springs las kyang / g.yo ba'i sems ni thos mtshungs bu lta bur/ /gter bzhin srog dang 'dra bar bsrung bgyi ste/ / gdug pa dug dang mtshon dang dgra bo dang / / me bzhin 'dod pa'i bde la yid byung mdzod/ / 'dod pa rnams ni phung krol bskyed pa ste/ / rgyal ba'i dbang bos kim pa'i 'bras 'drar gsungs/ / de dag spang bgyi de yi lcags sgrog gis/ / 'khor ba'i btson rar 'jig rten 'di dag bcings/ / zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/'ditsho ltar 'jigs pa thams cad dang / / sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yang / / sems las byung ba yin no zhes/ / yang dag gsungs pa nyid kyis bstan/ / ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa nges med kyi dpe ni/ rtswa ltar g.yo ba'i sems pa gang / glog ltar gzung du med pa ste/ / 'bab chu la sogs rab g.yo ba/ / gzhan yang

10 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yod na 'di dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni nges med dpe/ / zhes pa ste/dpe can skad cig kyang mi sdod mi brtan par rlung gis bskyod pa'i rtswa ltar g.yo ba'i sems pa gang yin pa de/ nam mkhar glog rgyu ba ltar du skad cig tsam las yun ring bor gzung du med pa ni/ dpe brag gzar gyi 'bab chu la sogs pa cung zad kyang mi sdod par rtag tu bzhur ba ste rab tu g.yo ba dang mtshungs kyi/ gzhan yang 'di lta bu'i dpe 'jig rten du yod na dpe can 'di dang mtshungs zhes brjod pa yin/ sems pa ni/ kun btus las/ sems pa gang yin zhe na/ sems mngon par 'du byed pa yid kyi las te/ dge ba dang mi dge ba lung du ma bstan pa rnames la sems 'jug par byed pa'i las can no/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de yang / dper na rdo khab len gyis lcags phye rang dbang med par g.yo ba ltar/ rang sems dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum po'i gang rung la g.yo zhing skul bar byed pa de la sems byung sems pa zhes zer/ des na sdug bsngal bar byed pa'i nyon mongs thams cad kyang thog mar sems las bskyed pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ji skad du/'jig rten sems kyis khrid pa ste/ / sems kyis yongs su drangs pa yin/ /sems kyi chos ni gcig pu yi/ / dbang gi rjes su chos kun 'gro/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / sems kyi chos las kyang / sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ / sems kyi phung bo byas pa ste/ / 'jig rten khams ni ji snyed pa/ / de snyed thams cad sems kyis bris/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di ni 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi nyes dmigs las brtsams pa'i dpe brjod yin/bdun pa bsdus pa'i dpe ni/ ngan 'gro'i tshor ba mi bzad pa/ / rno ba kho nas spu gri dang / / mtshungs pa ma yin 'gro sems la/ / 'jigs pa skyed byed kyis kyang ngo / / zhes pa 'di ni bsdus pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ste tsha grang bkres skom glen lkugs la

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 11sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rno ba'am sdug bsngal shin tu drag po myong ba tsam ste de kho nas/ dpe spu gri dang mtshungs pa ma yin par/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong ba 'di dag mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / ma mtha' ri mor bris pa tshun chad mthong ba'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi sems la 'jigs skrag skyed pa'i nus pa dang de gnyis lhan du bsdus pas/ dpe spu gri dang mtshungs zhes/dpe can de'i khyad chos gcig kho na ma yin par de'i khyad chos gzhan dag kyang lhan du bsdus nas dpe de dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ de ltar du bshes springs las/ sdig can dbugs 'byung 'gags pa tsam zhig gi / dus kyis bar du chod rnams dmyal ba yi/ / sdug bsngal gzhal yas thos nas rnam stong du/ / mi 'jig gang lags rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ / dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / / dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis rnams kyang / / 'jigs pa skyed par 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ / rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brgyad pa khyad par ba'am phul byung gi dpe ni/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba po/ / kun gyis sdug bsngal drag po shes/ / mtho ris 'byor ba sdug bsngal du/ / 'phags pas mkhyen pa 'di gnyis khyad/ / ces pa 'di ni khyad par dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ tsha dmyal brgyad dang / grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dang / byings dang kha thor la gnas pa'i dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal te/ dpe can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal de dag myong ba po ngan 'gror skyes pa'i sems can kun gyis rang rang gis myong ba'i sdug bsngal de sdug bsngal drag po zhig yin par shes pa dang / dpe mtho ris lha dang mi'i bde 'byor phun sum tshogs pa 'di dag kyang mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du 'phags pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gis mkhyen pa ste gzigs pa 'di gnyis/ rten dang yul gyi rnam pa tha dad

12 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsam gyi khyad par ma gtogs sdug bsngal du mthong tshul phyogs kun nas mtshungs zhes 'ud chen pos brjod pa yin/ de yang bzhi brgya ba las/ mkhas pa rnams la mtho ris kyang / / dmyal ba dang mtshungs 'jigs bskyed 'gyur/ / zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ su zhig 'jigs chen 'di las bdag / legs par skyob par byed 'gyur zhes/ / bred sha thon pa'i mig bgrad nas/ / phyogs bzhir skyabs dag 'tshol bar byed/ / phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni/ / de nas kun tu yi mug 'gyur/ / gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na/ / de tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/ / zhes dang / skyes rabs las kyang / 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis mtha' yas mthong / /'thab mo khon dang mya ngan sdug bsngal rgyu/ / 'jigs byed dug gi lo ma 'dra ba ste/ / me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'i so dang 'dra/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ / zhes gsungs pa sogs ltar ro/ /dgu pa rab btags kyi dpe ni/ mtho ris sgeg mo'i bzhin gyi dpal/ / yod ces pad dkar snyems mi 'tshal/ / rab 'bar sha ma li nags kyi/ / sring mo la yang de yod phyir/ / zhes pa 'di ni rab btags dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can mtho ris sgeg mo ste lha'i bu mo gzhon nu ma'i bzhin gyi mdzes sdug gi dpal nga kho na la yod ces/ dpe pad ma dkar bo khyod kyis snyems par mi 'tshal te/ nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba brgyad kyi nang tshan rab tu 'bar ba'am shin tu tsub pa'i shing sha ma li'i nags tshal gyi lang tsho dar la bab pa'i bzhin mdzes ma sring mo dang 'dra bas yang yang 'bod pa mthong ba'i bud med de'i mdzes sdug kyang lha'i bu mo dang mtshungs/ zhes dpe la rab btags kyis sgro btags te don du mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ 'di ni nye 'khor ba'i dmyal bar skyes pa'i sems can 'jigs skrag gi dbang gis gnas gzhan 'tshol du 'gro ba la/ nags tshal thibs po zhig gi tshal nas bud

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 13med mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba zhig gis yang yang 'bod pa thos pas nags tshal der phyin pa na/ skad cig gis nags de ral gri dang spu gri'i yal ga dang lo ma can gyi sdong bo sha stag tu mthong ste sdong bo'i rtse nas bud med mdzes ma zhig gis 'bod pa ltar snang bas/ shing der 'dzeg pa tsam nas ral gri dang spu gri'i lo ma dang yal ga rnams kyi rtse mo thur du zug ste lus 'bigs pa dang /yang sdong bo'i rtsa nas bud med des 'bod pa ltar snang bas/ thur du babs pa'i tshe ral gri dang spu gri'i yal ga dang lo ma rnams kyi rtse mo gyen du zug ste lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag rnams 'bigs pas/ mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal rtag tu myong ba de la sha ma li'i tshal zer zhing / bud med de la sha ma li'i tshal gyi bu mo yang zer/ bu mo 'di la sring mo zhes pa dang / pad ma dkar bo la snyems mi 'tshal zhes brjod pa ni rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra yin/ de yang skyes rabs las/ med par lta ba tshe rabs phyi ma la/ / gnas pa de na mun nag rlung grang ldang / / des ni rus pa'ang 'jig pa'i nad slong na/ / bdag la phan 'dod su zhig de ru 'jug / ces dang / slob springs las kyang / spu gri rnos gtams lcug tshal lo ma ral gri yis/ / nang du thang chad brgyugs nas lus rmas skyabs med pa/ / rtse gsum mdung thung dang ni ral gri rnos gang ba'i/ / khron pa gshin rje'i kha bas thu ba'i nang du lhung / / nyin mtshan gyis gdungs bzod dka' brlag par dga' ba'i lus/ / ljon shing lo ma sngo stug mthong nas song ba dang / / de yi lo ma mtshon brgya lhung bas lus dbug cing / / de na yun ring ngud mo las bshes brlag par gnas/ / bud med kun nas me lce brgya phrag thon pa'i me/ / me stag phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i rgyan gyis bzhag gyur cing / / sog le lta bu tsub pa'i lus kyis zon med par/ / shin tu sdug pa'i tshul du bcum nas 'khyud par byed/ / ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di ni ngan song gi sdug bsngal las brtsams pa'i dper brjod

14 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin/ /bcu pa rmad byung gi dpe ni/ tshangs gnas bsam gtan bde ba 'di/ / rtag brtan g.yung drung dpal 'dzin na/ / zag med bde bas mngon mtho ba'i/ / thar ba'i gnas dang mtshungs pa nyid/ / ces pa 'di ni rmad byung dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe bde 'gro'i gzugs khams pa'i tshangs ris dang / tshangs mdun/ tshangs chen te bsam gtan dang bo'i tshangs pa'i gnas gsum dang / 'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal te bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas gsum dang / dge chung / tshad med dge/ dge rgyas te bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas gsum dang / sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che ba/ mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya nom snang ba/shin tu mthong ba/ 'jig rten pa'i 'og min te bsam sa/tan bzhi pa'i gnas brgyad do/ / bsam gtan bzhi'i dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug thob pa'i zag bcas kyi bde ba 'di yis/ dpe can gnas lugs de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo rtag brtan ther zug g.yung drung gi dpal lam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo mngon du byed pa'i thabs 'dzin nus na/ rang bzhin spros bral chen po'i de nyid mthar thug so so rang rig pa'i ye shes la mnyam par bzhag pa'i zag med kyi bde bas mngon par mtho ba'i lam mam de'i gnas dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ / zhes dpe tshangs pa'i gnas la sogs pa'i gzugs khams kyi bsam gtan gyi bde ba la/ dpe can rtag brtan g.yung drung gi dpal lam thar pa'i bde ba'i yon tan de dag mi ldan zhing / gal te dpe de la zag med kyi bde ba'i yon tan de 'dzin pa'am ldan na/ dpe can khyod kyi dper 'os so zhes brtag pa mtha' bzung gi sgo nas dpe dang dpe can mtshungs par brjod pa yin/gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi bsam gtan dang po gsum

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 15la gnas gsum re dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa la gnas brgyad yod cing /'di'i 'og min ni 'khor ba'i gnas kyi 'jig rten pa'i 'og min gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ spyir longs sku'i zhing ste dag sa'i 'og min gyi zhing yang gzhan du yod do/ / gzugs med bzhi ni nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med/ srid rtse ste bzhi'o/ / 'di dag gi gnas rim ni/ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi la rgyal chen rigs bzhi yod cing / ri rab kyi steng na sum cu rtsa gsum yod/ 'thab bral nas 'og min gyi bar ri rab la ma brten par rang rang gi 'og gzhi'i rlung dkyil la brten nas rim bzhin brtsegs mar yod par gsungs la/ gzugs med bzhi ni/ mdzod las/ gzugs med khams na gnas med do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snyoms 'jug gi khyad par tsam gyis so sor phye ba ma gtogs gzugs med pas gnas so so yang med par 'dod/ rje btsun chen po 'di nyid sogs mkhas pa 'gas dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo'i tshig zin la brten nas gzugs med khams na gzugs yod par bzhed la/ bye brag smra ba kha cig gis kyang / gzugs med khams na snying yod pas gzugs yod par 'dod pa'i phyogs kyang yod/ de yang khams dang 'khrig pa'i 'dod pas rab tu phye bas 'dod khams dang / khams dang 'khrig pa'i 'dod pas rab tu phye ba'i lha yin pas 'dod lha zhes btags/'dod lha rigs drug ni/ gnod sbyin lag na gzhong thogs dang / lag na phreng thogs dang / rtag myos dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i lha ste rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / nye dbang sogs gnyis dang lha'i dbang po bcas so gsum yod pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas zhes bstan bcos lugs su grags kyang /'jig rten yongs grags la sum cu rtsa gsum ni/ nor lha brgyad/ nyi ma'i bu bcu gnyis/ drag po bcu gcig tha skar gyi bu gnyis dang so gsum du grags so/ / lha ma yin dang 'thab pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bas 'thab bral/

16 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dod pa'i dga' ba mang bo dang ldan pas dga' ldan/ rang gis byas pa'i longs spyod sprul pa la dga' bas 'phrul dga'/ gzhan gyi longs spyod la dbang bsgyur pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de tha snyad tsam gyi 'dod lha rigs drug gi ming yang de ltar btags/ 'di dag ni chos mngon pa'i lugs ltar yin/bcu gcig pa rmongs pa'i dpe ni/ yid ni rab tu chags bral bas/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs sdug dang / / dur khrod bor ba'i rus gong ni/ /khyad par 'byed la rmongs par gyur/ / ces pa 'di ni rmongs pa'i dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ dpe can rang yid ni 'dod pa'i yon tan la rab tu chags pa dang bral ste 'dod chags sogs spangs pa'i dge sbyong ngam dgra bcom pa dag gis bud med kyi mdzes sdug gi lang tsho shin tu rgyas pa'i gzugs kyi mtshar sdug de/ dpe dur khrod du bor ba'i rus gong ste keng rus dang khyad med par gzigs pas/ chags bral gyi stobs kyis mi sdug par mtshungs pa 'dra bas de gnyis kyi khyad par 'byed pa la rmongs pa skad du brjod pa lta bu yin/ de yang /bshes springs las/ gzhan gyi chung mar mi lta mthong na yang / / na tshod mthun par ma dang bu mo dang / / sring mo'i 'du shes bskyed bgyi chags gyur na/ / mi gtsang nyid du'ang yang dag bsam par bgyi/ / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/bud med gzhon nu'i lus ni logs shig tu/ / dri nga ba dang sgo dgu dod pa dang / / mi gtsang kun snod 'dra ba dgang dka' dang / / lpags pas g.yogs par rgyan yang logs shig gzigs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang cag rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa blangs pa'i gang zag phal ba rnams kyis/ 'dod pa'i chags pa mngon gyur pa bzlog pa'i phyir du bud med mdzes sdug can gyi lus la mi sdug pa sgom tshul yang / de'i lus dri nga ba dang / mi gtsang ba 'dzags pa'i sgo dgu dod pa dang / phyi'i lpags shun tsam ma gtogs nang

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 17bshang gci la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba'i rdzas so gnyis kyis gang ba zhig yin pas chags pa'i gnas cung zad kyang med par bsam pa dang / yang gzhan gyi chung ma'am bud med gang mthong na'ang / na tshod dang mthun par rang las rgan pa la ma dang / gzhon pa la bu mo/ mnyam pa la sring mo'i 'du shes bskyed dgos pa sogs bud med la chags pa'i blo bzlog pa'i tshul mang du gsungs pa de ltar yin/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas so drug ni/ nyan sa las/ skra dang spu dang sen mo so/ / glog pa dri ma pags pa sha/ / rus pa chu rgyus rtsa mkhal snying / /mchin pa glo ba rgyu ma dang / / gnyer ma pho ba long ga mtsher/ / phyi sa mchi ma rdul mchil ma/ / snabs zhag chu ser rkang dang tshil/ / mkhris pa bad kan rnag dang khrag / klad phri klad rgyas gcin dang bcas/ / so drug nang gi mi sdug pa/ / zhes dang / rnam par sngos dang rnam par brnags/ / 'bus bzhibs bam dang zos dang dmar/ / rnam pa 'thor dang rus gong dang / /keng rus rus pa'i keng rus dang / / bshang gci mchil ma snabs dang khrag / rnag rnams kyis ni gos pa dang / / mchan khung ljan ljin de mthun dag / phyi rol gyi ni mi sdug pa'o/ / zhes nang gi mi sdug pa'am mi gtsang ba'i rdzas so drug dang phyi'i mi sdug pa bco brgyad du gsungs so/ /bcu gnyis pa the tshom gyi dpe ni/ ci 'di shing lo'i rtser chags pa'i/ /chu thigs rab tu g.yo ba 'am/ / rab tu sred pa'i dbang gyur pa'i/ / mi lus yin zhes the tshom skyed/ / ces pa 'di ni the tshom dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe shing sdong lo ma'i rtser chags pa'i chu thigs rab tu g.yo ba ste chu thigs sar yang yang 'dzag pa'am/ yang na/ dpe can rab tu sred pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i mi lus te/ snga ma'i rgyu'i rnam shes la las kyi bag chags bzhag pa de la sred pa dang len pas gsos btab ste las kyi nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i stobs kyis srid par skye ba blangs pa'i mi lus 'di ni/ slar yang ma rig pa'i

18 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched phyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbang gis las sna tshogs bsags pas yang srid phyi mar slar yang 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung du skyes pa sogs 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun mi chad du 'khor ba 'di/ dpe shing lo'i rtse mo'i chu thigs sar yang yang 'dzag pa ltar/steng 'dod khams dang gzugs khams kyi lus rten nas/ 'og dmyal ba'i lus rten blangs pa dang / mtho ba rgyal bo'i lus rten nas/ dma' ba sprang bo'i lus rten blangs pa sogs rten 'di las kyi dbang gis gcig tu mi gnas par rab tu g.yo ba 'di gnyis so so'i dbye ba 'byed ma nus par the tshom za ba ste/ dpe dang dpe can phan tshun 'khrul ba 'di la thag ma bcad par the tshom gyi sgo nas mtshungs skad du brjod pa lta bu yin/ de ltar du bshes springs las/re re'i bdag nyid rus pa'i phung bo ni/ / lhun po mnyam pa snyed cig 'das 'gyur pa'i / / ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam/ / ri lus bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ / brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni/ / las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa la lhung / / 'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang / / 'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ / mtho ris bu mo'i nu ma rked pa la/ / reg pa'i bde ba yun ring myong nas slar/ / dmyal bar 'thag gcod dbral ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ / reg pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa nas/ nyi ma zla ba nyid thob rang lus kyi/ / 'od kyus 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te/ / slar yang mun gnag smag tu phyin gyur nas/ / rang gi lag pa brkyangs pa'ang mthong mi 'gyur/ / zhes rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bcu gsum pa gtan la 'bebs pa'am rtogs pa'i dpe ni/ 'jo sgeg tshul gyis 'gro ba dang / / sred ldan mgu ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ / ngan skyugs phung bo ma yin gyi/ / ri dwags mig can yin par shes/ / zhes pa 'di ni rtogs pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe bud med gzhon nu mdzes sdug can

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 19khengs pa'i 'jo sgeg gi tshul gyis 'gro ba dang / dpe can lha mo dbyangs can ma gnyis mdzes sdug rmad du byung ba'i 'jo sgeg gi tshul gyis 'gro ba mtshungs kyang / dpe bud med la sred ldan gyi skyes bu dag chags pa rgyas pa'i stobs kyis dga' zhing mgu ba bskyed cing / bud med kyi lus ngan skyugs kyi phung bo yin pa dang / dpe can dbyangs can mas skye bo dag la chags pa'i dga' mgu mi skyed pa dang / ngan skyugs kyi phung bo ma yin par zag med ye shes kyi lus can yin pas/ dpe don gnyis mtshungs pa shas che na yang dpe can la dpe de las yon tan khyad par can ldan par nges pa snyed nas the tshom bcad de dpe can ri dwags mig can ma'am lha mo dbyangs can ma nges par shes zhes gtan la phabs te brjod pa lta bu yin/ 'dir ngan skyugs phung bo zhes pa ni/bshes springs las/ gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yis/ / ngan skyugs 'phyag par bgyid pa de bas kyang / / gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag / bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/rin po che'i gser gyi snod rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gshong bar/bshang gci snabs lud la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba rnams rin po che'i phyags mas lhan du bsdus te spungs pa las kyang / mir skyes nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las byed pa ni shin tu blun no zhes bstan/ nyan sa las/ bud med kyi lus mi gtsang ba'i rdzas so drug spungs pa'i phung bo lta bur gsungs pa bzhin du/'dir yang ngan skyugs kyi phung bo can/ zhes brjod pa yin/bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ rtag tu rab 'bar sems gdung shing / / 'khor bar spyod pa rnams kyi gnas/ / nyon mongs 'phel ba'i khyim 'di ni/ / lo ma ral gri'i tshal dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni sbyar ba'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can 'khor ba'i khyim dang / dpe ral gri'i lo ma'i nags tshal gnyis ka la/ rtag tu rab 'bar/ zhes dpe can khyim ni/ sdug

20 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsngal sna tshogs kyi tshang dang nyon mongs pa sna tshogs rtag tu 'bar ba'i gzhi lta bu dang / dpe ral gri'i tshal ni/ der bgrod pa'i sems can la mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal rab tu 'bar ba bskyed pas/ dpe dpe can de gnyis kyi sdug bsngal gyis sems rab tu gdung ba bskyed pa sogs mtshungs pa'i dpe rnams don la sbyar nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la longs spyod pa rnams kyi gnas/'dod sred la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa sna tshogs 'phel ba'i khyim 'di ni/ral gri dang spu gri'i lo ma can gyi tshal dang mtshungs zhes brjod pa yin/de'ang 'khor ba'i khyim 'di ni nyes pa sna tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas dang / sdug bsngal gyi btson ra/ me 'bar ba'i 'obs lta bu dang / de ltar du khyim na gnas pa ni/ dge ba'i chos nyams shing / 'dod sred zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa sna tshogs rang shugs su bskyed par 'gyur ba sogs nyes dmigs shin tu che ba/ mdo dang / bstan bcos las mang du gsungs pa ste/dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo las/ khyim pa ni me'i 'obs na gnas pa lta bu'o/ / rab tu byung ba rnams ni bsil ba'i khang ba na gnas pa lta bu'o/ /zhes bka' stsal pa dang / skyes rabs las/ btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim la ni/ / nam yang bde bar ma soms shig / phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / / khyim na gnas pa nad du che/ / gcig ni srung bas nyon mongs la/ /gnyis pa tshol bas sha thang ngo / / phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / / gang na bde ba med gyur pa/ / de la dga' ba rmongs pa ni/ / sdig pa'i 'bras bu nyid du smin/ / zhes dang / cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dod pa dag ni rab tu brten byed cing / / bu dang chung ma dag la sred bskyed nas/ / smad par bya ba'i khyim la brten pa de/ / bla med byang chub dam pa gzhar mi thob/ /gang dag 'dod pa lci skam me bzhin spong / / bu dang chung ma dag la sred spangs nas/ / khyim gyis skrag ste khyim nas nges 'byung ba/ / de dag byang chub

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 21mchog 'di rnyed mi dka'/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / khyim las rab tu byung ba'i phan yon ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ / yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ / zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang / khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ / yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pas bstan pa la rab tu byung ste bslab khrims yang dag par srung ba ni/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten dang 'di phyi'i dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba gcig bu yin no/ / rgyan 'di dag ni 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal dang / thar ba'i phan yon las brtsams pa'i brjod bya dpe dpe can gyi tshul du bkod de gsungs pa yin/bco lnga pa mnyam nyid kyi dpe ni/ nga rgyal spangs pa'i dge sgrub dang / /sbyin la dga' ba'i mkhas rnams ni/ / gter gyi bdag po ji bzhin du/ / su war+ṇa yi dpal dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni mnyam nyid dpe/ / zhes pa ste/dpe nga rgyal la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa spangs shing 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis ma bslad pa'i sdig spong dge sgrub la 'bad pa'i bya btang ba dang / dpe can dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang sbyin gtong sogs la dga' ba ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i thabs la shin tu mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams ni/ dpe gter gyi bdag po longs spyod kyi dpal dang ldan pa ji bzhin du/ dpe dang dpe can de gnyis ka yang su war+ṇa ste rin chen gser dang 'dra ba'i rnam dkar bsod nams kyi dpal dang ldan par mtshungs/ zhes mtshungs chos mnyam pa'i yon tan gcig gi sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa yin/bcu drug pa smad pa'i dpe ni/ rab tu dben pa'i bsam gtan 'di/ / 'khor los sgyur ba'i bka' khrims dang / / dge chos spel bar

22 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshungs mod kyi/ / rnam g.yeng yid dang bral bas 'phags/ / zhes pa 'di ni smad pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can gnas rab tu dben par rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor bas zab lam rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i bsam gtan la gzhol ba 'di ni/ dpe 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo'i bka' khrims btsan pos/ 'bangs kyi skye bo rnams dge bcu'i khrims la gnas par byas te/ rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i chos spel ba dang mtshungs mod kyang / dpe can rnal 'byor bas rnam g.yeng dang bying rgod sogs bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa lnga spangs pa ste de dag yid dang bral bar byas pa dang / dpe 'khor bsgyur gyis dge bcu'i lam spel ba tsam las rang yid nyes pa de dag dang ma bral bas/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs pa tsam spyir bkod nas dpe de la skyon cung zad ldan par brjod de dpe la smad pa lta bu yin/bcu bdun pa bstod pa'am bsngags pa'i dpe ni/ ma la ya yi nags klung gi/ / bser bu 'di yis bde bskyed pa/ / bsod nams yongs su smin gyur pas/ / chos thos pa yang de dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstod pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe lho phyogs ma la ya'i nags klung gi dri zhim po'i dpal dang 'grogs pa'i bser bu'am rlung 'dis/ skye bo kun la bsil ba'i bde ba dang yid la dga' ba bskyed pa ni/ bsod nams kyi las kyi rnam smin yongs su smin par gyur pa'i 'bras bu yin zhing / dpe can dam pa'i chos thos pa'ang de dang mtshungs zhes/ dpe la yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bstod pa'am bsngags pa brjod de dpe can de dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ dam pa'i chos thos pa'i phan yon ni/ thos pa'i tshoms las thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ / thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / / thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob ces

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 23rkang ba dang bos shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag gi blang dor gyi rnam bzhag gsal bor shes pas 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba bskyed par bstan pa dang /rkang ba gnyis pas tshul khrims kyi bslab pa thob nas las kyi kun 'byung sdig pa las ldog par bstan pa dang / rkang ba gsum pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa thob nas nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung spong bar bstan pa dang / rkang ba bzhi pas shes rab kyi bslab pa thob nas skye ba'i kun 'byung 'khor ba spangs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i tshul bstan par rnam bshad rigs pa las rgyas par gsungs so/ / gzhan yang / skyes rabs las/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ / rkun po la sogs mi khyer nor gyi mchog / kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ / thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog / phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ / gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ / nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog / grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ / ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog / tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bco brgyad pa brjod 'dod dam rtog pa'i dpe ni/ bde ba'am sdug bsngal 'di bskyed ces/ / so sor nges par brjod mi byed/ / 'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod 'di/ / spu gri'i so 'dra zhes rtog go/ / zhes pa 'di ni rtog pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe dang dpe can gang la yang / 'di la bde ba dang ldan pa'am yang na sdug bsngal 'di dang 'di bskyed ces de'i khyad chos mi brjod par/ dpe can gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi longs spyod 'di/ dpe spu gri shin tu rno ba'i so la sbrang rtsi chags pa dang 'dra/zhes rang sems kyi rtog pa'i dbang gis brjod pa ste brjod 'dod kyi dbang gis dpe don mtshungs par sbyor ba yin/ de yang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/

24 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched phyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ral gri'i sor chags sbrang rtsi lta'i/ / 'dod pa rnams kyis mi ngoms na/ /rnam smin bde la zhi ba yi/ / bsod nams kyis lta ci ste ngoms/ / zhes spu gri'am ral gri'i rtse la chags pa'i sbrang rtsi la mngar ba'i ro'i bcud cung zad myong du yod kyang / bldags na lce bshags pa dang 'dra bar 'phral du bde ba cung zad thob kyang / 'di phyir sdug bsngal mi bzod pa myong bar 'gyur bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bcu dgu pa 'gal ba'i dpe 'dir chad/nyi shu pa dgag pa'i dpe ni/ rang bzhin spros bral ye shes gang / / yon tan ldan yang 'bad rtsol can/ / 'khrul bas bslad pa'i bsod nams tshogs/ / tshe gang 'bad pas ga la 'gran/ / zhes pa 'di ni dgag pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can khyad par can chos mtha' dag gi rang bzhin kun rdzob spros pa dang bral ba ste/ shin tu dag pa'i chos kyi de kho na nyid dam/gnas lugs kyi chos mthar thug tu gyur pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni/ dpe dman pa gzhan dbang kun rdzob 'khrul bas bslad pa ste nyon mongs dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs la/gnas skabs kyi yon tan 'ga' zhig ldan na'ang / de ni 'bad rtsol la bltos pa can te rnam shes 'khrul bas bslad pa'i kun rdzob spros can gyi chos yin pas de lta bu la tshe gang bor 'bad kyang / don dam bden pa gnas lugs spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang ga la 'gran/ zhes dpe can don dam bden pa la khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan dang ldan par brjod de/ dpe dman pa 'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i chos kyis de dang 'gran pa dgag pa lta bu yin/nyer gcig pa ngo bstod kyi dpe ni/ lhun po nor bu'i 'od kyis mdzes/ / tshangs spyod dul ba'i dpal gyis phyug / gzi brjid ldan par

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 25mtshungs mod kyang / / ri bo de ltar lhag pa min/ / zhes 'di mdzes pa'am ngo bstod dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe ri rab lhun po ni nyi zla nor bu'i 'od kyis 'khyud pas mdzes sdug dang ldan pa dang / dpe can tshangs par spyod pa'i dge slong ni 'dod chags dang bral ba ste/ dbang bo zhi zhing dul ba'i dpal gyis phyug cing tshul khrims kyi rgyan mdzes sdug dang ldan pas/ de gnyis mdzes pa'i gzi brjid dang ldan par mtshungs mod kyang / dpe ri bo ni phyi mdzes pa tsam gyi gzi brjid de lta bu las de la lhag pa'am yon tan gzhan gyi khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig min zhing / dpe can tshangs spyod ldan pa ni phyi zhi dul spyod bzang tsam du ma zad nang tshul khrims kyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa zhig ldan zhes/ dpe dang dpe can mtshungs pa spyir bkod nas dpe can gyi yon tan khyad par du 'phags par bstod pa'am mdzes par brjod pa yin/ nyer gnyis pa de nyid brjod pa'i dpe ni/ blo gros rnam par 'phel byed 'di/ / dbyangs can ma yin thos pa nyid/ / lus la sim pa bskyed 'di yang / / reg min shin tu sbyangs pa nyid/ / ces 'di de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can chos rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab bam blo gros rnam par 'phel bar byed pa 'di ni lha mo dbyangs can ma'i thugs rje kho na ma yin par/ rang gis kyang thos pa la brtson pa drag po bskyed pa 'di nyid kyis kyang blo gros rgyas par byed pa yin/ dpe lus sems la sim pa'am bde ba'i tshor ba bskyed pa 'di yang / reg pa las bskyed pa'i bde ba kho na ma yin par/zhi gnas khyad par can gyis zin pa'i lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba nyid kyang yod do/ / zhes dpe dang dpe can gyi khyad chos ma 'dres par rang rang gi gnas lugs sam de nyid brjod pa'i tshul gyis don la mtshungs par sbyar ba yin/

26 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyer gsum pa thun mong min pa'i dpe ni/ gzugs mdzes sogs dang bsam gtan las/ / skyes pa'i bde ba de kun gyis/ / zhi ba'i bde la bsgrun du med/ / de phyir mya ngan 'das nyid dpe/ / zhes 'di thun mong min pa'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe khyad 'phags can bud med gzhon nu'i gzugs kyi mdzes sdug la longs spyod pa sogs 'dod pa'i bde ba dang / bsam gtan gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gam de'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i bde ba sogs zag bcas kyi bde ba de dag thams cad kyis/ dpe can zhi ba myang 'das kyi bde ba'i cha tsam la'ang bsgrun pa'am 'gran du med pas na/de phyir zhi ba myang 'das kyi bde ba'i dpe gzhan zhig mi srid pas rang nyid kyi dper rang nyid bzhag pa ste mya ngan las 'das pa nyid dper 'os so/ / zhes dpe gzhan ma rnyed pa lta bu brjod pa'i rgyan 'di la thun mong ma yin pa'am rjes 'gro med pa'i rgyan yang zer/nyer bzhi pa 'byung min gyi dpe ni/ srid zhi'i legs lam ma lus pa/ /byed pos gcig tu bsdus 'dra ba'i/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog de dag / blo ldan kun gyis bsten par byed/ / ces pa 'di ni 'byung min dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe srid zhi'i legs tshogs kyi lam mam yon tan ma lus pa byed pa pos gcig tu bsdus pa dang 'dra ba'i dpe can theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog de dag blo gros dang ldan pa kun gyis nges par du bsten par byed/ ces dpe de 'dra 'jig rten du 'byung mi srid pa'i ngo mtshar ba zhig dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/nyer lnga pa srid min gyi dpe ni/ rtsod pa'i dus 'dir mang thos 'ga'/ / ngur smrig 'dzin yang g.yo sgyu dang / / gdug sems rtag tu 'chang ba 'di/ / bdud rtsi'i 'od las tsha gdung bzhin/ / zhes pa 'di ni srid min dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can shākya'i dge slong ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 27pa zhig yin na sdom khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir bzung ba'i steng bshad sgrub chos spyod bcu'i bya bas bstan pa kho na la bya ba mdzad pa las/ g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa dang / gdug sems 'chang bar mdzad pa ni mi 'os pa'am mi srid pa/ dpe bdud rtsi'i 'od can te zla ba'i 'od las bsil ba bskyed pa las tsha gdung bskyed mi 'os pa'am mi srid pa bzhin no/ / zhes dpe dang dpe can gyi mi srid pa'i khyad chos mtshungs par sbyar ba yin/ 'on kyang tshig 'dis/ rtsod pa'i dus te snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang du thos pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis/ thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge sbyong ngur smrig gi bla gos bzhes kyang / rgyun du rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi g.yo sgyu dang / gzhan la gdug pa'am gnod pa'i sems rtag tu 'chang ba 'di/ zhes jo nang bas 'dod pa'i gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i gzhung ri chos nges don rgya mtshor dgag pa gnang ba'i mkhas pa rnams la gsungs par snang ste/ de dag gi dgag yig ni don la mi gnas par legs bshad las nyes bshad sha stag byung ba zla ba'i 'od las tsha gdung bskyed pa bzhin no/ zhes thugs ma rangs par zur za mdzad par snang /nyer drug pa mang ba'i dpe ni/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa de bzhin du/ / grub pa'i bcud len nor bu dang / / dpag bsam shing ltar dge ba ni/ / bsten pa tsam gyis 'bras rab ster/ / zhes pa 'di ni mang ba'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/dpe 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa dang / de bzhin du grub pa'i bcud len gyi ril bu dang / dpag bsam gyi shing sogs bsten pa tsam gyis ji 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba ltar/ dpe can thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i lam bzang bo ste/ dkar po dge ba bcu'i lam bsten pa tsam gyis mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi 'bras bu rab tu ster ba'am smin par 'gyur/ zhes dpe mang bo lhan du bkod de/ de dag gi khyad chos re re nas dpe can gyi khyad

28 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chos gcig gi rang bzhin dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/nyer bdun pa rnam 'gyur gyi dpe ni/ dge bas 'tsho ba'i longs spyod 'di/ / yongs 'du'i tshal du rnam rol ba'i/ / mtho ris dbang pos 'byor ba la/ / yang yang longs spyod byed pa bzhin/ / zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe can dge bcu'i khrims la gnas te rnam dkar gyi bya ba 'ba' zhig gi 'tsho ba la longs spyod pa 'di/ dpe yongs 'du'i shing ngam dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal du rnam par rol ba'i mtho ris kyi dbang po'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ lha'i 'dod dgu zad mi shes pa'i 'byor ba dang bde dga' phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la yang yang longs spyod pa bzhin no/ / zhes dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi rnam pa tha dad tsam ma gtogs khyad chos kyi rang bzhin mtshungs par brjod pa yin/nyer brgyad pa phreng ba'i dpe ni/ nyin byed 'od kyis mtshan mo dang / /sman gyi dbang pos tsha gdung dang / / dbang pos da nu'i bu bzhin du/ / chos kyis sdig pa 'joms par byed/ / ces pa 'di ni phreng ba'i dpe/ / zhes pa ste/dpe nyin byed dam nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis mtshan mo'i mun pa 'joms pa bzhin du/ sman gyi dbang po a ru ras tsha ba'i nad kyi gdung ba 'joms pa dang /yang / dpe lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis da nu'i bu ste lha ma yin gyi dpung tshogs 'joms pa bzhin du/ dpe can dam pa'i chos kyis sdig pa thams cad 'joms par byed/ ces dpe du ma phreng bar bsgrigs te dpe can gcig gi khyad chos dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/nyer dgu pa ngag don gyi dpe las bzhin sgra gcig pa can ni/ chos dang 'khor ba de nas gzhan/ / skye bo sdig pa myang 'das rnams/ / bdud rtsi 'khor lo spre'u dang / / dug dang dga' tshal dag dang mtshungs/ / zhes 'di ngag don gsal byed kyi/ / dpe rgyan gsal byed sgra gcig pa'o/ / zhes pa ste/

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 29dpe can dam pa'i chos dang / srid pa 'khor ba dang / de nas sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab pas skye ba 'di las gzhan pa'i yang srid phyi0 mar slar yang 'khor bar skyes pa'i skye bo dang / des mi dge ba'i las bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / 'khor ba las grol ba'i thar pa ste myang 'das rnams ni/ dpe rim pa bzhin du lha'i bdud rtsi dang / 'khor lo dang / spre'u dang / lha'i dga' tshal dag dang mtshungs so zhes mjug tu mtshungs sgra'am bzhin sgra gcig gis ngag don gsal bar byed pa yin/ 'di la ngag don zer ba ni/yi ge du ma 'dus pa las ming / ming du ma 'dus pa las tshig tshig du ma ma 'dus pa las ngag don grub cing / 'dir yang gzhal bya dpe can dang /'jal byed dpe de'i chos dang chos can ston pa'i ngag don de la/ rnam dbye drug pa dang brgyad pa dor ba'i byed can drug po'i gang rung dang 'brel dgos pas/ rnam dbye gnyis pa dang gsum pa sbyor ba gtso che la gzhan dag kyang sbyar mi rung ba ma yin par gsungs so/ /bzhin sgra du ma can gyi ngag don gyi dpe brjod ni/ rgya mtsho bzhin du srid pa dang / / 'dzin khri bzhin du nyon mongs te/ / gru bo che bzhin chos kyi lam/ / ded dpon mkhas ltar ston pa'o/ / zhes 'di gsal byed du ma can/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du dpe can srid pa 'khor ba dang / dpe rgya mtsho'i nang gi 'dzin khri'am chu srin bzhin du dpe can sdug kun gyis bsdus pa'i nyon mongs dang / dpe rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu bgrod par byed pa'i gru bo che bzhin du dpe can 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bgrod par byed pa'i dam pa'i chos te lam gyi bden pa dang / dpe ded dpon mkhas pa bzhin du dpe can dam pa'i chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen no/ / zhes dpe dang dpe can phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor ba'i ngag don gsal byed kyi bzhin sgra du ma dang bcas mtshungs par sbyor ba yin/

30 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sum cu pa zla bo dngos po'i dpe ni/ chu klung bye ba phrag brgya yang / / chu yi gter du gzhol zhing 'bab/ / theg pa sna tshogs tha dad don/ / kun kyang chos kyi dbyings su gzhol/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe zla bo 'bab chu'am chu klung bye ba brgya phrag phyogs so so nas 'bab kyang / mthar thug chu gter te rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du gzhol zhing 'bab pa dang / dpe can ston pa thugs rje can gyis chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs pa yang / theg pa che chung gi khyad par dang dgongs pa bzhi dang ldem dgongs bzhi'i sgo nas gsungs tshul/rton pa bzhi'i sgo nas rton tshul/ drang ba dang nges pa'i don ji ltar 'byed tshul sogs mang du yod pa dang / nang ba'i grub mtha' smra ba la'ang rtsa ba'i sde bzhi dang / de dag las sde ba bco brgyad du gyes pa dang / theg dman la'ang bye mdo gnyis dang / theg chen la'ang sems tsam pa ba dang / rang rgyud pa dang / thal 'gyur ba rnams dang / de re re la'ang slob dpon so so'i bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang du yod pa dang / bod du'ang bstan pa phyi dar skabs nas/ bla ma so so'i bzhed dgongs dang / rang rang gi slob ma la ji ltar gdams pa'i khyad par las grub mtha' so so'i bzhed tshul gyi khyad par mi gcig pa sna tshogs mang du yod pa de dag thams cad kyi mthar thug gi dgongs pa'i don yang / gdul bya thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang bor 'god pa ste/ zag med ye shes chos kyi dbyings su gzhol ba'am dgongs pa'i gnad gcig tu 'bab bo/ / zhes dpe can gyi chos dang mthun pa'i dpe zhig zla bo'am grogs kyi tshul du bkod pa'i shugs las mtshungs par bstan pa yin no/ / de ltar du/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag chen rtsa ba'i gzhung lam du/ lha cig skyes sbyor ga 'u ma/ / lnga ldan ro snyoms yi ge bzhi/ / zhi byed gcod yul rdzogs chen dang / dbu ma'i lta khrid la sogs pa/ / so sor ming 'dogs mang na yang / / nges don lung rigs la mkhas shing / / nyams myong

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 31can gyi rnal 'byor bas/ / dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgya bod kyi nang ba'i grub mtha' mi 'dra ba thams cad kyis bstan pa'i rang rang gis 'dod pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam bzhag ni/bstan pa spyi'i phyag rgya las ma 'das pa kho na yin te/ 'dul ba sum brgya ba las/ phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ bslab pa gsum ni rab ston cing / / thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ / sangs rgyas gsung du mkhas pas rtogs/ / zhes 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa ste gsum mam/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba ste/ bstan pa'i gnad bzhis gzer btab pa dang /bstan bya sde snod gsum dang / bsgrub bya bslab pa gsum las ma 'das pas na/ ris su ma chad pa'i bstan pa dang de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la phyogs lhung dang bral te blo gzu bor gnas nas/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med dang / gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char ba'i nyams len la 'bad de snying thag pa nas dad pa dang gus par bya'o/ /so gcig pa mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe ni/ byang chub sems las sangs rgyas dang / / sgo nga'i sbubs las byed po bskrun/ / rgyal bas yang dag lam ston cing / / gzhan gyis lta bas thibs por khrid/ / ces pa 'di ni mtshungs sbyor dpe/ / zhes pa ste/ dpe byang chub kyi sems las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'khrungs pa dang / dpe can sgo nga'i sbubs las 'jig rten gyi byed po tshangs pa bskyed pa dang / yang dpe rgyal ba ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya'i khams dang / bsam pa/ mos pa dang 'tsham par yang dag pa'i chos kyi lam bstan pas lus can mtha' dag thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bkod pa dang / dpe can mu stegs kyi ston pa ste ston pa gzhan gyis log pa'i lam mam

32 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho3ma ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/log par lta ba'i chos bstan pas 'gro ba kun mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal gyi mun pa rab tu thibs pa'i lam ste ngan song du khrid/ ces dpe yon tan lhag pa'am khyad par can dang / dpe can yon tan dman pa can gnyis kyi bya ba rigs mi 'dra ba spyi'i rang bzhin so sor mi 'byed par khrid pa lta bu'i don gcig tu rma tshungs par bsdus te sbyar ba yin/so gnyis pa rgyu'i dpe ni/ 'dren pa bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam mi rtog la sems can don/ / lhun grub spyod phyir yid bzhin gyi/ / nor bu rin chen mchog dang mtshungs/ / zhes pa 'di ni rgyu yi dpe/ / zhes pa ste/dpe can rnam 'dren ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid mthar thug pa ji bzhin gzigs pas/ rnam par mi rtog pa ste blos byas kyi rnam par rtog pa phra mo tshun chad rtsa ba nas spangs la/ de lta bu'i ye shes chos kyi sku mngon du byas pa'i mthu de nyid la brten nas rang snang ba'i sku dang zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi mdzad pa nye bar grub la/ sku de nyid kyis gdul bya thun mong gi ngor ji ltar mos pa bzhin du mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pa mdzad de/ sems can thams cad kyi don nam gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad spyod dam rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du 'jug pa de'i phyir/ dpe yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang mtshungs so/ / zhes dpe can la yon tan de yod pa'i khyad chos gtan tshigs kyi rtags kyi tshul du sngon la bkod nas dpe de dang mtshungs par rjes su bstan te dpe don mtshungs par brjod pa yin no/ / de ltar du mdo sde rgyan las/ de lta na yang de yi mthus/ / gdul bya'i skal ba ji bzhin du/ / srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar/ / de yi mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ / ces dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji srid

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 33bar/ / 'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag / mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar lus can mtha' dag mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sar khrid par mdzad pa'i thun mong gi lam gyi rim pa brjod bya'i srog tu byas pa'i snyan ngag gi dpe rgyan so gnyis kyi dpe brjod legs par gsungs pa'i bstan bcos 'di ni/ bshes springs las/ bsnyengs dang bral la mang du gsol ci 'tshal/ / phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags te/ / khyed kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ / sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun chen po mchog gis snyigs dus kyi gdul bya nyon mongs kyi dug mtsho'i klung du lhung ba dag la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang / don che ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal las brtsams pa'i dpe brjod bslab bya'i tshul du gnang bas/ tshe 'dir snang gi zhen pa bzlog ste tshe rabs phyi ma'i bde ba don du gnyer bar gdams pa dang / yang / 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal dang / thar pa'i phan yon las brtsams pa'i dpe brjod bslab bya'i tshul du gnang bas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa bzlog nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis yid skyo ste srid las nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa shugs drag bskyed dgos pa dang / thar ba'i yon tan gyis yid drangs te thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la brtson par bskul ba'i zhal gdams 'di ni/ rang cag srid pa'i bde ba la yid rab tu chags shing brkam pa'i skye bo rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i bslab bya bla na med pa zhig yin no/ /tshig lhag ma rnams go sla ste/ dpe rgyan gyi skyon gsum ni/ pho mo ma ning gi rtags 'dres pa'i skyon dang / dpe don gnyis mchog dman che ba'i skyon/mang tshig dang nyung tshig 'khrugs pa'i skyon dang gsum mo/ / dang po'i dpe

34 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod ni/ dpe can mes po ste lha tshangs pa dang / dran pa ste khyab 'jug dang /drang srong gsum la/ dpe rim pa bzhin/ bud med dang / sgyu ma dang / sa 'dzin gsum sbyar ba ni dpe don sbyor tshul la pho mo ma ning gi rtags kyi khyad par mi mthun pa'am 'khrugs pa'i skyon byung ba lta bu yin/gnyis pa'i dper brjod ni/ dpe can bde byed bdag po'am brgya byin gyi khang bzang la dpe me tog bkram pa'i nor lhas sam phyugs kyi ra ba lta bu zhes brjod pa dang / yang / dpe can mgo'i skra bregs pa'i mgo zlum ste phal pa'i dge sbyong dal bu'i 'gros kyis bsod snyoms la 'gro ba ni/ dpe de bzhin gshegs pa grong khyer du gshegs pa ji bzhin no/ / zhes brjod pa lta bu ni dpe don gyi bar mchog dman che ba'i skyon yin/gsum pa'i dpe brjod ni/ dpe can grogs med gcig bur rgyu ba'i rnam shes ni/ / dpe tshong pa rnams kyi ded dpon dang mtshungs zhes brjod pa dang / yang dpe can zag bcas kyi tshor ba 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal rnams ni/dpe ri dwags bse ru gcig bur rgyu ba'i sdug bsngal lta bu bskyed/ ces dpe don la mang tshig dang nyung tshig 'gal ba'i skyon yod pa lta bu yin/ / skyon 'di dag ni snyan ngag la sbyangs pa chung zhing dpe don sbyor tshul la mi mkhas pa rnams kyi skyon du 'gyur/ 'on kyang / snyan ngag mkhan la ci yang rgyan/ /zhes pa ltar/ snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor 'bri tshul la sbyangs pa che ba'i snyan ngag mkhan mkhas pa rnams la skyon du mi 'gyur te/ dper na/ chos bzhin spyod na bud med kyang / / zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang bzhis pho mo ma ning gi rtags mi mtshungs kyang skyon du mi 'gyur bar bstan pa dang / g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo ltar/ / zhes sogs kyi rkang ba bzhis dpe don mchog dman che yang skyon du mi 'gyur bar bstan pa dang / ji tsam srid par gyur pa'i tshogs/ /zhes sogs kyi rkang ba bzhis dpe don la mang tshig dang nyung tshig 'khrugs kyang

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 35skyon du mi 'gyur ba ni snyan ngag gi dpe don gyi tshig sbyor sgrig lugs la mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin no/ /de ltar rjes gdams cung zad tsam/ / zhes sogs kyi don ni/ de ltar rang gi rjes 'jug slob bu rnams la 'di phyir phan pa'i chos kyi gdams pa cung zad snyan ngag gi dpe rgyan gyi tshul du brjod pa tsam ste/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i tshig gi rgyan dang / don gyi rnam bzhag 'ga' yod na yang / re zhig rje btsun mchog ste/ bdag gis brjod par ma nus so/ / 'on kyang snyan ngag gi dper brjod mdor bsdus 'di'i brjod don ni/ 'jig rten lugs kyi ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i 'dod gtam sogs ma yin par/ dam pa'i chos kyi rnam bzhag so so skye bo'i rgyud la phan pa'i gdams ngag gi tshul du brjod pa lags te/ mi'i dbang bo sa skyong khyed rnams kyis gdams ngag 'di la yang yang gzigs te rang rang gi thugs rgyud la brtag par 'os so/ / zhes bdag tā ra nā tha'am sgrol ba'i mgon pos smras pa ste/ zhes so/ /de ltar sa skyong mi'i dbang po sde ba rin spungs pa dang / gtsang ba sde srid karma ba yab sras sogs sbyin pa'i bdag po dang bu slob rnams la bslab bya'i tshul du snyan ngag gi dpe rgyan gyi lam nas brjod pa 'di ni/ spyir snyan ngag ni sde bzhi gang rung las brtsams pa'i brjod bya srog tu byas pa'i tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhig yin pas/ 'dir sde bzhi las 'jig rten nor gyi sde dang 'dod pa'i sde ni snying bo med par mthong nas/ chos kyi sde dang thar pa'i sde kho na'i dbang du byas pa ste/ brjod bya dam pa'i chos kyis snying bo byas pa'i rjod byed snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa cung zad bris pa 'di ni ngam rings chos kyi sde chen po nas spel ba'o zhes so/ /4/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo thams cad mkhyen pa rje sgrol ba'i mgon po'am tā ra nā tha mchog la nyid kyi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa'i

36 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho3ma ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/lamanas bsngags pa brjod pa snyan ngag gi tshig spyor gyi rgyan las dpe rgyan so gnyis la sbyar te 'god pa la/rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dpal sprul ba'i gar/ / rab dga'i sar gnas rgyal sras chen po'i tshul/ / dmigs med snying rje brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ / nges don bstan pa'i bdag po gang der 'dud/ / khyod kyi gsang gsum rab yangs nam mkha'i mtha'/ / rgyal dang de'i sras gzhal bar mi nus na/ / byis pa'i bsam brjod yul las rab dben yang / dad pa'i sems kyis dpe yi rgyan du 'god/ / phyag zhabs pad ma 'khor lo'i mtshan bzang dang / / dam sri tshar gcod rdo rje'i sngags bzla bzhin/ / 'khrungs dang lhan cig me tog char babs pa/ / don kun grub pa bltams pa'i mdzad pa bzhin/ / chos dpe'o/ / na tshod dang po'i lus kyi mdzes sdug ni/ / dri bral pad ma gzhon nu'i 'dab dang mtshungs/ / sgra brjod dag cing gsal ba'i gsung gi dbyangs/ / dri za'i phang 'gro'i rgyud la drangs pa bzhin/ /dngos dpe'o/ ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i blo gros ltar/ / khyod thugs mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ / rgyal sras snying stobs chen por bsngags pa ltar/ / kun dga' snying bo'i mtshan gsol don dang mthun/ / bzlog pa'i dpe'o/ / gzeb tu bcug pa'i nyam chung bye 'u bzhin/ / srid las thar 'dod shugs drag 'gog ma nus/ / bcos min nges 'byung bsam pas rab byung ba/ / bas mtha'i nags na bde ba'i bye 'u bzhin/ / phan tshun gyi dpe'o/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i bya bas dus 'das shing / / mdo rgyud man ngag gsang ba'i mdzod kyi bdag / sdom gsum rnam dag kun bzang spyod pa'i tshul/ / sa paṇa dang mtshungs rigs mthun gzhan yod min/ / nges pa'i dpe'o/ / thub pa'i bstan la ston pa'i mdzad bzhes pa/ / rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub dang mtshungs kyi/ / gzhan du mdzad pa

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 37der mthun 'jig rten 'dir/ / 'byon na khyod kyi rjes su rkang ba 'jog /nges med kyi dpe'o/ / khyod kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom dang thos sgom gyi/ / yon tan kho nas shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan/ / 'phags mchog klu yi rjes su 'gro min te/ / gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta ba'i srol phye 'dis/ / bsdus pa'i dpe'o/ /khyod sku nyi ma gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ / kha sbyor bdun ldan rgyal ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ / zung 'jug grub brnyes sa ra ha ba dang / / yul dus tsam las 'byed chos yongs ma dmigs/ / phul byung gi dpe'o/ / skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po shong dpang gis/ brda sprod smra la lha dbang gnyis pa zhes/ / snyems par mi 'tshal sgrol ba'i mgon po yang / / legs sbyar tshul la mkhyen rab klong nas brdol/ / rab btags kyi dpe'o/ / khyod ni mtshams sprin gos kyis rab tu mdzes/ / dbang po zhi dul lung rtogs rtsal rdzogs kyang / / mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyi ri mo gsal gyur na/ / shākya'i dbang po nyid dang cis mi mtshungs/ /rmad byung gi dpe'o/ / mgon khyod kun mkhyen chen po'i chos kyi khrir/ /'jigs med khyu mchog 'gros kyis byon pa na/ / lha dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang du/ / byon zhes legs bris bu rnams de'i rjes 'brang / / rmongs pa'i dpe'o/ / rab brjid lhun por nyi gzhon 'char ka yi/ / dmar ser 'od mdangs gsar pas 'khyud pa 'am/ / yang na khyod sku ngur smrig bla gos kyis/ / mdzes par bklubs snyam bdag yid 'phyang mo nyug / the tshom gyi dpe'o/ / khyod kyis dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug sogs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i e waṃ 'chad mkhas pas/ / smra mkhas g.yag rong sogs kyis bsgrun min te/ / de ni rtsod ngag smra la mkhas pa tsam/ / gtan 'bebs kyi dpe'o/ /thos bsam sgom dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs/ / mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan lhun rdzogs pas/ / bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher spel mdzad pa/ / 'jam mgon sa paṇa mchog dang kun nas mtshungs/ / sbyar ba'i dpe'o/ / kun

38 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho3ma ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkhyen chen po tā ra nā tha mchog / srid pa'i tsha gdung sel ba'i zla dkar bzhin/ / legs par dpal rdzogs bdud rtsi'i gter gyur pas/ / lha mi'i dbang phyug gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ / mnyam nyid kyi dpe'o/ / 'ga' zhig bshad pa gtsor 'dzin sgrub la 'dzer/ / gzhan dag sgrub pa gtsor 'dzin bshad par smod/ / phyogs lhung mkhas rlom can dag mgon khyod kyis/ /bshad sgrub zung 'brel 'dzin la ci zhig mtshungs/ / smad pa'i dpe'o/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi yi sgyu 'phrul mkhan/ / gnas lnga kun gzigs mkhas dgu'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / 'jam mgon sa paṇa mchog dang sgrol ba'i mgon/ / gsang gsum yon tan ma lus kun nas mtshungs/ / bsngags pa'i dpe'o/ / ma dag gdul bya'i snang ngor tha mal tshul/ / bzung yang lha yi zhal gzigs lung bstan thob/ / de phyir khyod ni grub mchog pir wa dang / /mtshungs zhes brjod 'dod su yis 'gog ma nus/ / brjod 'dod kyi dpe'o/ / mkhyen gter 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gsang ba'i bdag /snying rje lha mchog gsum dang sgrol ba'i mgon/ / zag med thugs kyi ngo bo dbyer med kyang / / rnam pa tha dad 'gal ba'i tshul du gnas/ / 'gal ba'i dpe'o/ / rtog ge mkhan po thos mang sgrub pas dben/ / drang srong rgan po sgrub brtson thos pa bral/ / mgon khyod mang thos sgrub pa lhur bzhes pas/ /thos bsam ya bral ba dang ci zhig mtshungs/ / dgag pa'i dpe'o/ / grub mchog bzhad pa'i rdo rjes dbu ma'i lam/ / ring bor sbyangs shing dpyad de nges pa rnyed/ / khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i 'od rnon 'khyug tsam las/ / sngon med gzhan stong lta ba'i bshad pa rdzogs/ / ngo bstod kyi dpe'o/ / 'di ni rtag brtan dam chos nges don gyi/ / dga' tshal yin gyi rgyal byed tshal ma yin/ /rten gsum phyur bur gtams pa'i gan bho la/ / yin gyi 'og min zhing mchog min par nges/ / de nyid brjod pa'i dpe'o/ / dmigs med snying rjes 'gro

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 39la rjes chags pas/ / gzhan don spyod pa rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin te/ / tshe gcig stong gzugs sgyu ma'i sku brnyes pa'i/ / mtshungs dper rang las zla bo gzhan ma dmigs/ / thun mong min pa'i dpe'o/ / mkhas btsun bzang grub dam pa'i bu slob dang / / gtsang ba sde srid la sogs dbang phyug can/ / chos srid grags pa'i skye dgu dbang bsdus pa/ / lha mi'i dbang gi rgyal bo gcig 'dus 'dra/ / 'byung min gyi dpe'o/ / chu gter klung las me yi phreng ba dang / / pad+ma'i tshal las dri ngan mi srid bzhin/ / nges don dbu ma chen po'i gzhung bzang la/ / nyes bshad 'khrul ba'i cha tsam gang na srid/ / srid min gyi dpe'o/ / dri za'i phang 'gro'i sgra dang lha yi rnga/ / g.yas 'khyil dung dang tshangs pa'i gdangs dbyangs bzhin/ / drug cu'i yan lag tshang ba'i gsung snyan gyis/ / mtha' dag 'gro la zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor/ / mang ba'i dpe'o/ / rgya chen gzhung lugs 'chad la byams mgon gyi/ / mgrin mdzes pad+ma'i tshal las byung ba bzhin/ / rgyud don 'doms la rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi/ / gsung gsang rdo rje'i tshig las blangs pa bzhin/ / rnam 'gyur gyi dpe'o/ / grub mchog dus zhabs pa yis 'phags yul du/ / dus rgyud legs drangs de yis bshad sgrub 'phel/ / de mthus ljongs 'dir rdzogs ldan gsar dar bzhin/ / khyod kyis kā la tsakra'i bstan pa spel/ / phreng ba'i dpe'o/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ / 'grel chen thun mong min pa'i bshad srol ltar/ / chos char 'jo bas rigs ldan pad+ma dkar/ / gangs can ljongs 'dir byon bzhin snyan pa 'bar/ / ngag don bzhin sgra gcig pa'i dpe'o/ / 'jam dbyangs thon mi ji bzhin sgrol mgon gyis/ / brda sprod rig gzhung dbyar mtsho bzhin spel bas/ / rkang drug pad mar rol bzhin gangs can bus/ / lnga rig pad ma'i bcud la dgyes dgur rol/ / ngag don bzhin sgra du ma can gyi dpe'o/ / gangs can ljongs 'dir mkhas grub mang

40 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ byon kyang / / khyod 'dra'i smra mkhas dbang bor 'gran nus su/ / rang mthong 'od kyis snyems pa'i rgyu skar dbus/ / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa gang na mchis/ / zla bo dngos po'i dpe'o/ / ston pas 'od srungs chen por lung gi bstan/ / gtad de zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa ltar/ / khyod kyis thugs sras sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la/ / gdan sa gtad de zhing gzhan dgongs par mdzad/ / mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe'o/ / thugs rje kun la snyoms pas zla zer dang / / sna tshogs gar gyis rol pas sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ / 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pas gaṅgā'i rgyun/ / gzigs pa dus las mi 'da' rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /rgyu'i dpe'o/ / de ltar 'jam mgon kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon/ / mgon de'i gsang gsum mdzad pa'i rnam thar mchog / mchog gsum yon tan gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal/ / dpal ldan mkhas pa yongs kyis bsngags pa'i gzhi/ / kun mkhyen ring lugs 'dzin pa mang byon kyang / / kun dga' snying bo lta bu su zhig byon/ / kun mkhyen mtshan snyan 'dzin pa mang na yang / / kun la phan pa'i legs mdzad 'di 'dra gang / / lta ba dbu ma chen pos 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / sgom pa ting 'dzin brtan pas dgra bcom dbang / / spyod pa phyi nang kun gtsang thub dbang dngos/ / kun mkhyen kun dga' snying bo phyogs las rgyal/ / de ltar dam pa'i rtogs brjod dad pa'i gter/ / dpe rgyan mtshan bzang grangs kyi rgyan ldan pa'i/ / bsngags brjod tshig phreng mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ / sde snod 'dzin pa chos kyi rdo rjes phul/ /smras pa/ gangs ri'i lang tsho dar ba'i 'dzin ma ru/ / nges don chos kyi sgron ma gsal 'byed mkhan/ / rnam kun mkhyen pa'i shes rab klong brdol ba/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan gyis brjod/ / gang de'i 'phrin las nyi ma'i shing rta ba/ / kun mkhyen kun dga' bskyed pa'i gsung dbyangs las/ / zab don chos kyi snying bo legs gdams pas/ / dge legs bsil

zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba'i tshig 'grel/ 41ba'i bde dga' snying la bskyil/ / chos tshul rnga yab dkar po'i 'jo sgeg gis/ / 'gro ba'i gdung sel phan bde dbugs dbyung zhing / / thub bstan 'dzin mar lang tsho'i dpal byin pas/ / grags pa g.yas 'khyil gdengs ka'i rtse mor bsgrags/ / ris med blo yi pad mtsho dwangs ma'i rlabs/ / lhag bsam dri bzhon dar mas legs bskyod pas/ / legs bshad ri mo gsar pa'i mdzes bskrun pa/ / kun mkhyen gnyis pa mchod pa'i sprin du spro/ / rnam dpyod bye 'u'i rtsal gyis ma zin par/ / don med lam du bsgyur pa'i rnyog ma'i chu/ / brtse chen nor bu'i 'od kyis bsal byas te/ / thugs rje nam mkha'i klong nas dgongs dwangs mdzod/ / 'dir 'bad dge bas thub bstan yug gcig gis/ / 'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab pa'i dge legs kyis/ / 'jig rten kun tu phan bde snang ba'i 'od/ / mi nyams rtag brtan 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces 'jam mgon smra ba'i dbang po rje btsun tā ra nā tha mchog gis mdzad pa'i zhal gdams dpe rgyan gsal ba zhes bya ba'i tshig 'grel kun mkhyen mnyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'di ni rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa yos lor/ nges don bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa/ rnga yul bse dgon pa'i slob dpon 7rje kun dga' thugs rje dpal ba mchog gis dgongs gzhi dgos pa khyad par can la gzigs nas/ rje btsun chen po tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i zhal gdams gsal ba 'di la 'grel ba rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig dang / rje sgrol ba'i mgon po mchog gi mdzad 'phrin gyi cha la bsngags pa'i dpe rgyan kha tshang zhig 'bri dgos/ zhes gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan gtso byas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang /dmangs sgor brgya dang bcu gsum/ dri med lha rdzas dkar po srid du ring ba dang bcas 'phrin yig gi lam nas bskul ma gnang yang / phran slob khrid

42 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched smong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sogs 'du 'dzi'i bya ba sna tshogs kyis g.yeng bas rim 'gyangs su song gshis/stabs ma legs par rje kun dga' rin po che zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs rkyen spyan lam du ma son yang / rje de nyid kyi sku tsha kun dga' sri gcod sogs zhal slob rnams kyis bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi thugs dgongs bzhin myur bar 'bri dgos zhes slar yang bskul ma nan cher byas rkyen/ blo dman bdag la zhal gdams zab mo 'di lta bu'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i spobs pa ma mchis kyang /rje de nyid kyi thugs dgongs zab mo rdzogs pa'i phyir du/ bse tshang skyes phreng drug pa shākya'i dge sbyong blo bzang dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje nas lcags sbrul lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes la mjug grub par byas pa'i dge bas bdag sogs skyes pa'i phreng bar theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba mgi lam̐/(rtsom 'di mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar ba'i 〈bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyi gsung rtsom 〉pod bdun pa las bdams/)

43༄ / / bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/tsho blo bzang /de yang bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa gtong tshe thog mar bod du dam pa'i chos ji ltar dar tshul skor mi gleng ka med yin stabs 'dir bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su bod la nang bstan dar tshul yongs grags kyi lugs dang sbrags te bod du bka' bstan thog mar bsgyur ba'i skor mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/dang po/ 'gyur gyi srol thog mar phye ba'i skor/thog mar dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes tshul ni bod kyi lo rgyus yongs grags su lha tho tho ri'i ring dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes zhes 'byung la/ tshul de ni dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas (150rdo—1566)mdzad pa'i 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du/ ‘‘de nas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa/ / rgyal sras kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul ni/ / sprul ba'i rgyal po tho tho ri gnyan btsan/ / dgung lo drug cu bzhes pa sku mkhar che/ / yum bu bla sgang rtse la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ / nam mkha' 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs bkra/ / me tog char dang lha yi rol mo byung / / gdugs shar tshe na nyi zer dang 'grogs nas/ / gser shog ngos la bai ḍūr+yas bris pa'i/ / pang kong
