44 gtsosayi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phyag rgya mdo sde za ma tog / yid du 'ong ba'i glegs bam rnam gnyis dang / /gser gyi mchod rten mu dra'i phyag brgya dang / tsin+ta ma ṇi'i skos phor rnam drug bab/ / / / chos sam bon du mkhyen tshul ma bstan yang / / gser skyems g.yu sngon la sogs kyis mchod de/ / gnyan po gsang ba zhes par mtshan gsol nas/ / rgyal pos phyag skor bkur sti rgya cher byas/ / ’’rjozhes bkod cing / de min 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉dang 〈sum pa chos 'byung 〉〈gu bkra'i chos 'byung 〉〈bdud 'joms chos 'byung 〉sogs su'ang glegs bam gyi grangs gcig gnyis kyi khyad par tsam las mdo sde dang mchod rten bcas ‘‘gnyan po gsang ba ’’bab tshul phal cher zhal mtshungs su bkod 'dugayang lo rgyus yig cha cung snga bar grags pa 〈bka' chems ka khol mar 〉gnyan po gsang ba'i byung tshul thad lha sgrung dang 'dres pa rgyas tsam zhig bkod yod kyang bstan bya nang don ni mdo sde bzhi'i glegs bam dang gser gyi mchod rten bcas bzhugs par bshad pas phyis kyi mkhas pa mang phyogs kyis lo rgyus brtsams skabs de dag ji bzhin 'khod pa mang mod/ 'on kyang de rnams las don dngos thog 'bab pa zhig ni lo rgyus smra ba'i dbang po 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal (1292—14ra1)gyis mdzad pa'i 〈deb ther sngon po'i 〉nang du/‘‘ne+el pa paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ bon po nam mkha' la dga' bas nam mkha' nas babs zer ba bon gtam yin gyi don la paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems 'tsho dang lo tsā ba li the ses chos de dag khyer 'ongs pa la/ rgyal pos yi ge mi shes shing don mi go bas paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba phyir log zer ba 'di dag pa 'dra ste/’midhizhes glegs bam dang mchod rten de dag gnam las byung ba ma yin par skabs de'i rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems 'tsho dang bod kyi lo tsā ba li the se zhu ba gnyis kyis bsnams yong bar bzhed cing nel pa'i gsung thugs la babs te ji bzhin drangs yod pa 'di yin/ yang de'i 'phror blo sems 'tsho dang phyis kyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 45gnyis gang zag gcig tu gsungs yod pa ni chos lugs kyi lta ba kho nas btsan sbyar gnang ba ma gtogs/ bod la nang pa'i chos gzhung dang rten rnams thog ma nas skad bsgyur la brten nas mis khyer yong bar gsungs pa ni don la gnas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i bzhed dgongs yang dag pa sha stag red/ des na mthar thug btsan po'i pho brang du chos dang rten gang dang ji tsam zhig byung yod pa'i thad la sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyang bzhed pa mi mthun de/ gong gsal dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i gsung ltar na yongs grags kyi 〈dpang skong phyag brgya pa 〉dhidang / 〈mdo sde za ma tog 〉gser gyi mchod rten ('di bka' chems ka khol ma dang lo rgyus la lar bang rim bzhi can zhes 'byung )dang /mu dra'i phyag rgya ('di chos 'byung rang du khru gang tsam gyi nor bu'i rigs kyi rdo la yig drug rang byung can yod ces gsungs )tsin+ta ma ṇi'i brkos phor ('di bdud 'joms chos 'byung du tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs kyi brkos phor te bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs kyi brkos phor zhes ra brkos can gsungs pa dag 'dug)bcas khyon rnam drug yod par gsungs mod/ tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs dang gzungs yig brkos yul gyi phor pa gnyis so sor bgrang ba min na drug mi tshang bas brtag par bya ba'i gnas so/ / yang chos 'byung mang che bar 〈dpang skong phyag brgya pa 〉dang gser gyi mchod rten/ tsin+ta ma ṇi'i brkos phor gsum byung tshul thun mong du bkod pa khyab che la/ de min gzhan kha shas glegs bam skor la yang 〈mdo sde za ma tog 〉dang / kha shas su 〈mdo sde dkon mchog sprin 〉dang / la lar 〈za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa 〉bcas chos tshan ming mi 'dra ba ci rigs shig bkod pa yod do/ / gang ltar skabs 'di la bod btsan po'i pho brang du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsung gi rten glegs bam dang thugs kyi rten mchod rten ma zad/ gzungs yig brkos pa'i dngos rdzas phor pa'am ca ga gang rung zhig byung yod pa yin la/ skabs der bod

46 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/btsan po'i chab srid dang bod 'bangs byings ni g.yung drung bon la brten nas bskyangs pa yin stabs/ rten de rnams mchod bkur gyi gnas tsam las chos spel gyi nus pa ma thon pa yin 'dug 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du‘‘spyir theg chen gyi mdo sngags gnyis dang lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi mtshon byed du rten de rnams byung ba la ’’rjozhes dang / 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉du'ang ‘‘ dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes shing de yan chad ni chab srid bon gyis bskyangs so/ / ’’duzhes gsungs te dus 'di nas bzung dam pa'i chos bod yul du dar ba'i 'go brtsams par ngos 'dzin gnang ba'i srol byung ba yin na'ang / don du deb sngon mkhan pos/ ‘‘de la lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la chos kyi dbu brnyes pa ni/ chos kyi glegs bam tsam byung ba yin gyi/bri ba dang bklags pa dang 'chad pa sogs ni med do/ / ’’dhizhes dang / sum pa mkhan pos ‘‘'di'i dus su dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel tsam 'grig cing ’’dhizhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin de/ skabs der bod khams su dam chos dar ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du rgya gar nas ā tsā ra'am paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems 'tsho bya ba dang bod mi skad gnyis smra shes pa'i lo tsā ba li the se bya bas skad bsgyur la brten nas/ skabs de'i bod kyi ches mtho'i dbang sgyur mi sna btsan po lha tho tho ri dang mjal te 'tshams rtags sam mjal rten du glegs bam dang mchod rten brkos phor bcas dngos po 'ga' phul ba la/ btsan pos phyi nas 'ongs pa'i sngon thon gyi rig gnas mtshon pa'i dngos po de dag ngo mtshar du bzung nas gtsigs su bkur te mchod gnas su bzhugs pa yin mod/ 'on kyang btsan po'i 'khor dang bod 'bangs byings ni bon lugs kho nar dad pa byed stabs btsan pos bon 'khor rnams kyis dang len bya ba'i ched du blo thabs la brten nas de dag gnam nas babs par bsgrags pa ma zad/ ming yang gnyan po gsang ba zhes btags te re zhig bka' rgya'i tshul du

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 47mchod bkur gyi gnas btsan po zhig tu bsgyur pa ma gtogs chos spel gyi nus pa ma thon te lus par mngon no/ /de nas dam pa'i chos kyi srol dngos su phye ba'i tshul ni bod kyi lo rgyus buyongs grags su chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring bod la yi ge med pas thon mi sam bho ṭa sogs byis pa blo gsal can bcu drug mngags pa las thon mis tsha grang dka' thub mang po spyad nas rgya gar nas slob dpon du ma bsten te sgra byang bar bslabs shing / phyir bod du log nas bod yig gsar rtsom mdzad pa ma zad/ bod skad dang mthun pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung kha shas brtsams te dam chos rnams bod yig tu bsgyur thub pa mdzad cing thon mi rang nyid kyis kyang gsung rab mang po bsgyur zhes brjod/ tshul de'ang 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du ‘‘rgya bal mkhas pa du ma spyan drangs te/ / gsung rab du ma bsgyur cing dar bar mdzad/ / rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra dang bram ze shang ka ra dang / /kha che ta nu dang / bal po shri la mdzi dang / rgya nag ha shang ma ha de ba che rnams byon/ lo tsā ba thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / de'i mchan bu dharma ko ṣa dang lha lung rdo rje dpal sogs kyis 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs/ zla ba sgron ma/dkon mchog sprin sogs bsgyur cing sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa yang bsgyur bar grags/ gtso bo thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgyur te ’’dhizhes mdo rgyud nyer gcig gi drangs 'dren bkod rjes/ ‘‘'di las 'od zer rnam bkod/ chu klung sna tshogs/ snang ba rol pa/ mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa rnams deng sang gi bka' 'gyur na mi snang la gzhan don zhags cho ga zhib mo la cho ga sngags kyi rgyud ces pa lta bu 'gyur khyad ma gtogs deng sang bzhugs la/ mdo rgyud nyer gcig po 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kho na yin no/ / ’mi⑪zhes dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba ltar na skabs der bod la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis dang / kha che bal bo

48 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas kyi paṇ+ḍita re re dang rgya nag gi ha shang bcas phebs te de dag dang bod kyi lo tsā ba thon mi dang khong gi phyag rogs pa'am sgyur byed mchan bu ba mi gnyis bcas bzhugs tshul bkod 'dug la/ khong tsho'i 'gyur chos la'ang 〈'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs 〉dang / 〈zla ba sgron ma 〉〈mdo sde dkon mchog sprin/〉 〈sher phyin stong phrag brgya ba 〉sogs dang gtso che ba mdo rgyud nyer gcig bsgyur bar gsungs so/ / yang bu ston rin po ches thon mis yi ge gsar skrun dang brda sprod kyi gzhung mdzad tshul bkod rjes‘‘mdo za ma tog bkod pa dang / dpang skong dang / mdo sde dkon mchog sprin la sogs pa bsgyur ro/ / riri⑪ zhes sogs sgras bsdus te sngar gyi lha tho tho ri'i dus su byung ba'i rang lugs kyi glegs bam gsum ma bkod pa ma gtogs mdo rgyud nyer gcig sgyur tshul dang drangs 'dren bcas dngos su bkod mi 'dug de mtshungs 〈gu bkra'i chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘srong btsan sgam po'i dus 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bzhi pa thon mi sam bho ṭa byung ste/ de yan chad bod na yi ge dang chos kyi nyan bshad mi shes par chos blon 'dis bod yig ka kha 'bru sum cu la sogs pa'i yi ge'i gzugs dang brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brtsams chos sgyur ba'i srol btod/’ri⑫ces gsungs la srol btod pa'i bsgyur bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs bkod med/ yang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba rang gi gsung du'ang ‘‘yang rgyal pos thon mi la thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba der ci 'dug klogs dang gsungs pas dpang kong phyag rgya ba dang mdo sde za ma tog byung skad/la la nas tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs/ za ma tog pang kong / mdo sde las rnam 'byed de bzhi byung zhes kyang snang /’ ⑫zhes thon mis btsan po'i bka' bzhin sngon yab mes ring gi thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba gzigs pas gong gsal mdo sde rnams byung ba ma gtogs mdo rgyud nyer gcig gi skor skabs 'dir gleng mi 'dug btsan pos gnyan po gsang ba la ci 'dug thon mir klogs

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 49gsungs pa la dpag na skabs der thog mar ngag sgyur gyi lam nas dam chos dar ba'i srol btsugs pa yin 'dug snyam/ gong zhus chos 'byung mang che bar dpang skong phyag brgya pa dang mdo sde za ma tog gnyis zhal mtshungs su thon mis bsgyur bar bzhed cing / sgos su si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas (1700—1774)kyis mdzad pa'i 〈sde dge'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉tu'ang ‘‘ya pa la/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa thu mi saṃ bho ṭa'i 'gyur/’’⑫zhes dkar chag tu thon mi'i mtshan dngos su bkod gnang 'dug mod/ 'on te bka' 'gyur dpar khag rnams ⑫kyi 'gyur byang du thon mi'i mtshan bkod yod sa gcig kyang mi 'dug la/ sde dge bka' 'gyur rang gi mjug byang du'ang ‘‘dpang skong phyag brgya pa rdzogs so/ / bod du dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i snga ltas su lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku ring la pho brang yum bu mkhar du nam mkha' las babs mi rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa 'ong zhes rmi lam du lung bstan te chos kyi dbu brnyes so/ / ’’⑫zhes glegs bam byung tshul dang mi rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa 'ong bar lung bstan zhes lo rgyus yongs grags dang mthun pa'i bshad tshul ma gtogs gzhan tshig ris ci yang mi 'dug 'dir mi rabs lnga na zhes pa ni phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis chos rgyal srong btsan sgam por dmigs te bkod pa yin la zhar du glegs bam de srong btsan skabs bar du nang don 'gyur ba phar zhog ci yin go mkhan zhig kyang ma byung ba shugs su bstan yod pa yin no/ / de min 〈mdo sde dkon mchog sprin 〉dang 〈za ma tog bkod pa 〉sogs kyi 'gyur byang yang phyis kyi lo tsā ba 'ba' zhig ma gtogs thon mi dang skabs de'i lo paṇa su zhig gi mtshan zur tsam yang bkod pa ma mthong la/des na gong zhus ltar kho bo'i bsam par srong btsan sgam po'i dus chos blon thon mi sam bho ṭas deng sang spyod pa'i yi ge 'di gsar bcos gnang ste thog mar rgyal po'i mdun du nang pa'i chos gzhung 〈dpang skong phyag brgya pa 〉sogs

50 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ngag bsgyur gyis bstan pa spel ba yin zhing rim gyis yi ge 'thus tshang du song rjes yig thog tu bsgyur ba yin stabs sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi srol phye zhes dam chos spel ba'i dbu brtsams par gsungs pa ni don la gnas pa'i gtam yin pas/ skabs der thon mis mdo rgyud nyer gcig la sogs pa bsgyur bar bshad pa ni cung zad bsam mno gtong dgos pa yod de/spyir bstan pa phyi dar ma gtogs snga dar gyi skabs su gsung rab rnams dkar chag tu bkod pa la mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang 'god pa'i srol mi 'dug mod/'on kyang rjes su phyi dar skabs gzhung dngos su 'gyur byang bsnan yod la snga dar skabs kyi lo tsā sum cu kha grangs kyi mtshan kha tshang bkod yod na bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i bod kyi lo tsā ba dang po thon mi'i mtshan mi 'god mi srid pas/ phal cher thon mis gzhung tshang ba zhig bsgyur med la dam chos kyi nang don rnams bod yig thog 'god thub pa tsam gnang ba ma gtogs chos gzhung de 'dra mang po zhig bsgyur yod thabs med pas na 'gyur byang du ma bkod pa yin snyam ste/ gang zhe na bod kyi lo rgyus snga shos kyi gras nyang nyi ma 'od zer (1124—1192)gyis mdzad pa'i 〈chos 'byung me tog snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud 〉ces par thon mis bod yig bcos tshul skor la/ ‘‘der rgya gar la med pa'i yi ge drug gis kha bskangs te/ ka mad sum cu tham pa byung ste da gzod bod skad du bsgyur btub nas rgya yig la bod yig tu bris nas rgya gar las bod skad du bstan nas sgra bsgyur nas gtan la phab/ bshad nyan dang sgomasnrub kyi srol ni ma thod 'bri ba dang klog pa'i srol ni ma thod de/’’⑥zhes bkod pa don la 'bab cing / de'i 'phror mdo sde mang po bsgyur tshul gsungs pa ni yongs grags kyi rjes su 'brangs pa tsam las don dngos su thon mi'i bka' drin ni rgya yig las bod yig tu bris nas rgya gar skad las bod skad du bstan pa ni dgongs gzhi gtso bo yin pa gsal ba ltar ro/ /

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 51gnyis pa/ bka' bstan gyi 'gyur dar zhing rgyas pa'i skor/bod kyi chos 'byung dang lo rgyus yongs grags su srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la bal bza' dang rgya bza' rnam gnyis bod la bsus te lha sa'i gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che gnyis bzhengs pa ma zad/ da dung mtha' 'dul yang 'dul dang ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang bcas bzhengs par bshad/ de nas khri lde gtsug btsan nam mes ag tshom gyi sku ring la gtsug lag khang kha shas bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus bkod yod la/ tshul de'ang khri srong lde btsan skabs btsan po yab yum sras dang blon che phra mtha' dag dkon mchog gsum dang sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzad pa mi gzhig par bro stsal ba'i gtsigs kyi yi ge na/‘‘ra sa'i 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang / khra 'brug gi bkra shis lha yul gtsug lag khang / pho brang 'khor gyi dge 'dun dang / ra sa'i rgya btags ra mo che dang / brag dmar gyi khams gsum mi ldog sgrol dang / bru sha yul dang /zhang zhung yul dang / mdo smad dang / sde blon ris dang / 'di rnams kyi gtsug lag khang gi dge 'dun pa re re la 'chang du stsald to/ / ’’⑪zhes bkod pa la gzhigs na yul dbus su gong gsal srong btsan dus kyi gtsug lag khang gnyis dang khra 'brug gtsug lag khang dang / khri lde gtsug btsan ring gi brag dmar mgrin bzang gtsug lag khang dang / de min yul mtha'i bru sha dang zhang zhung dang mdo smad dang / sde blon gyi ris sam bde khams te li yul phyogs bcas su'ang gtsug lag khang yod stabs gtsigs yig tu 'di rnams kyi zhes mang tshig sbyar yod pas mtshon/ srong btsan skabs bstan pa'i srol phye rjes rgyal rabs bzhi lhag song mtshams khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs yod par ma zad/ de dag gi nang na rten brten pa dang dge 'dun pa'ang mang du yod par mngon/ de'i sngon la sangs rgyas kyi

52 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsung rab bsgyur ba dang dam chos 'chad nyan gyi srol cher ma dar la khri srong lde btsan skabs nas bzung dam chos bsgyur ba dang 'chad nyan gyi rim pa sgom sgrub bcas dar rgyas su song ba dang dus mtshungs su dam chos bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las kyang rgya cher spel ba yin te/ 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du ‘‘btsan po'i zhal nas rgya yul gyi dharma kun dang mang yul gyi chos rnams rgya me mgo dang / rgya gar ānan+ta dang / rgya las skad mkhas pa su yod pas bsgyur shig ces bka' bstsal nas de gsum gyis has po ri'i bya khung du chos bod skad du bsgyur ’’⑫zhes bkod pa 'di ni thog mar khri srong lde batren sku na chung dus rba gsal snang mang yul du byon nas chos gdan drangs pa dang blon sang shi rgya yul du byon nas dharma mang po khyer yong ba rnams btsan por phul bas btsan po thugs dgyes te/ de rnams bod skad du bsgyur bar bka' babs nas de gsum gyis bsgyur 'go brtsams pa na bon lugs la mos pa'i blon chen ma zhang khrom pa skyes kyis chos bya mi chog par byas te rang gis khrims bsgrags pa la bod kyi lo rgyus rnams su ma zhang gis ‘‘khrims bu chung ’’byas zhes grags pa'i don rkyen de byung ba yin/ de nas btsan po'i 'khor du ban bon gyi rtsod pa dang chab srid thad 'thab rtsod dza drag che ba byas rjes khri srong lde btsan dgung lo nyi shur phebs dus snga phyir za hor nas nang pa'i khams pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang / u rgyan nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyis gdan drangs te bsam yas gtsug lag khang rten brten pa bcas rgya cher bzhengs pa grub rjes thog mar bod kyi sad mi mi bdunakhya ba yirab byung dang dge slong du bsgrubs rjes gzhi nas bod rang gi nang bstan chos lugs pa byung ste dam chos rnams bod skad du bsgyur ba'i srol cher spel ba yin 'dug tshul de'ang 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉du/ ‘‘gzhan yang mnga' bdag rgyal pos bka' bstsal ba/ / / / khye'u blo gros rno zhing

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 53gsal ba rnams/ / brda sprod skad gnyis lo tsā slob tu bcug / yod smra'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te/ / dang po dad pa che ba rba khri gzigs/ /bo dhi su tas mkhan po mdzad nas ni/ / rab tu phyung bas mngon shes lnga ldan gyur/ / bod kyi rin po che zhes rgyal pos bkur/ / bod mi rab byung kun gyi thog ma yin/ / de sogs bod la rab byung btub bam zhes/ / sad pa'i mi drug dang por bsnyen par rdzogs/ / phyi nas dge slong dge tshul rgya cher 'phel/ / za hor kha che yul dbus rgya sogs nas/ / paṇa chen tshad ldan mang du spyan drangs te/ / mkhas pa'i lo tsā du mas rgya gar nag li yul sogs nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab ni/ / ji snyed bzhugs pa phal cher bod du bsgyur/ / ’’②zhes bkod pa bzhin mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho bod la gdan drangs rjes bod mi rnams rab tu byung nas bstan pa'i gzhi tshugs pa yin la/ de nas mkhan slob de dag dang bod kyi lo tsā ba ka cog zhang gsum sogs kyis 'dul ba lung sde bzhi bsgyur bas mtshon mdor na lo paṇa de dag gis 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len mtha' dag thog mar gsal bar mdzad de bstan pa'i gzhi bting ba yin 'dug de la khri srong lde btsan skabs lo paṇa gang dag gis dam chos gang zhig bsgyur ba'i thad la bod kyi chos 'byung dang lo rgyus yig tshang rnams zhal mi mtshungs mod/ / dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i chos 'byung ltar na/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang grub rjes thog mar bod kyi rab byung pa byung zhing de dang dus mtshungs su bod phrug mang por lo tsā bslab tu bcug ste chos bsgyur ba'i dbu brtsams par bzhed de/ ‘‘sngar ye shes dbang po dang slob dpon bo dhi su tas gsol ba bzhin chos la 'jug par chad nas sgra bsgyur btsugs te lo tsā ba chen pos ni rgya gar gyi lo tsā byas/ rgya nag po'i lo tsā bran ka legs kong dang /lha lung klu gong / 'og gom dbus gong / khyung po rtse rtse sogs kyis byasadzo’’zhes rba bzhed lung drangs te bkod yod/ de las shes rgyu ni skabs der bod

54 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osasatho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la rgya gar gyi skad mkhas pa rba ye shes dbang po dang be+e ro tsa na sogs lo tsā ba chen po mang du bzhugs pas rgya gar gyi lo tsā byas te chos bsgyur ba ma zad/ rgya nag gi skad la mkhas pa'i lo tsā ba yang bran ka legs gong sogs mi bzhis mtshon skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba mang po bzhugs pa gsal/ yang de dag gis chos gang dang gang bsgyur pa dang gang gang ma bsgyur ba'i skor la dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas rba bzhed lung drangs pa 'di ltar/ ‘‘rba bzhed rgyas shos lugs gcig la rgya nag po'i chos rnams thog mar bsgyur/ rgya dkar po'i chos la nang rgyud de gsum sha chang la yongs te bod la mi 'tshams pas ma bsgyur/thams cad yod smra'i sde bye brag du smra ba rgyu 'bras ston te bod la 'tshams par mkhyen nas bsgyur/ ye shes dbang po la gsol te dang po lung sde bzhi las lung ring po dang gang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ngu zhig bsgyur/ mngon pa la nyan thos kyi ṣa bsgyur/’’⑫zhes chos de dag las bod la 'tsham pa'i skor gang gang bsgyur tshul dang bod la mi 'tsham pa'i rigs re zhig ma bsgyur bar bzhag gsungs 'dug ste/ de ni don dngos dang mthun pa'i gtam du snang 'dugagang zhe na 'jig rten gyi chos dang dngos po gang zhig yin na'ang skabs de'i spyi tshogs la bstun dgos pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs dang 'tsham nas de'i rin thang spyi tshogs thog mkho che chung gis gzhal ba yin stabs/ dam pa'i chos kyang de las ma brgal te skabs de'i bod spyi tshogs la dmigs te 'tsham pa'i rigs rnams bsgyur cing mi 'tsham pa'i rigs ma bsgyur bar mngon/ de'ang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi kyang ‘‘'dul ba yul dus dang bstun pa ’’zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir ro/ / yang 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉du ‘‘gzhan yang rgya gar gyi slob dpon bi ma la mi tra dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / shān+di gar+gha dang / bi shud+ngha sidha la sogs pa dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun dang / chos kyi snang ba dang / brne nam mkha' dang / sgro rin

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 55chen sde dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / shākya 'od la sogs pas lo tsā byas te chos mang po bsgyur to/ / ’’zhes dang ‘‘sngags 'chang dharma kirti zhes pa spyan drangs te yo ga rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du dbang bskur/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dza na mi tra dang / dā na shi la la sogs pas rnam dag khrims khang gling du khrims phog rgya'i hwa shang la sogs pas mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du bsam gtan byed/ brda sbyor tshangs pa gling du brda sbyor/ dkor mdzod pe har gling du rnor 'jog bai ro tsa na'i gling du chos 'chad pa sogs bstan pa yongs su rdzogs par dar bar byas te/ / ’ri⑫zhes bkod rjes lo paṇa rnams kyis 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉bsgrigs par gsungs 'dug lo rgyus mang por skabs der dam chos mang du bsgyur ba phal cher zhal mtshungs la/ yang mkhas pa'i dga' ston du paṇ+ḍi ta dang bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa de dag gis chos mang du bsgyur ba'i mi tshad be+e ro tsa nas don gsal sgron mes mtshon rba dpal dbyangs dang ka ba dpal brtsegs dang cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon shes rab snying po/ slob dpon bkra shis dang dpal gyi lhun po/ lce khyi 'brug sogs lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis bstan bcos mang du mdzad par ma zad/ btsan po dang btsun mo lha sras bcas kyis kyang bstan bcos mdzad par gsungs shing / de bden nam khri srong lde btsan dang be+e ro tsa na lce khyi 'brug la sogs pa'i mtshan 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma'i 〉nang bkod 'dug pas brtag par bya ba'i gnas so/ /skabs der byung ba'i bod kyi lo tsā ba grags chen ni rgan bar gzhon gsum mam rab 'bring tha gsum du 'bod pa'i be+e ro tsa na dang ldan ma rtse mang /kha che anan+ta gsum ni rgan gsum dang / gnyag ye shes gzhon nu/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ rma rin chen mchog gsum ni bar pa'am 'bring gsum dang /ka ba dpal brtsegs dang cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde ste yongs

56 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grags kyi ka cog zhang gsum ni gzhon gsum du bgrang ba yin la/ der rgan bar gzhon gsum du phye ba ni lo tsā ba'i lo tshad kyi che chung trem ston pa ma yin te/de ni lo tsā ba zhes 'jig rten mig tu grags pa'i mkhas pa'i yon tshad mtshon byed de deng sang gi ched las mkhas pa'i ming rtags dang go gnas mtho dma' la zer ba dang mtshungs pas/ de dag gi las 'gan yang rab kyis zhus chen dang 'bring gis bar zhus/ tha mas mchan bu'i lo tsā bcas byas pa'i phyir ro/ / mdor na btsan po khri srong lde btsan ring rgya gar dang / rgya nag za hor/ u rgyan/ kha che dang li yul sogs nas mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang slob dpon mang du gdan drangs rjes/ bod rang la rab byung gi sde btsugs nas skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang po byon te dam pa'i chos mang po skad rigs gzhan pa las bod skad du bsgyur ba ma zad/ btsan po 'di'i sku ring la mkhas pa zhi ba 'tsho dang / rba ye shes dbang po/ zhang rgyal gnyen nya bzang /blon khri bzher sang shi dang / lo tsā ba sna nam zhang ye shes sde dang lce khyi 'brug dang kha che anan+ta'am bram ze dga' ba (zhi ba 'tsho'i skad bsgyur pa yin )bcas kyis mdo sde bsgyur te bod kyi lo rgyus steng dam chos bsgyur ba'i bkas bcad dang po'am yig bsgyur rtsa don thog mar tshad ldan can du gtan la phab pa yin te/ tshul de'ang 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉su ‘‘sngon lha sras yab kyi spyan sngar mkhan po dang lo tsā ba mkhas pa 'tshogs pas/ dharma dkon mchog sprin dang laṅkar gshegs pa bsgyur te/ gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin du sgyur cig ’’ñcaces bkod pa bzhin phyis su btsan po khri lde srong btsan gyis bkas bcad gnyis pa mdzad skabs sngar yab kyi ring gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin gsar snon dang tshad ldan je rgyas su btang ba yin 'dug gol/ /skabs de dag la da dung 'chad nyan gyis dar spel dang sgom sgrub kyis nyams len mdzad pa'i skyes bu mang du byon yod pa yin la/ de las bcom ldan

bka' bstan bod du bsgrur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 57'das kyi ring lugs pa ste mkhan po dang / mchims phu'i brag la bzhugs pa'i sgom chen nyer lnga/ chos grwa'i slob dpon du bskos pa bcu gsum/ slob gnyer pa nyer lnga dang mtshams kyi ban+de rang ga ma bcas la btsan pos 'tsho ba bla nas sbyar ba dang / de dag la 'bangs mi khyim gtan 'jags bcad pas de nas bzung rim gyis bod kyi dgon sde la lha ris lha 'bangs gcod pa'i srol byung ba yin no/ /btsan po khri srong lde btsan la sras bzhi 'khrungs pa thog mar mu ne btsan po rgyal srid la bskos kyang srid yun ma ring / de nas sras mu tig btsan po'am yongs grags su sad na legs mjing yon zhu ba mtshan dngos khri lde srong btsan bya ba rgyal sar bskos/ spyir btsan po 'di ba bod kyi lo rgyus steng chos srid gnyis kar mdzad rjes che zhing bod kyi btsan po skyid pa'i gdung rab lngar grags pa'i gras yin mod/ 'on te 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉gtso byas pa'i phyis kyi tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa chen po sogs kyis yab sras gnyis kyi mtshan bsres te btsan po 'di ba'i mdzad rjes zur tsam gleng med la/ chos srid kyi mdzad pa mang po zhig sras khri gtsug lde btsan ral ba can gyi steng du sbyar 'dug〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉du khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs song rjes‘‘de'i sras mu ne btsan pos / de nas gcung khri lde btsan po lo bzhi ba la rgyal srid gtad pas sad na legs zhes grags te des skar chung rgyal sde bzhengs/ chos srol cher mdzad do/ / ’’yizhes btsan po'i mtshan cha shas khri lde btsan po zhes mdzad rjes tshig zur tsam las bkod med la/ de'i 'phror yab sras ming bsres te‘‘de la sras lnga 'khrungs te khri lde srong btsan ral pa can ’’zhes bkod rjes 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉khri ral skabs byung ba gzhir bzhag gnang ste sgra sbyor bam gnyis kyi gleng gzhi'i tshig rnams bar 'dir bcug 'dug 'on kyang de yang snga rabs mkhas pa thams cad kyi bzhed pa ma yin te/ 〈mkhas

58 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i dga' ston 〉du ‘‘de nas khri lde srong btsan rgyal sar bskos/ / 'jing yon sad na legs zhes mtshan du grags/ / dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ / lo paṇa mang mchod dam chos du ma bsgyur/ / nam yang sangs rgyas bstan pa mi bzhig par/ / bro bor ba yi bka' gtsigs yang yang bstsal/ / lo grangs sum cu rtsa gnyis srid bskyangs te/ / dgung lo nga bzhi pa la sbrags phur 'das/ / ’rinyuzhes gsal por bkod pa ma zad/ btsan po 'di'i ring gi bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge rnams kha tshang rang gi chos 'byung nang du drangs 'dug yang bod kyi lo rgyus snga shos kyi gras 〈mkhas pa lde'us mdzad pa'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa 〉zhes par/ ‘‘khri srong lde btsan dang tshe spong bza' dmar rgyan gyi sras/ mu ne btsan po/ mu tig btsan po/ khri lde srong btsan/’’⑫zhes sras gsum gyi mtshan bkod pa las khri lde srong btsan zhes gsal por bkod yod la/ 'dir mu tig btsan po zhes pa ni yi ge nor ba ste khri lde srong btsan skabs kyi rdo ring yi ge na ‘‘gcen mi rug ’’ces 'byung ba ltar mu rug btsan po yin dgos/ 〈deb sngon 〉du'ang rgyal rabs bgrang skabs kyang ‘‘khri srong lde btsan/ mu ne btsan po/ khri lde srong btsan/ ral pa can/’’zhes rgyal rabs bzhi'i yab sras dbon gsum gyi mtshan rnams gsal por bkod yod/ de ma zad/ 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉rang las/ ‘‘rta'i lo la btsan po khri srong lde btsan pho brang gi'i 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po / ’’⑫zhes 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉sam bkas bcad mdzad pa'i lo dang btsan po'i mtshan/ mkhan po dang lo tsā ba bcas kyi mtshan re re bzhin gsal por bkod 'dug de min yang khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi ring gi rdo ring yi ge na'ang ‘‘btsan po yab lha 'phrul khri lde srong btsan gyi zhal snga nas ’’phyezhes rang gi yab kyi mtshan gsal por rdo la ri mo brkos yod pa 'di rnams dag par 'dug go/ des na btsan po 'di pa'ang sngon byon mkhas

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 59dbang rnams kyis gsungs pa bzhin chos srid kyi mdzad rjes dang chos srol rgya cher gnang mkhan gyi rgyal po zhig yin pa ma zad/ chos phyogs su mu mthud nas yab khri srong lde btsan gyi phyag rgyun bskyangs te gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang dam chos mi bshig par bro bor ba sogs kyis mtshon lo paṇa mang po gdan drangs te dam chos spel ba yin 'dug khyad par du mdzad rjes 'bur du thon pa mig mthong lag zin du yod pa ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng skad grags che zhing shugs rkyen zab pa'i bkas bcad gnyis pa'am skad gsar bcad mdzad pa ste/ btsan po'i bkas dngos su bskul nas bkas bcad kyi rtsa don yig cha gzhung lugs dang ldan pa 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉dang saṃ bod skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod 〈bye brag rtogs byed chen mo 〉gnyis rtsom sgrig gnang ba ni da lta'i bar nga tsho'i mjal yul du bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /gsum pa/ bka' bstan gyi dkar chag dang bkas bcad skor/de yang bstan pa snga dar skabs su bod la bka' bstan gyi dkar chag chen po gsum yitsam byung ba'i gsung rgyun mkhas pa snga rabs pa rnams la grags che na'ang / da lta nga tsho'i mjal lam du gyur pa ni 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉gcig pu las lus med/ yang dkar chag de dag btsan po gang gi ring byung tshul dang gsum ga'i snga phyi gang yin bcas kyi thad la sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyang bzhed pa mi mthun pa ma zad/ deng gi dpyod dbang rnam pa'ang rang rang la bzhed pa mi mthun pa yod/ sngon byon pa 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉dang 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉〈sum pa chos 'byung 〉sogs su btsan po khri srong lde btsan ring byung bar bkod la/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi brtsams pa'i 〈sde dge bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉tu btsan po khri lde srong batren sad na legs kyi skabs su byung bar bzhed/ dkar chag de nyid du ‘‘bstan pa snga dar

60 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyi dus su chos kyi rgyal po sad na legs mjing yon gyi sku ring la/ lo tsā ba ban+de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta/ chos kyi snying po/ delben+da/ dpal gyi lhun po sogs kyis 'phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la/ tsheg bar brgyad brgyad la tshig rkang re re/ de bzhi la sh+lau ka/ de sum brgya la sogs pa la bam po'i tshad du byas te grangs 'di dang 'di'i zhes bkod pa dkar chag 'phang thang mar grags pa ste/ gangs can 'dir rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma ni 'di yin zhes yongs su grags la/ de'i rjes su lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs dang 'khon nā gen+d+ra rak+shi ta sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar gyi pho brang chen po na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab zhus chen mdzad zin pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas dkar chag mdzad pa la ldan dkar mar grags pa byung /’’zhes rgyas tsam zhig bkod 'dug la/ 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉rang nyid du/ ‘‘bod kyi rgyal khams su dam pa'i chos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi mtshan byang dkar chag bris shig ces bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi 'dun sa nas/ 'brug gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i ston/ sgra bsgyur gyi ban+de dpal brtsegs dang ban+de klu'i dbang po la sogs pas dam pa'i chos theg pa che chung gi mdo sde dang / gzungs che phra dang / mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dang / bstod pa dang / smon lam dang / bkra shis dang / 'dul ba'i sde snod dang / mdo sde'i ṭik+ka dang / dbu ma'i bstan bcos dang / bsam gtan gyi yi ge dang / rnam par shes pa'i bstan bcos dang / tar ka'i gzhung la sogs pa bod khams su chos 'gyur ngo 'tshal gyi mtshan byang bam po dang sh+lau ka'i grangs su mchis pa gtan la phab nas yi ger bris pa/’rizhes dang / de'i mjug byang du ‘‘gsung rab mdo sde dang bstan bcos thams cad la sh+lau ka dang bam po'i grangs gtan la phab ste zhu chen zin to 'tshal thams cad 'brug gi lo la pho brang ldan dkar du mtshan byang dkar

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 61chag tu btab pa rdzogs so/ / mi’②zhes dkar chag sgrig gnas pho brang chen po ldan dkar dang / sgrig mkhan sgra bsgyur gyi ban+de dpal brtsegs dang klu'i dbang po gnyis dang / sgrig lo 'brug gi lo zhes gsal por bkod yod na'ang / 'on te ‘‘bris shig ’’ces bkas bskul mkhan btsan po su yin pa'i thad tshig zur tsam yang ma smras pa'i rkyen gyis/ phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams la bzhed dgongs mi mthun pa 'dra min byung ba red/ de la deng gi dpyod dbang khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang lags kyis phyogs du ma nas sgrub byed btsal te 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi skabs su byung bar gsungs phyeyod mod/ 'on kyange bsam mno btang dgos pa'i gnas shig 'dug ste/ dkar chag rang nyid du gtso sgrig gnang mkhan ni ‘‘sgra bsgyur gyi ban+de dpal brtsegs dang ban+de klu'i dbang po la sogs pas ’’zhes lo tsā ba khong rnam pa gnyis kyi mtshan gsal por bkod yod/ der bkod pa'i ban+de dpal brtsegs dang klu'i dbang po gnyis ni yongs grags kyi ka ba dpal brtsegs dang 'khon klu'i dbang po gnyis yin pa dogs pa mi dgos 'dug des na ka ba dpal brtsegs ni khri srong lde btsan skabs kyi lo tsā ba che dgu'i nang gi chung ba ka cog zhang gsum yin tshul gong du song zin la khong rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gras su'ang bzhugs/ 'khon klu'i dbang po ni yongs grags kyi sad mi mi bdun gyi gras dang lo tsā ba che dgu'i nang gi bar gsum gyi gras yin pa bcas kyis khong rnam gnyis rgyal rabs gsum la dbon gyi bar du 'tsho bzhugs mi srid la/ yang gong gi lung drangs pa'i nang ‘‘bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi 'dun sa nas ’’zhes spyir btang mkhan po'i ming la khri srong lde btsan ring gi skad dod ji bzhin bris yod la phyis khri lde srong btsan skabs 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉su thad dkar mkhan po zhes bris yod pa las tha snyad 'di mthong rgyu med pa bcas la gzhigs na dkar chag ldan dkar

62 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ma ni btsan po khri srong lde gyi sku tshe smad dam sras khri lde srong btsan gyi sku tshe stod de bkas bcad bar ba ma byung gong la bsgrigs pa yin shas che'o/ /spyir btsan po khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon gyi sku ring la bkas bcad gnyis pa mdzad de btsan po'i bkas bskul nas lo paṇa rnams kyis 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉rtsom sgrig gnang ba yin 'dug mod/ 'on te gong du zhus pa bzhin bu ston sogs kyi btsan po yab sras kyi mtshan bsres pa'i rkyen gyis phyis lo rgyus mang por bkas bcad gnyis pa dang 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉ni btsan po'i sras khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi skabs su byung bar bzhed mkhan byung / de'i skor 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉rang la gzigs na gsal por shes par 'gyur bas 'dir cung zad drangs na/ de nyid las/ ‘‘rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang gi'i 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ / nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra dang / su ran+d+ra bo dhi dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang /dā na shi la dang / bo dhi mi twa dang /’ zhes rgya gar gyi mkhan po lnga dang / ‘‘bod kyi mkhan po ran+ta rak+shi ta dang / dharma tā shī la dang /’’zhes bod rang gi mkhan po gnyis/ ‘‘lo tsā ba mkhas par chud pa dz+nyā na se na dang / dza yang rak+shi ta dang /mañcā shrī lbarmyu dang / rat+na n+d+ra shī ’’zhes bod pa lo tsā ba mkhas pa mi bzhi ste de‘‘la sogs pas theg pa che chung las 'byung ba'i rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris te/ nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi bsgyur zhing kun gyis bslab tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas/ sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la/ ā tsar+ya bodhi satwa dang / ye shes dbang po/ zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang dang / blon khri bzher sang shi dang /lo tsā ba dz+nyā na de ba ko ṣa dang / lce khyi 'brug dang / bram ze anan+ta la sogs pas chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa mang dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas kha cig chos kyi gzhung dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 63mthun te/ mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos/’’yizhes gleng gzhir bkod pa'i nang bkas bcad mdzad pa'i lo ni rta lo dang / pho brang bzhugs gnas 'on cang rdo dang btsan po'i mtshan khri lde srong btsan zhes gsal bar ma zad skabs der bzhugs pa'i mkhan po dang lo tsā rbe bcas kyi mtshan re re bzhin gsal por bkod pa de yin/ yang ‘‘sngon lha sras yab kyi ring ’’zhes pa ni yab btsan po khri srong lde btsan ring gi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang rba ye shes dbang po sogs rgya bod kyi lo paṇa bdun gyi mtshan smos yod pa las kyang btsan po 'di gnyis yab sras yin pa ngo 'phrod/ de ma zad bkas bcad mdzad tshul yang 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉rang du ‘‘gna'i mkhan po chen po nā gā rdzu na dang /ba su ban+dhu la sogs pas ji ltar bshad pa dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'dren pa dang bstun te/ / btsan po'i spyan sngar ban+de chen po dpal gyi yon tan dang / ban+de chen po ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yang 'tshogs te/ rje blon gdan 'dzoms pa la zhus nas dharma bsgyur ba'i thabs dang / rgya gar gyi skad la bod kyi skad du ming btags pa rnams gtan la phab ste/ bkas bcad pa/’’chuzhes bkas bcad mdzad tshul gsal por bkod 'dug pa 'di ni sngar btsan po yab khri srong lde btsan ring phyogs bzhi'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba mang po bod la phebs nas rang rang gi skad las chos rnams bod skad du bsgyur ba yin stabs/ ming tshig bkol stangs/ brda sprod lugs/bsgyur thabs bcas la sngar yab kyis gtan 'bebs nang bzhin ma 'ong ste bsgyur tshul 'dra min sna tshogs byung nas chos yang dag par bslab dka' bar gzigs nas/ btsan po sku dngos nas bkas bskul te sngar gyi bsgyur lugs rnams gcig gyur dang tshad ldan gyi sgo nas gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i rtsa don yig cha gal chen 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉bsgrigs pa ma zad/ skad gsar de dag nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i ched du saṃ bod shan sbyar gyi tshig mdzod 〈bye brag

64 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtogs byed chen mo 〉zhes pa'ang rtsom sgrig gnang ba yin/ tshul de'ang de nyid kyi mjug byang du/ ‘‘pho brang 'on cang dor bod dang rgya gar gyi mkhan po thams cad kyis chos skad gtan la phab ste/ rje blon mol nas reg zin du mdzad pa skad gsar gyi ming sngon ma thogs pa dang / gtan la ma phab pa la mkhas pa rnams 'tshogs te ming du btags shing gtan la phab ste/ lha btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis bskul nas bkas bcad de mi bcos par gzhag pa rdzogs so/ / ri’chuzhes 'byung la/ gong gsal yig cha 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉dang 〈bye brag rtogs byed chen mo 〉gnyis bod kyi chos lugs dang lo rgyus thog shin tu gal che ba'i nus shugs dang go gnas bzung yod stabs snga rabs mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang gal che bar rtsis nas bka' bstan 'gyur dang mnyam pa'i gces spras gnang ste kha tshang bstan 'gyur par ma'i nang bzhugs yod pa 'di lags so/ /mchan 'grel/() (nye () 4) (nya (me () rkyu1 phoyi phon pho'ibacas ni mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis bskrun pa'i dz+nyochos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉stod cha'i shog ngos 166—169 168 182 183 183 372 310 358 363 364 407na gsal/rjo dhini sri khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i 〈deb ther sngon po 〉stod cha'i shog ngos 63da 64 64na gsal/duchos 'byung rnams su yi ge 'dra min 'byung yang (bka' 'gyur 〉rang du 〈dpang skong phyag brgya pa 〉zhes 'khod pa dag pa'o/ /du ⑪ tshi yini krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i 〈bu ston chos 'byung 〉shog ngos 181 182 187 190na gsal/mekan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i 〈sum pa chos 'byung 〉shog ngos 293na ba/rnga595/dhinang pa'i chos 'byung rnams zhal mthun la bon gyi ṭ+wāṃbastan 'byung 〉du bshad tshul gzhan yod/

bka' bstan bod du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus la dpyad pa/ 65yikrung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i dz+nyogu bkra'i chos 'byung 〉shog ngos 145na gsal/(1si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i 〈sde dge'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag 〉shog ngos 375 302da 303na gsal/yilha sa dang sog po'i par ma'i mjug byang sde dge par ma dang mtshungs la/ snar thang dang co ne+e li thang yun lo par ma bcas la mjug byang med/yisde dge 〈bka' 'gyur 〉par ma'i mdo ya pod kyi 〈dpang skong phyag brgya pa 〉zhes pa'i ldeb 5na gsal/⑪bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bskrun pa'i 〈chos 'byung me tog snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud 〉shog ngos 173—174na gsal/ pho)drangs 'dren mi mthun pa mang ba zur du gsal/gsalayi/ ② yi ñca po)sde dge'i 〈bstan 'gyur 〉las sna tshogs co pod kyi 〈sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉su phomebod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bskrun pa'i 〈mkhas pa lde'us mdzad pa'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung rgyas pa 〉shog ngos 358na gsal/4)lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi mdun gyi rdo ring shar ngos yig phreng 34par gsal/⑪yongs grags su dkar chag mchims phu ma dang 'phang thang ma ldan dkar ma gsum la zer/6yisde dge'i 〈bstan 'gyur 〉las sna tshogs jo pod kyi 〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉na gsal/tsokrung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i (khang dkar tshul khrims skal bzang gi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〉ces pa'i shog ngos 84na gsal/(dpyad rtsom 'di 2003lo'i dz+nyokrung go'i bod rig pa 〉deb dang po las bdams/)

66༄ / / ma thel dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling gi dkar chag dang dgon mtshan thogs tshul skor gleng ba/rdor phrugade yang ma thel dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling zhes pa ni da lta'i krang ye sa khul gyi su'u nan yu gur rigs rang skyong rdzong gi khongs su chags/ grong khyer krang ye bar spyi le re lnga yod/ dga' ldan dam chos gling ni rnam rgyal ma'i phug pa dang / 'od zer can ma'i phug pa/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi phug pa gong 'og bar gsum/ gser bzhengs mchod rten phug pa/ sangs rgyas stong sku'i phug pa bcas brag phug brkos ma bdun las grub pa dang bye brag phug pa bdun cu lhag yod/ rgyal khab rim pa'i rig rdzas srung skyob sde khag tu drangs yod/khyung tsha dge bshes rab brtan zhes pas de snga'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgya bskyed de je rgyas su btab cing btsun pa lnga brgya lhag 'dus par grags/ phug pa kun las gser bzhengs mchod rten dang sangs rgyas stong sku'i ldeb ris bzhengs pa zhib tshags che zhing sku nyams gson por mngon/ de las lhag tu ngo mtshar ltad mo'am mjal phyag bya yul lha gnas sum cu so gsum zhes pa'i lha khang ngam phug pa che shos kyi bzhengs sku thams cad brkos ma yin pa dang /

ma thel dgon pa'i dkar chag dang dgon mtshan thogs tshul skor gleng ba/ 67rang byung mchod rten mang bos dad ldan skye bo'i mig la mchi ma bsnyil ba dang dad pa med pa'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog par 'gyur/ da dung phyi'i yul ljongs las pad ri'i lha rtse zhes pa dang / 'brug nyal ltag 'gyed/ gling rta'i rmig rjes/ gsom gsang rbab chu zhes pa la sogs pa'i ljongs rgyu'i ltad mo tshar du dngar ba yod/ bod dar nang bstan lha khang zhes pa'i phug pa de zab la smis so gsum phyed dang zheng la smis nyer drug phyed tsam mchis te sgo khyams dang /mchod gnas/ bzhugs klog nang gral phyi gral bcas tshan pa du mas grub par/ kun dga' ra ba chen po zhe drug gi nang du yon rgyal rabs su sa skya'i bdag chen dam pa rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i rdo sku mi tshad can bzhugs su gsol/ ngo mtshar 'di 'dra ni krung go'i lo rgyus su gzhan zhig mthong thos su gyur ma myong / phug pa 'dir lha'i dngos grub tu bstsal ba'i chu mig cig byon par dbyar dus brug rgyu dang dgun khar skam rgyu med cing yan lag brgyad ldan gyi ngo bos mi rnams ched dmigs gsol chu len par 'ongs/ phug pa brgyad pa'i shar byang gi brag zur du rta mchog chen po'i rmig rjes gsal lhang lhang zhig rang byung du mchis pa'ang mjal yul du snang /de'ang rta rmig dgon nam ma thel dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling gi mtshan chags tshul gyi cha nas spros na bshad tshul gnyis snang ba las/ dang po la gnyis te/ brag phug brgyad pa'i shar byang gi brag zur du rta mchog chen po'i rmig rjes gsal lhang lhang zhig rang byon du gnas pa la rgya nag zhi han gong ma'i lha rta'i rmig rjes red dang / bod kyi gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i ring la hor gling g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi rta mchog rkyang rgod g.yer ba'i rmig rjes su ngos bzung / gnyis pa ni/ spyi lo1247par 'gro mgon yab sras lang gru'u sde bzhir phebs te hor rgyal khrin ci se han gyi snag tsha go dan dang mjal 'dzoms la sgug ring / khu bo sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gdan sa de ga'i

68 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho3ma ched sbong slob grwa'i dpyadastsom phyogs bsgrigs/sangs rgyas stong sku'i sgrub phug tu phebs pa na/ rdo pha bong gru bzhi zhig gi 'khris su grub chen bgres song zhig gi phyag tu gser bye sder gang btegs ste/gdan sa 'di ga rgya bskyed du bzheng rgyu dang / de la mtshan stsol gnang rgyu sogs zhus/ de nas rtsig rmang 'phab pa na g.yang ṭi'i tham ga zhig brnyed/de'i gting ngos su gsal byed ma yig rang byon cig yod pa'i ma dang / tham ga ni thel tse ste tshig sdud byas pas ‘‘ma thel/’’de'i mthar dgon pa sbyar bas ‘‘ma thel dgon pa ’’zhes grags/ de phyis ma thel zhes pa rgya yig gi lam nas sgra mtshungs kyi sgo nas rta'i skad dod paṃ dang rmig pa'i skad dod tho bris te paṃtho r+shazhes btags pas/ gong du bshad pa'i rgya nag zhi han gong ma'i rmig rjes red dang / ge sar rgyal po'i rta mchog rkyang rgod g.yer ba'i rmig rjes red ces pa'i ngag sgros dang stes dbang gis don mtshungs su song ba'i sgo nas rgyun 'byams su gyur par snyam/ de yang chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang du (2690)byang gi bod sog gi mtshams kyi chu nag dang nye ba'i gan cu zhes pa'i sa'i cha'i mi nyag (bod )rgyal po'i pho brang gi rgyab kyi brag la g.yu yi sgrol ma nang rten du yod pa'i tā re'i lha khang dang bka' gdams glegs bam du bshad pa'i rgyal po blo gros 'phel gyi ral gris klu bdud btul tshe bsnams pa'i rang gri nang rten du yod zer ba'i mchod rten bcas brag ngos der lha khang nyer lnga dang lha khang gsar pa gnyis dang 'du khang sogs kyang yod pa'i g.yas zur du ma thi (thel )si zhes grags pa'i dgon dga' ldan dam chos gling zhes pa khyung tsha rin po ches btab ces gsungs pa las kyang ma thi zhes yi ge ma dag kyang sgra mtshungs su yod pa gsal lo/ /dgon 'di'i dang thog gi phug pa ni ha lam rgya nag rgyal rabs las cin (au)shar ma'i dus nas 'go tshugs par gleng / de nas lo ngo chig stong sum brgya ring brgyud cing chags 'jig dang gyong rgud yang yang thebs/ yon rgyal

ma thel dgon pa'i dkar chag dang dgon mtshan thogs tshul skor gleng ba/ 69rabs dang de las snga mo'i dus nas bzung mu mthud du srung skyob dang bskyar bzhengs mdzad/ phug pa'i brkos sku sangs rgyas stong sku dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku 'khor bcas gsar gtod che zhing brjid du chags pas kan su'u'i phug rnying legs gras su gyur pa dang / ming rgyal khri lo bcu bzhi pa 1716lor gong ma chan lung lha skyong rgyal pos rta sga dang lba ba 'brug ris ma bstsal pa da lta'ang tshags su nyar yod/ de la'ang sgrol ma rang byon lha khang dang rta mgrin lha khang mtshams sbyor gyi tshul du bshad na/ sgrol ma rang byon lha khang ni/ lha gnas so gsum gyi gnas khang gi gtso sku sgrol ma rang byon yin pas tā re nyer gcig gi gzugs sku dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ kun rig so bdun sogs bzhugs snang /de yang ngag rgyun du gna' snga mo zhig la/ sa der kun bzang lha mor 'bod pa'i srin mo sdig pa can zhig yod zer/ des mi nor la gtses shing gnod pa bzod du med pa btang / skabs der rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs las/ dbus gtsang phyogs nas rgyal bu blo gros 'phel gyi bla ma a ba ju ti ba phebs te srin mo de chos la bkug sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas zhes pa'i brag ri der gnas bskor byed du bcug de nas yun ring song ba na/nyin zhig mos bskor lam du sgo phyes shig sgo phyes shig ces pa'i skad brgyab pa thos pa dang / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du bltas kyang ci yang ma mthong bas ha las/ gnas tshul de dag grub chen mdo sde ba la ji bzhin zhus pa la/ khyod kyis da dung yang de skad thos byung na sgo phye yod/ sgo phye yod ces lan rgyobs gsungs/ de nas mo rang snga ma bzhin bskor lam du song ba na yang sgo phyes shig ces pa'i skad de thos pa dang / sgo phye yod/ sgo phye yod ces skad gsang mthon pos sgrog pa dang mnyam du/ skad cig nyid la sa g.yos ri yom/ mtho zhing gzar ba'i brag ri kha phyes/ brag srub tu khung bu zhig brdol/ brag khung

70 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas mdzes shing sdug la lta bas chog kyang mi shes pa'i lha mo zhig mthong yul du mngon/ de ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sprul te rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma 'jig rten mi yul du byon pa dngos so/ / de la'ang bshad rgyun gzhan zhig yod pa ni/ nyin zhig gi mtshan mor dgon pa'i mkhan po bde rgu zhabs drung rin po ches dgon de'i (byang dgon )brag rtse ru 'od zhags gsal la mi gsal ba zhig 'tsher ba mthong ba dang / brag rtser 'dzegs te gzigs mor phebs pa na rma bya'i mgrin 'dra zhes pa'i rin po che mdog sngon po mtho tshad sor bzhi can gyi sgrol sku rang byon nam g.yu yi sgrol ma rang byon zhig bzhugs pa de'o/ / de nas mkhan po nyid kyis sgrol sku khru gsum tsam zhig bzhengs te g.yu sgrol rang byon de gzungs gzhug tu phul/ de yang gong du dgon pa'i mtshan thogs kyi skor du mi nyag rgyal po'i pho brang gi rgyab kyi brag la g.yu yi sgrol ma nang rten du yod pa'i tā re'i lha khang zhes pa sogs kyis kyang g.yu yi sgrol ma rang byon gyi lo rgyus mtshon pa'o/ / de'ang spyi lo 195rdopar re zhig 'jig mod/ spyi lo 1khar6par g.yu sgrol rang byon phyir chud de sde tsha dgon pa'i bla ma rje grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskyar bzhengs rab gnas mdzad de tā re lha khang du sgrol sku nyer gcig dang bcas mjal du snang ngo / /rta mgrin lha khang ni/ rten gyi gtso bo ste yongs grags su byu ru'i rta mgrin dmar po zer/ gna' snga mo'i dus su don mthun gyi tshong ba mi nyung ba zhig rgya mtshor skyod pa na 'thor rlung drag po'i rlabs kyis gru gzings gtor/tshong ba dang ded dpon lhan gyis gzings shing ya 'thor du song ba rnams thogs te srin mo'i gling phran zhig tu phyin/ der gzhes kyi srin mo rnams mdzes shing sdug pa la 'dod zhen brkam chags kyi spu long rnam par g.yo ba'i don mthun dag kun nas 'phreng ste srin mo dang mnyam du re zhig skyid dga'i dpal la rol/ phyis su srin mo yin pa dang g.yo 'og tu tshud pa sogs shes te 'byol

ma thel dgon pa'i dkar chag dang dgon mtshan thogs tshul skor gleng ba/ 71thabs kyi grabs gshom pa srin mo dag gis tshor cing gson gzan gyi nyen la thug pa na/ lha rta mgrin dmar pos bskyabs te rang rang gnas su 'dengs par byas shing pha ma nye 'brel dang 'phrad/ bde skyid 'tsho ba la rol/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la blo kha phyogs pa nas bzung ste sa de ga'i skye 'gro thams cad lha rta mgrin dmar por ha cang gis kyang dad do/ / de yang ngag rgyun gzhan zhig ni/ de ga'i sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas zhes pa'i brag phug tu ma ṇi'i rta mgrin rang byon sor mo gsum gyi sku tshad can zhig yod pa de phyis su rta mgrin lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa dang mnyam du rta mgrin gyi lha sku bzhengs skabs gzungs bzhug tu phul/'dir yang thugs rje chen po'i lha khang zhig yod kyang / der dung gi thugs rje chen po rang byon zhig yod ces da lam go thos su yod kyang mjal yul du mi snang bas shin tu nas kyang phangs so /(dpyad rtsom 'di 2006lor kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar ba'i 〈bod rgyud nang bstan dgon pa'i dkar chag kan su'u glegs bam 〉las bdams/)

72༄ / / 'khor phyogs gsum gyi byed phyogs lag tu bstar nas skad yig slob khrid kyi rnam pa gsar pa zhig gtod dgos/gdugasadakar skyabs/slob gso'i kha phyogs deng rabs can dang 'dzam gling dang ma 'ongs pa gsum la 'khor dgos pa ni rang rgyal slob gso'i bya ba spyi'i rtsa ba'i byed phyogs shig yin/ byed phyogs 'dis lo rgyus kyi dus rabs gsar pa'i nang rang rgyal gyi slob gso'i las don gong du 'phel bar kha phyogs gsar pa dang skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i mdun lam zhig bstan yod/'khor phyogs gsum po ni kha bral du gtong mi rung ba'i phung bo gcig yin la deng rabs can la kha phyogs pa ni gtso phyogs yin/ phyogs gsum po phan tshun brten cing 'brel la nus pa 'don res byed bzhin yod la so sor don snying zab mo re ldan/slob gso'i kha phyogs deng rabs can la 'khor ba zhes pa ni/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i shes rig dang dngos po'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dmangs gtso dang khrims lugs 'dzugs skrun bcas la kha phyogs te de dag gi dgos mkho la 'os mthun dang de dag la zhabs 'degs

'khor phyogs gsum la brten nas skad yig slob khrid kyi rnam gsar gtod dgos/ 73gang legs zhu bar 'bad dgos pa de la zer/slob gso'i kha phyogs 'dzam gling la 'khor ba zhes pa ni gang zhe na/ slob gso'i don sgrub na mig btsum zhing rna ba bcad la sgo yang brgyab nas rang srog skyob pa'i dpe ltar don dngos dang bral nas rang snang kho nar brten nas bya ba sgrub mi nyan te/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi slob gso'i bsam blo dang slob gso'i nang don/ slob gso'i rig pa dang slob gso'i thabs shes sngon thon can la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas nas rang re'i mi rigs slob gso'i gnas tshul dngos dang bstun nas bkol spyod byed cing gong 'phel du gtong bar brten mi rigs slob gso 'dzam gling sngon thon slob gso'i gral du chud par dka' spyad sdug rus bya dgos par zer ro/ /slob gso'i kha phyogs ma 'ongs par 'khor ba zhes pa ni/ slob gso ni ma 'ongs pa'i las don dang mi rabs gsar pa zhig skyed bsring byed pa'i las 'gul yin pa gsal por rtogs dgos par zer/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi ka gdung dang srog shing lta bu'i yon tan can ni da skabs kyi gzhon nu dang lo chung rnams yin nges la/ da nas bzung rim pa so so'i slob grwa so sos skyed bsring byas pa'i yon tan pa rnams kyis dus rabs 'di ga'i lo rabs gsar pa'i nang rang rgyal gyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas la phan nus chen po 'don thub par ma zad/ dus rabs gzhug mar shes yon can dang stobs shugs kyang gra sgrig byas yod/'khor phyogs gsum pos slob gso'i bya ba sgrub mkhan rnams kyi bsam blo je brtan dang ngos zin je gsal du btang yod cing skad yig slob khrid kyi tshad gzhi'ang je mthor btang yod pas/ skad yig gi slob khrid thad la bcos sgyur cis kyang byas nas rnam pa gsar ba zhig gtod par 'bad pa mi bya ka med red/

74 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osasatho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nye ba'i lo 'ga' zhig gi ring la/ slob 'bring gi skad yig slob khrid la bcos sgyur byas nas grub 'bras nges can zhig thob yod mod/ mdun du skyod bzhin yod pa'i deng rabs can bzhi po'i 'dzugs skrun gyi gom stabs dang mthun thabs med/ skad yig gi slob khrid ni deng rabs can la rkang ba btsugs shing 'thab jus kyi bsam pa bzung nas bcos sgyur bya dgos/bcos sgyur bya dgos sa ni gang zhe na/ slob khrid kyi bsam blo dang slob gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun/ slob khrid byed tshul/ slob khrid kyi thabs shes sogs so/bsam blo bcos sgyur bya rgyu ni slob khrid bcos sgyur byed pa'i rtsa ba'i gnad don zhig yin pas/ don dag gsum thag cis kyang gcod dgos te gang zhe na/(gcig)bang mdzod smra ba'i lta ba dor nas slob khrid ni dge rgan gyis shes bya rgyu ma blug blug dang slob mas shes bya dngos po gsog gsog kho na min la/ shes rgya je cher song ba'i thog nas nus pa skyed bsring dang blo rig 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos pa gsal por rtogs dgos/(gnyis/)khrid par mthong chen dang slob par mthong chung byed pa'i bsam blo bsgyur nas dge rgan ni lam ston dang slob ma ni lam 'gro lta bu yin pa rtogs nas dge rgan gyis slob khrid ji ltar byed pa zhib 'jug bya dgos par ma zad/ slob mas ji ltar slob par zhib 'jug bya dgos la/ slob ma tsho'i skad yig slob pa'i hur sems skul bar thabs brgya jus stong bya dgos/(gsum/)skad yig ni spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba gtug byed kyi yod byad cig yin pas slob khrid ni slob khang kho nar brten mi rung ste spyi tshogs kyi lag len dang 'brel gang thub byas nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba ni skad yig slob khrid kyi rgyab ljongs chen por 'gyur bar 'jug dgos/slob gzhi rtsom sgrig gi thad la do snang bya dgos sa gang dag yod ce na/

'khor phyogs gsum la brten nas skad yig slob khrid kyi rnam gsar gtod dgos/ 75(gcig)slob gzhi ni deng rabs can du sgyur dgos/ blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis gsungs par slob gzhi las deng rabs tshan rig dang rig gnas kyi sngon thon chu tshad mtshon dgos la rang rgyal gyi gnas tshul dngos dang mthun dgos zhes so/ da ltar spyod bzhin yod pa'i skad yig gi slob gzhir dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur mi mngon la bro ba'ang de tsam med de spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa gsar pa dang 'tsho ba gsar pa mtshon pa'i brtsams chos shin tu nyung bas/ 'tsho ba gsar pa mtshon pa'i brtsams chos phul byung can dang deng rabs spyi tshogs la dgos mkho che ba'i rtsom yig cis kyang snon dgos/(gnyis/)slob gzhi'i shes bya'i sgrig gzhir do snang bya dgos/ slob ma tsho'i skad yig gi nus pa skyed bsring byed par shes bya gang dag khrid dgos pa dang / shes bya so so'i tshan rig dang mthun pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa'i grangs ka mang nyung dang / ci ltar byas na shes bya ni phra zhing zhib la go rim dang ldan par 'gyur ba sogs ni thag gcod 'os 'tsham bya dgos/(gsum/)'chad nyan klog 'bri bzhi po'i 'brel ba thag gcod dgos/phyogs 'dus can gyi slob gzhi zhig yin na 'chad nyan klog 'bri bzhi po slob deb cig gi nang du 'dus yod cing / skad yig gi slob deb ni brgyud rim yod pa'i skye ldan phung bo zhig tu sgyur ched 'chad nyan klog 'bri bzhi po'i bar gyi 'brel ba thag gcod 'os 'tsham byas te phan tshun gyi 'brel sa dang mthud mtshams gsal por bya dgos/(bzhi/)slob deb kyi go rim sgrig pa 'os 'tsham yin dgos/ skad yig gi slob gzhi ni sla mo nas dka' mo dang rim bzhin je zab tu 'gro ba'i rtsa don ltar sgrig dgos/ slob deb re re'i bar them rgal re dgos te them rgal re re'i bar drang thig ltar gong du thad kar 'phar mi rung ste slob ma tsho'i ngos 'dzin dang nus rtsal gnyis kyi khyad chos dang mthun par byas te gcus ris

76 gtsosami rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ltar rim bzhin gong du 'phags par bya dgos/ 'o na deb re re'i bar rgal ci tsam 'jog dgos pa dang gcus ris re re'i bar thag ci tsam yin dgos pa sogs la zhib 'jug nan mo byas nas thag gcod dgos/mig sngar khab rgyag rgyag dang lugs srol can gyi slob khrid byed thabs da dung khyab che bas slob ma tsho'i slob sbyong la rang 'gul dang hur sems med par gyur 'dug gnas tshul 'di sgyur dgos na rmang gzhi sra brtan dang nus pa skyed bsring dang blo rig 'phel rgyas bcas kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas khab rgyag rgyag lta bu'i khrid tshul dor nas blo sgo 'byed pa'i khrid thabs spel dgos/da ltar nga tsho'i slob khrid kyi thabs shes gtso bo ni kha nas 'chad pa dang nag pang ngos su 'bri ba tsam las med/ 'di ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin rung dus rgyun du de tsam kyis mi chog pas/ cha rkyen gang legs gsar du bskrun nas slob khrid kyi thabs shes kyang deng rabs can du sgyur dgos te/ sgra phab dang brnyan phab/ glog brnyan/ rgyang grags/ skad sbyong tshod lta khang /glog klad sogs spyad nas 'chad nyan klog 'bri'i sbyong brdar ni dus dang yul gnyis kyi bkag rgya las grol te gson nyams ldan zhing mngon sum du grub pa'i dpyad gzhi thob la grub 'bras kyang legs po thob par byas nas kha dang sa smyug kho nar brten pa'i srol rgyun gyi khrid tshul bcos sgyur bya dgos/'dir nga tshos shes dgos pa ni gang zhe na/ dma' rim slob 'bring ni grong khyer dang zhing 'brog sa khul du khyab yod cing slob ma'i grangs ka'ang mang /kho tsho ni 'gyur bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun dang dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i dus 'gor 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i stobs shugs gtso bo yin pas/ skad yig bcos sgyur byas na dma' 'bring ni gtso gnad yin/ 'di ni dma' 'bring skad yig tshan khag gi khyad chos dang dgos mkho gnyis dang mthun zhing rang rgyal slob gso'i sgrig lam bcos sgyur byed pa dang mthun no/

'khor phyogs gsum la brten nas skad yig slob khrid kyi rnam gsar gtod dgos/ 77skad yig gi slob khrid bcos sgyur ji ltar bya dgos zhe na/ rang snang du gang shar gyis mi chog la slob gso'i tshod ltar phan 'bras yod pa'i thabs shes shig yin dgos/slob gso'i tshod lta ni slob gso'i khyab khongs su gtogs pa'i tshan rig gi tshod lta'i rnam pa dmigs bsal can zhig yin la/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi tshod dpag dmigs bsal la brten cing cha rkyen nan mor bzung nas sgrub pa yin/ dmigs yul ni tshod lta'i 'bras bur brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas nas slob gso dang slob khrid kyi nang don dang rnam pa dang thabs shes bcas la skyon yon gang yod pa gsal por 'byed cing rang nyid kyi tshod dpag la tshan rig gi rin thang dang dngos mkho'i rin thang yod med la brtag dpyad byed par brten lag len 'khyol thub cing khyon yongs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bcos sgyur byed thabs dang 'char gzhi bkod sgrig bya dgos/phyi rgyal du slob khrid bcos sgyur byed pa ni slob gso'i tshod ltar rkang ba 'dzugs pa yin te/ u ru su rgyal khab kyi slob gso rig pa dang sems khams rig pa gnyis la mkhas pa tsan kha'o h+phu'u zhes pa ni u ru su slob gso'i tshan rig khang spyi khyab slob gso zhib 'jug sa'o slob khrid dang gong spel tshod lta khang gi 'go khrid pa yin la/ khong gis 'go khrid pa'i 'og tu spyi lo 1957nas 1kha77lor khong sku 'das pa'i bar lo ngo nyi shu ring la slob khrid la tshod lta mang po byas te tshod lta'i 'bras bu phyogs sdom byas pa'i thog nas gong du spel ba'i slob khrid kyi lta ba spel ba red/ a me ri ka'i sems khams rig pa dang slob gso rig pa mkhas can pu'u lu'u nā zer bas rig gzhung tshan khag gi rtsa ba'i grub char sbyong dgos pa nan gyis bshad pa dang / slob ma tsho'i blo rig 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu dang gsar mthong gi thabs shes khyab gdal du spyad nas spel ba dang / slob khrid kyi nang don dang khrid thabs/ yon tan can

78 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/myur du skyed bsring byed pa sogs kyi thad la rang gi lta ba thun mong ma yin pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas yod/ khong gi dgongs pas skul 'ded byed pa'i 'og tu a me ri kar lo rabs lnga bcu'i dus mjug nas bzung slob chung dang slob 'bring gi slob khrid bcos sgyur la tshod lta rgya chen po byas/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring rang rgyal gyi skad yig slob khrid kyi tshod lta ni grong khyer dang grong rdal gnyis kyi slob grwar khyab par spel te de'i nang gtso gnad du gyur pa'i slob 'bring dang spyir btang gi slob 'bring yod la/ grong khyer gyi slob 'bring dang cha rkyen cung zhan pa'i grong gseb kyi slob 'bring yang yod/ tshod lta'i slob grwa dang tshod lta'i 'dzin grwa mang che bar grub 'bras thob pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng nas sngon nas dmigs pa'i yul der skyod bzhin yod cing dge rgan phul byung can mang che bas kyang tshod lta'i 'bras bu blangs yod/ dma' 'bring gi skad yig lo ngo gsum la sbyong mthar phyin min gyi tshod lta dang / rigs dbye ba dang phyogs gcig tu bsdu ba dang dus rim dbye ba'i sgo nas skad cha spyong brdar byed pa'i tshod lta dang / rtsom 'bri snying bor bzung nas skad yig slob khrid byed pa'i tshod lta/ slob thengs shig la slob tshan mang po slob khrid byed thabs dang /skor tshan slob khrid byed thabs sogs kyang tshan rig zhib 'jug thog nas grub 'bras thob yod/ dper mtshon 'di dag las snyon du mi srid pa ni gang zhe na/slob gso'i tshod lta ni skad yig slob khrid bcos sgyur byas nas tshan rig can du 'gyur bar byed pa'i bgrod lam yang dag pa yin no/slob gsor tshod lta byas na rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yang dag pa mdzub ston du 'jog dgos/ de las ldog na tshod ltar dmigs yul med pas lam gol bar ma zad tha na pham kha'ang nyo nges/ de'i phyir brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas te skad yig slob khrid kyi lo rgyus dang da lta'i gnas tshul la zhib mor dpyod cing / tshod lta byed pa'i skabs su brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten

'khor phyogs gsum la brten nas skad yig slob khrid kyi rnam gsar gtod dgos/ 79nas dka' khag khyad du gsod 'os/ slob gso'i tshod lta ni 'brel med kher rkyang du bya mi rung ste 'go khrid dang blo mthun rnams kyi rgyab skyor la brten nas nyams myong brje res dang phan tshun slob sbyong byas na slob gso'i tshod lta'i don 'grub cing 'bras bu'ang legs po thob nges/ /dpyad rtsom 'di 2001lo'i zla5par kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpar ba'i 〈dma' 'bring bod kyi skad yig slob khrid byed thabs 〉las bdams/

80༄ / / bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/sgom pa bkra shis/bod du dar ba'i chos lugs kyi cho ga sna tshogs las/ dmangs khrod kyi bsang gtong ba sogs kyi cho ga byed srol ni/ bod rang sa nas dar ba'i sa skyes rdo skyes kyi rig gnas snang tshul zhig yin zhing / de ni bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs bon gyi cho ga byed srol rnams 'das zin pa'i dus yun ring mo'i lo zla'i 'khor 'gros kyi khrod du 'phel 'gyur rabs dang rim pa brgyud nas byung ba zhig yin no/ /bod pa rnams kyi khrod du dar srol che ba'i cho ga de rigs spel skabs su/cho ga'i phan nus mngon du 'gyur bar dmigs nas/ sngags bon rnams kyis cho ga'i smrang zhes pa'i gyer tshig rnga gshang sogs rol mo dang sbrags te gyer 'don byed pa yin/ cho ga spel skabs kyi gyer bya'i tshig la ‘‘smrang ri’ dang ‘‘'phyongs ’’‘‘glu bo che ’’sogs zer srol yod kyang 'dir go bde ba'i ched du cho ga'i gyer tshig ces brjod pa yin/bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig ni bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi nang nas dar 'go ches snga ba'i rtsom lus shig yin zhing /bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi grub cha gal chen zhig yin pa bsnyon du med kyang / rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis/ da lta'i bar du 'di'i skor la phyogs

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 81yongs nas zhib 'jug brgyud rim dang ldan pa zhig da dung gnang yod pa ma mthong bas/ stong cha de skong thub pa byung na bod kyi rtsom rig la phyogs yongs dang cha tshang ba'i nges shes 'drongs par dngos yod kyi don snying mi dman pa bdog go snyam pa dang de'i phyogs la 'bad pa cung zad byed 'dod pa'i blos dpyad rtsom 'di sug las su bgyis pa yin/dang po/ bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs/spyir gdod ma'i rang byung chos lugs zer ba ni 'jig rten gyi dngos po kun la rnam shes sam bla srog yod par 'dod pa'am/ yang na rang byung las 'das pa'i stobs shugs la lha zer ba'i gang zag nus mthu mtha' yas pa zhig gi 'du shes bzung ba'i bsam blo la brten nas byung zhes mkhas pa tsho'i khrod du grags che yang / bod pa tshos phyi 'jig rten gyi dngos po thams cad klu gnyan sa bdag zer ba sogs kyi gang zag ‘‘mi ma yin ’’gyis bdag tu bzung bar 'dod pa las/ sa rdo ri brag dang rtsi shing nags tshal sogs la rnam shes sam bla srog yod par mi 'dod pa ni/ li shus mdzad pa'i〈yul sa'i 'gras bsdum 〉dhilas/ ma sangs yul lha gnyan po rnams/ / sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi tshogs/ / tsang tsang 'khor ba sa yi bdag/ lha mo brtan ma la sogs te/ / sa la mnga' mdzad thams cad la/ / zhes dang / khyung rgod rtsal gyis gter nas bton pa'i 〈yul sa'i bsang mchod 〉dhilas/ stong gsum srid pa'i 'jig rten dang / / yul ri sa phyogs 'di dag la/ / gnas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan dang / / yul sa gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ / zhes dang / 〈gtsang ma klu 'bum dkar po 〉dhilas/ gnyan zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' la gnas/ sa bdag ces bya ba ni sa la gnas/ klu zhes bya ba chu la gnas/ zhes bshad pa sogs shes byed kyi lung ches shin tu mang bo yod cing /

82 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/de las nga tshos ‘‘mi ma yin mthu bo che rnams kyis srid par dbang bsgyur bar ’’'dod pa ni gna' rabs bod mi rnams kyi 'jig rten lta tshul zhig yin zhing /de la brten nas ‘‘mi ma yin ’’bkur ba dang de la gsol mchod byed pa'i cho ga byed thabs sna tshogs gsar du bzos pa las ‘‘brdol bon ’’du grags pa'i bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs byung ba rtogs thub pas/ bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs ni 'dzam gling gi gdod ma'i chos lugs gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa zhig go/ /gnyis pa/ bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga byed srol/dbyin ji'i mi'i rigs tshan dpyod rig pa ba h+phu rus zer (/ tri bhu1tsho01)gyis/ mi'i rigs yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i brgyud rim khrod du/ cho ga byed srol byung ba ni chos lugs byung ba las kyang snga shas cheXzhes bshad yod pa ltar/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs lo rgyus steng du chos lugs dang cho ga byed srol gnyis po dus mnyam du byung ba min par cho ga byed srol byung snga zhing / cho ga byed srol ni 'gro ba mi'i spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs ha cang zhan pa'i dus su byung ba ste/ gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs kyi chu tshad dang gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi blo tshod gcig 'dra yin phyir/ kho tshos rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gzhigs byed stangs ltar/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas ‘‘mi ma yin ’’gyi stobs shugs kha lo bsgyur 'dod pa'i kun slong la brten nas gdod ma'i cho ga byed srol byung bar 'dod do/ /mdo dbus mtho sgang du 'tsho ba'i gna' bo'i bod mi rnams kyis/ dus yun ring bo'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i lag len gyi khrod nas/ rang nyid 'tsho gnas byed sa'i rang byung khams chen por gnyug ma nas rdzu 'phrul che zhing phan gnod sna tshogs byed pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa'i ‘‘mi ma yin mthu bo

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 83che ’’bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas shing / de dag gis snod bcud bdag tu bzung zhing dbang sgyur gyi yod pa'i bsam pa'i 'du shes byung ba dang chabs cig tu/ ‘‘mi ma yin ’’de dag gis rang la phan pa'i grogs byed pa dang gnod pa'i gegs sel ba'i ched du/ de dag la mchod bkur byed pa dang / phog thug btang ba'i nyes pa sel byed kyi cho ga byed srol sna tshogs bzos/ cho ga byed srol gyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas dar rgyas su phyin pa'i gdod ma'i chos lugs la brdol bon nam rgyu'i bon zer zhing / gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga de rigs sgrub mkhan la gshen dang gyer/ bon/ le'u/ lha bdag sogs 'bod srol mi 'dra ba du ma yod/ lha gsol klu mchod dang 'gras bcos 'khrugs bsdum byed pa sogs kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga byed srol sna tshogs dus da lta'i bar bod pa rnams kyi khrod du ma nyams par yod do/ /gsum pa/ gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i rgyar chig1 cho ga'i gyer tshig byung tshul/rigs kyi ni lha bdar na/ / khungs kyi ni smrang gyer ro/ / duzhes dang /nyin gsum nyin la chas su bsags/ / mtshan gsum mtshan la smrang du gyer/ / dhizhes pa ltar/ cho ga sgrub skabs cho ga'i gyer tshig skad kyi gcong dgu'i du'adon rta la drangs te dbyangs su gyer ba ni cho ga'i nang don gyi grub cha gal chen zhig ste/ cho ga'i gyer tshig de rigs dang thog ki ki bso bso zhes lha 'bod klu bskul gyi gdung ba'i nga ro sgrog pa nas rim gyis ‘‘glu bo che ’’dang ‘‘smrang ’’‘‘tshig bshad ’’sogs zer srol yod pa'i ngag rtsom gyi rnam pa zhig tu gyur cing / spyi tshogs yar rgyas su phyin pa dang chabs cig tu/ cho ga sgrub pa'i bya ba ched du gnyer ba'i bon po byung rjes su/ de dag gis mgo 'dzin mdzad de cho ga sgrub skabs bod mi snga rabs pa thun mong gis gsar rtsom byas shing /

84 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du chu lam zhugs dang rdo lag brgyud kyi tshul du ngag nas ngag du brgyud pa'i srid pa chags rabs dang / srid pa'i mi rgyud grol rabs sogs brjod bya gtso bor gyur pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig gi rigs rnams cho ga'i phan nus mngon 'gyur 'ong ba'i ched du gyer srol byung ba ni bon gyi 〈mdo gzer mig 〉rjolas/ bon sla 'gyur gyi sde ni/ chab nag srid pa rgyud kyi bon gyer ba la spro ba'o/ / zhes dang / 〈bstan pa rjes bzhag gi mdo'i 〉dhile'u las/ chab nag srid pa bon la gtogs pa ni/ shes rab rgyud sbyangs tshig gi lo rgyus mang bo sbyar ba'o/ / phyi rgyud shi thabs 'dur thabs dang / /nang rgyud na thabs glud thabs dang / / bar rgyud gso thabs gto thabs gsum/ / sems can don du mang bo tshogs par gyer/ / zhes dang / 〈snang gshen theg pa'i mdo'i 〉nyule'u las/ smrang ni zhib la rgyas pa bya/ / chab nag nus pa smrang las 'byung / / dpon gsas nus pa ting 'dzin las/ / de phyir chab nag smrang gis gtso/ / zhes bshad pa sogs kyis shes nus so/ /dbyin ji'i mi'i rigs tshan dpyod rig pa ba ma lin na'o si ke (2 ྾ma1sa0tebyasmo1 )yis/ gdod ma'i cho ga la skad cha'i nus pa bed spyod cher byed cing / skad cha la brten nas bskul ba byed pa dang / bden tshig brjod pa/ 'grub dgos pa'i dmigs bya la tha tshig sgrog par byed pa yin/ zhes dang / lha sgrung dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i mes po gong ma dang / rig gnas khrod kyi dpa' bo rnams lung 'dren pa yinaldizhes bshad pas/ cho ga'i phan nus mngon 'gyur byed thabs su srid pa chags rabs dang / srid pa'i mi rgyud grol rabs sogs kyi lha sgrung 'chad pa dang / bden tshig brjod pa sogs ni gna' bo'i mi rigs so so thun mong gi srol zhig yin tshod 'dug go/phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs dgu pa yas mas su/ gna' snga mo nas dar ba'i gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga byed srol yig thog tu bkod pas/ gdod

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 85ma'i don brjod snyan tshig gi rang bzhin can gyi gna' bo'i cho ga'i gyer tshig mang bo zhig da lta'i bar nyar tshags bya thub pa byung / yin na'ang / da lta nga tsho'i mthong yul du gyur pa'i cho ga'i yig cha de dag lo ngo chig stong lhag gi dus yun ring bo brgyud nas byung ba yin pas/ ‘‘ban la bon 'dres bon la ban 'dres pa'i ’’rig gnas gsar rnying mnyam 'dres kyi shan zhugs yod pa smos ma dgos/de yang bon la ‘‘bsgyur bon ’’dang ‘‘bon gsar ma'i lugs ’’zer ba'i chos bon 'dres ma'i lugs byung zhing / ban de rnams la mtshon na/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis bon gyi lha mang bo dam la btags nas de dag gsol mchod byed thabs kyi cho ga 'ga' zhig la chos kyi chings mdzad pa dang /be+e ro tsa na dang dran pa nam mkha' sogs kyi sku ring nas bon gyi bsang sel gto mdos la sogs pa'i cho ga byed thabs du ma nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs su bsgyur te chos kyi cha lag tu bed spyod srol byung bas/ ban bon gyi cho ga'i yig cha spyi dang bye brag cho ga'i gyer tshig gi khrod du ban bon gyi lugs gnyis ka'i chos skad du ma phar bsre tshur bsre byas pa'i snang tshul byung yod par ma zad/ phyis kyi sngags bon rnams kyis blo bzo dang gsar rtsom byas pa'ang yod nges pa yin/2 cho ga'i gyer tshig gi nang don/gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi nang don gtso bo ni/〈mdo dri med gzi brjid 〉⑫las/ dang por phyi snod chags pa dang / / srid pa ji ltar srid pa dang / / skos pas ji ltar bskos pa dang / / mi rgyud gang ltar grol ba dang / / sngon gyi cho rabs bshad pa dang / bden pa'i smrang gis bkrol ba ste/ / zhes pa ltar/ gna' rabs bod mi rnams kyis rang gi blo kha dang 'tsham par phyi snod kyi srid pa ste 'jig rten gyi rang byung khor yug chags

86 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshul dang / nang bcud kyi srid pa ste lha mi sems can byung tshul/ srid pa'i bskos rabs te 'jig rten gyi dngos po kun gyi bskos thang ngam bkod thang bshad pa/ srid pa'i mi rgyud grol tshul te 'jig rten du mi'i 'gro ba byung tshul/sngon gyi cho rabs bshad pa ste cho ga byed srol gyi khungs sam lo rgyus dang / cho ga'i phan nus sogs bshad pa bcas yin zhing / gzhan yang shis brjod 'dod gsol bstod bskul bsang rngon g.yang 'bod mo tshig sogs kyang cho ga'i gyer tshig gi brjod bya yin/ de'i skor cho ga'i yig cha rnams las 'dir dpe mtshon tsam drangs na/(1)srid pa chags rabs brjod pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig ni/ dper na/〈lha tshan dkar po 〉⑫zhes pa las/ dang po ci yang med pa'i stong ba la/ / de las ye yod cung tsam srid/ / de las bag tsam rdul tsam srid/ / de las zil ba khrom tsam srid/ / de las rin chen ri rab cig tu srid/ / ces pa lta bu'o/ /(2)nang bcud kyi srid pa byung rabs brjod pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig ni/dper na/ 〈yul sa'i 'gras bsdum 〉stizhes pa las/ / kyai/ ma sangs yul lha gnyan po rnams/ / dang po rlung dang zer las srid/ / 'od las lha gar rten gsum srid/ / rlung dang mtsho gnyis bshos pa las/ / dung sgong dkar po gcig tu srid/ / g.yu mtsho dkar mo'i nang du gshegs/ / mi lus khyung gi gshog pa can gcig byung / / de dang mtsho gnyis bshos pa las/ / yul sa mgon byed mched gsum srid/ / de mtsho dkar lha mo gsum dang rol/ /char mang rgya mtsho mched gsum srid/ / char mang g.yu mtsho sprul ba las/ /yul sa lcam dral lnga ru srid/ / gcen po gangs dkar ti se dang / de 'og sa ri thang lha rje/ / de 'og yar lha mthu bo che/ / de 'og bar lha seng ge'i mgo/ / tha chung ge khod lha rgyud srid/ / mi mgon ming sring bco brgyad

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 87dang / / rma yi sa bdag spun dgu srid/ / de nas rim par grol ba yi/ / sa bdag yul lha gnyan po rnams/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(2)srid pa'i bskos rabs brjod pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig ni/ dper na/〈rdo sel dkar nag 〉nyuces pa las/ rtsa ba med pa'i dug sdong ser bo dang / / lo ma med pa'i dug sdong nag po gnyis/ / yod dang med gnyis mtshams su 'debs pa la/ / rtsi lo dug lo gnyis su byung / / rtsi lo lung gi yar mdor 'khrungs/ / dug lo lung gi mar mdor 'khrungs/ dug de dang po su yis btsal ba ni/ / zhe sdang rgyal bo sbrul gyis btsal ba yin/ / de yi phyir na sbrul dug 'khyil ba la/ / shing la dug bab shing dug glang ma yin/ / rdo la dug bab rdo dug khar (dkar )gong yin/ / sa la dug bab sa dug bong ba yin/ / chu la dug bab chu dug na rtswa yin/ / rtswa la dug bab rtswa dug ril lcag yin/ / ldum la dug bab sdum dug thang khrom yin/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(4)srid pa'i mi rgyud grol tshul brjod pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig ni/ dper na/ 〈mdo dri med 〉yizhes pa las/ ye smon 'phrul gyi rgyal bo dang / / rdzu 'phrul mi mo'i sprul ba las/ phywa dmu gtsug dang gsum du srid/ / che ba phywa rje sgam po dang / / de 'og dmu rje btsun po dang / / gcung bo gtsug rje og sko gsum/ / de dang gnam gnas bu gcig las/ / srid pa smon pa'i dbu nag srid/ / de dang yob chags 'od ma las/ / phywa rje ye mkhyen thang bo srid/ / de dang lha lcam bsdebs pa las/ / rdzu 'phrul gser gyi mi thung srid/ / de dang dung lcam dngul mo'i sras/ / phywa rab stag cha 'al 'ol srid/ / de dang mtshams za khyad khyud las/ / srid pa'i lha rabs mched bzhi srid/ / che ba ya bla bdal drug dang / / de 'og 'od de gung rgyal dang / de 'og khri lde sum po dang / / chung ba phywa rje ya bla bdal drug las/ / thug kar lha rabs gnyen po dang / / 'dzam gling sgo bzhi'i mi ru grol/ / de 'og 'od de gung rgyal las/ /

88 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/ge khod gnyan gyi lha rabs grol/ / de 'og khri lde sum po las/ / rdzu 'phrul yul sa'i gnyan dmag grol/ / phywa bla 'bram shing dgung du gshegs/ / dmu la dmu rje btsun po dang / / lha mo gung thang sprul ba las/ / dmu rabs 'then dgu'i tha ma la/ / rgyal rigs dpag pa'i mi rnams dang / / rje rigs bram ze rmang rigs te/ / 'dzam gling sog kha'i mi ru grol/ / gtsug la gtsug rje og sko dang / / phywa dmu gtsug gsum sprul ba las/ / 'dzam gling sogs kha'i mi ru grol/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(5)sngon gyi cho rabs brjod pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig ni/ dper na/〈bsen mo spun dgu'i mdos 〉⑪zhes pa las/ yul ni kha rag rtsang steng na/ / rgyal bo rtsang rje thod dkar des/ / yul ni mdo ri lung gsum na/ /mdo lcam rmang mo bag mar blangs/ / skar ma de ni skag la chas/ / lam dang de ni bshul nor bas/ / gangs chu g.ya' brag kun la 'drim/ / gdug byed bsen mo rnams kyis thos/ / bag ma'i phyi nas 'brang ste byung / / thams cad de ni kun gyis kyang / / kha nas ki 'debs ral ba gsigs/ / lag pa g.yab ste 'o dod 'bod/ / bag ma de ni smyos te na/ / der rtsang rje stobs kyi phyag can des/ / dman mo de ni spun dgu ni/ / bag ma'i phyi nas 'brang ba mthong / / de nas mdos glud gtor ma bshams/ / sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ / bsen mo rnams la bsngos te byin/ / btsun mo de nas gdon las grol/ / da dung gdug sems cho 'phrul bstan/ / rtsang rje thabs la mkhas pa des/ / drag po'i rdzas dang sngags kyi zil/ / yungs dkar rgyal bo phor nyar 'gyed/ / de tshe dman mo'i sde tshogs rnams/ / bya 'phur rjes su 'ur rdo bzhin/ / rang rang so so'i gnas su song / / sngon byung srid pa'i dpe bzhin du/ / de ring bdag dang yon bdag gis/ / mthun pa'i mdos glud 'di 'bul bzhes/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 892 cho ga'i gyer tshig gi rnam pa/gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi rnam pa gtso bo tshig rkang gi tsheg bar do mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad yin zhing / rtsom lus kyi cha nas tshigs bcad snyan tshig gi rigs su gtogs/ de la tsheg bar do mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad dang do mi mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad rigs gnyis su dbye chog tsheg bar do mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad la/ spyir btang du tsheg bar lnga can nas tsheg bar dgu can gyi bar du yod cing / tsheg bar bdun ma shas che ste/ de'i tshul dpe'i sgo nas mdo tsam mtshon par byas na/(1)tsheg bar lnga can ni/ dper na/ 〈klu btsan spyi mdos 〉yizhes pa las/ lho yi lho btsan ni/ /mi ser rta ru ser/ / ser bo nyi ma'i mdog /mi ser 'bum gyi rje/ / rta ser 'bum gyi bdag / snga zhags mda' ltar 'phen/ / phyi zhags sbrul ltar 'khril/ / zhes pa lta bu/( 2)tsheg bar drug can ni/ dper na/ 〈snang srid spyi mdos 〉⑫zhes pa las/ btsan rje ni ci la dgyes/ / bza' ba de sha la rngams/ / btung ba de khrag la rngams/ / len pa de srog dbugs len/ / mthun pa de bgegs dang mthun/ / sdong ba de bdud dang sdong / / skyob pa de bdud bon skyob/ /ces pa lta bu/( 2) tsheg bar bdun can ni/ dper na/ 〈bye'u chung gser mdos 〉tsozhes pa las/ / kyai/ dang po gnam med sa yang med/ / bar du gnam sa bar phye nas/ / skar ma smin drug srid pa mkhar/ / steng gi lha yang srid pa 'o/ / bar du myi yang srid pa 'o/ / 'og tu klu yang srid pa 'o/ / lha 'dre mi gsum srid pa 'o/ / zhes pa lta bu/(4) tsheg bar brgyad can ni/ dper na/ 〈rgyags brngan lha bsang 〉②zhes pa las/ pha gnam la 'brug chen lda ma ldir/ / ma sa la glog
