90 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chen gya ma gyu/ / bu rta sgo gangs kyi thig pa yin/ / rgya mtsho chu yi lbu ba yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/( 5)tsheg bar dgu can ni/ dper na/ 〈rta glud srab mda' dkar nag 〉yices pa las/ dung khyung dkar po'i dmu thag dkar po de/ / khyung rus 'jog po'i lag nas yar la thon/ / lha chen snang ba 'od ldan dmu thag dkar po de/ / 'dre chen mun pa zer ldan lag nas yar la thon/ / ye smon rgyal bo'i dmu thag dkar po de/ / ngams rje rtsol bo'i lag nas yar la thon/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /tsheg bar do mi mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ dper na/ bsang mchod kyi gyer tshig las/ yul phyogs 'di'i dgon grong lha khang / ri lung thang gsum/ chu brag lam gsum/ rtsi shing nags tshal/ g.yas ri g.yon ri/mdun ri rgyab ri/ phu mdo bar gsum/ stod smad nyin srib/ ri chen thang chen/ lung chen lung phran sogs na gnas pa'i lha mthu bo che/ klu mthu bo che/btsan mthu bo che/ gnyan mthu bo che khyed rnams la bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa dam pa 'di gsol lo/ / mchod do/ / brngan no/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa/ cho ga'i rgyar chig gi khyad chos/gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi khyad chos gtso che ba 'ga' phyogs gcig tu dril na gsham gsal ltar te/1 lo rgyus kyi phug khungs zab cing rgyun ring ba/ g.yung drung bon gyi lugs la rgyu'i bon dang / 'bras bu'i bon gnyis su dbye srol yod pa las/bon dar snga ba ni rgyu'i bon rnams yin zhing / cho ga'i smrang gyer ba ni rgyu'i bon gyi cho ga byed thabs gal chen zhig yin/ lo rgyus thog tu bon gyi chos lugs la dar rgud dang 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs shig byung yod kyang / bon lugs kyi cho ga

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 91byed pa dang cho ga'i gyer tshig gyer 'don byed pa gna' snga mo nas da lta'i bar du/ bod mi mchog dman bar ma kun gyis rang gi legs dgu spel zhing nyes dgu sel thabs su bed spyod byed mus su yod pa zhig yin pa ni/ 〈grub mtha' shel gyi me long 〉tsolas/ bon ltar gyer la dga' zhing gto thabs sogs/ /bon gyi bcos kas phan par kun gyis re/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de las nga tshos bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig la lo rgyus kyi phug khungs zab cing rgyun ring ba'i khyad chos ldan pa rtogs thub/2 mi rigs dang sa gnas kyi khyad rtags mngon par gsal ba/ h+phu rus tser gyis/ cho ga'i phan nus la yid ches shing dad mos byed pa ni/dngos gnas dmangs yongs dang / 'dzam gling yongs khyab kyi dad mos shig redadzoces bshad pa ltar/ 'dzam gling gi yul gru so so'i gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi khrod du rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i thon skyed kyi lag len nam 'tsho ba skyong thabs dang 'brel ba'i cho ga byed srol sna tshogs shig dar yod cing /bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig las gna' bo'i bod mi'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jig rten lta tshul dang / chos lugs dad mos/ yul srol goms gshis sogs mtshon yod pas/ mi rigs dang sa gnas kyi khyad rtags mngon par gsal ba'i khyad chos ldan pa red/2 rig gnas kyi nang don phun sum tshogs pa/ rig gnas kyi rim pa dbye zhib byed thabs sogs tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rigs lam la brten cing /rig tshan mi 'dra ba du ma'i cha nas zhib dpyod byas na/ de la rig gnas kyi nang don phun sum tshogs po ldan pa rtogs thub ste/ dper na/ 〈bsang rngon 〉yizhes pa'i cho ga'i gyer tshig tu/ skye 'gro dga' ba zas kyis brngan/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i lha la 'bul/ / bar snang gang ba'i gnyan la 'bul/ /sa gzhi gang ba'i klu la 'bul/ / 'di rnams bza' na sha re che/ / 'di rnams

92 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched smong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/btung na khrag re mang / / zhes bshad pa las/ sha khrag dngos sam tshab mtshon gang rung gi ‘‘dmar mchod ’’gtong ba'i cho ga byed srol mtshon zhing / de'i rig gnas nang don gyi cha nas/ ri dwags dang phyugs zog gi sha khrag dngos sam tshab mtshon gang rung gi mchod rdzas ni gzugs can gyi dngos po yin pas/phyi rim gyi rig gnas su gtogs pa ste/ de las cho ga byed mkhan mi rnams kyi skabs de'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i rgyu cha gtso bo ci zhig yin pa rtogs thub la/‘‘dmar mchod ’’gtong byed mchod rdzas kyis lha gnyan klu gsum sogs ‘‘mi ma yin mthu bo che rnams ’’mchod cing brngan pa'i cho ga dngos su sgrub pa de ni/mi rnams kyi lus ngag gi bya spyod cig yin pas/ bar rim gyi rig gnas su gtogs shing / de las mi rnams kyi dad mos byed tshul mtshon thub/ ‘‘dmar mchod ’’byed pa'i cho ga las mtshon pa'i mi rnams kyi nang bsam pa'i 'du shes ni/ nang rim gyi rig gnas su gtogs te/ de las mi rnams kyis rang gi 'tsho rten gyi kha zas gtso bos ‘‘mi ma yin mthu bo che ’’rnams la ‘‘sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag ’’dang / ‘‘phyi bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs ri’byas te/ rang gi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar 'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung zhing /'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sgrub par sdong grogs byed pa'i re ltos 'cha' ba sogs kyi bsam pa mtshon no/ /4 lha sgrung gi tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba/ lha sgrung la bod rang gi gna' rabs yig cha dag las lha rabs zer/ bod kyi gna' bo'i cho ga'i gyer tshig la lha sgrung ngam lha rabs dang gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi tshon mdangs rnam par bkra zhing / de ni bod kyi gna' bo'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa 'di'i khyad chos gal chen zhig kyang yin no/ /deng gi lha sgrung rig pa ba rnams kyis lha sgrung la sgra dog 'jug gi dbang du byas pa dang / sgra yangs 'jug gi dbang du byas pa'i lha sgrung gnyis su dbye

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 93zhing / phyi ma ni mi'i rigs kyi gdod ma'i dus skabs kyi lo rgyus dngos yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ de phyir/ gna' bo'i cho ga'i gyer tshig rnams las bod kyi gna' bo'i mi rgyud phywa dmu gtsug gsum bcas rtsa ba'i rus tshan gsum du grol zhing de las mang du gyes pa dang / de dag gi rtsa ba'i rgyud khungs ‘‘mi ni lha las mi ru grol/ / ’’yices srid pa ye smon rgyal bo'am sangs po 'bum khri dang yum chu lcags rgyal mo gnyis la thug par bshad pa de 〈rlang—sa kyi po ti bse ru 〉sogs lo rgyus deb ther 'gar bkod pa la/ 〈chos 'byung dpag bsam ljon bzang 〉nyulas/ 'jig rten pa'i rgan po dag gi ngag sgros de'ang dbus kyi mkhas pa kha cig gis tshad mar mdzad de yi ger bkod/ ces cha 'jog med par gsungs yod kyang / 'jig rten rgan po dag gi ngag sgros la'ang bden pa'i cha yod srid cing / lhag par du 〈rlangs kyi po ti bse ru 〉tsolas/ de rnams ni mi la lhar ming btags pa yin par gsungs yod pas/mtha' gcig tu tshad mar 'dzin mi rung zhes brnyas mi 'os shing / mtha' gcig tu bden par 'dzin kyang mi 'os so snyam pa ni zhar la thal ba'i gtam mo/ /5 tshig sbyor snyan zhing ngag tu gyer bde ba/ cho ga'i gyer tshig la rjod byed tshig gi sdeb legs shing rna bar snyan pa dang / de sgra dang ni sgra tshig gi kha skong du sbyar bas tshig gi gcod mtshams gsal zhing ngag tu gyer bde ba'i khyad chos ldan pa'i khar/ bod skad rnal ma'i khrod kyi zung ldan gyi tshig rgyan di ri ri dang / si li li/ ldems se ldems/ lhabs se lhab sogs kyis mdzes par spud yod pa ni/ dper na/ 〈klu 'bum nag po 〉⑫zhes pa las/ ne'u sing de ni sngon mo ru/ / ba dmar glang dmar di ri ri/ / ngang ngur mang bo lcongs se lcong / / rma bya spu sdug lhabs se lhab/ / ces pa lta bu'o/ /

94 gtsosayi rigs dge 'os mthodze+em ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lnga pa/ cho ga'i rgyar tshig gi rig gnas kyi byed las/bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig ni bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi rnam pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin zhing / de la rtsom rig gi mdzes dpyod kyi rin thang ldan par ma zad/ rig gnas kyi byed las mngon gsal che ba du ma yod pa las gtso che ba 'ga' zhig ni/1 gna' bo'i rig gnas kyi brda 'phrin nyar tshags dang brgyud spel gyi byed las ldan pa/ cho ga'i gyer tshig gi nang du yul dus nges can gyi mi rnams kyi thon skyed byed tshul dang 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs/ bsam pa'i 'du shes/yul srol goms gshis sogs spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus rig gnas kyi brda 'phrin mang bo gsog nyar byas yod par ma zad/ cho ga spel ba dang cho ga'i gyer tshig gyer 'don byed pa'i rig gnas kyi bya spyod la brten nas/ mi rigs rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas kyi srol rgyun brgyud 'dzin dang mi nyams gong du spel bar phan nus gal chen thon gyi yod/2 mi dang rang byung mthun gnas 'ong ba yar bskul gyi byed las ldan pa/ rang byung khams chen por lha klu gnyan gsum la sogs pa'i ‘‘mi ma yin mthu bo che ’’rnams gnyug mar gnas shing / de dag gis rang byung khams bdag tu bzung ste dbang sgyur gyi yod pa dang / rtsi shing nags tshal dang bya dang gcan gzan ri dwags la sogs pa rang byung khams kyi cha shas yin par ma zad/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyang rang byung khams kyi cha shas shig yin pas/srid pa'i bskos thang ltar de dag zhi mthun mnyam gnas byung na 'jig rten du bde dge legs tshogs rgyas pa dang / de las ldog na bkra mi shis pa'i rtags sna tshogs 'ong bar 'dod pa ni bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga byed srol gyi bsam blo'i rmang gzhi yin pas/ cho ga'i gyer tshig rnams las bsam blo

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 95de gsal bor mtshon pa ni/ dper na/ 〈yul sa'i 'gras bsdum 〉nyuzhes pa las/ sa bdag klu gnyan yul sa'i tshogs/ / gshen po bdag gi smrang la nyon/ / sa gnyan brkos pa ma mchis sam/ / gal te brkos na zhi bas bsdum/ / rin chen mchod pa bsang gis bsdum/ / rdo gnyan bzlog pa ma mchis sam/ / gal te bzlog na zhi bas bsdum/ / rin chen mchod pa bsang gis bsdum/ / chu gnyan bsgyur ba ma mchis sam/ / gal te bsgyur na zhi bas bsdum/ / rin chen mchod pa bsang gis bsdum/ / shing gnyan bcad pa ma mchis sam/ / gal te bcad na zhi bas bsdum/ / rin chen mchod pa bsang gis bzlum/ / ri rtser ki yis btab pa dang / / rdzing dang yur ba drangs pa dang / / chu mig gnyan po slog pa dang / / ri la me chen zhog pa dang / /gnyan bya bsad dang ri dwags brngon/ / na dang rmas pa ci byung yang / / rtsi sman sna tshogs mchod pa dang / / ston pa lha yi thugs rje yis/ /yul sa'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig / yul sa gnyan po khyed rnams la/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ / 'gras pa yod na 'gras bsdum mo/ /khros pa yod na zhi gyur cig / 'khrugs pa yod na 'khrugs bsdum mo/ /gnod pa'i gdug sems zhi gyur cig / ces bshad pa sogs las shes thub pa ltar te/ gna' bo'i dus su cho ga'i gyer tshig gis mi rnams kyi bya spyod tshad gzhi can du gtong ba dang / mi dang rang byung mthun gnas 'ong bar yar bskul gyi byed las thon gyi yod/2 lha dgyes mi spro bgyi byed kyi byed las ldan pa/ cho ga'i gyer tshig la gyer tshul dbyangs rta sna tshogs yod cing / de cho ga'i yo byad rnga gshang dung gling sogs rol mo'i ram 'degs dang bstun nas dbyangs su gyer ba la mi sems kun nas g.yo bar byed pa'i byed las rang chas su mnga' bas/ snang sridakyi ‘‘lha 'drer rimispro spel dgyes skyed kyi byed las ldan par ma zad/ mi

96 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnams la spro snang sbyin thub pa'i byed las kyang ldan pa ni/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la bsam yas kyi cong bzo skabs/ ‘‘cong lugs su blug tu ma ster ba la/ spyi mdos bsham nas/ lha 'dre yengs byed kyi glu bo che blangs nas/che chung lcags ri'i rgya la ltos/ / mtho dma' ri rab rtse la ltos/ / mang nyung skye 'gro'i grangs la ltos/ / mdzes sdug dar zab 'phan la ltos/ / gsungs pas lha 'dres yengs kyi bar cong lugs thebs so ’’⑧zhes pas kyang rtogs thub bo/ /4 cho ga'i gyer tshig gis phyis kyi rtsom rig la thebs pa'i shan shugs/gna' bo'i cho ga'i gyer tshig gi nang don dang rnam pa gnyis ka'i cha nas phyis byung bod kyi rtsom rig la shan shugs zab mo thebs yod pa ni 〈tun hong gter yig 〉khrod kyi bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po dang / gri gum btsan po sogs kyi byung ba brjod pa dang / 〈gling rje ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung /〉〈mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur 〉sogs las shes thub cing / cho ga'i gyer tshig rnams las ‘‘sngon gyi cho rabs bshad pa'i ’’skor ni bod kyi don brjod snyan ngag gi thog ma'i rnam pa dang / bod kyi lha sgrung gi brjod bya'i 'byung khungs gal che ba zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed rigs par snang ngo / /drug pa/ mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/mi lo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol nas rang rgyal gyi rgya mi rigs dang /gna' bo'i rgya gar dang / e jib/ pa pis lun/ zhi po le/ ghi ru si rnams su glu gar snyan tshig dang / rig byed rtsom rig bstod smon dang lha sgrung sogs kyi rtsom rig dar yod/ de bzhin du bod mi rigs la'ang spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i yar sngon gyi bon dar ba'i dus rabs su/ glu dang sgrung /lde'u/ cho ga'i gyer tshig sogs gna' rabs rtsom rig gi rnam pa du ma dar

bod kyi gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi cho ga'i gyer tshig gi skor che long tsam gleng ba/ 97myong zhing / sgyu rtsom gyi rigs su gtogs pa de dag dar nas mi lo stong phrag du ma song yod pa bon gyi rig gnas lo rgyus dag las shes thub/ lhag par du cho ga'i smrang ngam gyer tshig gi skor ni/ nye dus kyi mkhas chen dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 〈gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma 〉yilas/ bod kyi rtsom dngos ma ni 'di tsho yin 'dug ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ legs sbyar rtsom rig gi shan ma zhugs pa'i bod rang gi gna' rtsom dngos yin zhing / bon dar ba'i dus rabs kyi snyan tshig gi rigs thun mong ma yin pa zhig ste/ de ni gna' bo'i bod mi rnams kyis rang byung khams shes rtogs byed pa dang / rang byung khams la bstun 'gyur dang bsgyur bkod byed pa'i dus yun ring bo'i thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i lag len gyi khrod nas thun mong gis gsar rtsom byas pa'i 'bras bu yin pas na/ bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig la dpyad pa gtong ba'i dpyad gzhi rin thang che ba zhig tu ngos 'dzin bya 'os so/ /lung khungs dang zur mchan/()()(nyepo)〈zhal 'don nyer mkho phyogs sgrig 〉las/ rnga ba snang zhig dgon pa'i nam mkha' g.yung drung gis bsgrigs/ snum dpar ma/rjodaga' ldan gnas bcu rab 'phel gling gi shing dpar ma las/melhi 〈n+t+raṣ+ṭha〉(r+sā)ṭha lko lko.aus+dzastsa ṣ+ṭhat+t+waṃlolholko lta༅ṭha/cisgrespratshimaglone+eṭ+wāṃ1978midzame〈yul lha gsol ba dang shug bsang gtong ba'i srol la dpyad pa 〉mkhar smre'i bsam gtan gyis brtsams/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i rig deb/ 2002 1 219dhi〈klung rta'i kwa 'dzugs bsod nams dpung bskyed 〉las/ bris ma/
1987 66yi(dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom 〉pod dang bo/ bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / 1994 bci8(dpyad rtsom 'di 2004lo'i 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉 deb bzhi pa las bdams/)

100༄ / / yig sgyur lag len khrod du gzhung lugs gsar pa nang 'dren byed dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin brjod pa/klu 'bum rgyal/spyir yig sgyur ni byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus shin tu ring ba'i gna' dus kyi rig tshan cig yin mod/ 'on kyang yig sgyur gyi rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs ni da dung 'dzugs skrun byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin pa kun gyi mthong lam du gnas pa'i don dngos shig yin pa smos ci dgos/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la/ yig sgyur gyi slob khrid med pa nas yod pa dang / spyir btang gi khrid tshan zhig nas gtso gzhi'i khrid tshan du gyur pa bcas kyag kyog gi bgrod lam yang bskyar brgyud de/ yig sgyur gyi zhib 'jug dang lag len/ slob khrid/ gzhung lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun sogs gang thad nas rim pa gcig gis mthor 'degs byung yod pa ni dga' 'os pa'i gnas su brtsi chog na yang / bcos sgyur byed dgos pa'i gnas dang mi 'dang sa mang po'ang mngon sum du mchis pa nga tshos nges par du shes dgos pa red/ dper na sgyur rtsom gyi chu tshad dma' zhing grangs nyung ba/ rig pa gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa'i phyogs la thon dgos pa'i nus pa thon med pa/ slob khrid kyi spus tshad dus rabs kyi 'gros dang bstun te gom pa mdun du spo dka' ba/ khrid tshan gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i

yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin/ 101shed shugs tshad gnas su son dka' ba/ spyi tshogs kyi lag len du gal che ba'i gnas su bzhag ste do snang chen po byed mkhan nyung ba bcas mi 'dang sa dang / legs bcos byed dgos pa'i gnas shin tu mang ngo / / ji skad du/yigasgyur ni tshan rtsal gsar pa dang sngon thon gyi rig gnas nang 'dren byed pa'i thabs lam gtso bo yin la/ sgyur thabs gsar pa bkol spyod byed pa ni yig sgyur gyi nus rtsal mthor 'degs byed pa'i brgyud lam nyag gcig yin no zhes brjod pa nang bzhin/ bdag gis 'dir yig sgyur gyi 'phel rgyas/ yig sgyur gyi lag len dang gzhung lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun khrod gal che bar snang ba'i skad cha'i rig gnas kyi khyad par dang / rig gnas lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs/nus mtshungs kyi yig sgyur sogs byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' gleng bar bya ba la/dang po/ yig sgrur 'phel rgyas dang gzhung lugs gsar pa spyir gleng ba/bstan pa snga dar nas yig sgyur lag len rgya cher spel ba dang sbrags/bod kyi yig sgyur gzhung lugs kyang snga rabs mkhas dbang rnam pa'i bka' drin las rim gyis ma lag tu grub ste/ byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus dang nang don gyi rin thang gang ci'i thad 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi stegs bu'i steng 'grems ston byed pa la ngo gnong mi dgos mod/ yin na yang lo ngo stong phrag brgyud de cha 'phrin gyi dus rabs zhes 'bod pa'i deng gi dus 'dir slebs pa na/ phyi'i snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems khams kyi phyogs la mngon sum mig gi mthong lam du grub pa'i 'gyur ldog byung yod pa gzhir bzhag sgos su rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs khrom ra'i dpal 'byor gyi lam lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dgos pa dang bstun/ tshan rig rig gnas kyi bye brag mang du gyes pa dang shes bya'i gnas gsar pa dbyar gyi shwa mo brdol ba dang mtshungs

102gtsosayi rigs dge 'os mtho3ma ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par 'phel rgyas su song yod la/ yig sgyur lag len dang gzhung lugs zhib 'jug byed pa'ang dus rabs kyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas rnam pa rgya che zhing nang don gting zab pa'i sgo nas gong 'phel du song yod/ de dang bsdur na ni bod kyi yig sgyur gyi spus tshad dang yig sgyur byed thabs gzhung lugs kyi grub cha dag da dung snga mo'i tshad gzhi de las brgal med cing / rig pa gsar pa'i zhib 'jug gi phyogs nas da dung mi 'dang sa dang rjes su lus pa/ tha na stong char gyur pa'i gnas kyang mi nyung ba zhig mchis/nye ba'i lo ngo lnga bcu yas mas kyi ring la/ 'jig rten gong du 'phel ba dang tshan rig 'phel rgyas blo yul las 'das par myur bas yig sgyur gyi bya ba spel bar yar skul gyi shan shugs chen po thebs shing / lhag par du dus rabs phyed ka'i nang skad brda zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu dang 'phel rim bcas kyis yig sgyur gzhung lugs kyi zhib 'jug gting je zab tu 'gro bar skul 'ded kyi nus pa gal chen po thon pa red/ yo rob dang a me ri ka'i yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs smra ba rnams kyis lo grangs bcu phrag 'ga'i dus yun ring 'brel yod rig tshan gsar pa so so'i zur dang phyogs sna tshogs kyi steng nas yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs 'thus tshang du 'gyur ba dang / khungs lung du 'dzin chog pa/ kun gyi mthun snang du bsgrub thub pa zhig gsar 'dzugs bya ba'i thad la phra zhing zhib pa'i zhib 'jug rgyun ldan du bgyis pa brgyud/ yig sgyur gzhung lugs kyi gnas so so sngar las je zhib dang gong 'phel du song ba lag pas snyob chog cing mig gis mthong thub pa zhig tu 'khums/ ji ltar zhe na/ srol rgyun gyi yig sgyur gzhung lugs dag gi nying bcud sdud len byas pa'i gzhi rtsa'i steng nas deng rabs yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs zhib 'jug byed pa'i khyab khongs rgya bskyed de rig pa'i gnas gsar pa mang po zhig dang 'brel mthud byas yod pa ma zad/ rig tshan gyi khyab khongs so sor 'tshol rtog gi yig sgyur

yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin/ 103gzhung lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun la rgyud lam mang po zhig gsar du 'byed pa dang sgrub byed sna tshogs mkho sprod bgyis yod pa red/ rig tshan de dag gi khyab khongs gtso bo niṣa dngos spyod kyi skad brda rig pa/ rtsom lus rig pa/gshib bsdur skad brda rig pa/ spyi tshogs skad brda rig pa/ skad don rig pa/ sems khams rig pa/ mtshon rtags rig pa/ gshib bsdur rtsom rig dang gtan tshigs rig pa bcas yin par bstan yod kyang / lag len dang phyogs de dag gi gzhung lugs la brtag cing dpyad na yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs la shugs rkyen gting zab cing khebs che bar thebs yod pa ni yo rob dang a me ri ka'i nye rabs kyi brda sprod gzhung lugs dang gshib bsdur skad brda rig pa/ rtsom lus rig pa bcas kyi zhib 'jug la ngos 'dzin dgos par snang ngo / /rang rgyal la mtshon na/ yig sgyur gyi bya ba 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod pa de bsnyon du med pa gzhir bzhag spus tshad dang grangs ka gang ci'i thad nas gom pa mdun du spos pa'i steng yig sgyur gzhung lugs kyi phyogs la dpyad bsdur gyi mtho rlabs 'phyur rim ngang ngam shugs kyis byung yod pa red/ dus yun ring po zhig gi bar du don ji bzhin mtshon pa dang gsal zhing go bde ba/tshig sbyor snyan pa/ zhes pa'i grags khyab che ba'i yig sgyur gyi tshad gzhi'i skor la yang bskyar dpyad bsdur byas pa dang / thad sgyur dang don sgyur gtso phal gyi phyogs la rtsod gleng rgya chen po bgyis te gzhung lugs thad kyi bsam gzhigs dang lta ba sna tshogs byung ba brgyud/ phyi gling na grags che ba'i dbyin ji'i khad thu h+pho dhi sogs kyi bzhed pa gsar pa ste tshad mnyam dang a me ri ka'i nel ta sogs kyis 'dod pa'i nus mtshungs kyi yig sgyur bcas rig pa gsar pa mang po zhig nang 'dren byas dang byed bzhin mchis/rtsom lus kyi steng nas yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs la zhib 'jug byed pa ni

104gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho3ma ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus rabs bdun cu nas yo rob dang a me ri ka'i yig sgyur gzhung lugs kyi khyab khongs su gsar du dar pa'i gal che ba'i rig tshan gyi gnas shig yin zhing / de ni yig sgyur gzhung lugs la zhib cha ches cher thon pa la nus shugs 'gangs che ba byung thub pa'i rgyud lam zhig tu gyur yod pa red/spyir skad brda rig pa dang rtsom lus rig pa'i zur nas yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs gom gang mdun spos kyis dbye ba je zhib dang gting je zab tu zhib dpyod byed pa/ rtsom lus so so'i khyad chos dang bstun te yig sgyur gyi byed thabs sna tshogs phyogs bsdoms bgyid pa ni tshan rig dang mthun pa'i rig tshan gsar pa zhig yinaXzhes brjod pa nang bzhin/ de sngon thon gyi gras su tshud pa'i rgya'i yig sgyur gyi las rigs dang yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs la mtshon na'ang gsar du byung ba'i tha snyad dang gsar du nang 'dren byas pa'i gzhung lugs shig tu snang na/ 'phel rgyas cung zad dal ba'i bod kyi yig sgyur gyi lag len dang gzhung lugs zhib 'jug gi khyab khongs su mtshon na nye lam go thos su gyur pa zhig yin pa lta ci smos/ des na shes bya'i klong brdol ba zhes pas mtshon pa'i deng gi 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang mnyam du 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi lam nas rtsom lus rig pa'i zhib 'jug dang sbrags te bod kyi yig sgyur gyi spus tshad dang yig sgyur byed thabs/ gzhung lugs kyi grub cha sogs gna' snga mo'i tshad gzhi las brgal bar byas te/ gu yangs por bskyed pa dang / rig pa gsar pa nang 'dren dang zhib 'jug thad kyi mi 'dang sa dang stong char gyur pa'i phyogs la ci lcogs kyis kha bsabs te rjes lus kyi gnas bab bcos bsgyur bya rgyu ni yig sgyur gyi phyag las gnang ba'i mkhas pa re gnyis ma yin par rgya che ba'i bod yig gi bya ba sgrub mkhan tshang ma'i phrag tu bab pa'i rang 'gan ldog thabs bral ba zhig tu 'khums/

yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin/ 111'gro ba mi la chab srid kyi bkag rgya bzo ba la ngo rgol byed pa bcas bstod pa'i rang bzhin gyi tha snyad cig yin pa lta bu red/sa gnas dang gnam gshis sogs kyis rig gnas lo rgyus la khyad par yod pa dper na/ rang re gangs can pa rnams kyis dpyid kyi dpal yon rgyas pa la sman ltar phan pa'i sbrang char bsil ma la bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor ba dang / rgya rnams kyis kyang ṭ+wāṃ.or+sākre0 tsha zhes brjod par mtshon na/ rang re rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs las ched du gtan khel byas te krung go rgyal khab kyi rig gnas lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs su da gzod de ltar go ba len chog pa ma gtogs/ nub gling gi rgyal khab dang dpyid dus sam spyir char chu mang drags pa'i rgyal khab kyi mi la mtshon na krung go'i mi dang mtshungs par g.yis las dkon pa'i sbrang char zer ba'i don spyi zhig byung mi thub la go ba'ang lon mi thub/der brten rig gnas byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus la zhib dpyod ma byas na ma rtsom gyi gting rim gyi go ba thob dka' zhing yig sgyur gyi bya ba spel de bas dka' bar snang /de yang skad rigs rjes spor dang 'brel gtugs kyi khrod rig gnas lo rgyus kyi zhib dpyod la nyams snang bgyid dgos pa'i gnas mdor bsdus su brjod na/(1)mi rigs rig gnas kyi srol rgyun dang / gong 'phel/ 'pho 'gyur/lo rgyus rgyab ljongs sogs ni/ dus rgyun ming dang tshig gi nang don gyi zur lta byed sa'i gnas gal che ba dang rgya che ba'i khyab khongs yin zhing / des ming tshig gi nang don 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i brgyud rim ston thub pa ma zad/ lhag par du lo rgyus kyi dus skabs nges can zhig gi khrod 'dus pa'i ming tshig gi nang don khyad par ba dag gsal bshad byed thub pa/

112gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(2)mi rigs rang nyid kyi gcig mtshungs kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus kyi khrod grub pa'i spyi'i rang bzhin gyi sems khams te/ phal cher gcig mthun du gyur pa'i kun spyod kyi lta ba/ rin thang gi lta ba/ mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba dang snying stobs sogs tshang ma rig gnas kyi steng nas tshur snang byed pa dang /skad cha'i khrod nas gsal ston byed pa yin phyir rig gnas lo rgyus kyi zhib dpyod la brtsi mthong chen po byed dgos la yig sgyur gyi bya ba don sgyur byed thabs la brten dgos so/ /(2)mi rigs kyi gnas yul te sa khul rang bzhin gyi khyad rtags dang rang byung cha rkyen gyi shugs rkyen thebs pas gong gi don tshan dang po gnyis pa bcas kyi byed nus las grub pa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i lugs srol dang /goms gshis/ dad mos/ lta ba chags stangs tshang ma rig gnas kyi khrod nas mtshon ston byed pa khag theg yin pa gzhir bzhag rig gnas lo rgyus kyi zhib dpyod la nyams snang bya rgyu ni yig sgyur gyi spus tshad legs po 'byung ba la 'brel ba dam po yod do/ /2 nus mtshungs kyi yig sgyur dang rig gnas kyi khyad par/ skad cha dang skad cha'i bar mtho dma' bzang ngan gyi dbye ba 'byed rgyu med la/ mi 'dra ba'i skad cha thams cad 'dra mnyam gyi mtshon byed nus pa ldan par 'dod pa'i nel ta'i lta tshul de tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig yin/ don spyi'am nang don gang rung skad rigs so so nas rnam pa mi mtshungs par mtshon ston byed thub pas/ nus pa thod thug pa'i yig sgyur gyi thabs jus gtso bor bgyid dgos pa las/ thad sgyur gyis rnam pa thod thug par bya ba yig sgyur gyi byed thabs gtso bor 'dzin pa gzhung lugs su brjod sla yang lag len du bsgrub dka' ba'i gnas shig e yin nam sems/yang 'ga' res/ yig sgyur ni skad cha'i bya 'gul rkyang rkyang zhig ma yin

yig sgyur gyi gzhung lugs gsar pa nang 'dren byed pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin/ 113par/ gzhi rtsa'i steng nas bshad na rig gnas kyi bya 'gul zhig yin pa redaṇaces bstan pa la khungs bcol te/ nel ta'i nus mtshungs sam byed nus thod thug pa'i rmang gzhi'i 'dod tshul ni/ ma rtsom klog mkhan rnam pas ma rtsom las go ba lon pa'i rim pa dang ma rtsom gyis klog pa por spro snang rgyas par byed thub pa'i tshad gzhi ltar/ 'gyur rtsom gyi klog pa po rnam pas 'gyur rtsom las go ba lon pa'i rim pa dang 'gyur rtsom gyis klog pa po rnams la spro snang rgyas par byed thub pa'i tshad gzhi dang gshib bsdur bya ba bcas yin pas/ klog pa po ni yig sgyur gyi zhabs 'degs zhu sa'i gzhi yin par gdams yod pa red/nga tshos 'dir ne+el ta'i yig sgyur gzhung lugs kyi dmigs 'ben 〈ye shu'i gsung rab 〉bsgyur ba la zhabs 'degs zhu ched yin min la gdeng 'jog bya ba spangs nas nang don gyi byed nus thod thug par yig sgyur bya thub min gyi phyogs la cung tsam brtag cing bsam gzhigs byas na/ skad cha ni rig gnas kyi me long lta bu yin zhing / rig gnas kyi phyogs mtha' dag skad cha'i khrod nas tshur snang byed kyin yod pa red/ 'o na rig gnas mi 'dra ba'i bar gyi yig sgyur du byed nus thod thug pa ste rgyu tha dad 'bras bu gcig pa'i snang tshul zhig byung thub bam zhe na/ thad sgyur gyi steng nas ma rtsom gyi rnam pa mi 'gyur ba dang rig gnas kyi khyad par nang 'dren byed pa de dang chabs cig tu nang don nus mtshungs su yig sgyur byed dka' ba ma gtogs/ don sgyur gyi sgo nas rig gnas kyi khyad par gshib bsdur gyis thod gtugs te so so'i skad cha'i brjod stangs dang rig gnas gtso byas nas yig sgyur byas na/ nang don gyi byed nus thod thug pa zhig bsgyur thub par 'dod la tshig rgyan gyi phyogs nas kyang klog bde ba zhig yong thub par sems/dper na/ (1)(rgya yig bod yig tu bsgyur ba )a.a71྾ ni pham pa khas mi len par gyong bo mthar 'khyol ba'i don yin la/ bod kyi skad cha'i

114gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched smyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod stangs ltar/ ngan rengs rtser son (mon gling g.yul 'gyed du )zhes bsgyur na nang don nus mtshungs su thon zhing rig gnas dang 'gal ba med/tshoṣ+ṭhalhad+ku ni rang rkya mi thub par shing lo chus khur ba lta bu la zer ba yin/chu sna gar khrid (dpe chos rna ba'i bdud rtsi )ces bsgyur na rig gnas dang 'gal ba med cing nang don nus mtshungs su ston thub/ smokhri.ā+oṃ7( ni ngal ba don du mi smin pa'i don yin la/ chu zla snyob pa (dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las )dang chu zla sbar 'dzin zhes bsgyur na nang don gyi byed nus mtshungs so/ /(2)(bod yig rgya yig tu bsgyur ba )bla na med pa zhes pa ni/ de'i yan med pa ste ches mchog tu gyur pa'i don yin la/ ༅oṃlkostu zhes bsgyur na rgya'i skad cha'i brjod stangs ji bzhin du nang don nus mtshungs su bstan yod la rig gnas kyi phyogs su'ang 'gal ba ma mchis/seng ge'i mgo la spre'us lag rtsed zhes pa ni/ nyen kha che ba'i las la 'jug pa'i don yin la/ oṃrma smerngu7rwa zhes bsgyur na nang don nus mtshungs yin pa ma zad/ rig gnas kyi khyad par yang nus mtshungs su bsgyur yod pa red/bu rabs tsha rgyud ces pacha7ṣ+ṭha4shu du bsgyur na bod rgya mi rigs gnyis ka'i skad cha'i brjod lugs dang mthun zhing nang don nus mtshungs yin pa smos ci dgos/ bong bu dar ('khyags )thog tu 'ded pa zhes pa zla༈lhane+e༄lko ru bsgyur na/ rig gnas kyi khyad par dang nang don gyi phyogs gang nas kyang nus mtshungs yin pa lta bu'o/ /gong ltar ne+el ta'i gzhung lugs su srol rgyun gyi yig sgyur gzhung lugs la med pa'i khyad chos dang gzhung lugs kyi 'then shugs mchis la/ de'i rig

116༄༅ / / ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/sangasargyasamakhar/bod kyi mi rgyud 'di gna' snga mo'i dus na lo rgyus dang yig tshang la mthong chen byed pa'i mi rigs shig yin pa ‘‘rang gi mi rgyud ma shes na/ nags kyi spre'u dang 'dra/ pha mes kyi yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phrug yul bor dang 'dra/’’zhes byung ba'i kha dpe 'di las shes la/ tung hong gter yig la'ang btsan po'i rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba'i shog dril thor ma mang po byung ba de dag las kyang gsal rtogs thub par yod/ lo rgyus dang yig tshang la bdag gces byed rgyu ni spyir na 'gro ba mi'i 'os 'gan yin la/ sgos su mi rigs rang rang gi pha rgyud kyi gnas tshul bu rgyud kyis gnyer ba'i 'os 'gan yang yin/ yin na'ang lo rgyus kyi dar rgud dang chab srid kyi 'pho 'gyur sogs kyis rang cag gi gna' bo'i yig tshang nyams dmas su song nas slar gso gnang ma thub par mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud pas mun sprul gyi gtam rgyud dang gzhi 'dres par gyur/ gnad don 'di yi ge yod pa'i mi rigs shig la mtshon na/ spyi dmangs slob gso zhan pa'i gna' rabs pa spyi'i thun mong gi skyon cha yin la/zhib 'jug kyi las kar mi dga' ba'i dad zhen can rnams kyi thun mong gi skyon cha zhig kyang yin/ skyon cha 'di gnyis kyi sgo nas gtam rgyud du gyur pa'i lo rgyus kyi tshig don 'brur phab pa la brtag dpyad byas pa dang ma byas pa ci

‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 117rigs 'byung bas/ byas pa rnal du 'khel ba rnams ni rgyud 'dzin dang ma byas pa dang byas 'khrul gyi rigs can rnams ni da dung brtag dpyod nan mo bya dgos par yod/ de bas 'dir yang ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor tha snyad gzhir byas kyis dogs dpyod bgyid par bya'o/ /dang po/ ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’khri lde gtsug brtan la mi go ba'i gnad gsed pa/‘‘mes ag tshom ri’zhes pa bod kyi chos 'byung dang deb ther rnams na/khri lde gtsug brtan gyi mtshan yin rabs gtam rgyud lhu rkang bsgrigs nas mdzad yod pa phal cher mthun tsam du snang yang / brtag par bya ba 'di yod de/ ‘‘mes ’’zhes pa dang ‘‘ag tshom ri’zhes pa re re btsan po khri lde gtsug brtan la 'byor ba'i skabs mi rnyed pa ste/ khong nyid khri srong lde btsan gyi yab yin pa las mes ma yin pa dang / dgung lo yang nyung mtha' 45dang mang mtha' 52las ma bzhugs pas yongs grags ltar gyi ag tshom dkar po can zhes pa'i don de yang mi 'byor/ ming de don dngos su dbon sras kyi 'brel ba dang smin tshod kyi gdong dbyibs las/ btsan po khri srong btsan la btags par nges pa sgra don gyi 'brel ba dang gtam rgyud kyi lhug rkang las gsal rtogs thub par yod/ de lta bas na tha snyad des bzung ba'i gdags gzhi btsan po khri lde gtsug brtan la bca' ba ni shin tu mi 'os pa ste/ 'khrul che bas cis kyang dpyod dgos par 'duga'akhrul ba la cha 'dra ba'i gzhi mthun zhig dgos/ bod kyi lo rgyus khrod byung bab cha 'drar yod pa ni btsan po khri srong btsan dang khri lde gtsug brtan gnyis yin/ lo rgyus 'dra ba'i sgo nas btsan po 'di gnyis mtshan 'khrul rgyus

118gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched phyung slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'khrul byung ste mang srong gi cha nas bos pa'i mes ag tshom khri lde gtsug brtan la sbyar pa dang / gung srong gi gnas tshul 'jang tsha lha dbon la sbyar cing /'un shing kong jo'i gtam rgyud yang mi 'byor bzhin du gyim shing kong jor sbyar nas lo rgyus la nang 'dzings chen po bzos/ lo rgyus 'khrul ba'i 'gal ba de ji ltar byung ba dang / ci'i phyir byung ba'i don rtogs pa la/ nga tshos thog mar ‘‘mes ’’dang ‘‘ag tshom mi’gnyis so sor 'phral zhing / so so'i sgra don gyi 'brel ba'i sgo nas bsam blo 'di ltar gtong dgos pa ste/ ‘‘mes ’’ni dbon gyi cha nas btags shing / mes dbon gnyis ltos bcas kyis brdar nges pas/de'i bar du pha'i rgyud rabs shig cis kyang tshang dgos par yod/ pha ngo gzhir byas kyis bu'i cha nas pha'i pha la ‘‘mes ’’dang / mes kyi cha nas bu'i bu la ‘‘dbon mi’zhes 'bod pa/ bod 'dir chos bon rig gnas gsar rnying gis mi'i 'du shes la 'gyur ldog gang mang bzos kyang rabs rgyud kyi 'brel ba'i ngos 'dzin byed tshul ma 'gyur bar de lta rang du yod/ rabs rgyud kyi 'brel ba'i ngos 'dzin de'i sgo nas lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'dra ba'i rgyal rabs snga phyi 'di gnyis la khyad chos de dag tshang min gyi gdengs 'jog gnang na/ khri lde gtsug brtan dang 'jang tsha lha dbon bar du ‘‘mes dbon ’’gyi 'brel ba gtan nas gzhi ma grub pa dang / gal te ‘‘mes dbon ’’gyi 'brel ba gzhi 'grub dgos na yab sras de gnyis kyi bar la pha'am bu'i rabs rgyud cig chags dgos par yod/ yin kyang yongs grags kyi lo rgyus la de ltar ma byung la tun hong gter yig gi rgyal rabs la yang btsan po de gnyis yab sras yin pa las mes dbon ma yin pa shin tu gsal/ des na mes zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di rang khri lde gtsug brtan la gtan nas mi 'byor ba mngon gsal dod por 'byung /‘‘ag tshom ’’zhes pa spyir pho skyes kyi kha spu la go yang / 'dir mes ag tshom zhes pa'i ag tshom ni bgres po'i zhal tshom la dmigs su go dgos par

‘‘mes ag tshom gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 119yod pas/ khyad chos de nyid khri lde gtsug brtan la sbyar na lo bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu'i bar gyi skyes pa la ag tshom dkar po chags pa gnas ma yin pas de tsam mi 'byor/ ag tshom gyi go don 'di gtso bo kong jo'i me long la 'char ba skad du bris pa'i ‘‘rgad po bzhin mi sdug pa byad spus khengs pa ’’dhizhes dang /mun 'joms nor phreng du ‘‘mes po rgan po rgas shing 'khogs pas ngo mis sdug cing / byad spus khengs pa ’’dhizhes dang / khyad par du chos 'byung me sbrang las ‘‘da ni yab bgres po dbu skra thams cad dkar po/ zhal thams cad ni sma ra dkar pos khengs pa/ zhal gang na yod ngo mi shes pa de 'dra zhig gzigs ’’rjozhes byung ba'i don la brten nas btags pas/ bgres po'i rnam pa 'di dag lo lnga bcur ma bud par gshegs pa'i khri lde gtsugs brtan la sbyar na/ mi'i skyes lugs kyi smin tshod dang / tshe lo'i gnas tshod sogs gang gi cha nas brtags kyang shin tu mi 'byor ba dang / gal te 'byor du bcug na'ang gyim shing kong jo bsus pa'i skabs su (spyilo71rkya)khri lde gtsug brtan dgung lo bdun yin pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med pas/ ‘‘rgas 'khogs skra dang ag tshom dkar por ’’gyur pa'i me long la 'char ba skad kyi btsan po de khri lde gtsug brtan yin mi srid pa la lung rigs thags su bsdebs nas bkag kyang khogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa/ ‘‘mes ag tshom ’ribatsan po khri srong btsan la go dgos pa'i don dpag pa/lo rgyus kyi gnas bab 'dra ba'i rgyal rabs 'di gnyis gang yin yang /phan tshun bar ‘‘mes dbon ’’gyi 'brel bar gnas pa dang / ‘‘mes po rgas 'khogs dbu skra dkar po can/ byad kyang kha spu dkar pos g.yogs ’’pa'i ‘‘'brel rgas ’’kyi khyad chos 'di dag rgyal rabs dang btsan po gang la gzhi

120gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mthodze+em ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grub zer na/ srong btsan sgam po ste/ khong nyid sku tshe ring zhing chab srid rgyas la phyi 'brel bzang ba sha stag can zhig kyang yin pas/ dngos su bshad na ‘‘mes dbon ’’gyi 'brel ba gzhi grub pa'i btsan po ni srong btsan sgam po dang mang srong gnyis yin/ spyir mes dbon gyi tha snyad ni su la'ang gdags rung du yod kyang mi chos gnas lugs la zhal ngo lhan 'dzoms byung na da gzod mes dbon gyi tha snyad 'dogs dgos par yod pas/ de lta'i gdags rung du gyur pa ni btsan po'i rgyal rab khrod khri srong btsan dang mang srong gnyis ma gtogs gtan nas mi 'byung / mes dbon gnyis zhal 'dzoms mus su mes srong btsan gyi chab srid rgyun thag yab gung ru ma brgyud par (gung srong grongs pas slar khong nyid bzung )dbon mang srong gis thad kar bzhes pas mes dbon gyi 'brel ba tshad mar grub 'dug pa red/gnyags ston pa'i gdung rabs la ‘‘'dus srong mang bo rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po/ de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom/ de'i sras gung srong gung btsan ri’duzhes 'byung ba 'di yang / mes ag tshom dang khri lde gtsug brtan gnyis gzhi gcig tu 'dzin pa'i yongs grags kyi lugs la mi 'byor mod/ bdag gi 'dod tshul la 'byor ba ste mes ag tshom ni khri srong btsan yin pas khri srong btsan gyi sras gung srong yin pa gtan nas mi 'gal/'gal ba ni khri lde gtsug brtan dang mes ag tshom gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbyar ba de rang yin pas/ de gnyis so sor 'phral nas go ba tha dad du len dgos/de ltar byas na mes ag tshom gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po khri srong btsan yin pa gsal rtogs thub par 'gyur zhing / khong gi sras gung srong dang de'i sras mang srong ste gung srong grongs rjes mang srong dang lhan du bzhugs pas mkhas pa lde'u lags kyis kyang ‘‘de nas gung srong gung btsan gyi blon po myang mang bo rje gsal snang dang snubs btsan sto re mang snang gis blon po byas nas

‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 121lo bcu gsum lon nas chab srid lo lnga bzung ste/ dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes nas yab ma 'das pa la grongs so/ / sras ma bltams pas yab kyis yang srid bzung ngo / / de nas khyi'i lo la de'i sras mang srong mang btsan bltams te/ de nas lo skor gcig na mes 'das nas lo bcu bzhir rgyal srid bzung ste sku tshe nyer bdun bzhes pa'i dus na gtsang gi bar snang (tun hong gter yig la bang sna zhes 'byung ) zhes par sku 'das so/ / ri’zhes gsungs/des na gung srong yab khri srong btsan gyi dgung lo 52pa ste spyi lo 62 0lor 'khrungs shing 622lor chab srid bzhes/ 624lor kong jo bslangs/ yab bzhugs bzhin du chab srid lo lnga bskyangs te spyi lo 627par gtsang gi bang sna zhes par sras ma 'khrungs pa la sku 'das/ de'i phyi lo 62ṭ+wāṃpar mang srong 'khrungs shing mes dbon gnyis zhal 'dzoms bzhin du mes ag tshom gyis lo bcu gnyis ring yang srid bskyangs/ de ltar byung bas khong gnyis bar mes dbon gyi 'brel ba mthong chos mngon 'gyur du grub 'dug pa shin tu gsal ces/ /mes srong btsan sgam por smar ag yod rabs yig cha khag la ma mthong yang / chos rgyal sgrub phug gi 'jim sku dang gna' bo'i 'dra thang mang bor khong gi shar nyams kyi sgeg chos la sma ra dang ag tshom ldan pa bris pas/ gang ltar khong gi zhal ngor sma ra dang ag tshom stug po yod pa rang cag rnams nges pa 'drong dgos pa red/ de bas 'dir yang mes khri srong btsan dgung lo gya gnyis bzhugs pas dbu skra dang ag tshom dkar por gyur yod pa chos nyid kyis grub phyir/ kong jo'i me long la 'char ba skad kyi ‘‘rgas 'khogs dbu skra dkar po can/ byad kyang ag tshom dkar pos khengs ri’pa'i rgad po'i rnam pa de yang / don dam par srong btsan sgam por 'byor gyi khri lde gtsug brtan la ma yin pa rjes dpag gis grub/ spyir btsan po'i lo rgyus yig cha dngos ma ni

122gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho3ma ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/bstan pa bshig pa'i khrod brlag tshar zhing / phyi rabs rnams bskangs pa ni phal cher de nas lo bdun ci phyin pa'i tshun gyi kha rgyun dang gtam rgyud sogs bsdus nas gung bsgrigs pa yin pas dag min sna tshogs yod/ mang che ba lo rgyus kyi gnad do ci bzhin du thon yang 'ga' zhig spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes kyis lha sgrung gi ngo bor bsgyur pa dang / 'ga' zhig gnas skabs kyi chab srid kyis bden pa'i ngo bo thog ma nyid nas bkab ste gsang sgrogs gnyis su gleng bas sgra ji bzhin par go mi rung ba nyid du btod/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na gtam rgyud dang lha sgrung tshul can du thon pa'i lo rgyus kyi skabs don de dag la lo rgyus dngosagatso ring lugs kyi lta ba'i sgo nas zhib dpyod nan mo bgyi dgos par yod pas/ dpyod dbang don grub rgyal gyis kyang ‘‘ngag thog gi lo rgyus nang du rnam pa lha sgrung la bcings pa shas che na yang / de'i nang du mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i dngos gtso'i bsam blo dang lo rgyus kyi byung ba ngo ma yod par su zhig gis bsnyon par nus/’’zhes gnad la 'khel bar gsungs shing / 'di las nga tshos bod kyi lo rgyus kyi gnad don 'ga' zhig lha sgrung la gzhi 'dres te yod pa gsal rtogs thub par yod/ des na kong jo'i me long la 'char ba skad du bris pa'i gtam rgyud de yang don dam par skabs don gsang ba'i ched du thun mong ma yin pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes kyis gnas tshul sgyur bcos byas pa mngon gsal dod por yod pas/ me long la dang por 'char ba bu yag lha'i sras po 'dra ba mthong bar brjod pa de gung srong yin la/ thengs gnyis par 'char ba'i rgad po skra dang ag tshom dkar po can mthong ba de khri srong btsan yin/ kong jo slong ba'i skabs gung srong sku 'tsho bar yod la gdan 'dren pa'i skabs grongs pas mi bzhugs pa dang / yin na'ang bod rnams gsang rgya byas te gdan drangs pa don gyis bstan yod pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bod dbus la slebs kyang lo drug tsam la mo hreng du bsdad pa dang /

‘‘mes ag tshom ’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 123mthar ag tshom dkar po can gyi khri srong btsan la bsus par sgro btags nas thang gis srong btsan gya gcig pa la mag pa'i cho lo sbyar bar mngon pas/gang ltar ag tshom dkar po'i cha lugs de mang srong dbon po'i mig nang na mes po khong gi sger chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig gi tshul du gyur yod stabs ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’zhes byis pa'i ngag gis de ltar btags shing / khong nyid nam rgyun brda des bos pas spyi grags ma yin pa'i ming 'di thog mar khab so'i nang khul la byung bar snyam/btsan po khri lde gtsug brtan la ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’zhes ji mi snyam par 'bod pa de/ don dngos su lo rgyus kyi gnad la ma zhugs pa'i gtam du mngon yang / sngon chad 'di'i skor la blo gros kyi 'jug pa zhib mos dogs slong gnang mkhan ma byung bas btang snyoms su bzhag 'dir smra srol rnying ba las brgal nas de ltar dogs dpyod bgyis na/ mang mang zhig gi blor ji 'dra zhig 'char bar tshod mi dpog mod/ gang ltar sgra don gyi 'brel ba'i cha nas brtags na don gyi snying bo de 'dra zhig tshur 'byin pas mi 'dod na'ang bsam blo gtong dgos par 'dug dpe mi srid do snyam na srong btsan skabs btsun mo slong ba'i 'bul skyes kyi rnam grangs la yang / bka' chem bka' khol ma gtso byas pa'i chos 'byung phal che bar bal bzang khri btsun gyi slong rten la ‘‘gser khrab rin po che'i rgyan can ’’(gser khrab bam rin po che'i khrab zhes kyang 'byung )byin pa dang / rgya bza' kong jo'i slong rten la ‘‘gser rmog rin po che'i rgyan can ’’(gser rmog gam rin po che'i rmog ces kyang 'byung )byin rabs gleng ba de yang yul 'chug pa ste/ thang yig gsar rnying dang bod kyi chos 'byung me sbrang sogs la kong jo'i slong rten gser khrab rin po che'i rgyan can byin rabs dngos su 'byung bas 'di gnyis kyang rim pa 'chol 'dug pa shes nus/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na rgan rin po che dor zhi tshang gis lo rgyus skor

124gtsosayi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sbong slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/thag gcod rgyu shin tu dka' mo yin/ mang mang gi kha rgyun la yid rton mi rung ba mang du yod par ma zad/ yig tshang du bkod pa'i lo rgyus yin yang yid rton mi rung ba mang du yod ces gsungs pa ni gnad la gzhol pa'i ngag tshad ma ba yin pas/ don dam pa'i gnas lugs la'ang bod kyi lo rgyus ban bon gnyis kyi kha 'thab las dngos don mog por bsgyur pa yod la/ 'ga' zhig rgan po'i ngag rgyun yig 'brur bkod pas dag cha ma mthon pa'ang yod nges phyir/ yig ngor byung tshad tshang mar blang dor med par yid ches byed pa ni rig pa smra ba'i gnas lugs la mi mdzes pa shin tu gsal/gsum pa/ 'jang tsha dang gung srong gi 'gal 'khrul skor zhib tu gsed pa/lugs rnying gi kong jo 'jang tsha lha dbon la bsus pa dang / 'jang tsha grongs nas yab khri lde gtsug brtan gyis bzhes par grags pa'i ‘‘gtam rgyud 'di ’’chos lugs sogs kyi dgos pa gzhan med na shin tu mun sprul du gyur pas ‘‘dpyad mi bzod pa ’’dhirgan rin po che dor zhi tshang gis mdzad pa'i lung rigs bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang la mjal na bde blag ngang rtogs thub par yod/gal srid gtam rgyud 'di bden ngor bcug na yab ma skyes pa la sras thog mar skye dgos pas gnas lugs la ji ltar 'tshams/ de bas kong jo bsus pa'i gtam rgyud 'di nyid rdzun gyi phung tshogs mi 'byor bzhin du 'jang tsha yab sras gnyis la btsan gyis khag 'gel byas pa shin tu gsal bas/ lo rgyus kyi gnad la mi 'phrod pa'i nor 'khrul 'di'i ngo bo cis kyang rtogs dgos pa'i chos can du 'byung / gnad don 'di gsal rtogs byung na da gzod ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi dang thogs don rnal ma khong du chud par 'gyur la/ ‘‘pha zhwa bu skyon ’’du gyur pa'i nor 'khrul gyi nongs dmigs sogs kyang rang bzhin nyid

‘‘mes ag tshom gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 125kyis 'grol thub par 'gyur ro/ /'jang tsha lha dbon zer ba'i mi zhig btsan po'i gdung rabs la byung ngam zhes na/ khri lde gtsug brtan gyi sras su byung yod pa ma zad/ chab srid sgyu ma'i zlos gar khrod du nyams nyes 'khur ba'i lo rgyus kyi mi sna gal chen kyang yin/ khong gi skyed ma 'jang yul las bsus pas 'jang tsha dang btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyang yin pas lha dbon zhes bos par mngon yang tun hong gter yig la lhas bon zhes 'byung / gang ltar yab yum gnyis kyi rus khongs kyi 'brel ba'i cha nas de ltar btags pas/ nga tshos skabs der 'jang bod rgyal khab gnyis bar 'brel lam zab mo yod pa rtogs thub pa ste/ ‘‘lho phyogs kyi smad na 'jang dum mya dkar po zhes bya ba'i rgyal bo sde mi chung ba zhig 'dug la/rgyal bo (khri lde gtsug brtan )thugs sgam po'i rlabs dang thabs kyis bka' stsal te/ mya'i rgyal bo kag la bang zhes bya ba/ (bod kyi )'bangs su phyag 'tshal nas/ thabs gcung stsal te/ (btsan po'i chab srid la )mi mang gi snon btab/ yul che'i 'dab bskyed ’’dupar tun hong yig rnying la grags pas/ khab sor yang ‘‘'jang mo khri btsun khab tu bzhes pa'i ’’dhiganyen 'brel gyis rgyal sras shig 'khrungs par mtshan la yang / 'jang bod kyi 'brel ba'i cha nas 'jang tsha lha dbon zhes ma bgros rang mthun du btags par sems/'ja' tsha lha dbon nam 'khrungs pa'i lo tshigs skor yig tshang khag la mi gsal yang / 'das pa'i lo ni ‘‘yos bu'i lo la (spyilo72kha)btsan po dbyar chab srid la beg du gsheg ste/ sras lhas bon dron na bzhugs/ bzhugs pa las nongs/ btsan po yab dgun bod yul du slar gshegs/ btsan mo kim sheng khong co nongs par lo chig’’dhices tun hong gter yig la gsal 'khod byung bas yos lo ste spyi lo 729bar gshegs pa tshad thub tu 'dug de nas lo gsum phyin pa'i ‘‘rta'i lo (spyilo 742)la/ btsan po pho brang dbyard mtshar

126gtsos mi rigs dge 'osasatho rim tshed sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bu sna na bzhugs/ rgya'-i pho nya an da lang dru mya nag po po nya la bṛ pyag 'atsald/zlor shud pa khong zung dh+ra / lang gro khong rtsan gny-is/ 'byung 'juge rtsis rgyaste thang khram btab/ khu nye mon gangasu blon mang po rjes 'a zha'-i mkhos brgyas/btsan po srong lde brtsan brag dmar du' bltam/ yum mang mo rje nongs phar lo gatshog ’’rjoces byung ba'i rta'i lo ste/ spyi lo 742par khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs pas/ rgyal sras 'di gnyis kyi 'khrungs 'das la bar khyad lo gsum tsam brgyugs shing zhal ngo lhan 'dzoms med pa tun hong gter yig la gsal yang / lde'u chos 'byung la ‘‘ljang ('jang )tsha lha dbon snyags khri bzang yang ston gyis bkrongs te/ rgyu mtshan khri srong lde btsan la mnga' ris gtod pa'i phyir ’’⑪zhes gsang ba phyag rgya can gyi 'chad lugs ltar byung ba dang / dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs la ‘‘gnyags (snyags )kyi bu mo ma blangs pa'i 'khon gyis gnyags khri bzang yang 'don (ston ) gyis rgyal bu ('jang tsha )bkrongs ’’⑪zhes sgrogs pa snang lugs ltar byung bas/ gsang sgrogs gnyis kyi 'dod tshul de tun hong gter yig gi dgongs par gtan nas mthun thabs med pa zhig tu gyur 'dug gal srid gsang ba'i lugs de bden na rgyal sras 'di gnyis skabs der zhal 'dzoms byung yod pa dang / tun hong gter yig bden na skabs der zhal 'dzoms gtan nas byung med pas gang bden gyi brdar sha las sla bos mi chod mod/ skabs don gyi chab srid la brtags na gsang lugs kyi gleng ba de bden thub tu mchi bar mngon pa dang / tung hong gter yig skabs thog de'i yi ger nges pa'i cha nas bsam na lde'u chos 'byung sogs la byung ba ni ha lam log bshad sha stag tu gyur pas/ gleng ba 'di gnyis las tshad grub pa ni 'di'o zhes kha tshon gcod rgyu shin tu dka' mor 'byung yod pa red/lo rgyus kyi gnad don la spyir gsang sgrogs gnyis byung bas de gtso bo

‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 127chab srid kyi dgos par bcos pa ste/ gsang ba phyag rgya can ni skabs don ngo ma yin la sgrogs pa snang lugs ni chab srid kyi dgos par bstun nas dngos don 'gebs spyad la ched du bzos pa zhig yin/ gsang sgrogs kyi rig pa 'di'i sgo nas brtags na/ lde'u chos 'byung dang dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs la byung ba de bden thub tu mchi yang / tun hong gter yig la brtags na de lta gnas lugs la mi srid pas 'di'i bar du 'gal ba chen po zhig byung 'dug bod 'dir sngon gyi lugs la btsan por sras ci tsam 'khrungs kyang / gcen por rgyal sa gtod cing de'i srid dbang sra brtan nang gtsang yong bar gcung rnams thang mtshams su dbab pa'i srol ka yod pas/khrisrong lde btsan rgyun lugs la thang mtshams su phab nas 'jang tsha lha dbon chab srid la gtod dgos par yod mod/ rus zhen sogs kyis go brjes nas 'jang tsha dbab rtsis byas pa la bod 'jang gi mdza' mthun 'brel bar bsam ste ma phab/ lhan du bzhag na chab srid nang gtsang mi yong / de bas nar ma son gong gnyags khri bzang yang ston gyis chab srid lag thabs spyad nas 'jang tsha lnga lam du btang zhing / de'i don ngo'i gsang ba srung spyad la gnyags kyi bu mo ma blangs pa'i 'khon gyis bkrongs so zhes rdzun gyi gtam rgyud bsgrigs nas sgrogs pa snang lugs kyi gleng ba de ched du btod par mngon/ de ltar bsam na khag dkri ba'i yul tsam 'gal yang don dam par gsang sgrogs gnyis dmigs yul mi 'gal bas bden grub tu mchi yang snyam mod/ da dung brtag dpyad gnang rgyu gal che'o/ /rgyal sras 'jang tsha lha dbon grongs pa'i gnas tshul yig rnying khag de ltar mi 'dra ba'i thog tu/ da dung lo rgyus smra ba mi nyung ba zhig ‘‘rta dkyus btang nas grongs ’’rabs gsungs pas/ 'das rkyen rta grir 'dogs pa ni gsang sgrogs gnyis la mi mthun pa'i gleng lugs gsar pa zhig yin/ gang

128gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bden gyi 'khrun ngo gcod dka' yang kha mi mtshungs pa'i gnas tshul 'di dag las 'jang tsha'i gnad don ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog tu nyog 'dzings che ba'i le tshan skyon can zhig yin pa shin tu gsal/ rta dkyus kyis grongs pa'i btsan po zhig bod kyi rgyal rabs khrod byung yod kyang yul dus sogs 'gal bas 'jang tsha lha dbon gtan nas min/ gal srid yin du bcug na'ang kong jo bsu ba'i dngos yul 'jang tsha ma yin pas 'byor thabs gtan nas mi rnyed/ des na 'di ni lo rgyus khag gnyis kyi 'gal 'dzol te/ gzhi gcig tu bsgrigs pa ni brtag dpyod ma gnang ba'i 'khrul skyon chen por mthong / gna' bo'i lo rgyus de ltar 'dzings pa las ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi'i ngos 'dzin 'khrul bar gyur cing / rta dkyus kyis grongs pa'i btsan po yang 'jang tsha la 'chugs pa dang / 'un shing kong jo bsu ba'i dngos yul yang mun sprul du gyur nas rgya bza' ma 'byor gong sras grongs pas mes rgas 'khog zhal tshom dkar po can dang 'dus par brjod pa'i gyim shing kong jo'i gtam rgyud de yang bcug pa'i skabs nor ba mngon gsal dod por snang /rta dkyus btang nas grongs pa'i btsan po gang yin zhe na/ gung srong gung btsan te gsang ba phyag rgya can la ‘‘btsan srong bzhugs nam lho khar rta gyir bkrongs te/ rgyu mtshan la rta rgod ma thub pas so/ / ’’yizhes byung bas/btsan srong bzhugs nam ni khong nyid chab srid bzhes pa'i skabs kyi srid 'dzin bkur ming yin/ (btsan po 'di ba'i mtshan yig la gung ri gung btsan dang /gung srong gung btsan/ btsan srong bzhugs nam zhes snga rabs pa rnams 'bri srol sna tshogs thon/) mes ag tshom gyi gdags gzhi 'khrul ba'i sgo nas phyi dus kyi lo rgyus smra ba rnams gung ri'i 'das rkyen 'di yang 'jang tsha lha dbon la sbyar nas 'khrul thog la yang 'khrul gyi 'khor lo bskor bar mngon/ de bas kong jo bsus pa dang rgyal sras grongs pa gnyis rgyal rabs snga phyi nor ba dang / gung

‘6mes ag tshom ’’gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 129srong rta grir grongs pa de 'jang tsha la btags nas phan tshun go brjes pa dang /'un shing kong jo dang gyim shing kong jo gnyis kyang phan tshun 'khrul la btsan po khrisrong btsan dang khri lde gtsug brtan gnyis kyang cha lugs nor nas/ rgyal rabs snga ma'i lo rgyus kyi byon rabs mang bo zhig rgyal rabs phyi ma la btsan gyis bkab nas pha zhwa bur skyon du btang / rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na rgan rin po che dor zhi tshang gis ‘‘gyim shing kong jo dang 'jang tsha'i gtam rgyud de yang yig tshang gi lo tshigs dang gtan nas 'grig thabs med pa zhig yin pas/kong jo snga ma dang gung ri gung btsan gyi don de kong jo phyi mar pha zhwa bun bskon du song ba zhig min nam snyam mo/ / ’’⑫zhes bden pa'i gnas lugs khengs skyung gis gsungs shing / don dam par khong gi gsung de ni lo rgyus kyi gnad rtsa zin pa'i ngag tshad grub pa yin phyir/ 'un shing kong jo bsu ba'i dngos yul gung srong yin la/ rta grir grongs pa'i btsan po yang gung srong yin/mang srong 'khrungs pa dang gung srong grongs pa gnyis lo snga phyi'i chags 'jig tu gyur pas kong jo'i me long la 'char ba skad kyi thog ma'i gzhon shar des gung srong bstan pa dang / phyi ma'i bgres song des khri srong btsan bstan pas/ de dang rten byung 'brel du gyur pa'i ‘‘mes ag tshom ’’yang don dam par khri srong btsan yin la khri lde gtsug brtan ma yin pa shin tu gsal/bzhi pa/ gung srong dang kong jo gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa/gung srong dang kong jo gnyis zhal 'dzoms yod med lo rgyus kyi dngos gzhi la mi go yang / yongs grags la kong jo bod la skyod pa'i lam bar tsam na btsan po'i pho nya byung ste gung srong rta dkyus kyis grongs rabs kyi brda 'byor ba skad du brjod pas zhal ma 'dzoms pa tsam du snang la/ tun hong yig rnying gi zong bo 'go sngon can du yang gung srong dang mjal rabs yi ger ma zin pas

130gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/lhan 'dzoms byung min mi gsal/ yin kyang kong jo bod la 'byor nas khri srong btsan gshegs pa'i bar lo dgu phyin pas/ lo ngo dgu de tun hong yig rnying la ‘‘de nas lo gsum na (spyilo 644)/ btsan po khri srong btsan gyi ring la/lig snya shur brlags te zhang zhung thams cad 'bangs su bkug ste mnga'o/ /de nas lo drug (spyilo 65rkya)na/ btsan po khri srong brtsan dgung du gshegs so/ / btsan mo mun cang kong co dang dgung lo gsum bshos so ’’⑫zhes byung bas/ khri srong btsan dang kong jo gnyis lo gsum las ma bshos pa shin tu gsal/ sngon gyi lo drug la sras gung srong dang zhal 'dzoms pa'i bzo 'dra zhig tshig ngos tsam la 'byung yang / mang srong gi 'khrungs lo (spyilo62ṭ+wāṃ)dang gung srong gi 'das lo (spyilo 627)/ kong jo'i 'byor lo (spyilo 641)rnams kyi khyad bag zhib tu bsdur na/ kong jo rgya yul nas ma bskyod pa'am/ yang na yar skyod pa'i lam thog tsam na gung srong rta dkyus kyis grongs pas zhal ngo lhan 'dzoms med pa shin tu gsal bas/ lo de drug la kong jo bod yul du chen chun btsun mo'i 'gal ba'i khrod mo hreng nyid du lus pa de lta red/ dngos gzhi'i bsu yul mi mchis pas bod rnams phyir skyel rtsis byas pa la ‘‘bu mo'i 'dun ma lan cig yin ’’zhes re snyegs dgung lo don dgur slebs pa'i btsan por bcol ba ni bden pa'i gtam yang dag tu srid do/ /kong jo bsu ba'i dngos yul rta grir grongs pas mi bzhugs na'ang /bod yul nas lo drug bsdad mthar slar log pa'i 'dun pa blos btang nas spyi lo 647par mes khri srong btsan gyi btsun mo'i rtul zhugs gnang / de ltar byung bas bod pa rnams mtha' gcig tu kong jo khri srong btsan la bzhes par sgro btags pa dang / thang gis kyang srong btsan gshegs pa'i snga lo ste spyi lo 64khalor mag pa'i cho lo bstsal nas de lta'i don can du khas blangs/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na bod kyi lo rgyus rtog zhib byed mkhan rin ne chang gis

‘6mes ag tshom gyi gdags gzhi ngo ma btsan po gang yin skor gleng ba/ 131kyang rgya bza' kong jo sras gung btsan la blangs pa yin pa 'dra zhes dogs slong gnang zhing de ltar bsam gzhigs skyed pa ni don gyi gnad la zhugs pa'i gtam yin pa ma zad/ rgan rin po che dor zhi tshang gis ‘‘nga'ang srong btsan dgung lo gya gnyis la gshegs pa 'thad ldan du 'dod cing / rgya bza' kong jo yang thog mar sras gung btsan gyi mna' mar bslangs shing / sras dang mnyam du lo drug bsdad/ ( sras gung srong dang kong jo gnyis zhal 'dzoms ma byung bas/ lo drug ring bod dbus nas mo hreng nyid du bsdad/) de dus mes srong btsan zur bzhugs byas nas sras kyis srid bskyangs/ kong jo blangs pa'i lo bdun parasras gung btsan lo bco brgyad lon pa rta bskyod pas bkrongs/ de nas mes po srong btsan slar yang rgyal khrir phebs/ kong jo slar rgya nag tu skyel grabs byas kyang / thang gi chab srid kyi dmigs yul dang 'gal bar dgongs nas/ bu mos 'dun ma lan cig yin zhes mes po rgan po rgas shing 'khogs pas ngo mi sdug cing / byad spus khengs pa de dang 'dus/ rgyal phran dag dang thang gi blon po sogs kyis kyang rgyal bos rang gi sras kyi mna' ma dang 'dus pa la 'dra min sna tshogs bshad cing / mtshams der thang gi gong mas kong jo mes po srong btsan gyi btsun mor dngos su khas len pa mtshon phyir mag pa'i cho lo sprad cing khyab bsgrags byas te/ mang mang gi kha 'khrugs mnan zhing srong btsan gyi ngo srung ba red bsams shing / de ltar byas na kong jo srong btsan dang lo drug la ngo ma 'jal ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / lo gsum la bshos zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / gshegs pa'i snga lor cho lo gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan rnams snga phyi 'brel chags pa zhig yin snyam ’’nyuzhes bden pa'i gnad las 'phros te lo rgyus 'khrugs pa'i 'dzing rgya lhug par grol ba 'di la kun gyis nges pa skyed rigs so/ /'gro ba mi'i skye khams chags tshul gyi nges pa'i cha nas dpag na/ rgas

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 139pa med zer na/ 'o na chos thams cad rtogs nas mi rtag pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyi rgol yang dag la chos thams cad rtogs pa'i gang zag yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ des chos thams cad rtogs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir sogs spro sla/ byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i don dang tha snyad gnyis ka sgrub byed kyi rtags yang dag yin byas pa la/ gzhan dag na re/ byas pa chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i don sgrub kyi rtags yang dag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par byed pa'i dngos kyi sgrub bya'i chos su bzung bya yang yin mtshan nyid yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skad cig ma de'i dngos kyi bsgrub bya'i chos yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra skad cig ma de'i dngos kyi bsgrub bya yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra skad cig ma chos can/ khyod byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyi rgol yang dag gis ma rtogs par thal/ de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya dang phyogs yin pa'i phyir/ma khyab na yig cha dang 'gal la/ 'dod mi nus te/ byas rtags kyi sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyi rgol yang dag gis khyod rtogs pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud na khyod rtogs pa'i blo don mthun yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud na khyod rtogs pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la khyod rtogs pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub tu song ba'i rgol ba de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ yig char/ de 'dra'i rgol ba dbang rno med kyang dbang rtul yod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la de rtogs pa yod kyang des ma rtogs zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra

140gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho3ma ched sbyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyi rgol yang dag yin na byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyi rgol yang dag gi rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ phyi rgol yang dag yin na/ phyi rgol yang dag gi rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ skyes bu yin na skyes bu'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa yin pas khyab pas phyir/ der thal/ nang gi gzugs yin na/ skyes bu'i shes rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs yin pas khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyir sogs spro bya mang ngo /gzhan yang / byas pa dus kun tu sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin byas pa la/ kho na re/ byas pa'i rgyu dus dang 'bras dus re re'i dus su byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i dus su byas pa de sgrub kyi rjes khyab yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i dus su byas pa mi rtag pa dang 'brel ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi rgyu dus dang 'bras dus re re'i dus su khyod medaci par thal/ khyod dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byas pa rtags su ma bkod pa'i tshe byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags su bkod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de'i dus sam tshe yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir sogs dang /ri bong rwa'i dus su byas pa de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag yin min sogs spro bar bya'o/ /byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yin na byas pa dang gcig yin pa'i khyab byas pa la/ kho na re/ skad cig ma chos can/byas pa dang gcig yin par thal/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byas pa'i rtags kyi thal

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 141'gyur chos can/ mi rtag ste/ skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags yin pa'i phyir zer/ /byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin byas pa la/gzhan dag na re/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rjes khyab yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rjes khyab sgrub byed kyi tshad ma gsum yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags dang dgag bya'i chos kyi gzhi mthun 'gag pa'i tshad ma yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags dang dgag bya'i chos kyi gzhi mthun med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rtag pa de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rtag pa de sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yin gang zhig dgag bya'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/bdag med yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ rtag pa dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/tshul gsum tshang ba rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid zer ba la/ gzhan dag na re/ de mi 'thad par thal/ dang po'i mtha' dpyod las de bkag pa'i phyir zer na ma grub ste/ de ni khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi tshul gsum tshang ba de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid zer ba bkag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la gzhan dag na re/ byas pa byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i sbyor skor gcig gi dngos khyab grub par thal/ khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi rjes khyab grub pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de'i rtags

142gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyis de sgrub kyi rjes khyab grub cing dngos khyab ma grub par gsungs pa'i phyir/yang gzhan dag byas pa byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rjes khyab yin par rtogs pa'i tshad ma'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de la byas pa byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rjes khyab yin par grub pa de 'jog pa'i phyir/gsum pa/ nyan bya sogs kyi mtha' dpyad pa/nyan bya sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs yin byas pa la/ gzhan dag na re/ nyan bya chos can/khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs chos gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi phyogs chos can du song ba'i gang zag gis de sgrub kyi khyab pa rnal mar yang ma nges phyin ci log tu yang ma nges pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/khyab pa rnal mar nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de sgrub la phyogs chos can du song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud na nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges pa'i blo yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rgyud na nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sngar nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges phyis su sgra dang nyan bya'i ming don gyi 'brel ba nges nas de'i rjes su nyan bya'i rtags la brten nas sgra mi rtag par rtogs dgos kyi gang zag de yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nyan bya sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyogs chos can du song ba'i gang zag yin na/ nyan bya sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyogs chos can du song ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyis bsdus pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub ste/ dang po'i mtha' dpyod las/ de de grub kyi rtags yang dag du song ba'i rgol ba srid pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab ste/ zhes dang / yang de

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 143las/ sgra chos can/ mig shes kyis bzung bya yin par thal/ khyod mig shes kyi bzung byar byed pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ gzhan dag ma khyab zer ba la 'o na/ sngar nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges phyis su sgra dang nyan bya'i ming don gyi 'brel ba nges nas sgra mi rtag pa ma nges pa gcig yod par thal/ nyan bya sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag tu song ba'i rgol ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rnam bshad las/ phyogs chos su song nas nyan bya mi rtag par nges nas sgra la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa ma nges pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / yang de nyid las/ nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges pa'i tshad ma de nyid kyis sgra la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges par byed pa yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / dang po'i mtha' dpyod las/ rim pa de ltar nges pa'i gang zag gis sgra mi rtag pa nges pa'i blo rjes dpag ma yin kyang de 'dra'i rjes dpag srid pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer ba la gzhan dag na re/ rim pa de ltar nges pa'i gang gi rgyud kyi sgra mi rtag par nges pa'i blo rtags can rjes dpag ma yin kyang de 'dra'i rjes dpag srid pa mi 'gal ba'i don yin zer na/ 'o na rim pa de ltar nges pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi sgra mi rtag par nges pa'i blo la nyan bya'i rtags la brten nas skyes pa zhig mi srid par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyan bya'i rtags la brten nas sgra mi rtag par rtogs pa'i rjes dpag skyes pa zhig mi srid par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sngar gyi yig char 'gal lo/ / rim pa de ltar nges ba'i gang zag gis sgra mi rtag pa nyan bya'i rtags la brten nas rtogs pa ma yin yang nyan bya'i rtags la brten nas rtogs pa gcig yod dgos pa'i phyir/der thal/ dang po'i mtha' dpyod las/ 'di spyir btang gi dbang du byas kyi/gzhan du na sngar khyab pa dang phyis ming don gyi 'brel ba la brten nas sgra nyan

144gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bya yin pas phyogs chos kyis rjes dpag bskyed pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ zhib cha de ltar med na gong 'og nges 'gal 'byung ba'i phyir zhes pa'i zhib cha 'byed tshul yod pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ sngar nyan bya la mi rtag pa'i khyab pa nges phyis su sgra dang nyan bya'i ming don gyi 'brel ba nges nas sgra mi rtag pa ma nges pa'i gang zag de chos can/ nyan bya rtag mi rtag the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ sgra dang nyan bya'i ming don gyi 'brel ba nges pa'i gang zag gang zhig sgra rtag mi rtag the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dang bo'i mtha' dpyod las/ khyod nyan bya rtag mi rtag the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod sgra dang nyan bya'i ming don gyi 'brel ba nges pa'i zag gang zhig khyod sgra rtag mi rtag the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ ming don gyi 'brel ba sngar nges pa la dgongs zhes zer ro/ / rim pa de ltar nges pa'i gang zag gis sgra mi rtag pa tshad ma gnyis kyi byed pa las rtogs pa yin byas pa la/ kha cig na re/ mi 'thad par thal/ de rtags la brten nas rtogs dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal rnam bshad las/ phra ba'i mi rtag pa rtags las rtogs kyang rags pa'i mi rtag pa mngon sum gyis grub pa dang mi 'gal lo/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de ni rtags sam rgyu mtshan la brten nas rtogs dgos pa'i don yin gyi/ rtags sbyor dngos su bkod pa la mi bltos pa'i phyir te/ mtha' dpyod las/ rjes dpag thams cad sgrub ngag la brten mi dgos par 'dir yang 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sgra skad cig tha ma mi rtag pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i so skyes zhig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na 'dod byas pa la/ sgra skad cig tha ma chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba sbyor ba yang dag ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ tshul

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 145gsum grub pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ yang na/ de 'dra'i sbyor ba de sbyor ba yang dag ma yin par thal/ de'i rtags kyis sgrub dgos kyi skabs babs kyi gang zag cig med pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ 'di ltar rtags med byis par byas/ / skyes bu phyis 'byung ba dang ni/ / 'brel med mar me la sogs kyi/ /'jig pa mthong bas yongs spyod nyid/ / ces dang / spyi yi rten ni grub pa na/ / spyi de nyid ni grub pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sgra chos can/ khyod skad cig tha ma mi rtag pa rtogs na mi rtag pa rtogs pa'i khyab par thal/ khyod skad cig tha ma mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na sgra skad cig tha ma chos can/ khyod mi rtag pa mi rtag pa phra mo yin par thal khyod dngos po yin pa'i phyir na de sgra sbyar nas lan 'debs dgos so/ / rtsa bar/de ma grub na de ltar de/ / rab tu grub phyir rjes dpag yin/ / 'dra ba gzhan ni yod pa'i phyir/ / la lar yongs su mi shes te/ / 'khrul phyir sgong gi tha dad bzhin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/bzhi pa/ rang rten chos can gyi mtha' dpyad pa/rtsa bar/ thog ma'i bag chags las byung ba'i/ / rnam par rtogs pa'i yongs sgrib pa/ / yod med gnyis ka la brten pa/ / sgra don chos ni rnam pa gsum/ / zhes sogs kyi skabs su phyogs glang gis bkod pa'i sbyor ba'i rtags chos don gsum dngos bzung ba yin zhes pa la kho na re/ phyogs glang gis bkod pa'i sbyor ba'i chos can la gtso bo'i don spyi 'jog par thal/'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rtog pa la gtso bor snang ba de'i chos can la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ ṭīka chen las/ rtog pa la gtso bor snang ba de nyid grangs can pa dag gtso bo khyad par lnga ldan du 'dod la/ rang lugs la sgra don du 'dod pas khyad par lnga ldan gyi gtso bo yin min rtsod pa'i gzhi yin

146gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'i phyir/ rtog pa la gtso bor snang ba nyid chos can du bzung bar byas pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ phyogs glang gis bkod pa'i sbyor ba'i chos can la gtsor snang mi 'jog par thal/ de la gtso bo rang mtshan de nyid 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam bshad las/ phyogs glang gi sbyor ba 'di'i dngos zin ltar na/ gtso bo rang mtshan de nyid chos can du bzung nas de yod pa la dgag pa byed pa ltar mngon la/ de'i dgongs pa rnam 'grel 'dir bkral ba na gtso bo snang ba de nyid gtso bo rang mtshan gyi nyer len dang / gtso bo de nyid nye bar len pa por sgrub pa 'gog pa ltar snang / 'di dag gi dgongs pa mkhas pa'i dbang bo kā ma la zhi las/gtso bo nyid chos can du bzung nas dgag dgos kyi de min na de rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyi nyer len yin pa kheg kyang gtso bo rang ldog nas mi kheg par 'gyur la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang na/ rtog pa la gtso bo snang ba chos can/ phyogs glang gis bkod pa'i sbyor ba'i chos can yin par thal/ rnam bshad las/ rtags tshad mas nges pa'i gzhi ni gtso bor snang ba nyid la bzhed do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ gtsor snang chos can/ phyogs glang gis bkod pa'i sbyor ba'i chos can ma yin par thal/ rang brten chos can ma yin pa gang zhig chos can 'ba' zhig pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/de 'dra'i sbyor ba'i bsgrub bya'i chos dang khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi 'brel ba ma grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ chos kyi khyad par du byas pa'i chos can dang / chos can gyi khyad par du byas pa'i chos sogs bsgrub byar mi 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ chos can la tshad ma'i gnod kyang tshogs pa bsgrub bya yin pa la mi gnod par thal/ de la chos can 'ba' zhig pa las med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/rtsa bar/ gzhan du chos can gzhan la ni/ / gnod kyang 'di la ci zhig 'gag / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ 'di la chos can

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 147tshad ma'i bsal na bsgrub bya mi 'grub pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ sgra don smyon na sgrub pa la/ / chos kyi rten ni bsal ba'i phyir/ / tshogs pa bsgrub byar mi 'gyur la/ / yal gar chos ni grub pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/byas pa la kho na re/ sbyor ba yang dag yin na khyod kyi chos can yod pa'i ma khyab par thal/ gzhi ma grub pa chos can du bzung ba'i sbyor ba yang dag du ma yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan las/ gzhi ma grub pa chos can du bzung ba'i phyogs chos can gyi gtan tshigs mang po yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa nas/ de 'dra'i rtags yang dag yod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'jug pa las/ mo gsham bu ltar skye ba dang bral phyir/ de ltar gyur ba'i bdag ni yod min zhing / zhes gsungs pa lta bu mang ba'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ dang po'i mtha' dpyod las/ rang nyid rtsod gzhi yod med gang rung zhig bkod pa'i sbyor ngag dang thal 'gyur gang rung yin na/ rang nyid rtsod gzhi yod pa'i sbyor ngag dang thal 'gyur gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la gzhan dag na re/ rtog yul na yod pa'i rtags kyis ri bong rwa zla sgras rjod rung du sgrub par byed pa'i sbyor ba'i chos can yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/de 'dra'i sbyor ba'i chos can gyi ngo bo yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na de 'dra'i sbyor ba'i chos can gyi mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi yod med/ de la gang 'jog de 'dra'i sbyor ba'i chos can du bzung ba de 'dra'i sbyor ba'i chos can gyi mtshan nyid yin min/ chos can mtshon bya yin min sogs spro bar bya'o/ / de la kho na re/ ri bong rwa chos can/ yod pa yin par thal/ med pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyi gsal ba yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de 'dra'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags gsal gnyis ka phan tshun tha dad yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra

148gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched ljong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/chos can/ ma byas pa yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags gsal gnyis ka phan tshun tha dad yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ mtha' dpyod las/ rtags gsal tha dad kyi thal 'gyur yin na/ khyod kyi rtags gsal gnyis ka phan tshun tha dad yin pas khyab zer na/ sgra chos can/ ma byas pa yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ de 'dra'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags yod par thal/ rtag pa de yin pa'i phyir na kha cig ma khyab zer/ 'o na/ khyod rang la dngos por rtogs pa'i tshad ma mi rtag pa yod par thal/ bum pa de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dngos por rtogs pa'i tshad ma yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/dngos po ma yin pa'i phyir/ gong gi lung de song tshod kyi rtags la dgongs zer na/ de 'dra'i thal 'gyur gyi rtags gsal gnyis ka tha dad yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ de 'dra'i thal 'gyur de rtags gsal tha dad kyi thal 'gyur yin pa'i phyir/ sogs spro bar bya'o/ /lnga pa/ 'gal rtags sogs kyi mtha' dpyad pa/kha cig na re/ byas pa de sgra rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i chos kyi ngo bo 'gog pa'i 'gal rtags yin par thal/ mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan las/ dang po yod de/ sgra chos can/ rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba 'di chos kyi ngo bo 'gog byed dang / de'i 'gal rtags gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de gnyis ka yin kyang / chos kyi ngo bo 'gog pa'i 'gal rtags ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos kyi ngo bo sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 149yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ zer ba la gzhan dag na re/ sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags dang / sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag gnyis yin khyab mnyam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos yin kyang skad cig ma ma yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa ma yin pa de/ sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags yin kyang / sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig mi rtag pa'i rgyu dus su yod pa'i byas pa chos can/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin par thal/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags yin pa'i phyir zer na/'dod byas pa la/ de chos can/ mi rtag pa dang 'brel ba yin par thal sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de dang bdag gcig 'brel ma yin pa gang zhig rten byung 'brel ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ma grub na/ mi rtag pa'i rgyu mi rtag pa dang bdag gcig 'brel yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na mi 'dra zer ro/ kho na re/ nyan bya chos can/ sgra rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i 'gal rtags yin par thal/ khyod de sgrub kyi phyogs chos gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi dngos khyab phyin ci log tu nges pa'i phyir te/ sde bdun rgyan las/ 'gal rtags la mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de sgrub kyi phyogs r+has sgrub cing khyab pa phyin ci log tu tshad mas nges pa'o/ / zhes dang / mgul rgyan las/ sbyor ba skor gcig gi 'gal rtags kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ de sgrub kyi phyogs chos gang zhig khyod kyi rtags kyis de sgrub kyi dngos khyab phyin ci log tu nges pa yin pa de/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na kha cig ma khyab ste/ phyogs chos can du song ba'i gang zag gis nges pa la byed pa'i phyir/ zer ba la gzhan dag na re/ nyan bya chos can/ khyod sgra rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i 'gal rtags yin par thal/de sgrub kyi phyogs chos gang zhig de sgrub la phyogs chos can du song ba'i gang

150gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho rim ched phyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zag gis khyab pa phyin ci log tu nges pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'dra'i gang zag gi rgyud na de ltar nges pa'i blo dang tshad ma gang zag sogs yod pa'i phyir/phyi ma grub ste/ de la de ltar nges pa'i gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/sngar nyan bya la rtag pa ma yin pa'i khyab pa nges nas/ de'i phyis sgra dang nyan bya'i ming don gyi 'brel ba nges/ sgra rtag mi rtag the tshom za ba'i gang zag de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de 'dra gcig yod pa'i phyir te/ nyan bya sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag tu song ba'i rgol ba de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la nyan bya sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags su song bar thal/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu song ba'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ / rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ de sgrub kyi ma nges pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rtsa bar/ khyad par rnam par gcod pa yi/ /gtan tshigs su 'gyur ma mthong phyir/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ don byed nus stong chos can/ bye brag pas sangs rgyas pa la bkod pa'i sbyor ba de'i 'gal rtags yin par thal/ de sgrub kyi chos can gyi ngo bo 'gog byed dang 'gal rtags gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ zer na 'dod byas pa la/gzhan dag na re/ de 'dra'i sbyor ba chos can/ phyogs chos grub pa'i sbyor ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ shes 'dod med nas ma grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sangs rgyas pa la shes 'dod med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzhan don skabs kyi phyogs chos grub pa'i sbyor ba yin na/phyogs chos rgol phyi rgol gnyis ka'i grub dgos pa'i phyir/ rigs sgo las/phyogs kyi chos ni rgol ba dang phyi rgol ba gnyis ka la nges par bzung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang / rtsa bar/ ma grub sbyar ba brjod bya min/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ci rigs pa'i dpe don sbyor tshul gyis shes pa'i phyir zer ba dang / gzhan dag na re/ bye brag pas sangs rgyas pa la bkod
