tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 151pa'i dngos gyur gyi nam mkha' chos can/ rtag ste/ don byed nus stong yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba chos can/ khyod kyi chos can rgol phyi rgol gnyis kas grub par thal/ gzhan don skabs kyi phyogs chos grub pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir zer na/ gzhan dag ma khyab zer ba mi 'thad par thal/ 'di la chos can mthun snang ba yod par dbu sems kyi gzhung du ma las gsungs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ thal rang gnyis la chos can mthun snang ba yod pa'i dper bkod pa la zla bas kyang dpe la 'dra ba med pa'i lan mdzad pa'i phyir/'dod na/ rgol phyi rgol gnyis kas nam mkha' rtogs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ ming tsam mthun snang du grub pas mi chog pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod mi nus te/ bye brag pas nam mkha'i ngo bo thog reg bkag tsam gyi med dgag tu ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ bye brag pas bkod pa'i sgras zin gyi sbyor ba de 'gal rtags kyi sbyor ba yin par thal/ dz+wan byed nus stong gi rtags kyis nam mkha' dngos por sgrub pa'i phyogs chos can gyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i rtags kyis nam mkha' dngos por sgrub 'dod nas bkod pa'i de 'dra'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rtsa bar/ ma brjod na yang 'dod pa'i khyab/ / bdag gis don gzhan bsgrub byar 'dod/ / zhes dang / sgra ni rjod 'dod rjes 'brangs phyir/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod mi te/ de 'dra'i sgras zin gyi sbyor ba'i dngos khyab phyin ci log tu ma nges pa'i phyir dang / de 'dra'i sbyor ba ma nges pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ grangs can pas sangs rgyas pa la bkod pa'i mig sogs chos can/ 'dus pa ma yin pa'i yul can gzhan gyi don byed de/'dus shing bsags pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i sbyor ba chos can/ chos can rgol phyi rgol gnyis ka la mthun snang du grub par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ bdag gzhi dang bcas na shes bya nyer gsum dor nas nyer bzhi chos

152gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/can du 'dzin par rigs rgyan las gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ spyi gtso bo'i bdag gzhi mthun snang du grub par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/gtso bo mthun snang du grub pa thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ kha cig na re/bdag med yin na rtags yin pa'i khyab byas pa la/ kha cig na re/ byas pa kho na chos can/ rtags yin par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir zer na sbyor lugs skyon can gyi lan 'debs/ byas pa la kho na re/ byas pa kho na chos can/rtags yin par thal/ sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byas pa kho na'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir zer ba la/ gzhan dag na re/ byas pa kho na chos can/ mi rtag pa dang 'brel ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de dang tha dad yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer ro/ kha cig na re/ mtshan mo'i rgya mtsho'i skya rdzas mthong nas du ba yin min la the tshom za ba'i gang zag la/mtshan mo'i rgya mtshor chos can/ me yod de/ du ba yod pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa'i tshe na/ du ba de sbyor ba de'i rtags la the tshom za nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin par thal/ de yin par mgul rgyan las gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/'dod byas pa la kho na re/ de 'dra'i rgol ba du ba la the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skya rdzas du ba yin min la the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin na/ du ba la the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin pa'i khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra mi rtag pa la the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin na mi rtag pa la the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin pa'i khyab par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byas rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i phyi rgol yang dag chos can/ mi rtag pa la the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 153par thal/ sgra mi rtag pa la bam̐ tshom za ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de sgrub kyi phyi rgol yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ zer na dpyad rgyu cung zad yod kyang zhib cha phye sla'o/ kha cig na re/ sbyor ba de sgrub kyi ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin na de bcu bzhi bo'i gang rung yin pa'i khyab zer na/ gang zag gi bdag med chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtag par sgrub par byed pa'i ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs bcu bzhi bo'i gang rung yin par thal/ de sgrub kyi ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de sgrub kyi shes 'dod med nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sgra gang zag gi bdag med du rtogs nas/ sgra mi rtag pa la shes 'dod zhugs pa'i gang zag cig mi srid pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sdug bden bdag med du rtogs nas sdug bden mi rtag pa la shes 'dod zhugs pa zhig mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar/ de phyir mi rtag las sdug bsngal/ / sdug bsngal las ni bdag med gsungs/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ de sgrub kyi don la bltos te ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs lnga bo'i gang rung ma yin pa gang zhig blo la bltos nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs drug po'i gang rung yang min/ rgol ba la bltos te ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs gsum po'i gang rung yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags re re nas sla/ de la kho na re/ de chos can/ khyod sgra mi rtags par sgrub par byed pa'i ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs bcu bzhi gang rung yin par thal/ de sgrub kyi blo la bltos te ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ rtags grub ste shes 'dod med nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ de chos can/ de sgrub kyi shes 'dod med nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs gsum po'i gang rung yin par thal/ de sgrub kyi shes 'dod med nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ khyab par thal/ de gsum de'i dbye ba yin pa'i phyir na yang ma khyab/ rtags grub ste/ mgul rgyan las/

154gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mthodze+em ched smyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sbyor ba skor gcig gi shes 'dod med nas ma grub pa'i gtan tshigs la dbye na gsum yod de/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ stong nyid gtso bor ston pa'i mdo de/dpyad gsum gyi lung gi rtags kyis shin lkog ston pa'i lung rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu bar sgrub par byed pa'i mthun dpe chos can yin byas pa la/kho na re/ de 'dra'i rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu ba cung zad lkog gyur yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bka' brgyad stong ba rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu ba cung zad lkog gyur yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de shin tu lkog gyur yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/dpyad gsum gyi dag pa'i lung de bka' brgyad stong ba rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu bar sgrub par byed pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/dang po'i mtha' dpyod las/ dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung de brgyad stong ba rang gi bstan don la bslu med du sgrub pa'i yid ches kyi rtags yang dag ma yin par thal lo/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/de'i bstan bya cung zad lkog gyur yin pa'i phyir/ rigs rgyan las/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ zhes pa nas/ rtags de gsum gyi bsgrub bya dngos po stobs shugs kyi tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang bzhi brgya ba las/ de yi stong ba nyid bstan te/ / de nyid kho nar yid chos bya/ / zhes dang / legs bshad snying bo las/ rten 'byung gi/ / lan 'di nyid kyis gsung gzhan yang / / tshad mar gyur bar nges pa skyes/ / zhes yid ches kyi sbyor ba'i mthun dper gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ gzhan dag na re/dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa bstan pa la mi bslu ba cung zad lkog gyur dang sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa bstan pa la mi bslu ba shin tu lkog gyur yin pa'i lung snga phyi gnyis mi 'gal zer na/ de la 'o na/ bka' brgyad stong ba chos can/ dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa bstan pa la mi bslu ba yin te/

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 155dpyad gsum gyi dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir zhes pa dang / yang de chos can/sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa bstan pa la mi bslu ba yin te/ dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba gnyis sbyor ba yang dag yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer ro/ / de bzhin du cung zad lkog gyur ston pa'i lung rang gi bstan bya'i don la mi bslu bar sgrub pa'i sbyor ba yang dag yod dam med/ dang po ltar na/ phar phyin mchan las/ ji srid dngos stobs kyis dpyad pa 'jug pa'i tshe na lung gis sgrub pa don med pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / sde bdun rgyan las/ 'o na sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la'ang /sgra mi rtag par ston pa'i lung chos can/ khyod rang gi bstan bya la mi bslu ste/dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod na skyon ci yod ces na/ dge ba med pa'i skyon yod de/ zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal la/ phyi ma ltar na blo rig zur rgyan las/ byas pa la kho na re/ bum pa chos can/khyod rtogs pa'i yid ches rjes dpag med par thal/ khyod mngon gyur yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ gzhi grub na/ khyod shin tu lkog gyur du song ba'i gang zag yod pa'i khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod las kyang gsungs pas dpyad rgyu cung zad yod pas de dag gi steng nas spro sla'o/ /drug pa/ rtag 'dzin sems sogs kyi mtha' dpyad pa/rtag 'dzin sems kyi mtshan nyid rigs rgyan ltar rang 'bras rjes dpag gi rtags kyi tshul mjal ba'i blo 'jog zer na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ bsgrub bya la shes 'dod zhugs pa'i rgol ba'i rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ des na bsgrub bya la shes 'dod zhugs pa'i rgol ba'i rgyud kyi de sgrub kyi rtags kyi tshul mjal ba'i blo de rtags 'dzin

156gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched sgrong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sems kyi mtshan nyid yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ 'dod byas pa la/ 'o na/ rtags 'dzin sems la des khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ bsgrub bya rtogs pa'i gang zag gi rgyud na khyod med pa thal lo /zhes sogs tshig gi 'khrul mang ngo / / rtags 'dzin sems la bcad shes kyis khyab bam ma khyab/ dang po ltar na/ rigs rgyan sogs dang 'gal la/ phyi ma ltar na/ / tshad ma mdo las/ rjes dpag rjes su dpag las byung / / zhes dran shes dgos par gsungs pas de dang 'gal min/ mngon sum le'u'i ṭīka las/ tshul gsum mjal ba'i tshad ma nyid rtags 'dzin sems yin la/de la lha shāka dang slob dpon chos mchog mi mthun pa med do/ / zhes sogs gong 'og bsdur nas dpyad par bya'o/ /rgyu spyi sgrub kyi 'bras rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid mtha' dpyod ltar byas ba la/ gzhan dag na re/ re 'ga' pa'i dngos po rang rgyu dang bcas pa dang rten byung 'brel yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na/ 'dod byas pa la/ rang rgyu dang bcas pa med na re 'ga' ba'i dngos po med pa'i khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir zer na lan ji ltar 'debs dpyod/ tshad ma yin na rang gi gsar du gcod rgyu'i sgro 'dogs yod pa'i khyab/ byas pa la kho na re/rnam mkhyen skad cig gnyis pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/de med par thal/ dang pos bcad zin pa'i sgro 'dogs shig bcad rme ma yin pa gang zhig ma bcad pa'i sgro 'dogs med pa'i phyir sogs spro sla/ dngos po sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i khyad par ltos btags gang yin zhes na btags pa bar 'jog dgos la/ 'on kyang mtshan nyid sogs kyi steng nas dpyad rgyu cung zad yod/ mdun gyi gzhi 'dir sha za bskal don du song ba'i gang zag sha za bskal don du song ba'i gang zag yin nam min/ dang po ltar na/ des sha za yod par dam bca' mi rigs pa dang de'i rgyud na sha za yod par khas len

tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 157pa'i khas len dang gang zag med par 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rtsa ba dang 'grel ba kun dang 'gal bas dpyad par 'tshal lo/ / smras pa/ rigs gzhung yangs pa'i sa chen las 'phags pa'i/ / rigs lam zab mo'i ke la sha yi ngos/ / rigs 'phrul ral ba'i khur 'chang 'gyeng nyams kyis/ / rigs pa'i gad rgyang sgrog pa'i 'phrog byed dang / bskal mnyam spyod pa'i blo gros thob min yang / rigs tshul cung tsam thos pa'i gzugs brnyan dag / bdag yid me long ngos nas yal dogs ste/ / rjed byang bur gyi mtshan ma 'di dag bkod/ / ces bya ba'ang smras so/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 1999lo'i 〈nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i rig gzhung dzus deb 〉deb gnyis pa las bdams/)

158༄ / / bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyad pa/ngag dbang rgya mtsho/bon gyi rig gnas ni bod gna' rabs rig gnas khrod kyi med du mi rung ba'i grub cha gal chen zhig yin pas/ bon gyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug byas na bod kyi rig gnas kyi khungs 'tshol ba dang / shes rig gi lo rgyus ring du gtong ba sogs dge mtshan mang du mchis/ de bas grub mtha'i phyogs zhen spangs te bon gyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug mthar phyin pa byas na nges shes yang dag pa zhig 'drong thub nges red/ bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don de gshen rab mi bo che ma byung gong gi srid pa'i bon dang / ston pa gshen rab kyis srol gtod pa'i g.yung drung gi bon ste rigs gnyis su phye nas so so'i go don la cung zad dpyad par bya'o/ /dang po/ srid pa'i bon gyi go don la dpyad pa/gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis phyi rol yul gyi dngos po la ngos 'dzin gsal po med stabs/ dngos po dag la 'du shes yod pa'i 'dod tshul byung ste/rang byung khams kyi snang tshul sna tshogs mi'i gshis lugs can dang spyi tshogs can du 'gyur ba las lha 'dre srung ma thab lha dgra lha sogs snang ris sna tshogs byung / de las mi rnams la phan thogs can dag la lha dang srung mar brtsis te

bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyad pa/ 159gsol mchod byed pa dang / mi rnams la gnod pa'i rigs dag la 'dre byas nas bzlog bsgyur byed pa'i srol dar/ gzugs med kyi 'dre srin mang pos mi rnams kyi blo kha bsgyur nas gnam gnyan klu gsol ba'i gdod ma'i chos lugs dar te/ 'tsho ba'i khrod du dka' gnad sel ba'i thabs sna tshogs 'don pa dang / 'dre srin sogs gnod pa'i rigs rnams mgo gnon pa ste bon po 'dre srin gyi kha gnon zhes grags byung / bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che ma byung gong du dar ba'i bon 'di rigs la srid pa'i bon zer ba dang / bon zhes pa'i go don yang yul dus dbang gis 'gyur bzhin yod pas gcig chod kyi mtshan nyid med rung / thog mar bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don de shes rig spyir 'jug pa zhig lags/ mdo gzer mig las bon gyi rnam grangs nyer gnyis tsam drangs pa de dag re re bzhin 'grel na/ dbal bon zhes pa ni dbal chu dang rdza sogs me'i las sbyor gyi rigs la mnga' dbang brnyes pa'i bon po dang / yogs bon zhes pa ni yugs bon zhes pa'i don te yugs sa'i 'dre srin gnon pa'i bon po/ khrin bon zhes pa ni khrims bor zhes pa'i don te bka' khrims gal brten pa'i bon po/ gnyer bon zhes pa ni yul lha sogs srung ma'i tshogs la gnyer du gtad cing srung skyob zhu ba'i las sbyor la mkhas pa'i bon po/ 'o bon zhes pa ni 'brog pa rnams kyi dkar rigs 'o zho'i 'phel skyed kyi las sbyor la mkhas pa'i bon po/ 'tsham bon zhes pa ni gnyen sgrig mthun sdebs kyi las sbyor la mkhas pa'i bon po/ dmu bon zhes pa ni rigs mchod cing bsnyen pas rang gzhan gyi phan bde sgrub pa'i bon po/ srin bon zhes pa ni mi'i srid rgyud 'phel bskyed kyi las sbyor la mkhas pa'i bon po/skos bon zhes pa ni rtsis kyi sgo nas legs spel nyes sel byed par mkhas pa'i bon po/ phywa bon zhes pa ni phywa g.yang 'gugs cing dge legs kyi dpal bskyed pa'i las la mkhas pa'i bon po/ lha bon zhes pa ni 'go pa'i lha rigs gtsang

160gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sel gyi mthu dpung skyed par mkhas pa'i bon po/ bdud bon dang btsan bon zhes pa ni bdud la brten mkhan bdud bon dang / btsan la brten mkhan btsan bon ste lha 'dre sogs la dmar mchod kyi cho ga la brten nas skabs kyi 'dod don bsgrub pa'i bon po/ nyi bon zla bon skar bon gsum ni gnam gyi nyi zla skar gsum gyi 'grod tshul nges pa can la brtag nas sa steng du dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog gang 'dra yod pa dang / de'i chos nyid dang bstun nas zhing 'brog thon skyed kyi las ka bkod sgrig byed par mkhas pa'i bon po zhes pa yin/mdor na skabs de'i bon zhes pa'i tha snyad de shes bya la 'jug pa/ bod kyi lo rgyus nang du rgyal po gnya' khri'i skabs la bon shes pa can bcu gnyis byung /bon shes pa can bcu gnyis ni mgon shes lha bon/ g.yang shes phywa bon/'gro shes klud gtong / 'dur shes srid gshen/ gtsang shes sel 'debs/sgrol shes lha bon/ phan shes sman dpyad/ skos shes rtsis mkhan/ smra shes gto dgu / lding shes sha ba/ 'phur shes ju thig 'gro shes 'phrul bon te bcu gnyis yod/ bon shes pa can bcu gnyis zer ba de'ang shes rig sna kha bcu gnyis yod par go ba ma gtogs/ bdag sgra 'jug pa tsam gyis gang zag bcu gnyis la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ni nor 'khrul yin/ byams ma las bon shes pa can bcu gnyis kyi 'grel ba las/ lha yar gsol bas mgon byed pa/g.yang tshur blangs par nor phyugs 'phel ba/ glud phar gtor byas 'dre tshims pa/ shi ba 'dur bas bde ba thob pa/ g.yang dme phye bas lha srung bskang ba/ dgra bgegs bsgral bas 'tshe ba med pa/ nad gso bas tshe'i bar chad med pa/ rtsis 'debs pas snga phyi'i ltas bzung ba/ khams sa'i klud bsngos pas 'dre shags 'debs shes pa/ bag phye'i sha ba btang bas btsan gyi yul du 'phur shes pa/ mo lha bdar pas legs nyes mgon shes gsal ba/rtsi shing ban bun bsngos pas lha 'dre'i yul du rang 'gros byed cing lha 'dre'i

bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyad pa/ 161gnod pa zhi ba zhes 'khod yod/ des na bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don de shes bya spyir 'jug pa shes sla/ rgan nam mkha' nor bus kyang bon zhes pa ni dus skabs der chos lugs spyi'i ming du gnas pa zhes dang / 'go ba dge bshes bstan 'dzin 'brug grags kyis bon zer ba ni spyir bsam blos shes rgyu yod pa'i shes bya tshang ma dang / khyad par du rna bas go ba'am thos pa dang /gnad don gang zhig bstan pa'i don sogs la 'jug pa zhes so/ /yang bshad tshul gzhan zhig la/ khyung po rgod tshang gi lo rgyus las/ bon ni stong pa ma yin pa'i don du 'jug zer ba dang / sku zhabs phun tshogs tshe ring gis sa thog tu myu gu skye ba'i rgyu las sa bon zhes 'bod/ de'i phyir kha ba can gyi yul du mi lo stong phrag du ma'i sngon rol du dar ba'i gdod ma'i chos lugs 'di chos lugs kyi myu gu 'phel ba'i rgyu lta bu'am chos lugs gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i nang don yod stabs bon zhes 'bod/ yang kha shas kyis bon dang bzlas gnyis don gcig yin par 'dod/ gna' rabs kyi bon po dag gis sngags mang du bzlas te rang gzhan gyi gegs bar chad bsal ba dang /gnod byed gang la mthu gtong ba'i las sgrub kyi yod stabs ming de ltar byung ba yin/ bon zhes pa'i tha snyad de skad dod du ‘‘gyer ’’zer/ g.yung drung bon la drung mur gyer/ gyer ni zhang skad yin rung da lta phal cher zhang bod thun mong du spyad/ gyer ni bod skad kyi cha nas klog pa'i don la 'jug bon po rnams kyis sngags mang du bzlas pa dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa shes thub/thub bstan rjes 'brang pa dag gi gsung las/ bod du dar ba'i bon la rigs gsum phye yod de/ brdol bon dang 'khyar bon bsgyur bon bcas phye yod/ brdol bon zhes pa ni rgyal rabs drug pa'i skabs su dbus 'am shod lon bya ba rus gshen yin pa'i byis pa lo bcu gsum lon pa zhig 'dre yis lo bcu gsum gyi bar du bod khams yongs su khrid nas lo nyi shu rtsa drug la mi'i

162gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nang du chud pa la/ mi ma yin nus pas yul 'di dang 'di lta bu byed/ de la gsol mchod dang / yas stags gtong lugs 'di 'dra byas pas phan rab sna tshogs shes pa byung / skabs de'i bon rnams kyis yar rgan gyi lha mchod pa/bar khyim gyi thabs 'don pa/ mar 'dre sri'i mgo gnon pa'i srol yod/ thu'u bkwan tshang gis de rigs la rgyu bon chab nag ces gsungs/ rgyu bon rigs bzhi ni rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long las snang gshen bal thod can gyi phywa dang g.yang 'gug lha dang sman gsol/ dge legs dang dpal bskyed nas mi nor rgyas par byed/ 'phrul gshen bal tshon can gyis mdos dang yas gtong /srid dang rten 'dzugs/ 'phral phugs kyi 'gal rkyen thams cad sel bar byed do/ phywa gshen ju thig can gyis/ legs nyes kyi lam ston/ yin min gyi the tshom sel/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes 'chad par byed do/ dur gshen mtshon cha can gyis gson gyi bgegs sel/ gshen gyi dur 'debs/ chung gi sri gnon / gnam gyi rgyu skar lta/ sa'i 'dre btul ba yin no/ zhes pa las rgyu bon rigs bzhi gsal por bstan yod de/ gshen rab mi bo che bod du phebs skabs/ da lta bod kyi lha 'dre rnams bon gyi bka' la nyan zhing ci bcol sgrub pa ste/ bon pos lha mchod na mgon byed/ 'dre rdung na thub/bkar na 'gro ba ni ston pa'i bka' gnyan po'i dam 'og du ring nas tshud pa'i phyir te/ bon po 'dre srin gyi kha gnon zhes grags pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yin/gdon bon dang btsan bon de rigs ston pa gsher rab ma byon gong du yod/gdon bon dang brdol bon zhes pa gnyis don gcig yin par snyam/'khyar bon zhes pa ni gri gum gyi gri bshid bod kyi bon pos ma shes nas kha che dang / bru sha/ zhang zhung bcas nas bon po gsum gri bshid la bos pas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa sogs deb ther las gsal ba/ thu'u bkwan tshang gis kyang de gsum ma byung phan chad du bon la lta ba 'di yin bya ba med/ de

bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyud pa/ 163phyin chad nas bon gyi lta ba cig kyang bzung ste/ mu stegs dbang phyug pa'i grub mtha' 'khyar ba bon dang 'dres pa yin zer ba dang / rgan nam mkha' nor bus kyang snang srid sgong nga las grol tshul ni mu stegs pa'i lta ba bon la 'dres pa zer/ tho chi'i bod ljongs gna' rdzas zhib dpyod zhes pa'i deb tu/bod kyi rig gnas la phyi'i mi rigs dag gis shan zhugs pa mngon gsal red ces pa ltar/ bod kyi rig gnas la phyi phyogs rig gnas kyis shan zhugs rung / dbang phyug pa'i lta ba bon la ma 'dres gong bon la lta ba med zer ba'ang thal che ba'i skyon du 'gro ste/ gnya' khri'i skabs su gshen snang ba mdog can gyis gsang sngags bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/bsgyur bon zhes pa ni paṇ+ḍita sham thab sngon po can dang rin chen mchogagashen rgur klu dga' gsum gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du thub bstan pa'i chos bon du bsgyur ba la zer/ bon chos gnyis thun mong gi cha yod pa ni mngon gsal yin yang / bon tshang mar bsgyur bon zer ba bon po rnams kyis khas len mi bya/ bon la chos 'dres chos la bon 'dres zhes pa ltar phan tshun shan zhugs pa ni don dngos yin/ thub bstan dang gshen bstan gnyis lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i 'thab rtsod dang mnyam bsres kyi khrod du phan tshun gyi legs cha bsdu len ci thub bgyis te phan tshun mtshungs cha ldan 'os pa zhig red/ bon la rgyu bon bzhi dang zab mo snyan rgyud sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i cha'ang ldan pas/ de dag tshang ma chos nas bsgyur zer na thal che ba'i skyon du 'gyur/bon gyi bka' bstan rnams la bltas na de dag gi rig gnas kyi srol rgyun ni bon po rang sha stag yin pa shes thub/gnyis pa/ g.yung drung bon gyi go don/g.yung drung bon gyi skad dod du drung mu gyer zhes dang / de'i go don mi

164gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/g.yo mi 'gyur bar ston pa'i don can yin pa'i phyir sher phyin rnam bshad tshig don rab gsal las/ skye med don las mi g.yo bas g.yung / 'gag med rtags las mi 'gyur bas drung skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i don ston zhing gdul bya skyob par byed pas na bon zhes bya ste mdo las/ g.yung zhes bya ba don las mi g.yo ba drung zhes bya ba rtags las mi 'gyur ba/ bon zhes bya ba dbyings nyid bdal ba'i klong / zhes dang / bon ni mi g.yo skyob pa'i sgra/ /zhes dang / rje mnyam med kyi khams sdud 'grel pa las/ bon nyid kyi don las mi g.yo zhing gdul bya 'gro ba ma lus pa skyob pas na bon zhes bya/ spyir bon zhes pa'i sgra la 'jug yul brgyad yod de/ shes bya 'khor 'das yid kyi yul/ bsod nams lam dang don dang ni/ gsung rab theg pa brgyad la 'jug shes bya la 'jug pa dper na/ bon thams cad bden pa gnyis su 'dus lta bu/ rnam shes tshogs drug yid kyi rnam par shes pa la 'jug ste/ming gzugs dang zhes pa nas yid dang bon zhes dang / 'khor ba myang gzugs dang zhes pa nas yid dang bon zhes dang / 'khor ba myang 'das la 'jug pa dper na/ 'khor 'das kyi bon lta bu/ bsod nams la 'jug pa dper na/ spyod pa'i sgra thos par dka' ba g.yung drung gi bon la spyad lta bu/don la 'jug pa dper na/ gnas lugs don gyi bon lta bu/ lam la 'jug pa dper na/ lam gyi bon lta bu/ gsung rab la 'jug pa dper na/ ston pas sgo bzhi mdzod lnga gsungs lta bu/ theg pa la 'jug pa dper na/ theg pa bla na med pa g.yung drung gi bon zhes so/ / g.yung drung bon dang chos gnyis tha snyad khyad par yod pa ma gtogs brjod bya'i don la khyad par med de/ gsham nas ston pa dang / lta ba/ spyod pa/ skyabs 'gro/ / 'bras bu bcas nas thub bstan dang gshen bstan gnyis cung zad bsdur ba bya'o/ /ston pa/ ston pa shākya thub pa dang gshen rab mi bo che gnyis thog mar

bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyad pa/ 165byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / bar du bskal ba grangs med tshogs bsags pa/ mthar mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa gcig 'dra yin pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gcig pa dang / sems can ma smin pa rnams smin par byed pa'i mdzad pa'i las gcig pa/ bskal ba grangs med gsum la tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rgyus mtshan bzang po sum cu so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spud pa'i sku'i yon tan gcig pa dang /bon gyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs te mi mjed zhing khams kyi gdul bya rnams smin par grol bar mdzad pa'i gsung gi yon tan gcig pa/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi yon tan gcig pa/ sku gsungs thugs gsum gyi phyogs nas ston pa gnyis ngo bo gcig pa yin pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis las rtogs thub/skyabs gnas/ spyir phyi nang grub mtha' gnyis po'i 'byed byed dkon mchog gsum dang 'jig rten gyi lha dbang phyugs sogs la skyabs su 'gro min gyi khyad par 'jog pas de yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan la rgyal sras thogs med bzang pos ‘‘rang yang 'khor ba'i btson rwar bcings pa yis / 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus/ / de phyir gang la skyabs na mi bslu ba'i/ /dkon mchog skyabs 'gro rgyal sras lag len yin/ / ’’zhes lha dbang phyug la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi lha yis 'gro bar skyabs kyi nus pa med cing dkon mchog gsum la de ldan pas skyabs su 'gro ba yin pa shes thub/ sngar bod kyi byung ba brjod pa 'bel gtam lung gi snying po las/ ‘‘nang pa gshen rab pa'i grub mtha'i sgor 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas/ bon dang / sems dpa' gsum la dkon mchog gsum du brjod cing / de'i steng du bla ma bsnan pas skyabs gnas yul mchog gnas bzhi zhes brjod/’’ nang pa thub bstan pas sangs rgyas dang chos/ dge 'dun gsum ni dkon mchog gsum la ngos

166gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin gyin yod/ dge bshes bskal bzang dar rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i 〈zhwa dkar bstan pa'i lo rgyus ke ta ka'i phreng mdzes 〉las ‘‘bon dang chos zhes brda yi khyad tsam ste/ brjod bya'i don la khyad par yod ma yin ri’zhes pa ltar bon chos gnyis tha snyad tsam gyi khyad par ma gtogs brjod bya'i don gyi steng nas khyad par gang yang med/lta ba/ g.yung drung bon gyi lta ba bkar btags kyi mdo bzhi khas len pa ni gshen rab pa yin te/ bon gyi lta ba bkar btags kyi mdo bzhi ni/〈rig pa'i rtse 'bum 〉las ‘‘'dus byas thams cad kyi mdo mi rtag pa'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mdo sdug bsngal ba'o/ / mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi mdo zhi ba'o/ / bon thams cad kyi mdo bdag med pa'o/ / ’’zhes pa dang / de bzhin du nang pa sangs rgyas pas lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa rnams nang par 'dod de/ lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya bzhi ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba'o/ / zhes brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi tshig gang thad nas khyad par yod pa ma mthong ste/ de las ldog ste bdag mi 'gyur ba lta bu rtag lta ba dang tshe snga phyi khas mi len pa'i chad lta ba ste gang rung du lta ba ni phyi rol mu stegs pa'o/ /spyod pa/ de yang tshad ma smra ba'i seng ge las/ ‘‘spyod pa ni dge ba dang sdug pa'o ’’zhes pa'i nang pa gshen rab pa'i spyod pa nito sgrib sbyang tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i thabs phyin ci ma log pa ci rigs la 'bad pa'o/ / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa ni/ ji skad du/ ‘‘sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / dge ba phun sum tshogs pa yis/ / rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin ’’zhes pa ltar/ dkar phyogs dge ba'i las la

bon zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la cung zad dpyad pa/ 167brtson pa ni ban bon gnyis ka'i thun mong gi spyod pa yin/ de las ldog ste me lnga sgrub pa dang 'tshe ba chos su smra ba rnams phyi rol mu stegs pa'o/ / 'di la skye bo kha shas kyis bon gyi rgyu theg bzhi ni 'tshe ba chos su smra ba zhes 'dod kyang de ltar ma lags te/ bya ba'i bzang ngan mo yis brtags pa dang / legs nyes rtsis kyis gzhal ba/ gdon gyis bzung ste na bar gyur na gto thabs kyis zhi ba dang 'chi bar gyur tshe dpyad kyis 'tsho ba/ 'gro ba la phan 'dogs pa ma gtogs 'tshe ba chos su smra ba ma yin no/ /'bras bu/ nang pa gshen rab pas gnas skabs su tshe nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i lha mi'i go 'phang thob rgyu dang mthar thug tu thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob rgyu de yin/ de bzhin nang pa sangs rgyas pa'ang mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis kyi 'bras bu las ma 'das pa'o/ /bstan gnyis kyi gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang mthar thug 'bras bu ste sangs rgyas pa gang thad nas gcig 'dra yin pa mngon sum tshad mas grub/ phyi rol pa ni tshe 'di la tshe nor longs spyod 'dzoms pa ma gtogs sangs rgyas rgyu med de/ phyi rol pa'i 'jig rten 'di la dbang che ba'i tshangs pa dang dbang phyug la sogs bsten pa dang / rags snang gi lha mngon zhen du bsgoms pas dbang phyug gam tshangs pa'am khyab 'jug lta bu'i rtog pa can thob pa dang / phyal bar bsgoms pas srid rtse'am 'byung ba'i bag la zha ba'i nye 'khor thob par 'dod do/ /g.yung drung bon gyi theg rim dang sangs rgyas chos lugs gnyis mthun te/ sangs rgyas chos lugs pas phyi nyan rang dbu sems bzhi/ nang bya spyod rnal bla bzhir bshad pa las/ thub bstan pa'i nyan thos dang gshen bstan pa'i gshen rab rnam rtsod pa dang don gcig de bzhin du rang rgyal dang rang rtogs gshen rab don gcig sems tsam pa dang thugs rje sems dpa'

168gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim ched spyong slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/don gcig dbu ma ba dang g.yung drung sems dpa' spros med pa don gciganang rgyud la'ang gzhan sde'i bya rgyud dang rang gi bya rgyud dang bya ba gtsang spyod rnams don gcig spyod rgyud rang gi spyod rgyud dang kun ldan rnams don gcig rnam 'byor dang ye gshen rgyud dang dngos bskyed rol ba rnams don gcig rnam 'byor bla med dang ye gshen chen po'i rgyud dang don ldan kun rdzogs kyi rgyud rnams don mthun pa yin zhes mkhas pa dag gis gsungs/'on kyang bon yin na g.yung drung gi bon yin pas ma khyab pa dang / chos yin na dam pa'i chos yin pas ma khyab pa gsal po mkhyen dgos so/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 2002lo'i 〈krung go'i bod ljongs 〉deb gnyis pa las bdams/)

169༄ / / grangs rig slob khrid kyi gnad don bcos sgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char 'ga' gleng ba/'jigasabyed/lo rgyus thog bod mi dmangs kyis ngal rtsol 'tsho ba'i khrod du grangs rig shes bya nges can zhig khong du chud yod de/ dgon pa lte gnas su gyur pa'i srol rgyun slob gso'i nang du grangs rig pa thar thor re phyi rabs par brgyud khrid byas mod/ yin na'ang brgyud rim ldan zhing cha tshang ba'i grangs rig pa'i ma lag cig grub med/ nye rabs su nub phyogs grangs rig sgo kun nas zhib 'jug dang / bsgyur sprod/ slob khrid bcas byed pa'i sde khag dang rtsa 'dzugs med pas/ bod kyi rang byung tshan rig gi rig pa gsog 'jog dang 'phel rgyas gtong ma thub par bod khul du deng rabs kyi tshan rig phal cher stong char lus/der brten/ deng rabs kyi tshan rig khyab spel dang bod rigs kyi slob gso dar rgyas 'gro ba dang bstun/ brgyud rim ldan pa'i sgo nas deng rabs kyi tshan rig slob sbyong dang sdud len bya rgyu de deng skabs bod kyi slob gso 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i las 'gan gtso bo'i gras shig yin/sgyur bcos sgo dbye byas pa nas bzung / bod kyi slob gso'i las don mgyogs myur slar gso dang 'phel rgyas byung ste/ bod skad kyi grangs rig slob gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun dang / dge rgan gyi slob khrid chu tshad/ slob khrid kyi spus tshad sogs gang gi thad la'ang dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras thob/ bod skad

170 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grangs rig (bod kyi skad yig gis khrid pa'i grangs rig )slob khrid kho na'i thog nas bltas na/ mig sngar zhing ljongs lngas slob chung nas mtho mabring bar gyi lo rim so so'i slob deb gcig gyur gyis sgrig sgyur byas shing / snga rjes thengs 'gar ming tshig dang tha snyad gcig gyur byas la/ slob deb de dag rgyal yongs kyi bod rigs sa khul du bkol spyod byas pas rgya che'i bod rigs slob ma'i dga' bsu thob cing / bod rigs slob ma'i grangs rig chu tshad de khyon yongs nas je mthor song yod/ kan lho khul la mtshon na/ 1khardo0lor mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwa nas bod skad grangs rig gi dge rgan gnyis gdan drangs te/ gzhi rim gyi bod yig dge rgan bzhi bcu lhag bdams nas kho tshor gcig bsdus thog lo gcig ring bod skad grangs rig slob khrid byas/ 19ṭ+wāṃ2lor thengs dang por rgyugs sprod bsdu len byas pa'i dge rgan bcu mtsho sngon slob gso'i slob gling du bod skad kyi rang byung tshan rig tshan khag gi ched gnyer slob sbyong du mngags/ 1khaṭ+wāṃ4lor yang snga rjes su mtsho sngon rma lho khul nas slob chung gi bod skad grangs rig dge rgan sum cu lhag gdan drangs shing / lo der kan lho mi rigs slob grwar bod skad grangs rig slob khrid byed 'go btsugs pa ma zad/ rjes su mu mthud du gso skyong dang sbyong brdar byas pas bod skad grangs rig gi dge rgan dkon pa'i gnas tshul zhi lhod du gyur/ rjes su khul yongs kyi slob grwa 'bring chung bdun cu lhag la bod skad grangs rig slob khrid byed 'go btsugs shing / 19ṭ+wāṃ6lo nas slob grwa de dag gis slob dus mthar phyin dang slob rim spor ba'i gcig gyur rgyugs sprod skabs bod skad grangs rig rgyugs gzhi lag bstar byed 'go brtsams/ 1rdzordo7lo nas bzung khul nang logs kyi 'bring rim ched gnyer slob grwas bod yig gtso bo byed pa'i slob ma bsdus/ des slob mas rgya yig ma shes pa'i rkyen gyis grangs rig pa slob rgyur shugs rkyen thebs te slob khrid kyi

grangs rig slob khrid kyi gnad don bcos sgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char 'ga'/ 171spus tshad zhan pa'i gnas bab rim gyis bsgyur cing / tshad nges can zhig gi thog nas slob gso dang slob khrid kyi spus tshad je mthor btang bas/ bod skad grangs rig de bod kyi srol rgyun rtsis rig nas deng rabs kyi grangs rig tu mngon 'gyur byung ste/ bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'gro bar rnam pa gsar pa zhig bskrun/grangs rig pa ni mi'i rigs kyis thun mong du bskrun cing thun mong la mnga' ba'i shes rig gi nying bcud cig yin pas/ deng rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal khong du chud par 'dod pa'i mi rigs shig gis nges par du rang skad kyis rig pa'i ma lag 'dir slob sbyong dang / zhib 'jug brgyud khrid bcas bya dgos/ de ltar byas tshe da gzod grangs rig pa de dngos gnas mi rigs de'i rig pa'i gnas shig tu 'gyur nges la/ mi rigs kyi dpal yon yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i rmang rdor yang 'gyur srid/deng rabs tshan rig gi ma lag khrod du/ grangs rig pa ni rang byung tshan rig gi rmang gzhi yin pa ma zad/ tshe srog tshan rig dang / do dam tshan rigaspyi tshogs tshan rig ar las lag rtsal gyi khyab khongs so so'i thun mong gi rmang gzhi dang / tshan rig gi sgo chen 'byed byed gser gyi lde mig lta bu'ang yin/rmang gzhi'i slob gso'i skabs su ma skad kyi grangs rig khrid pa de slob gso'i chos nyid dang mthun zhing / grangs rig pa khong du chud pa'i rgya che tshad dang gting zab tshad gang nas kyang skad rigs gzhan spyad pa las dge mtshan lhag par che ba ma zad/ dngos lugs dang rdzas 'gyur sogs kyi slob tshan khrid pa la rmang gzhi legs po 'ding thub rgyur cha rkyen bzang bo zhig bskrun thub pa lag len las ra 'phrod byung / 'on kyang bod skad kyi grangs rig pa 'di mthar gtugs na bod kyi rig tshan gsar ba zhig yin zhing / da dung thog ma'i gsar gtod kyi dus skabs la gnas yod na slob khrid (dge rgan dang

172 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/slob deb )dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug (slob khrid zhib 'jug dang grangs rig gi gzhung lugs zhib 'jug )sgyur sprod dang lhag par du slob deb kyi rtsom sgyur sogs kyi gnad don rab dang rim par nga tshos da dung mu mthud du zhib 'jug dang thag gcod byed dgos pa'i gnad don mang dag cig yod cing /las 'gan ljid mo 'di lo rgyus kyis nga tsho mi rabs 'di'i bod kyi grangs rig las don pa'i phrag thog tu phab pas na/ 'dir kho bos dpyad gzhi'i tshul du rang gi lta ba rags tsam zhu bar 'dod/dang po/ bod skad grangs rig gi slob deb bzo skrun dang slob khrid khrod du gnas pa'i mi 'dang sa/1 rtsom sgyur byed skabs ming tshig dang tha snyad ci 'dod du bsgyur ba'i rkyen gyis grangs rig pa'i ming tshig gam tha snyad/ go don sogs ma yig gi don dang 'gal ba'i snang tshul mngon pa ste/ (1)ming gcig la bsgyur tshul mang ba ste/ des grangs rig gi ming tshig rnyog 'dzing can du bzos pas/slob mkhan gyis khong du chud dka' bar gyur/ (2)lo tsā ba'i grangs rig chu tshad cung dma' ba ste/ des grangs rig pa'i ming tshig 'ga' zhig grangs rig pa'i go don dngos ltar bsgyur ma thub par go ba log par btang bas/ slob mkhan la don med kyi dka' gnad bzos pa ma zad/ 'brel yod nang don la go ba len mi nus par gyur/ ( 2)lo tsā ba'i bod yig chu tshad cung zhan zhing /bod kyi brda dag gis dbul bas ming du ma ming gcig rang du bsgyur pas go don mi gsal bar ma zad/ tha na ‘‘rgya skad 'gros kyi bod skad ’’du gyur nas/bod kyi klog pa pos go dka' bar gyur/2 bod skad grangs rig pa'i dge rgan kha shas kyi chu tshad cung zhan pas/bod skad grangs rig slob khrid kyi bya ba'i 'khur chen theg dka' ste/ mtshan

grangs rig slob khrid kyi gnad don bcos sgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char 'ga'/ 173nyid dang nges srol sgrub pa/ dper brjod sam ṭar bris te thengs gcig gnyis re bklags pa tsam gyis chog par byed pa'i skabs 'grig tsam yin yang /grangs rig dge rgan tshang mas cung brgyud rim ldan pa'i sgo nas grangs rig pa slob mar khrid thub pa ga la yin/ slob ma grangs tshad nges can zhig grangs rig slob sbyong byed skabs ‘‘skyes stobs kyi rig pas mi 'dang ’’bar ma zad/da dung dge rgan skor zhig gis phal cher slob deb kyi nang don khong du chud kyang / slob khrid kyi thabs rtsal zhan la/ grangs rig pa'i tshags dam rang bzhin dang grangs rig pa'i skad cha yang dag par spyod pa la do snang mi byed cing / tshig gnad la mi 'khel ba/ grangs 'bor kyi 'brel ba yang dag par mtshon mi nus te/ dper na/ ‘‘31sa2snu’dang 31k+ṣu ’ ‘sku—rdo dang ‘216lta bu'i go don dang bklag thabs kyi dbye dbyed mi thub pas/ bod skad grangs rig slob khrid de ngan thog ngan 'khor gyi rjes su 'brangs shing / des bod skad grangs rig slob khrid kyi spus tshad sgo kun nas mtho ru 'degs par 'gog rkyen chen po bzos yod/2 byang tshad ldan pa'i bod skad grangs rig slob khrid kyi zhib 'jug mi sna dkon pa ste/ bod skad grangs rig slob khrid la slob gso'i chos nyid dang mthun pa dang / tshad dang ldan pa/ gcig gyur bcas kyi blang bya med par/gang 'dod de sgrub byas pas slob khrid rtsa gnad kyis gtan la phab pa'i blang byar slebs mi thub cing / slob khrid kyi grub 'bras kyang gcig gyur gyis gzhal dka' bar ma zad/ skabs 'gar tha na rgyugs gzhi'i dri tshig kyang gcig gyur min te/ skabs skabs su rgya yig gi rgyugs gzhi bkod pa dang / yang skabs rer bod yig gis rgyugs gzhi bkod stabs/ slob ma rnams kyi bod skad grangs rig slob pa'i brtson sems la gnod pa dang / bod skad grangs rig

174 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/slob khrid la chos nyid kyi rang bzhin cher mi ldan pa'i 'byung gzhir gyur/4 spus tshad ldan pa'i bod skad grangs rig pa'i slob gseng klog deb dang dpyad yig dkon pas/ slob ma'i shes rgya bskyed dka' zhing / na gzhon dge rgan gyi las sgo'i chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong dka' ba ma zad/ lhag par du grangs rig pa'i shes yon ldan pa'i slob ma 'ga' deng rabs grangs rig pa'i khyab khongs su gzhug par dka' khag chen po bzos/gnyis pa/ bod skad grangs rig slob khrid bcos sgrur byed pa'i bsam 'char 'ga'/1 ‘‘zhing ljongs lnga'i bod skad grangs rig zhib 'jug mthun tshogs ri’'dzugs dgos te/ de'i 'gan nus ni/ (1)slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi tshad dang ldan la kun gyis khas len pa'i bod skad grangs rig slob khrid spus tshad kyi tshad gzhi 'jal byed gtan la 'bebs dgos/ (2)bod skad grangs rig pa'i slob dpyod bya ba'i mthun sbyor dang / 〈bod kyi grangs rig 〉dus deb rtsom sgrig 'grel spel gyi bya bar khrid ston bya dgos/ ( 2)bod skad grangs rig slob deb rtsom sgyur las don la zhib bsher gtan 'babs byed pa dang /slob khrid kyi zur lta'i dpyad yig dang slob gseng klog deb rtsom sgrig ming tshig tha snyad rnams dus thog tu zhib bsher gtan 'khel byed pa'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ (4)bod skad grangs rig gi 'gran sdur spel te slob ma'i dang zhen skul slong dang slob ma'i mthong rgya bskyed dgos/2 zhing ljongs lnga'i khyab khongs su bod skad grangs rig pa'i mi sna'i stobs shugs gcig tu bsdus te/ spus tshad mtho zhing kun gyis khas len pa'i bod skad kyi grangs rig tshan khag re gnyis bsgrubs shing / bod skad grangs rig slob khrid kyi spus tshad rim pa gcig gis je mthor btang nas kun gyis

grangs rig slob khrid kyi gnad don bcos sgyur byed pa'i bsam 'char 'ga'/ 175khas len pa'i grangs rig pa'i yon tan ldan pa'i bod rigs na gzhon la cung bzang ba'i mtho rim slob gso thob tu 'jug dgos pa dang / bod skad grangs rig pa'i slob khrid yongs la mig dpe dang khrid ston gyi nus pa bton te/bod skad kyi grangs rig pa'i slod khrid de je bzang je legs su 'gro ba bya dgos/2 bod skad grangs rig pa'i slob khrid kyi nang don 'thus sgo je tshang du gtong ba dang / sgyur bcos byas te bod skad grangs rig pa'i rtsom sgyur dang /par 'debs/ zhu dag sogs kyi bya ba sngar las lhag pa legs sgrub byas nas rim bzhin bod rigs slob mar khyad du mnga' ba'i bsam gzhigs goms srol dang bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang mthun sbyor yong ba dang /tshan rig gi rang bzhin dang / bsam blo'i rang bzhin/ sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin/ slob 'dod kyi rang bzhin bcas gcig mthun yong ba/ deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi blang bya dang slob ma'i dang len nus pa gcig mthun yong ba bcas bya dgos/4 dge rgan gso sbyong byed pa'i thad gcig gyur 'char 'god dang dmigs bsal srid jus lag bstar yong ba bya dgos pa ste/ bod rigs slob grwa 'bring chung dma' gsum gyi grangs rig pa'i dge rgan la lo lnga rer gso sbyor thengs re spel te/ ched las rig pa gsar du brjes shing deng rabs slob gso'i gzhung lugs dang du len dgos/ 'gan khur theg nus shing bod skad byang chub pa'i mtho 'bring slob grwa'i bod skad grangs rig pa'i rkang 'dzin dge rgan mtho rim dge thon slob grwa chen mor las gnas dang bral ba'i gso sbyong du mngags dgos shing / srid gzhung gis ma dngul sogs kyi thad nas 'gan srung bya dgos/5 bod skad grangs rig de bod kyi tshan rig rig gnas dar spel gtong

176 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i rmang gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun du bzung ste/ khul dang rdzong rim pa'i srid 'dzin sde khag gi 'go khrid gtso bo'i nang du bya ba 'dir ched du 'gan khur mkhan yod dgos shing / bod skad grangs rig las don pa'i bya bar hur brtson gyis rgyab skyor byas te bod skad grangs rig slob sbyong dang bed spyod byed par khor yug dang cha rkyen bzang bo zhig bskrun dgos pa dang bcas/mdor na/ mi 'dang sa la yang dag par blta ba dang / slob deb kyi rtsom sgyur bya ba dam 'dzin/ ming tshig tha snyad sogs tshad ldan du bzo ba/slob khrid la bsam gzhigs dang khrid thabs sngar las lhag par je legs su gtong ba bcas byas na bod skad grangs rig pa'i spus tshad je mthor song nas dus rabs la ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i grub 'bras thob nges so/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 2002lo'i (bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉deb dang po las bdams/)

177༄khya/ / zlos gar gyi rnam bshad nyung bsdus/lhamakhar tshe ring /'phags pa'i yul du zlos gar gyi rig pa 'di dar che zhing shin tu ya mtshan gyi gnas su bya la/ zlos gar snyan ngag ni snyan ngag kun gyi mdzes pa'i tshad du 'dzin par byed/ rang rgyal gyi shin cang yu gur sa khul nas rnyed pa'i slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad par grags pa'i zlos gar gyi bstan bcos kha mi tshang ba gsum yod pa ni rgya gar gyi zlos gar ches snga shos su brtsi/ de las 'khrab tshan dgu can gyi zlos gar zhig yod pa/ mjug gi 'khrab tshan gnyis ma gtogs lhag med pa de'i mjug byang du gser mig gi bu rta dbyangs kyis 〈shā ri'i bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i zlos gar 〉brtsams zhes bkod yod/ 'khrab tshan dgu can gyi 〈shā ri'i bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i zlos gar 〉nang shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal bu gnyis nang pa'i bstan la zhugs pa'i lo rgyus bris yod cing / de snga lhag yod pa'i mjug gi 'khrab tshan gnyis po'i brjod bya yang shā ri'i bus ston pa skyabs su 'dzin pa'i dus shā ri'i bu'i grogs kyis rgyal rigs kyi rig byed gzhung dang bram ze'i chos gnyis gcig tu 'dzin pa'i 'os med do zhes bsnyad par/ shā ri'i bu na re/ dma' ba'i rigs kyis sdeb pa'i sman gyis nad sel mi thub bam/ dma' ba'i rigs kyis byin pa'i chus skom pa sel mi thub bam zhes rigs pas dgag lan sprad/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus shā ri'i bu dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis khengs pa mthong nas de'i don gyi rgyu mtshan bris te rtogs rjes/ shā ri'i bu dang 'grogs te nang pa'i ston pa skyabs su bkur/

178 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ston pas kho gnyis ma 'ongs par bdag gi sras chen gnyis su 'gyur ba'i lung bstan gnang tshul de yin/ rgya nag cin shar ma'i skabs kyi btsun pa h+pha tsang gi rgya gar lam yig nang du skabs der rgya gar du dge 'dun gyi 'dus tshogs gang du chos gsungs tshe shā ri'i bu'i mchod rten la phyag dang bskor ba byed srol rgya cher dar zhing / mchod me nyin mtshan kun tu rgyun chad pa med cing rol mo mkhan gyis rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dkrol ba sogs nang par rab tu byung ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang mo'u 'gal bu dang 'od srung chen por mchod pa'ang de dang 'dra zhes 'khod yod/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis shā ri'i bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i zlos gar mdzad rjes/ rgya gar du shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal bu/ 'od srung chen po rab tu byung ba'i lo rgyus rjod gzhir bzung ba'i zlos gar 'khrab ston byed srol ma nyams par shin tu dar che/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyi zlos gar bstan bcos gzhan gnyis po thar thor chad lhag che bas ngos 'dzin dka' yang zlos gar gyi bstan bcos gsum ga'i brjod don nang don rig pa dang 'brel ba che ste de'i nang sher phyin dang / ting 'dzin/ ston pa'i bstod pa sogs nang don rig pa'i tha snyad mang du 'byung ba dang / zlos gar de gnyis kyi mtshan byang dang mdzad byang chad bor dbang gis mi snang yang /rtsom srol dang brjod don 'dra che bas slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad par byas te yongs grags su rta dbyangs kyi zlos gar bstan bcos kha mi tshang ba can gsum yod par 'dod do/ / slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i zlos gar gsum po 'di rgya gar gyi gna' rabs legs sbyar skad kyi 'khrab gzhung gi sgyu rtsal khyad chos dang mthun cing 'khrab gzhung nang bro gar rang bzhin gyi 'khrab ston pa yang yod la/ rigs mtho dman gyi skad kyi rnam pa mi 'dra la lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs zhugs pa dang 'then pa sogs gar stegs kyi rnam pa ldan cing / glu tshig dang shis tshig ste 'khrab tshan mjug rdzogs skabs shis

zlos gar gyi rnam bshad nyung bsdus/ 179tshig shas cher 'byung ba bcas kyi khyad chos 'di dag rgya gar gna' rabs kyi zlos gar rig pa'i gzhung gi 'gros dang mthun che'o/ /rgya gar du zlos gar rig pa'i gzhung de nam dar bar lta tshul mi gcig kyang / slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i zlos gar gsum po der bltas na phal cher dus rabs dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs nas bzung rgya gar gna' rabs kyi legs sbyar skad kyi zlos gar dar che ba'i sgang yin pa shes thub/'on kyang rgya gar gyi zlos gar dus nam dang yul gang nas dar 'go tshugs pa la bshad tshul mi 'dra ste/ gna' rabs zhi lā'i zlos gar gyi shan zhugs 'og dar bar bshad pa dang / rig byed dar ba'i skabs byung ba'am/ yang na rgya gar gyi snyan ngag ring mo bha ra ta dang rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud byung ba dang dar bar bshad pa sogs rang rang la 'dod tshul sgrub byed kyi yig khungs re 'dren rgyu yod/ 'phags yul gyi rig byed gzhung gi ngag rgyun ltar na/ rig byed bzhi las glu tshig dang / dbyangs/ cho ga brtse sems bcas zlos gar gyi rgyu cha rnams bsdus te rig byed lnga brtsams par grags pa ni zlos gar gyi bstan bcos 'di yin la/ rig byed kyi gzhung lnga pa'i zlos gar ni rgya gar gyi rigs bzhi ga'i thun mong gi spyod yul du 'jog la/ rig byed gzhan bzhi po ni mi rigs rang rang gi bgo skal du gyur te spyod pa las thun mong du spyod pa'i 'os med do/ / de'i shes byed ni zlos gar gyi go don 'jog skabs zlos gar gyi rjod byed tshig phal cher skad rigs rnam pa bzhi'i skad kyis tshigs su bcad de blangs pa dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur yang rigs bzhi ga'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang bstun te zlos shing gar byed do zhes pa'i don yang de la thug yod la/zlos gar ni thun mong gi rig gnas kyi grangs su bgrangs pa'i rgyu mtshan phyogs gcig kyang 'di la dgongs par 'dod par bltas na/ zlos gar gyi rig pa 'di ni thog mar dmangs rigs dang gdol rigs te rgya gar gyi rigs dma'

180 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i dmangs tshogs kyi nang du dar te rim bzhin rigs bzhi ga'i thun mong gi spyod yul du gyur ba zhig yin pa gor ma chag ste/ kho tsho'i lo rgyus kyi yig cha las 'byung ba ltar na/ glu len gar rtsed dang / bzhad gad mkhan/ 'khrab ston pa sogs don du gnyer ba'i rigs ni spyi tshogs kyi go gnas dma' zhing /ches tha shal gyi gras su brtsi ba yin/ rim gyis rgya gar gyi rigs bzhi ga phan tshun 'dres shing nang pa'i chos kyis rigs kyi khyad med par spyi snyoms su 'dzin pa bcas kyi rig gnas chos lugs kyi 'thab 'dzing khrod zlos gar 'di rgya gar du thun mong gis khas len cing thun mong gi spyod yul du gyur song ba red/ de bas zlos gar nang du bram ze'i chos kyi cho ga dang rgyal rigs rje rigs kyi nyam thag 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal dang / rigs dang rigs bar gyi brtse ba dang gdug tsub/ rigs dang rigs bar gyi pho mo'i brtse dung gi dga' skyo'i rnam pa sogs bris yod phyir/ zlos gar 'di la snyan ngag gi brtse dung zab mos phyug cing zlos gar nang mi'i 'tsho ba'i brtse sems kyi rnam pas khengs yod pa yin/nga tsho bod du 'khrab bzhin pa'i zlos gar phal che ba ni gna' rabs rgya gar gyi zlos gar la brten nas byung ba yin cing / rgya gar du gna' snga mo nas bha ra ta dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ bu mo sha kun+ta'i zlos gar/ rma bya'i zlos gar/ ne tso'i zlos gar/ spre'u ha lu man tha'i zlos gar sogs bod la 'gyur ba dang ma 'gyur ba'i zlos gar lo rgyus yig cha dag nang ming zur mang du bton yod/ lhag par du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos rgya cher dar ba dang bstun skyes bu dam pa'i lo rgyus zlos gar la sbyar ba dang skyes rabs rnam thar zlos gar du sbyar ba'i rnam thar gyi 'khrab gzhung shin tu mang po byung ba dang / zlos gar 'khrab pa'i chos kyi dus ston chen po yang rgyal rabs so sor rgya gar gyi yul gru kun tu dar khyab che bar snang / de'i shan gyis nga tsho bod du'ang 〈gzugs kyi nyi ma 〉

zlos gar gyi rnam bshad nyung bsdus/ 181dang 〈dri med kun ldan 〉sogs rnam thar zlos gar mang po bod rang gi mkhas pas rtog bzo byas pa shin tu mang la/ zlos gar de dag gi brjod bya'i sa bon sngon byung ston pa'i skyes rabs dang rtogs brjod/ 'dul ba dang mdo sde'i khrod nas blangs pa sha stag yin zhing de'i khar bod rang gi lo rgyus gar du byas pa 〈snang sa 'od 'bum 〉sogs dang / 〈gtam pad+ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar 〉sogs lta bu zlos gar snyan ngag gi rtsom rig kyang mang du brtsams pa red/ nga tsho bod du dar ba'i zlos gar de dag la rgya gar gyi zlos gar bstan bcos las bstan pa'i mtshan nyid mi tshang yang / de dang cha mtshungs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ston pa'i zlos gar te sems can rnams dga' ba bskyed pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba'i phyir thar pa don gnyer can la dmigs te brtsams pa'am 'khrab ston byas pa shig yin/nga tsho bod kyi zlos gar la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos shig chags yod de/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rtogs brjod rnam thar gyi brjod bya'i gtam rgyud dang / glu tshig gi zlos stangs sogs tshur bsdus byas la/ lha mo'i zlos gar gyis zur brgyan pa bcas 'phags bod kyi zlos gar ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i khyad chos ldan/ 'on kyang de gnyis kyi khungs mi 'dra ste/ rnam thar zlos gar ni rgya gar gyi zlos gar la lad zlos byas te byung ba zhig dang / lha mo'i zlos gar ni bod dmangs khrod nas dar ba zhig yin pa mang du spro mi dgos so/ / lha mo'i zlos gar 'di dbus gtsang yul du shin tu dar che la rnam thar zlos gar ni a mdo'i yul du dar che ba ni spyir btang tsam gyis bshad pa yin no/ / rnam thar zlos gar phal che bar zlos gar bstan bcos las bstan pa'i mtshams sbyor yan lag dag tshang zhing sgeg pa sogs gar gyi nyams mtha' dag ldan pa yin/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar las byung ba'i mdo 'dzin yan lag de rnam thar zlos gar khrod du yod de/ rnam thar gang du 'khrab tshe

182 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thog mar de ring 'khrab pa'i rnam thar zlos gar 'di lta mgron rnams la ngo sprod byed pa de yin/ zlos gar 'khrab ston mi sna'i skad cha ni mdzes pa'i snyan ngag gi rang bzhin can yin dgos pa ma zad/ bla med kyi spyod bzang la bsngags brjod dang g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi spyod ngan la sun 'byin byas pa zhig yin/gna' rabs rgya gar gyi zlos gar dang bod kyi rnam thar zlos gar gang rung pho mo'i brtse dung dang khyo shug gnyis kyi brtse dung gi 'tsho ba rjod gzhi'i phyogs gcig 'dzin pa ni kho tsho'i rtsom lugs shig tu gyur yod pa la yul ljongs dang /brtse dung / 'thab 'dzing / chos lugs bcas ni zlos gar dang zlos gar snyan ngag gi rgyu cha bzhi lta bur gyur yod pas brjod bya phun sum tshogs shing sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos kyang ches mtho ba'i tshad du slebs yod de zlos gar ni mi sna'i bya byed dang tshugs rnam gtso bor gyur ba'i glu tshig dang / rol mo/ rgyan gos/gar stegs sogs sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs mang mnyam 'dus can yin pas so/ /mdor na/ zlos gar 'khrab gzhung dang zlos gar rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs la thon pa'i phan nus zab cing rgya che la sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa gzengs su thon pa'i rig gnas shig red/ nga tshos sngon byung zlos gar gyi rig pa rgyud 'dzin byas te deng rabs kyi zlos gar rig pa khyab spel du gtong rgyu ni gal che zhing / zlos gar gyi rig pa 'di deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi mi rnams kyi mdzes dpyod kyi sems khams su nye bar mkho bas 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam shin tu yangs so/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 2001lo'i 〈bod ljongs sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug 〉deb dang po las bdams/)

183༄ / / gna' rabs bod kyi dngul lor brje res skor mdo tsam gleng ba/mgon po rnam rgyal/dang po/ spyir btang gi dngos po cha 'dra ba brje res byed pa'i skor/nye ba'i lo shas ring gna' rdzas lo rgyus la brtag dpyad byas pa las shes gsal ltar/ lo ngo stong phrag bzhi'i snga rol nas mdo dbus khams gsum du gna' bo'i zhing phyugs las dar ba dang / zhing phyugs las kyi dbye bas dngos po brje res kyi cha rkyen bskrun zhing / thon skyed dang brje res kyi 'phel rgyas brgyud nas spyir btang gi dngos po brje res byed pa'i srol chags/gangs can kha ba'i ljongs 'di sa khyon che zhing 'ogrim 'grul stabs mi bde bas dngos po cha 'dra ba brje res byed pa de'ang sa gnas kyi khyad par gyis sna mang can du gyur/ thang dang sung rgyal rabs kyi brtsams chos dag dang i ṭa li'i zhib 'jug pa mar khu po lo'i yul skor zin tho la bod mi'i bza' tshwa dngul lor gyi tshab tu bkol ba'i tho 'god yod la/ 'jar man gyi zhib 'jug pa le pho sin gyis gna' rabs bod mi'i star gas dngur lor byed pa dang /yang na dar gos sogs kyis dngul sprod byed thabs spyad par gsungs yod/skabs der mtshon na mar (skabs de'i tshad 'jal byed khe yin/)dang nya lcibs phyi skogs dang rdo'i rigs kyi phreng ba sogs rin gong tshad 'jal byed kyi lag char gyur/ de las phreng ba dar rgyugs che la/ goms srol ltar na phreng rdog lnga

184 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bya gcig la brje ba dang / phreng ba gcig gis 'bru rigs khe bzhi nyo thub/ ba mo gcig phreng ba bzhir brje ba'i srol yod par grags/ skabs de'i phyugs rigs nor ni gna' bo'i bod kyi lo rgyus dus rim gyi tshong zog brje res byed pa'i rgyu cha gtso bor gyur pa gsham gsal ltar/ rta dang lug ra ma sogs phyugs rigs kyang nor gyis tshad 'jal gyin yod la/ rta gcig la nor gsum dang / lug bcu la nor gcig ra ma nyi shur nor gcig0dang brje res byed pa'i srol yod/gnyis pa/ dngul lor gyi 'byung ba dang 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi gtan la phab tshul/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ltar na lo ngo stong phrag gcig gi sngon la yar klung gtsang po'i 'gram rgyud du chags pa'i yar klung du (gter rdzas thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod pas gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter byung ba gor ma chag )phyugs gnyer las gzhan zhing las kyang dar khyab ha cang che/ thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas byung ba dang bstun tshong zog brje res la'ang 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod/ yang bod rgyal stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi skabs tshong pa phan tshun bar 'os mthun gyis nyo tshong brje res byed pa'i tshong las byung zhing skabs de'i nyo tshong ni dngos zog brje res 'phel rgyas che ba'i dus rim zhig yin la/ rim bzhin tshong zog brje res de sa gnas las brgal te lcags rigs dngul sgor 'byung bar thon skyed dang brje res sogs phyogs yongs kyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms po byung dhi/1 ‘‘dngul sgor ni brje res brgyud rim khrod med du mi rung ba'i thon rdzas yin/’’zhes gsungs pa ltar bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs byung ba nas gser ni pur rgyal bod kyis dngul lor gyi tshab tu bkol spyod byas pa yongs

gna' rabs bod kyi dngul lor brje res skor mdo tsam gleng ba/ 185khyab tu gyur/ a me ri kha'i zhib 'jug pa pe khu wa'i sis (tshe 65slotwe'i)gser dang dngul gnyi ga bod btsan po'i dus dngul lor du bkol myong zhes pa dang da dung khong gi dpyad rtsom〈bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi dpal 'byor la thog mar dpyad pa 〉zhes pa'i nang du‘‘bod btsan po'i skabs su gser phye dang dngul/ dar gos/ bza' tshwa sogs ni brje res kyi smyan byed gtso bo yin/bod dang thang rgyal rabs kyi nyo tshong khrod du tshong chen byed dus gser phye dang ma rtsa chung rigs brje res byed skabs dngul dang dar gos sogs yin la/yang phyi gling ba dang rgya gar ba sogs la tshong byed skabs phal cher dngul lor bkol spyod byas/ gzhan dong tse yang bod batren po'i skabs su dngul lor gyi gras su bkol spyod byas par grags/’’rjozhes 'khod/thang rgyal rabs kyi dus skabs su dmangs khrod nyo tshong brgyud nas rgya bod dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs la 'brel ba dam zab byung ba dang bstun bod sa gnas khul gyi dngul lor lam lugs bcos sgyur la'ang 'phel rgyas chen po byung / skabs der nang sa nas gser dang dngul sgor blugs ma/dar gos/ ja lo sogs drangs nas bod yul du rta nor lug gsum dang /pags pa/ rtswa sman sogs dang phan tshun brje res byas/ de nas bzung dngul lor gyi tshad len pa de bod khams yongs la khyab gdal du song bas tshad gzhi de gtan 'jag su gyur/ bod kyi sku drag dang tshong pa 'byor ldan sogs kyi lag par dar rgyugs che zhing rgyun du kha rgyun du yod pa'i dngul rta rmig ma'am dngul lnga bcu ma zhes pa de phing gcig gi tshad yin no/2 bod rgyal so gcig pa stag ri gnyan gzigs (57khad 619)kyi dus su bod gcig gyur byed pa'i 'go brtsams/ mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran rnams la dmag drangs te ban pa rje dang / drang gang rje/ zing po rje/ zhang zhung rje sogs btul/ rgyal phran rnams kyi gsum cha gnyis tsam mnga' 'og tu

186 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsdus/ btsan po'i sa khongs rgya cher phyin pa dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor rig gnas nyin bzhin gong du 'phel rgyas byung / 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉las ‘‘'di nas khri dor snang btsun mong gi bus bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad kyis bcal/ / dga' gnyis tshong las mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs/ / de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med/ / de phyir mdzangs mi bdun gyi gsum par grags du’’zer/ rgyal rabs so gnyis pa gnam ri srong btsan (601—62kha)gyi skabs su byang nas tshwa kha rnyed/ byang tshwa lho ru 'dren pa'i srol dar/ rgyal po 'di gnyi ga'i ring bre srang phul gsum gtan la phab/bod rgyal so gsum pa srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus gzhi nas bod 'di gcig gyur byung ba des bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'gro ba'i dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi gcig gyur bzo dgos pa de yang gal che'i gnad don du gyur/ de'i thog nas srong btsan sku dus bod kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed dang brje tshong thad gong 'phel che tsam byung ba dang / dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs kyang che tsam yod pa mtshon thub/ ‘‘srong btsan sgam po nas khri ral pa can gyi bar btsan po'i rgyal rabs skabs kyi bre tshad ni 'bru rigs ya khyor nyi shu rtsa gcig la bre gang du brtsi ba dang / de yang ya khyor gsum dang phyed ka la phul gang du brtsi ba'i phul drug la bre gang / bre nyi shu la khal gcig brtsi ba'i lugs gcig dang / yang ya khyor gsum la phul gang dang phul bdun la bre gang / bre nyi shu la khal gcig brtsi ba'i lugs gnyis yod rung / gang ltar ya khyor nyi shu rtsa gcig la bre gang brtsi bar khyad par med pa de ni skabs de'i 'bru rigs 'jal gshor gyi khal dang bre'i tshad gzhi yin la bre ni shing bre yin/ sha mar sogs 'degs byed srang gi tshad gzhi ni/ nas rdog che ba gnyis dang / 'bring ba gnyis/ chung ba gnyis

gna' rabs bod kyi dngul lor brje res skor mdo tsam gleng ba/ 187bcas nas 'bru che chung drug gi ljid tshad la se ba gang / se ba nyi shu'i ljid la zho gang / zho bcu'i ljid la srang gang / srang bzhi'am spor bzhi la nyag gang /nyag nyi shu ste srang brgyad cu tham pa la khal gcig brtsi ba ni skabs de'i 'degs 'jal gyi srang tshad yin/ 'degs byed kyi srang ni shing srang yin par grags/ gser dngul sogs kyi 'degs tshad ni srang bdun la nam gciganam bdun la zho gang / zho bcu la srang gang yin par grags/ skabs de'i ring thung 'jal tshad ji yin lo rgyus yig lam nang 'khod khro ma mthong rung /sor bcu gnyis la mtho gang / mtho do la khru gang / khru bzhi la 'dom re brtsi ba'isrol nye rabs bar rgyun chags su gnas yod pa ltar bod snga rabs pa'i ring thung 'jal tshad kyang de rang min nam snyam pa dpyad gzhi bcas de ltar srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus gshor 'degs kyi 'jal tshad bre/ srang / phul/khyor/ zho/ nam/ se/ srang sogs bka' la btags pa ste batren po'i bkas bcad pa ni khrims yig gnyis pa 'bum gyi gser thag sha ba can gyi khrims su grags pa'o/’’rjo'ajal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi gcig gyur bzos pa des skabs de'i zhing 'brog thon rdzas brje len dang / tshong las sogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar stabs bde'i nus pa ha cang cang chen po thon pa ni smos ma dgos so/ /gsum pa/ bal bod dngul lor nyo chong dang de'i skor gyi rtsod gleng /‘‘dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dus dkyil du bal po'i ka ta man tu nas dngul sgor blugs ma bod yul du dar 'go tshugs/ ka ta man tu'i rgyal po ma hin rda la ma lās ( 1560da 1579bar du rgyal sa bzung /) bod dang 'brel ba btsugs nas dngul sgor dang bod yul gyi dngul dkar brje res

188 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ byed pa'i chings yig bzhag pa des lo ngo nyis brgya lhag gi ring bal bod dngul sgor nyo tshong byed pa'i rgyun bskyangs/’’du dang thog gi brje res byed thabs ni dngul sgor dang dngul dkar gyi ljid tshad 'dra mnyam ngang brje ba las blugs rin rtsis mi rgyag deng skabs brtag dpyad byas pa ltar na bal yul nas byung ba'i dngul lor steng gi ri mo mi 'dra ba'i dngul sgor blugs ma rigs bzhi bcu lhag yod la/ de dag gi ljid tshad khe bzhi dang grangs chung brgyad nas khe lnga dang grangs chung lnga'i bar gcig mthun min/ ring tshad ha'o rmid nyer drug nas nyer brgyad bar yin/ mthug tshad ha'o rmid gcig dang grangs chung lnga tsam yin la de dag bod yul du 'byor tshe re rer dngul dkar zho gcig dang skar lnga la brje bzhin yod/ne pa lar mnga' 'og rgyal phran gyis dngul blugs skabs nang du rdzas rdzun ma bsre ba dang / pa ta kāng gi ches mjug gi dpon po la nā ci thi ma lās rdzas su dong bsres nas dngul sgor blugs shing rgyu spus dman pa'i dngul sgor de mu mthud de bod la drangs pa la bod mi dmangs rnams mos mthun ma byung /'di lta bu'i dngul sgor rdzun ma la bal yul gyi lo rgyus steng du'ang ‘‘bsre dngul ’’zer zhing bod yul du da dung dngul dkar zho gcig dang skar lnga la brje/ 'dra mnyam min pa'i dngul lor nyo tshong de las re zhig bal yul la yongs 'bab legs po yod pa smras ma dgos/ a me ri kha'i mi kun a'i has bshad pa ltar na ‘‘ni pa la'i mir dngul lor nyo tshong khrod brgya cha bcu gnyis kyi yong sgo thon zhing / de las brgya cha bzhi ni bod yul nas brjes pa'i dngul rta rmig ma btso sbyang byas pa'i nying bcud yin la/ brgya cha brgyad ni dngul sgor rdzun ma blugs pa las byung ’’dhizhes pa'o/dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus dkyil tsam la/ ko ra khu'i mi rnams kyis pha'o la thu we na la yang hra a'i 'go khrid 'og snga gzhug tu ka ta man

gna' rabs bod kyi dngul lor brje res skor mdo tsam gleng ba/ 189tu'i rong sa'i rgyal phran dag bsnubs shing bal po gcig gyur byas nas dngul sgor rdzun ma blugs pa'i rgyun de yang bskyar bskyangs pas bal bod dngul lor nyo tshong gi rtsod gleng de tshabs chen rang bzhin du gyur pa la/ bal bod mtha' mtshams nas 'khrug pa bslangs shing phyis su bal bod dngul lor nyo tshong gi rtsod gleng de rim gyis 'dum 'grig byung / bal bod dngul lor nyo tshong gi rtsod gleng de brgyud nas bod kyi dngul lor bzo bcos la'ang 'phel rgyas chen po byung zhing dngul lor bzo bcos kyi lam lugs de tshad ldan can du gyur/‘‘bod dang hin rdu'i tshong zog brje res las hin rdu nas thon pa'i bu ram sogs gshor la 'degs pa dang / bod thon gyi mar dang bal sogs khal la 'degs kyi yod pas khal gcig la nyag nyi shu dang / khal bcu gnyis la mon do gcig bcas yin/ da dung 'bru rigs gshor byed ru'i khal gang la bre nyi shu/ bre gcig la phul drug yin/ gzhis rtse khul du chos 'bo zhes bre brgyad 'gro ba'i 'bo yang yod/ tshad 'jal ni ras kha gang zhes ras sogs kyi kha zheng tshad 'jal gru bzhi ma zhig gi tshad la zer/ sha la sogs pa 'ga' shas la spom tshod kyang byed kyi yod/ bod dngul thad kha gang gnyis la skar lnga dang /gsum la skar phyed brgyad/ bzhi la zho gang / drug la tram ga zho bcu la srang gang / srang lnga bcu la rdo tshad gcig bcas kyi brtsi srol yod/ bod nas bal dang gla rtsi/ g.yag gi rnga ma/ 'phyi ba'i pags pa/ phag spu/ tha na gro mo dang kham bu nas thon pa'i zhog khog 'brug yul nas thon pa'i slo ma/ phyur skar sogs dar rgyugs che/ hin rdu nas bod du 'bras dang gro zhib/ chu tshod/ rdo snum/ me mdel sogs 'dren gyin yod par gragasaṇa’’bzhi pa/ mjug bsdu ba/rang re'i bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'di'ang mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar

190 gtsos mi rigs dge 'osamatho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi brgyud rim khrod rang byung khams chen po dang 'thab rtsod brgyud nas rim bzhin spyi tshogs 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas byung ba dang bstun/ spyir btang gi dngos po cha 'dra ba brje res la nges par du mkho ba'i tshad 'jal byed cig gtan khel mi byed ka med byung bas 'jal gshor 'degs gsum gyi tshad gzhi ‘‘bre srang phul khyor zho nam se bsran sogs/ / bka' la btags pa khrims yig gnyis pa ste/ / 'bum gyi gser thog sha ba can zhes grags/ / ’’zhes pa ltar bka' btags nas gtan la phab/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i thon khungs phun sum tshogs po yod pa sus kyang bsnyon par mi nus/ yin yang thon rdzas de dag re zhig btso sbyang dang las snon gang legs shig byed ma thub pas rgyal khab gzhan dag dang mi rigs gzhan pas las snon byas pa'i dngul rdzun blugs ma de'i rigs bkol spyod byas pa bal bod dngul lor nyo tshong gi rtsod gleng gis kyang mngon thub cing / 'obs su thengs gcig lhungs na shes rab thengs gcig 'phel zhes pa ltar bal bod dngul lor nyo tshong gi rtsod gleng gis bod pa rnams gnyid las bslangs pa bzhin dngul lor bzo bcos lam lugs de tshad ldan gyi phyogs su bskyod pa'i skor mdor bsdus su bkod pa re zhig rdzogs so/ /mchan 'grel/rjokrung go tshan rtsal mi rigs zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs pa'i 〈nag chu rdzong gi rnga pa tsho pa'i zhib bsher snyan zhu 〉ji 76pa/ du〈bod ljongs mi rigs slob gling gi rig gzhung dus deb 〉deb bzhi pa'i ji 38pa/tshung khu wa'i si'i (245k+ṣe'i)〈bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs kyi dpal 'byor la thog mar dpyad pa 〉9 103pa/dhiphun tshogs tshe ring gis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i 〈deb ther kun gsal me long 〉9 31pa/(〉cab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs dang nor brang o rgyan gnyis kyis bsgrigs pa'i dz+nyobod kyi lo

192༄khya / / rgya bod gtam dpe lo tsā'i tshad gezhi dngos dang de'i sgyur thabs skor gyi dpyad pa phran bu/'od can 'bum/dang po/ lo tsā'i tshad gzhi dang de'i 'brel ba mdor bshad/lo tsā'i tshad gzhi'i skor la phyi nang gi lo tsā'i gzhung lugs smra ba'i mkhas pa rnam pas bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba gang mang bstan yod de/ rgya'i lo chen yan h+phu'u zhes pas ‘‘lkozlo༄ skre༄7’’zhes pa ste/ ma yig gi nang don 'phyugs pa med par phab sgyur bya dgos pa dang gcig brjod bde rtogs sla yong ba bya rgyu dang gnyis/ snyan 'jebs nyams 'gyur ldan dgos pa dang gsum ste/ mtshungs gsal bde gsum gyi tshad gzhi thog mar bton pa dang / h+phu le'u yis don la ma nor tshig la ji bzhin thon mi dgos zhes pa dang / sku zhabs krang phe ci yis ‘‘ma yig la bstun pa dang brjod bde ba ’’zhes pa dang / chus chi'u pa'e yis ‘‘don spyi mtshungs pa ’’zhes pa dang / a me ri ka'i lo chen ne tās/ bton pa'i ‘‘nus pa mnyam pa'am yang na nus mtshungs ’’zhes pa/ rang re'i bod la da yod khungs btsan pa'i yig cha ltar na/ lo ngo stong tsam gyi yar sngon nas lo tsā'i tshad gzhi gsum tsam byung / dang po ni sgra sbyor bam gnyis las/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lugs ni don dang yang mi 'gal la bod la yang gar bde bar gyis shig ces gsungs pa dang / tshad gzhi gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ lo

rgya bod gtam dpe lo tsā'i tshad gzhi dngos dang de'i sgyur thabs skor gyi dpyad pa/193tsā ba ni ne+e tso lta bu zhes dang / tshad gzhi gsum pa ni lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje mchog gis tshig gsal la go bde ba don dang yang mi 'gal bar byas te zhes bye brag tu tshad gzhi gsum tsam gtan 'bebs byas/ tshad gzhi rnam pa sna tshogs byung ba de dag las nga tshos shes thub pa ni/ 'dod tshul de dag phan tshun gzhogs 'degs dang phan tshun lhan thabs su gyur yod par ma zad/ da rung mtshan nyid so so'i kha phyogs sa mi gcig 'on kyang dgongs gzhi'i snying po tshang ma ni sgyur byed bu yig gis ma 'phyugs ma nor bar bsgyur bya ma yig gi don snying de ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon dgos shing / bsgyur bya ma yig gi nyams dang rnam pa de mngon gsal du mtshon dgos pa de'o/ /bsgyur bya ma yig gi don snying ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon zer ba ni bsgyur bya ma yig gi yig ngos go don dang / snang brnyan gyi bstan don/ 'phros don bcas phyogs gsum gyi sgo nas ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon dgos/ 'on kyang bsgyurakhya ma yig gi grub tshig re re dang / gtam dpe re re/ tha snyad re re sogs thams cad la dus gcig tu go don rigs de gsum ldan pa ma yin te/la la yig ngos kyi don kho na tsam las/ snang brnyan gyi bstan don med pa dang /la lar yig ngos go don dang snang brnyan gyi bstan don gnyis las 'phros don med/ lhag par du mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i skad cha'i rig gnas gnyis gang char yang thams cad gcig mtshungs yin pa dpe mi srid la/ bsgyur bya ma yig khrod kyi go don rigs gsum po de tshang ma sgyur byed bu yig khrod du'ang yang bskyar mtshon pa ni spyir bshad na dka' mor 'dug gal srid yig ngos kyi go don nam yang na snang brnyan gyi bstan don dang 'phros don rnams lo tsā byed dus rigaganas kyi khyad par yod pa'i dbang gis 'gal ba byung na 'phros don la bstun dgos/ de min na ma yig gi snang brnyan gyi go don de dmigs yul yod pa'i tshig grub du do mnyam zhig rnyed mi thub pa'am yang na nye ba'i snang

234༄khya / / ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ri’gyi dgongs don la brten nas mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod las don gsar 'byed byed dgos/sgrol ma 'tsho/dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni shes ldan mi sna 'gran slong drag po byed pa'i dus skabs shig yin/ tshan rig lag rtsal dar spel dang shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i rmang gzhi rten sa ni slob gso yin/ slob gsos mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos/ ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’migyi dgongs don gal chen gyis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas las don 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu ni/ slob gso'i las don dang khyad par du slob chen dpe mdzod khang gi las ka'i mdun du lhags pa'i gnad don gsar pa zhig yin/gcigatang gi tshogs chen bcu drug pas ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs pa nga tsho'i tang gi spyod lam gyi phyogs ston du gtan 'khel gnang ba ma zad/ blo mthun cang tse rmin gyis nga tsho'i tang gi mdun skyod kyi kha phyogs thog mtha' bar gsum du mtshon par byed dgos zhes de'i don snying rgyas bshad kyang gnang /‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’ni nga tsho'i tang gi spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i bsam blo'i mdzub ston thad kyi 'phel rgyas

mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod las don gsar 'byed byed dgos/ 235gsar pa zhig yin/ der krung hwa mi rigs dar rgyas rlabs chen 'byung ba'i las 'gan gyi 'du shes dang 'gan khur gyi bsam blo shugs drag pos kun nas khengs pas/ krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i bla srog gi rten sa yang ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’yin pa bshad mi dgos pa red/ sngon thon gyi rig gnas ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gong 'phel byung ba'i nying bcud yin la/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dar spel gtong ba'i dpal yon gyi sgul shugs dang rig stobs kyi rgyab skyor yang yin pas/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khyab khongs so sor 'brel ba dam po yod/mi rigs mtho rim slob grwa'i dpe mdzod khang ni slob grwa'i slob gso dang tshan dpyod zhabs 'degs kyi rig gzhung las khungs su gyur ba'i slob ma'i slob khang gnyis pa yin/ dpe mdzod khang gis na gzhon slob ma tshor phugs bsam yag po gso skyong dang kun spyod bzang bo'i shugs rkyen thebs par nus pa gal chen 'don thub pa yin/ ‘‘dus rabs nyer gcig par spyi tshogs ring lugs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i rtsa ba'i 'gan khur ni/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar phugs bsam ldan zhing spyod lam bzang ba dang / rig gnas kyi yon tshad mtho ba/ sgrig khrims brtsi srung gi 'du shes yod pa bcas kyi spyi dmangs gso skyong byed rgyu de yin/’’ de bas nga tshos slob ma'i spus tshad slob gsor sngar las lhag par shugs bsnan nas shes yon pa gso skyong byed pa'i rgyu spus khyon yongs nas gong 'phel gtong ba dang / phugs bsam yag po ldan zhing kun spyod bzang bo yod pa/ rig gnas yon tshad 'dzoms la khrims lugs brtsi srung gi 'du shes ldan pa'i mi rabs gsar pa zhig skyed sring byed rgyu ni/ slob grwa'i 'gan khur gal chen zhig yin pa ma zad/ dpe mdzod khang gi las ka dang 'brel ba'i gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig kyang yin/'on kyang sgyur bcos sgo 'byed byas pa'i tshun chad la nub phyogs kyi rig

236 gtsos mi3gas dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnas bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun sna tshogs phon cher nang sim byung ste/ rgyal nang tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la'ang skyid 'dod ring lugs dang mi sger ring lugs kyi slu brid las sla bos thebs shing / sngon thon rig gnas kyi gsar gtod yang phyogs so so nas 'gran slong la 'phrad/ de'i stabs kyis nga tshos gom gang mdun spos kyi sgo nas bsam spyod brtan tshugs thub pa'i las don la shugs bsnan nas spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab legs bsgyur byed dgos pa'i gtsos/ da dung ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi snying don 'gangs chen nan tan gyis slob sbyong byas te lag len du 'debs thub pa byed dgos/ khyad par du sgyur bcos sgo 'byed kyi gnas tshul yag por brten nas/ mtho rim slob grwa'i dpe mdzod khang gis rang mdzod na nyar ba'i mar le ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung / ting zha'o phin bcas kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs skor gyi phon che ba'i yig cha dang / chab srid dpal 'byor/ na gzhon gso skyong la sogs pa'i nyer mkho'i rgyu cha la brten nas slob mar sne khrid kyis/ dpe cha mang bo klog pa dang klog par skul ba byed dgos par ma zad/ nang don yang phun sum tshogs po rgyus lon gnang du 'jug dgos/de ltar byas na na gzhon slob ma'i bsam blo'i rgyu spus dang rig gnas tshan rtsal gyi chu tshad mu mthud du 'phel rgyas gtong thub pa dang / slob mar 'dzam gling gi phul du phyin pa'i rig gnas grub 'bras bsdu len byed du 'jug thub pa yin pas/ nga tshos dngos don la brten nas slob ma tshor ‘‘ting zha'o phin gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs ’’dang / ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs don gnyis rang re'i rgyal khab 'byor phyug ldan pa'i lam du bkri ba'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs yin pa gsal rtogs gnang du 'jug thub pa yin/

mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod las don gsar 'byed byed dgos/ 237gnyis/‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs don gal chen lag bstar byed pa la/thog mar las byed mi sna'i bsam spyod kyi spus ka bzang bo'i 'dzugs skun la shugs bsnan nas/ las rigs kyi kun spyod slob gso dar spel du gtong dgos/ mi rigs mtho rim slob grwa'i dpe mdzod khang gi las byed mi sna ni dpe mdzod zhabs zhu'i las ka'i nus shugs gtso bo yin pa ma zad/ dpe mdzod khang 'khor skyod byed pa'i nang rkyen gyi grub cha gtso bo'ang yin/ dpe mdzod las byed mi sna'i kun spyod blo sbyong dang bsam blo'i lam phyogs la shugs snon pa ni/ slob grwa'i bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i grub cha gal chen gyi nang khongs su gnas pa'i bya ba zhig yin la/ bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi 'dzugs skrun las don la skul 'ded byed pa'i gnad gzhi 'gangs chen gyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen zhig kyang yin/ dpe mdzod las byed mi sna'i bsam spyod grags 'gul re res klog pa por gzugs su ma grub pa'i bag chags nges can 'jog thub pa yin/ nga tshos lhag bsam rnam dag gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i bsam blo'i rkang gzhi btsugs te bya ba dngos gzhi'i khrod klog pa por gang zhus dang len dang gang dris lan gtong / gshis 'jam snang bde bcas kyis rogs ram byas te/ slob ma rnams shes bya yon tan gyis tshim du 'jug dgos rgyu ma zad/ zhabs zhu'i rogs ram gyis kyang sems khong mgu thub pa byed dgos/ las byed mi sna'i skad grags med pa'i snying stobs kyi skyes 'bul gyis rgya che ba'i slob ma tshor 'bod skul dang bag chags bzang bo 'jog thub pa lag len steng nas bden dpang byung bas/ nga tshos nam yin yang rang gi spyod lam la gzab nan bya rgyu gal che/dpe mdzod las byed mi snas nges par du dpe mdzod las gnyer gyi bya ba la dga' zhen dang klog pa po phebs par dga' zhen byed dgos/ deng rabs

238 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi spyi tshogs khrod dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha'i tshan rig dang / nus pa'i 'byung khungs kyi tshan rig cha 'phrin rgyu 'grul gyi tshan rig rnams ni/ deng rabs tshan rig gi srog shing chen po gsum yin/ tshan rig gi srog shing chen mo 'di gsum dang dpe mdzod khang gi bar rten bcas kyi 'brel ba zab mo yod/ dpe mdzod las byed mi snas rten bcas kyi 'brel ba der ngos 'dzin gang legs byas te/klog pa por zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i las ka'i khrod rang nyid la klog pa po phebs par dga' zhen byed pa'i kun slong yag po ldan pa gso skyong byed dgos pa ma zad/ zhabs 'degs kyi las kar dga' zhen yod pa'i bsam blo'i brtse dung yang gso skyong byed dgos/ rang 'gan gtsang bzhes kyis klog pa por zhabs zhu yag po mkho sgrub byas nas/ kho tsho'i khrod du rang nyid kyi spyi rnam yag po chags par brtson dgos/de ltar byas na da gzod ‘‘mtshon byed gsum mi’gyi blang byar bstun thub pa dang / tang gi bsam blo'i spyod lam dang bya ba'i spyod lam/ slob srol dang las byed pa'i 'tsho ba'i spyod lam sogs kyi 'dzugs skrun las don tshad gzhi gsar pa zhig la bstod thub pa yin/gsum/‘‘sngon thon thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas kyi blang bya mtshon par byed pa'i ririthabs lam la brten nas/ dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dar spel byed pa'i las don gyi khrod du mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod khang yang hur brtson gyis zhugs dgos/ bsgyur bcos gting zab tu gtong ba'i khrod tshan rig lag rtsal ni thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin pas/ de 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i dgos mkho ltar du/ rgyal khab kyi shes rig gsar gtod ma lag 'dzugs skrun byed par hur skyed kyis skul 'ded byed dgos/sngon chad slob chen gyi dpe mdzod khang so so dang / khyad par du mi

mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod las don gsar 'byed byed dgos/ 239rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod khang gi zhabs 'degs dngos gzhi'i las ka'i phyogs so so na/ da dung bsdad sgug brten gsum gyi tshur skul zhabs zhu'i bsam blo'i bkag rgya sngar mus bzhin gnas yod pa ma zad/ zhabs zhu'i ltos yul yang sgug nas bsdad na tshur sgo gam du yong ba ni slob grwa'i nang khul gyi klog pa po sha stag yin pas bya ba'i 'jug sgo gu ha cang dog/ tshong ra'i dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi nyin bzhin gting zab tu 'gyur ba'i cha 'phrin gyi spyi tshogs 'di'i nang du/ 'di lta'i zhabs zhu'i las kas dpe mdzod khang gi bya ba'i 'phel rgyas la bkag rgya tshabs chen thebs kyi yod/ de'i phyir bsam blo bcing 'grol byas te 'du shes gsar sgyur gyis 'gran brtson gyi nang rkyen tshur bsdu dang tshong ra'i 'gran sdur la the gtogs/ dus rabs gsar pa'i dgos mkhor mthun pa'i rgyud dra 'dzugs skrun gyi las don la hur skyed kyis shugs snon byed pa dang / thog mtha' bar gsum du thon skyed nus shugs sngon thon can gyi tshab mtshon blang bya de bya ba dngos gzhi'i khrod du dngos 'bebs byed pa/zhabs 'degs dang lag rogs kyi nus pa rang 'gul gyis 'don spel byas nas bcos sgyur dang 'phel rgyas/ brtan 'jags bcas la khyon yongs nas zhabs 'degs thub rgyu byung na/ dpe mdzod kyi sde khag so so'i bya ba da gzod rim pa gsar pa zhig la bstod thub pa yin/zhabs 'degs las ka spyi tshogs kyi ngo bor sgyur ba ni da lta'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi drag rlabs shig yin pa ma zad/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i dgos nges kyi cha rkyen gsar pa zhig kyang yin/ srid 'byor gyi gnas tshul 'phel rgyas byung ba'i dgos 'dun ltar du zhabs 'degs kyi las tshan rnam grangs kyang mu mthud du rgya skyed 'thus tshang du gtong dgos/ slob chen gyi dpe mdzod khang gis kyang srol rgyun gyi las ka'i rnam pa dang bya ba'i nang don/ ltos gzhi'i sgrig rim sogs rtsa gtor du btang nas/ hur brtson
