240 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyis rnam pa gsar pa'i zhabs 'degs byed stangs bsdu len dang / zhabs 'degs kyi ltos dpe gsar 'byed dang rgya skyed kyis rang re'i slob grwa'i klog pa por zhabs 'degs bzang bo sgrub pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog hur brtson gyis nye logs kyi slob grwa dang spyi tshogs thog gi bed spyod byed mkhan la yang yig cha'i zhabs 'degs mkho sprod byed dgos/de ltar byas na spyi tshogs thog gi cha 'phrin zhabs zhu'i sde khag so so dang dpe mdzod khang gi las ka'i bar spyi snyoms can gyi 'gran slong gnas bab 'dzugs thub pa dang / dpe mdzod khang rang steng gi rin thang dang 'dren nus je mthor gtong thub pa yin pas/ nga tshos ma 'ongs pa'i 'dzam gling gi 'gran slong nang rkyen khrod rgyal kha thob thub pa'i shes ldan mi sna skyed sring byed par rang nyid kyi nus shugs 'bul thub pa ma zad/ nam yin yang sngon thon thon skyed nus shugs 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i tshab mtshon gyi blangs bya ltar du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun las don mu mthud du mdun skyod yong bar skul 'ded byed thub pa yin/bzhi/‘‘sngon thon rig gnas kyi mdun skyod kha phyogs mtshon par byed pa ’’ni/spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon gom gang mdun spos kyis 'dzugs skrun byed par rag las yod/ de yang mar le ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung dgongs pa/ ting zha'o phin gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs bcas kyi mdzub ston dang tang gi tshogs chen bcu drug pa'i dgongs don yang dag par brten nas/ phugs bsam yod cing kun spyod bzang ba/ rig gnas yon tshad dang khrims brtsi'i 'du shes ldan pa'i spyi dmangs gso skyong gi las don dmigs gzhir bzung ste/ deng rabs can dang 'dzam gling dang 'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs shing dmigs pa'i mi rigs dang tshan rig dang / spyi byings bcas kyi

mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod las don gsar 'byed byed dgos/ 241khyad chos ldan pa'i krung go'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rig gnas dar spel gtong dgos/ las don de'i khrod slob chen dpe mdzod khang gis nges par du hur brtson byas te byed sgo sna tshogs kyi bsam blo'i slob gso'i thad kyi bya 'gul gang mang spel dgos pa ma zad/ gting zab sgos ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs pas bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun gyi gal che'i rang bzhin dang dgos nges rang bzhin tshur 'byin gnang dgos/mi rigs slob chen gyi dpe mdzod khang ni/ mi rigs slob chen dang mi rigs dge 'os slob chen gyi slob sgrub dgos mkho'i srog shing chen mo gsum gyi ya gyal yin/ 'dis slob grwa'i bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi 'dzugs skrun las don la mu mthud du byas rjes 'jog bzhin yod/ slob grwa'i bsam blo'i chab srid las ka'i gzhi rtsa'i 'gan khur gyi dgos mkhor brten nas hur brtson gyis yig cha dang ris mo'i 'grem ston sogs kyi dril sgrog bya 'gul spel dgos pa dang / dpe mdzod ched las thad kyi mkhas dbang gdan drangs te ched gnyer slob khrid spel nas/ slob khang gnyis pa'i nus pa sngar las lhag par 'don spel byed dgos/ da dung rtsa 'dzugs byas te hur brtson gyis klog 'don bgro tshogs dang ched don dpar ris bsham ston sogs ya rabs tshul ldan la do snang gis srol gsar gtod pa'i bya 'gul rab dang rim pa spel dgos/ de ltar byas na slob grwa'i bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun las don la shugs snon par nus pa gal chen 'don thub pa smra ma dgos pa yin/mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’ni nga tsho'i tang gi tang khag 'dzugs pa'i ma rtsa dang / srid 'dzin gyi rmang gzhi/ nus shugs kyi 'byung khungs yin pas/ mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dpe mdzod kyis ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs don gal chen gzhung lugs kyi snying bo dang thabs lam gyi gtso bor bzung nas/ ‘‘klog mkhan rtser 'dzin gyis/ zhabs

242 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyadartsom phyogs bsgrigs/'degs yang rtser sgrub pa'i ’ridamigs yul yid 'jags brtan po byed dgos par ma zad/ dpe klog zhabs zhu'i rnam grangs rgya skyed dang ngo bo gsar 'byed/rnam pa legs sgyur gyi 'gran slong rkang chags par byas te/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi las don hril bor 'brel ba yod pa'i rang rgyal gyi rgya che'i mi shugs thon khungs dang de'i dge mtshan 'don spel byed rgyur nus pa gdon dgos/ de ltar byas na deng skabs kyi gnas tshul dang slob grwa'i dngos don zung 'brel byas te dpe mdzod khang gis deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun las don la mkho ba'i ‘‘khyad chos bzhi 'dzoms ’’kyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong dang skyed sring byed pa la gang mkho'i byas rjes 'bul thub pa ma zad/ tang gi slob gso'i las don mu mthud mdun du skyod par nus pa 'don thub pa yin/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 2003lo'i 〈rtser snyeg 〉deb gnyis pa las bdams/)

243༄ / / mi rigs dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi cha byad nyams stabs tshad ldan du gtong dgos pa'i gnad mdor tsam brjod pa/lhargyal tshe ring /dang po/ dge rgan gyi rmad du byung ba'i cha byad nyams stabs ni slob mar slob gso 'chad khrid mdzad pa la rnam par mkho ba'i thog ma'i cha rkyen yin/dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni mi rigs kyi rig gnas tshan rig shes bya brgyud spel mdzad pa'i rig pa'i dpa' bo dang / rmad du byung ba'i bsam blo'i shes rtogs blo gsal kun la skyed par mdzad pa'i mi rigs kyi rtogs ldan dang /phyi rabs pa rnams la ya rabs bzang spyod kyi bgrod lam legs par ston pa'i rnam dpyod ldan pa'i slob dpon dang / mi'i rigs kyi ches phul du phyin pa'i phun tshogs rig gnas shul bzhag rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel du gtong ba'i mi phyed brtul zhugs can dang / bsdu ba bzhi yi byed thabs kyis gdul bya bye ba skyed bsring mdzad nas 'od zer stong ldan gyi legs lam du dkri bar mdzad pa'i khyad mtshar shes rab kyi bdag nyid do/ / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ni rang nyid kyi shes rig dang lhag bsam la rnam par brten nas/ spyi tshogs ni 'phel rgyas kyi lam la legs par skul ba dang / mi rnams ni rig dar gyi sa la nye bar 'god do/ / ji skad du/ srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru bo che/ /

244 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lam mchog 'khrul bar mi 'gyur ded dpon dngos/ / las nyon me tshogs 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i char/ / ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi zlar mtshungs/ / theg pa shin tu che bas sa gzhi 'dra/ / phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing / / chos kyi mdzod ldan bum pa bzang bo ste/ / kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag / kun la snyoms par byams pas pha ma yin/ / che zhing myur ba'i snying rje chu klung mtshungs/ / 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dga' ba ri dbang 'dra/ / 'khrugs pa med pa'i btang snyoms char sprin bzhin/ / zhes man ngag ston pa'i bla ma'am tshad mar gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshungs med yon tan dang khyad 'phags mdzad 'phrin mngon par bstan pa dang / 'jam dbyangs bla ma blo bzang grags pa mchog gis/de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ / rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ / lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis/ / bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ / mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar/ / bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas/ / rnal 'byor ngas kyang nyams len de ltar byas/ / thar 'dod khyed kyang de bzhin bskyang 'tshal lo/ / zhes dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed kyi 'byung khungs yin par legs par bstan pa bzhin no/ / blo rig bkra zhing lang tsho dar la bab pa'i slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma rnams ni dung zhen che la gzhung rgyud drang ba dang / tshor rtog rno la 'tsho bar zhen pa dang / yag la dga' zhing smon 'dun che ba 'ba' zhig yin phyir/ mdzes snang ldan pa'i bya dngos thams cad kyis ni kho tsho'i mig dbang 'phrog pa dang /yid brtan g.yo bar byed pa dang / sems pa 'brid par bgyid pa dang / kho tsho'i lus ngag yid gsum la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs kyin mchis so/ / de'i phyir/ dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi phyi tshul gyi mdzes pa ni ha cang

slob chen dge rgan gyi cha byad nyams stabs tshad ldan du gtong dgos pa/ 245gal che ba yin no/ / phyi tshul mdzes la lhag bsam dkar ba'i phul byung dge rgan zhig gis ni khong nyid kyi khyad du mtshar ba'i nyams 'gyur dang bla na mtho ba'i mdzad spyod kyis slob ma rnams kyi dran 'dzin gyi ras gzhi'i ngos su nam yang yal ba bral ba'i rmad byung gzugs brnyan zhig rtag brtan du 'jog par byed la/ khong nyid ni slob ma rnams kyis bya ba'i lag len khrod du lad zlos dang mig dper 'dzin pa'i gzhi ma ru 'gyur bar nges so/ /spyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi phyi tshul nyams stabs zhes pa ni gzugs byad kyi mdzes dpyod rig pa'i khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin no/ / mdzes dpyod rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis/ / rkang gnyis mi yi gzugs byad kyi mdzes pa ni ches khyad du 'phags pa dang ches mi sems 'phrog par byed pa'i mdzes tshor ram mdzes snang zhig tu mngon par brjod do/ / mi yi gzugs byad kyi mdzes pa zhes pa de ni/ lus khams kyi mdzes pa dang / rgyan spras kyi mdzes pa dang / nyams stabs kyi mdzes pa bcas gsum gyis rnam par grub pa dang / mdzes pa de dag nam yang sems khams kyi mdzes pa dang gcig tu 'grogs shing dam du 'brel ba zhig yin no/ /lar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi phyi tshul nyams stabs kyi mdzes pa de nyid ches tshad mar 'gyur ba dang ches kun nas 'dzoms pa zhig tu thon pa shin tu dka' na'ang / mdzes dpyod rig pa dang / sems khams rig pa dang /slob gso rig pa'i gzhung lugs gzhir bzung nas tshad gzhi zhig bzhag yod pa ni 'di ltar yin te/gcig yang dag pa'i mdzes dpyod rig pa'i lta ba dang mdzes dpyod 'du shes gzhir 'dzin dgos pa dang /gnyis/ rang rgyal mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang / spyi tshogs kyi sgrig lam/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos bcas dang 'os shing 'tsham dgos pa dang /

246 gtsosayi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum/ dge rgan gyi byed las khyad chos dang / slob gso bya yul te slob ma rnams kyi blo dang 'tsham dgos pa dang /bzhi/ dge rgan rang nyid kyi rang gshis khyad chos dang bsam blo yon tan la 'tsham dgos pa de yin phyir/ nga tshos cis kyang tshad gzhi 'di dag gzhir bzung nas dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan rnams kyi phyi tshul nyams stabs tshad ldan du 'gyur bar brtun pa bskyed dgos snyam/gnyis pa/ dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi gzugs byad la rang bzhin lhun chags sam rang byung bab chags kyi mdzis snang ldan dgos/mtshan nyid rig pa dang spyi tshogs rig pa'i thad nas bltas na/ 'gro ba mi yi yag btsog la zhib rtog mdzad tshe/ mi de nyid kyi phyi lus kyi mdzes pa dang /khyad par du nang sems kyi mdzes pa gal cher 'dzin pa yin/ yin na'ang /zang zing dpal 'byor rnam par dar ba'i deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du/ mi rnams kyis phyi tshul gyi mdzes pa de nyid ngang ngam shugs kyis gal cher 'dzin par byed pa dang / tshong las dang chab srid sogs spyi tshogs 'brel 'dris byed pa'i bya 'gul sna tshogs kyi khrod du'ang / phyi tshul gyi nyams snang dang phyi tshul gyi mdzes snang la nye bar brten nas tshong las mnyam 'brel bgyid pa'am mdza' brtse'i 'brel zam sogs 'dzugs par byed do/ /lus kyi 'jon thang ni dge rgan rnams kyi gzugs byad kyi rang byung lhun grub kyi mdzes pa'i rmang gzhi dang srog shing du nges shing / skyes pa yin na 'dra/bud med yin na'ang 'dra/ lus khams bde thang yin la gzugs byad yid du 'ong ba dang / phung bor 'jon thang ldan la mi grung sha dod pa zhig yin na ni ches mdzes snang ldan pa zhig yin no/ / de'i phyir/ dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i

slob chen dge rgan gyi cha byad nyams stabs tshad ldan du gtong dgos pa/ 247dge rgan zhig la cha mtshon na/ dus rtag tu lus khams gso skyong byas nas lus gzugs kyi mdzes snang la do snang bya rgyu dang / lus phung sbyong brdar byas nas lus gzugs 'jon thang ldan pa zhig yong rgyu ni ha cang gal che ba zhig yin no snyam/ / na gzhon dge rgan la la ni rang nyid kyi phyi yi mdzes sdug la mngon par chags nas ni/ brang gzhi ches 'bur du dod pa dang / sked skabs phra mor btums nas 'chad stegs steng rol sgeg ngom pa dang / yang na mthang sham ches thung ngu gyon nas brla rkang rjen par ston pa dang / ngo gdong yag la dga' drags te skag tshos mthug por bskus nas 'khrab ston gar stegs la zhugs pa ji bzhin 'chad stegs steng 'bud pa dang / yang na gzhon dge rgan la la ni le lo dang sgyid lug gi dbang du gyur te/ tshi len tshi dregs can gyon pa dang / lham la sa rdul chags pa dang / skra lo gzengs shing 'chang ba dang /ske la tshi drigs chags pa dang / sen mo la sen dregs chags pa bcas mthong ba tsam gyis nyams dmas pa dang kho chad pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'chad stegs steng 'bud pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rmad du byung ba'i rang byung lhun chags kyi phyi tshul nyams stabs kun nas smad pa'i gzhi mar gyur pa dang /dge rgan gyi phyi tshul nyams 'gyur gyi cha rkyen ma 'dzoms pa yin phyir/ slob ma rnams la bag chags ngan pa dang tshor snang ngan pa zhig 'jog par nges pa dang / slob ma rnams kyi yid la dad zhen dang mos gus/ brtson sems bcas skyes pa'i gegs su 'gyur bar nges so/ de la 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ nang na yon tan kun ldan yang / / cha lugs ngan na kun gyis brnyas/ / pags bye'u mkhas kyang spu med pas/ / 'dab chags kun gyis spang zhes grags/ / zhes gsungs so/ /

248 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa/ dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi gos rgyan tshul ldan dang tshad ldan yin dgos/gos rgyan zhes pa ni mi rnams kyis lus la mnabs pa'i gos lwa dang gyon gos kyi rnam pa/ dbu skra 'jog tshul dang mi'i lus gzugs la rgyan pa dang spud par byed pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs la zhu ba yin no/ / rang rgyal gyi snyan ngag mkhan ko mo ro mchog gis/ gyon gos ni rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags dang /bsam gzhig gi rnam pa ru nges so zhes gsungs pa dang / u ru su'i rtsom pa po chi khi h+phu'u mtshog gis/ 'gro ba mi yi cha byad dang gyon gos/ sems khams dang bsam blo bcas yod tshad ci nas kyang mdzes sdug ldan la yid gar 'ong ba zhig yin dgos zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin/ mi'i rigs kyi rnam shes rnam par bskrun pa'i bzo bo ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig yin tshe/ slob gling 'chad stegs steng dpe khrid mdzad skabs kyi gos rgyan yang tshul dang mthun zhing tshad dang ldan la yid gar 'ong ba dang / mdzes snang ldan pa zhig yin dgos/ khyad par du dge rgan gyi gos rgyan la thun mong ma yin pa'i rmad byung khyad chos shig ldan dgos te/ dge rgan gyis mnabs pa'i gyon gos dang spras pa'i rgyan cha ni ci nas kyang dge rgan rang nyid kyi yon tan dang thob thang bya bzhag dang na tshod/ gzugs byad dang bzhin mdangs/ ngang gshis dang nyams 'gyur bcas dang 'os shing 'tsham la kun nas ran pa zhig yin dgos/spyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gos rgyan ni cis kyang kun dang mthun la tshul dang ldan pa dang / lus la mdza' ba dang / rmad du byung ba zhig yin dgos/lar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gos rgyan ni rnam pa legs la kha dog mdzes pa zhig yin dgos te/ rags pa spyi yi sgo nas bshad na ni/ gos rgyan gyi kha dog la rnam pa gnyis yod de/ de ni drod snang stsol ba'i kha dog dang /

slob chen dge rgan gyi cha byad nyams stabs tshad ldan du gtong dgos ga 249bsil snang stsol ba'i kha dog gnyis so/ / dmar po ser po li khri gsum ni drod snang stsol ba'i kha dog dang / sngon po ljang khu rgya smug gsum ni bsil snang ster ba'i kha dog go/ dper na/ ljang mdog gis ni/ lang tsho dang / zhi bde/gsar dar mtshon pa dang / sngon po yis ni/ mdzes sdug dang / dwangs gtsang / zhi 'jags mtshon par byed do/ / rgya smug gis ni/ 'byor phyug dang / rmad byung / khyad mtshar mtshon pa dang / dkar bo yis ni/ dri med dang / mchog gyur/ dga' bde mtshon par byed do/ /dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan zhig yin phyin/ bsil snang stsol ba'i kha dog ste sngon po dang / ljang khu dang / rgya smug mdog can gyi gos lwa mnabs na 'os shing 'tsham pa yin te/ zhi ba dang / bab brling / dag gtsang dang tshul mthun gyi rang mdangs dang ngang tshul thon par nges la/ skyes stobs 'bar la re 'dun ldan pa'i nyams 'gyur yang thon par 'gyur ro/ /de yang gcig byas na gos rgyan gyi kha dog dang rang nyid kyi sha mdangs/ gos rgyan gyi rnam pa dang rang nyid kyi rang gshis na tshod dang 'os shing 'tsham dgos pa yin no/ / na gzhon dge rgan zhig yin na gos rgyan gyi kha dog la bkrag mdangs ldan pa dang / gos rgyan gyi rnam pa rmad du byung ba yin na bzang du mngon zhing / lang tsho'i gzi byin mtshon par nus so/ / na tshod rgas pa'i dge rgan zhig yin na/ bab chags shing tshul dang mthun pa'i gos rgyan mnabs tshe bab brling dang yid gzhung ba'i rang gshis mtshon par nus so/ /dge rgan gyi dbu skra'ang dge rgan rang nyid kyi ngo gdong dang cha byad la ran par 'jog dgos te/ bud med dge rgan yin na/ mgo rgyan me tog dang / brang rgyan ske rgyan dang / rna lung rnga ma can sogs ches tshad las 'das pa dang ches rmad du byung ba'i rgyan cha bag med du btags nas 'chad khrid byas na tshul dang mi mthun par 'gyur la/ 'chad khrid kyi bya ba gtso bo ma yin par

250 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'chor sgeg dang 'jo sgeg gtso bor 'dzin pa ltar snang ngo / / lar 'chad khrid mdzad pa'i dge rgan gyi phyi tshul rgyan gos ni tshad dang ldan la tshul dang mthun pa zhig yin dgos par ma zad/ dam pa'i chos la nyan pa'i gdul bya'am dge rgan gyi dpe khrid la nyan pa'i slob ma yin na'ang rin chen rgyan cha spras nas 'phyor sgeg dang ldan par slob khang du zhugs na ni ha cang mi 'os par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab bdun pa bu mo mu tig 'khri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pa las kyang / rgyal rigs su skyes pa shākya ming chen gyi chung ma zla 'od ma shākya'i bu mo'i tshogs dang bcas song ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ljon shing rlung gis skyod pa ltar phyag 'tshal ba na/ de nyid gser 'od rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa mthong nas/kun dga' bos/ ma ma khyod kyi cha lugs 'di dregs pas rgyags shing / rab tu zhi ba dang bral ba yin te/ chos zhu ba ni dka' thub chags bral gyi gnas yin pas 'phyor rgyan 'di mi 'os so/ / zhes smras par/ zla 'od ma skyengs shing rgyan rnams bkrol nas khyim du bskur ro/ / de nas thams cad 'khod pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i chos gsung ba'i tshe/shākya'i bu mo gzhon nu ma zhig lang tsho dar cing / gzugs dang skal ba bzang ba'i bsam pas khengs dregs skyes nas/ rang gi mgul la mu tig gi phreng ba nu ma'i thad du 'phyang ba la blta zhing chos mi nyan par 'dug go/ tshul de zla 'od mas mthong nas/ chos gsung ba la mi nyan par rmongs pas dngos po do shal 'di la blta ba/ nga'i do shal bstan na mo'i 'di bas brgya 'gyur gyis lhag pas/ mthong ba tsam gyis mo'i khengs dregs zhi bar 'gro'i snyam nas/rang gi g.yog mo ro hi ta la/ song la/ khyim nas nga'i do shal mgyogs par longs shig byas te ched du mngags pa'i lo rgyus brjod de/ chos 'chad mkhan ma zad chos la nyan mkhan rnams yin yang / cis kyang zhi ba dang chags bral

slob chen dge rgan gyi cha byad nyams stabs tshad ldan du gtong dgos pa/ 251gyi sgo nas don du gnyer dgos pa legs par bstan pa lta bu yin no/ / gcig byas na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gos rgyan ni mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar dbu mar gnas pa zhig yin dgos te/ cis kyang do snang byed dgos pa zhig ni/ dge rgan rnams kyis 'chad khrid mdzad skabs/ rgyan gos khyad du mtshar ba mig la 'dzer ba mi bklubs la/ gyon gos nyams dmas pa hral hrul du gyur pa'ang mi gsol bar/ cis kyang bab chags tshul mthun te bar ram 'bring tsam mnabs rgyu de yin no/ /dge rgan la las gos rgyan ya mtshar ba blo la mi shong ba gyon pas na/slob ma rnams kyi rgyud la mos gus dang dang ba mi skyes par 'gyur la/ dge rgan la las skra mi shad par kun nas gzengs pa dang / sma ra mi bzhar bar rgya rag tu gyur pa dang / tshi len mi 'khrud par tshi rag chags pa dang / thog lwa dang rkang snam la gnyer ma babs pa/ sgrog gu kha mi tshang ba/ zhwa mo zur gyis gyon pa/ lham mi phyi bar 'bag btsog tu gyur pa bcas kyi sgo nas 'chad stegs steng bud nas slob khrid bgyis na ni/ dge dpe gzhan ston gyi nus pa zhan par 'gyur la/ slob ma rnams kyi rig gnas sbyong 'dod kyi 'dun pa nyams par byed do snyam/ u ru su'i slob gso ba mar kha len khi lags kyis/'chad khrid stegs bu'i steng du bud de/ glo khug nang nas kun nas gnyer zhing 'bag btsog tu gyur pa'i lag phyis nyid phyir phyung ste kha sna 'phyid pa'i dge rgan de nyid ni/ tshad dang ldan pa'i dge rgan zhig tu mi 'dod do zhes gsungs pa'ang dge rgan gyi phyi tshul nyams stabs gal che bar dmigs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa/ dge rgan la rmad du byung ba'i phyi tshul nyams stabs shig ldan dgose/spyir nyams stabs zhes pa ni mi yi kun spyod dang / shes rig dang / cha

252 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byad dang / zhal mdangs sogs kyi nyams snang spyi tshogs 'brel 'dris sam bya 'gul khrod du tshur snang byung ba'i thun min gyi grung spyod la zhu ba yin/ de la'ang rigs mang ste/ la la zhi zhing dul ba dang / la la mkhas mdzangs blo gros ldan pa dang / la la brtan zhing brnying la brjid chags pa dang / la la rang dbang thob cing 'jigs pa med pa dang / la la skyo ba spangs shing blo khog yangs pa dang / la la mchog tu gyur cing shes rig ldan pa dang / la la blo khog zab cing nus mthu ldan pa dang / la la blo spobs che la dpa' gdeng ldan pa yin no/ / rmad du byung la thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams stabs de dag ni mi de rnams kyi sems pa dang / rang gshis dang / shes rig dang / nyams 'gyur dang / cha byad bcas gcig tu 'dus pa las byung ba'i mngon tshul lam mtshon pa yin/dge rgan gyi nyams stabs ni dge rgan gyi ches gal che ba'i rang steng gi cha rkyen zhig yin phyir/ dge rgan gyi rmad byung nyams stabs kyis ni skal ldan slob ma rnams kyi sems khams su bsub kyang bsub tu med pa'i gzi brjid ldan la yid gar 'ong ba'i snang brnyan zhig rtag brtan du 'jog par nus so/ /mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig dang khyad par du mi rigs dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan zhig la cis kyang rnam par 'dzoms dgos pa ni rang steng gi mdzes pa yin no/ / de yang dge rgan rang steng gi mdzes pa ni phyi tshul nyams 'gyur gyi mdzes pa dang / sems khams yid byed kyi mdzes pa gnyis kyis rnam par grub cing / sems khams yid byed kyi mdzes pa de ha cang gal che na'ang / phyi tshul nyams 'gyur gyi mdzes pa'ang snang med du 'jog mi nyan par gtsigs su 'dzin dgos/sems khams yid byed kyi mdzes pa ni mi yi cha byad dang / smra brjod/ stangs ka bcas brgyud nas phyi ru mngon pa yin no/ / rtsom pa po hra hri pis yā mchog

slogechenadage rgan gyi chakhyad nyamagastabasatshad ldan du gtong dgosapa/ 253gis/ spyod lam phal bar snang ba'i mi de nyid kyi phyi tshul gyi mdzes pa de ni/ se gol gtogs pa'i yun la 'jig par 'gyur ro/ / gal srid gzugs gzhi rnam par mdzes pa'i khong la bsam pa yag po zhig zhugs na ni/ khyod kyi phyi tshul nyams 'gyur gyi mdzes pa'ang mi 'jig rtag tu brtan par nges so zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/cis kyang phyi tshul gyi mdzes pa gtsigs su 'dzin dgos par ma zad/ sems khams kyi mdzes pa'ang gal cher 'dzin dgos pa dang / mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i phyi tshul nyams 'gyur dang / rmad du byung ba'i byams sems brtse zhen mchis na ni/ blo gsal slob ma bye ba'i dad gus kyi me tog 'thor bar 'gyur la/ shes brtson gyi chu rgyun ring du 'bab par nges pa dang / 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul sa skya paṇa chen mchog gis/ yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ / ma bsdus par yang rang nyid 'du/ / dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nyid nam yang brtson ldan slob ma stong gis bskor zhing bsten par 'gyur ro/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 2005lo'i 〈zla zer 〉deb gsum pa las bdams/)

254 ༄ / / skad gnyis slob khrid kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/dge 'dun/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs tshun/ las rigs khag nyams pa sor chud kyis 'phel rgyas byung ba brgyud/ bod kyi slob gso'ang yar rgyas gong 'phel byung dang 'byung mus lags/'byung 'gyur bskal brgya'i 'char 'god la/ slob gso spel ba rmang gzhi'o/ / zhes rgyal khab cig dang / sa gnas shig dang / mi rigs shig la mtshon na/ yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bar rgyu rkyen mang yang gtso che ba slob gso yin te/ blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis/ tshan rtsal ni thon skyed nus shugs gtso bo yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing / tshan rtsal de slob gso la rag las pas/ slob gso ni rmang gzhi'i rmang gzhi yin pa ha cang gsal/deng dus slob gso dam 'dzin byed dgos la/ ma 'ongs par ni de bas kyang de ltar ro/ / des na rjes su lus pa'i bod mi rigs kyis slob gso de yun ring du gtsigs su bzung na ma gtogs/ sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud thabs med/de yang slob gso las slob grwa'i slob gso ni gtso bo dang / de las kyang slob khrid ni lte ba ste/ de ni dge slob zung gi thun mong bya 'gul zhig yin la/

skad gnyiyoslob khrid kyi skor lacung zad dpyad pa/ 255de skad dang yi ger brten nas spel dgos/ 'o na bya 'gul de spel byed du skad yig gang sbyad na 'bras bu bzang po thob pa bya rgyu ni/ nges par du dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs te/ legs par brtags shing lag len la mi rmongs pa bya dgos pa ni gnad kyi dam pa yin no/ /rang rgyal ni mi rigs mang zhing skad dang yig rigs kyang du ma yod pa'i rgyal khab chen po zhig yin pas/ rgyal yongs mi grangs kyi brgya cha dgu bcu lhag zin pa'i rgya'i skad dang yi ge ni/ rgyal yongs mi rigs so so'i dbar phan tshun brda sprod byed kyi thun mong yo byad lta bur gyur yod/ lhag don rgyal nang gi tshan rtsal rig pa dang 'phrin brda gsar pa ci yod rgya yig las sbyong dgos par brten rgya'i skad yig slob sbyong bya rgyu ni dus rabs kyi blang bya lta bur gyur pa smos ci/ 'on kyang 'dir do snang bya dgos pa'i gnad cig yod pa ni mi rigs nang khul du da dung rang rigs kyi skad kyis brda sprod byed pa dper na/ rang cag bod la cha mtshon na brgya cha dgu bcu lhag gi rong 'brog sa khul kun tu da dung rang skad ma gtogs spyod shes kyi med pa 'di ni da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul zhig red/dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i smad nas lo rabs bdun cu pa'i smad cha'i bar du g.yon thal gyi bsam blo'i khrid ston la brten/ 'bras bu'i legs nyes la ma bltos par/ slob grwa'i khrid tshan tshang ma rgya yig 'ba' zhig gis khrid de/ mi rigs grangs nyung gi skad yig la do snang de tsam ma byas pa ma zad/ zhwa dpe lham 'gebs kyis rgyal nang du ci byed na bod du'ang de ltar bya dgos pa'i lung 'dzin ring lugs kyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen gyi rkyen pas mi rigs sa khul gyi phyi yul dngos don gzhir bzung mi rigs kyi slob gso 'phel rgyas ga tong mi thub pa'i skyon cha lhags yod/ lo rabs bdun cu pa'i smad cha nas bzung tang dang rgyal khab kyis lo rgyus kyi bslab byar phyogs sdom

256 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnang ste/ rnyog zing drang bcos kyis mi rigs rang gi skad yig de slob grwa dang spyi tshogs su spyod par mthong chen gnang dang gnang mus red/ 'on kyang bod la mtshon na rong 'brog sa khul du btsugs pa'i slob grwa 'ga' zhig la da dung rgya'i skad yig rkyang pas dpe khrid byed pa da nga/ yang na rgya yig gtso bor byas nas bod yig nyung tsam las mi khrid pa/ de bzhin khrid tshan 'ga' re rgya'i skad yig gis khrid pa dang 'ga' re bod yig gis khrid pa sogs snang tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung bas/ da gzod skad gnyis slob khrid ces pa'i tha snyad gsar pa de byung ba red/spyir skad gnyis slob khrid ni srid zus kyi rang bzhin dang / mi rigs kyi rang bzhin/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin bcas shugs che ba'i gnad cig yin pas/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mi nyung ba zhig sgas zhib dpyod gnang dang gnang bzhin pa'i sgang ste/ gzhung lugs dang lag len zung du grub 'bras dga' 'os pa thob par grags/thos rgya dang mthong rgya rgya khab kyi bu ga las dog pa'i dman pa bdag 'dra la skad gnyis slob khrid skor gleng ba skabs su ma bab mod/ 'on kyang tang gi slobagaso'i bya gzhag dang mi rigs kyi las don la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i kun slong gis bslangs te/ skad gnyis slob khrid thad rang gi bsam 'char 'ga' zhu ba la/ nongs 'gal gyi cha mchis na dpyod ldan rnams la bzod gsol zhu/de yang thog mar ci zhig la skad gnyis slob khrid ce na/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis bkram pa'i (1991)lo'i yig ang 22pa las/ mi rigs grangs nyung gi slob ma gtso bor bsdu ba'i slob grwar/ cha rkyen 'dzoms tshe mi rigs skad yig gi slob deb spyod dgos pa ma zad/ mi rigs skad yig gis khrid pa dang / lo rim 'os 'tshams shig tu rgya'i skad yig gi khrid tshan bsnan

skad gnyis slob khrid kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 257te/ skad gnyis slob khrid lag len du bstar nas/ rgyal yongs su spyod pa'i thun mong gi skad khyab gdal du spel dgos/ zhes 'khod pa ltar/ bod la mtshon na/ rgya yig gcig pu de rgya skad kyis khrid pa las/ khrid tshan gzhan tshang ma bod skad yig gis khrid pa'i skad gnyis spyad pa'i slob khrid cig la go dgos pa min nam snyam/tang dang rgyal khab kyi yig cha rab dang rim par mi rigs skad yig gi go gnas dang nus pa/ slob sbyong dang bkol spyod byed pa'i byed phyogs dang /srid jus/ byed thabs bcas gsal por bstan yod mod/ spyi tshogs steng skad gnyis slob khrid thad da dung 'dod tshul mang la gtso bo ni gsum ste/'ga' res rgya rigs sngon thon yin pas de'i skad yig spyod rgya che/ mi rigs grangs nyung gi skad yig spyod rgya dog la rjes lus yin pas/ mi rigs grangs nyung bas thad kar rgya'i skad yig gis khrid tshan so so khrid na/ lam kyog tu 'gro mi dgos par sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud sla bar 'dod pa dang /'ga' res rang rigs mi nyams gong du spel ba la/ rang gi skad yig 'ba' zhig las gzhan gang gis kyang tshab byed mi nus te/ bod la mtshon na/ sngar gyi rig gnas tshang ma bod skad yig gis brtsams yod pa dang / rang rigs gnas pa'i sar nang phan tshun bod skad kho na smra ba dang / bcings 'grol thob tshun yang spyi tshogs su nus pa khyad par can thon dang 'don bzhin par 'dod pa/ 'ga' res rang rigs kyi skad yig gis rmang byas/ rgya'i skad yig gis zur brgyan/ skad yig gzhan dag kha skong gi tshul du bzung na/ da gzod rang rigs kyi srid 'byor rig gsum 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis dus yun thung ngur sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud thub la/ bskal ba ji srid du mi nyams par gnas kyang thub par 'dod pa dang bcas gsum mo/de yang 'dod tshul dang po de 'thad par mi mthong ste/ khyed ltar na/

258 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rjes lus pa dag gis rang la byang cha yod pa'i rang rigs kyi skad yig dor zhing / slob grwa'i khrid tshan dag sngon thon mi rigs kyi skad yig gis khrid na/sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud sla zer na/ rgyal nang du khra'o zhan rigs ches sngon thon yin pas/ rgyal yongs kyi slob grwa kun tu khrid tshan thams cad de'i skad yig gis khrid na de bas sngon thon ma yin nam/ de mi rigs grangs nyung lta zhog sngon thon mi rigs kyis kyang khas gtan nas len mi srid/ yang rgyal nang du sngon thon gyi tshan rtsal yod tshad rgya yig gis brtsams yod pas yin zer na/ deng dus 'dzam gling gi sngon thon tshan rtsal phal che ba dbyin ci sogs rgyal khab kyi yi ger bkod yod pas/ 'dzam gling gi mi rigs kun gyis thad kar de dag gi skad yig bslabs na de bas sngon thon ma yin nam/ yang spyi tshogs 'phel rim ste mi rigs mnyam 'dres kyi chos nyid dang bstun pa yin zer na/ thog mar gral rim nub pa dang / de nas rgyal khab nub pa dang /mthar mi rigs nub pa ste/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rim ni de ltar yin/ zhes 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i gtso 'dzin pa rnams kyis gsungs par ma zad/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dus rabs ni mi rigs so so 'dra mnyam dang / mthun sgril/ yar thon/ phan tshun slob sbyong bcas kyis thun mong phyug por gyur cing / thun mong yar rgyas gtong ba'i dus yin/zhes tang dang rgyal khab kyi yig cha rab dang rim pa las yang dang yang du bstan pa ma yin nam/ ma 'ongs par mi rigs mnyam 'dres su gyur pa'i dus yong srid kyang / mi rigs ga ge mo zhig tu 'gyur ba'i nges pa med par snyam/des ma tshad mi rigs grangs nyung la mtshon na/ rgya yig gi sgra nges dka' ba dang / pir ris rnyog dra che bas 'bri dka' ba/ yi ge'i grangs mang bas blo la nges dka' ba sogs dka' ba du ma yod pas/ skad dang yi ge bye brag pa yod pa'i mi rigs grangs nyung dag gis rang la byang cha yod pa'i rang gi skad yig

skad gnyis slob khrid kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 259bzhag ste/ rgya'i skad yig kho nas slob grwa'i khrid tshan dag khrid na/ sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud par ci la nges te/ dper na rgya'i skad yig ma gtogs rang rkya 'pher ba'i skad yig med pa'i hu'e rigs sogs mi rigs grangs nyung du ma da dung rjes lus pa'i gral du lus 'dug pa ma yin nam/der ma zad mi rigs so sor rang gi yi ge spyod rgyu dang gong du spel ba'i rang dbang yod ces pa'ang stong gtam tsam du gyur pa ma yin nam/gong gi 'dod tshul 'dis lo rgyus dang da yod kyi gnas tshul/ slob gso'i nang khul gyi chos nyid/ mi rigs slob gso'i khyad chos/ mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang skad yig gi srid jus bcas la do snang ma byas pa ste/ brgya kha gcig gcod dang phyogs re ba'i sgo nas rgya'i skad yigagacig pus khrid tshan dag khrid pa gtsigs su bzung ba des mi rigs kyi slob gsor mi 'os pa'i gyong gun phog pa 'das zin pa'i lag len gyi thog nas nyams myong byung yod/ 'dod tshul gnyis pa'ang 'thad par ma mthong ste/ khyed ltar na/ rang gi skad yig gcig pus ma gtogs mi rigs kyi srid 'byor rig gsum 'dzin skyong spel gsum bya mi nus zer na/ phyogs gcig bden yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas de lta min te/ gang yin zhe na/ mi rigs shig gi dar gud de skad yig tsam ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed dang de min phyi nang gi 'brel ba'i 'phel tshad la'ang rag las pa yin zhing / rig gnas te skad yig gcig pu la bshad na'ang rang skad gcig pus ga la chog ste/ deng dus 'dzam gling du grags pa rgyas pa'i bod kyi rigs gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu 'di yang / sngon byon lo paṇa sa chen po'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa dag gis gsar btod kyi snying stobs chen pos dka' ba dang du blangs nas/ rgya dkar nag sogs phyogs kyi mi rigs dag gi rig gnas kyi nying khu bsdus te rang rigs kyi thun mong ma

260 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mthoram̐m slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas zab yangs chu gter lta bu bskrun yod/ de yang yin te/ sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis thog mar rang gi skad yig la sbyang pa dpyis phyin par gnang ba'i rmang gzhi'i steng / rgya dkar nag sogs kyi skad yig la dka' ba khyad bsad kyis sbyangs shing / de dag gi rig ba'i gzhung lugs kyi legs cha rnams bsdus te/ rang rigs kyi rig gzhung phun sum je tshogs su btang ba de bka' bstan sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung las gsal ba ma yin nam/ slob dpon thon mis bod yig gsar btod gnang ba'i brgyud rim la bsam na de bas gsal po yin/ mi rigs shig gam rgyal khab cig la mtshon na rtag tu rang mthong cher rlom gyis sngar srol sor gnas las/ gzhan gyi legs char slob sbyong byed mi 'dod pa ma zad/ rnying pa thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ / gsar pa thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems/ / zhes pa ltar/ rang gi dang rnying pa thams cad mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / gzhan gyi dang gsar pa yod tshad than ltas su 'dod pa zhig yin phyin/ de nyams shing nub par 'gyur pa las/ gzhan 'gro lam gang yang med pa gna' deng phyi nang gi nyams myong las mngon par rtogs thub/ de bod rang la mtshon na/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis/ mi lo brgyad brgya'i yun la rgya gar du/ / ma slebs phyi dal can gyi lo tsā ba/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste/ de snga mi rigs gzhan dag dang 'brel ba med pa lta bu'i gnas su gyar ba'i dbang gis da lta'ang rjes lus pa'i gras su lus 'dug pa ma yin nam/ yang 'ga' res mi rigs gzhan dag gi skad yig khrid na rang gi rig gzhung nyams par dogs pa 'di ni dgos med de/ dper na/ rang gi lus zung rgyas par zas rigs sna tshogs bsten pa lta bu/ rang gi skad yig mkhas par bslabs pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng mi rigs ji tsam gyi skad yig shes na de tsam gyis rig pa 'phel ba rje tsong kha pa chen pos kyang / tha dad 'gro ba'i skad la thogs med pa'i/ /

skad gnyis slob khrid kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 261nges tshig so sor yang dag rigs pa sogs/ / bde blag thob nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ / the tshom gcod pa'i mchog tu bdog gyur cig / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / der brten/ mi rigs gang zhig gis bcos sgyur dang sgo 'byed mi bya zhing / rgya sgo gtan nas sngar goms sor gnas byed pa de ni rang nyid rang gis lcebs pa dang gnyis su med/'o na gang ltar 'grig ce na/ 'dod tshul gsum pa de shin tu 'thad par sems te/ de yang mi rigs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos las skad dang yi ge ni gtso bo yin pas/ yul srol goms gshis dang mi 'dra ste/ de spyi tshogs thon skyed nus shugs kyi 'phel rgyas dang phan tshun tshod 'dzin cing skul ma thebs la mi rigs kyi sems khams thun mong ba'i rgyu dang 'brel 'dris dam po yod/ de ni mi rigs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos las cung rtag pa zhig yin pas/ mi rigs yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba dang sha khrag lta bu'i 'brel ba yod pa lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo las ha cang gsal/ des na skad dang yi ge de mi rigs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos shig yin par ma zad/ rig gnas tshan rtsal tho ru 'god byed dang /'grem spel/ brje res kyi yo byad nyag gcig yin pas/ skad yig la lo rgyus kyi chos nyid dang mthun zhing / phyogs yongs dang / gong du spel ba bcas kyi 'dzin stangs yod dgos pa ha cang gal che/a ma'i nu zho nyid phru gu skyong byed kyi bcud mchog ste/ skad dang yi ge bye brag pa zhig yod pa'i mi rigs shig la cha mtshon na/ skad yig ni rang nyid mi nyams yun gnas yong ba'i rgyu nyag gcig yin/ de yang bod la mtshon na/stod gangs ri man chod nas smad shing sgo yan chod kyi skye bo kun gyis rang nyid bod rigs su rlom pa de yang skad yig gi nus pa las 'os med/ des na rang la 'dris cha che pa'i gdangs dang mthun pa'i bod yig de khrid sla ba mngon sum tshad mas grub yod/ 'jig rten rgan po'i gtam dpe la/ 'phur sa a sngon

262 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbyings yin yang / / 'bab sa dog mo'i sa yin/ / zhes pa'i dpe ltar/rgyal khab gang dang mi rigs gang gise 'dzam gling gi sngon thon tshan rtsal dang rig pa'i longs spyod slob pa'i tshe/ bslab yul de dang de'i skad yig shes dgos pa bden mod/ gzhi 'dzin sa'am slob byed kyi yo byad gtso bo ni rang gi skad las gzhan gang gis kyang dod mi 'ong ba smra ci dgos/ 'on kyang 'ga' res bod skad smra mi shes pa'i bod mi 'ga' la kha g.yar nas/ bod skad yig gis slob khrid byas na mang tshogs kyis mi go zhes dgag kyang / bod spyi la mtshon na/ mi grangag kyi brgya cha dgu bcu yan chod kyis bod skad shod pa de tshos ma mkhyen nam/ 'ga' res bod yig gis deng dus kyi tshan rtsal gyi don ji bzhin mtshon mi nus zhes gsungs na/ bod yig gsar du mdzad ma thag nas bzung bka' bstan sogs mi rigs gzhan pa'i rig gnas rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i don rnams bod yig tu ji bzhin mtshon nus pa ma yin nam/ der ma zad bod yig la rtsa ba'i nga ro nyung zhing klog bde ba/ 'bri sla ba/tshig nyams phun sum tshogs pa/ rang skad dang mthun pa'i brda sprod rig pa'i ma lag cha tshang la tshags dam pa sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pas/ rang rigs ma zad/ blo gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas dbang dag gis rjes su yi rang dang bsngags pa'i me tog thor dang 'thor bzhin pa de tshos ma gzigs sam/ mdor na khrid tshan so so bod yig gis khrid mi thub ces dang / bod yig gis khrid na slob deb dang dge rgan gyi cha rkyen da dung 'dzoms med ces dang / slob grwa chung 'bring du bod yig gis khrid na mtho rim slob grwar spor mi thub pa'am spar sa med ces pa la sogs pa'i gtam sna tshogs smra ba ni/ mi rigs kyi slob gso gnyer ba'i chos nyid khong du ma chud cing / mthar bod kyi skad dang yi ge nyams par byed pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu sems la/ de mi rigs kyi brtse dung la gnod pa dang / mthun

skad gnyis slob khrid kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ 263sgril la mi phan pa/ srid jus dang mi 'tshams pa/ rtsa khrims la snang 'jog mi byed pa bcas kyi skyon du mthong bas nges par spong bar rigs so/ /'o na rang gi skad yig gcig pus chog gam zhe na mi chog ste/ lhag bsam rnam dag gis rang nyid mi nyams gong du spel bar 'dod na/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs gang zhig sngon thon nam gang gi rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa yin na/ de dang der slob dgos te/ de yang de dang de'i skad yig la brten pa las thabs gzhan med/ nged cag la mtshon na rgya'i skad yig la legs par slob dgos te/ gcig tu na rgyal nang du mi rigs so sos phan tshun bar brda sprod byed kyi thun mong gi skad yig yin/ gnyis su na rgya'i skad yig la lo rgyus ring zhing nang don phun sum tshogs pas nga tshos dper 'dzin 'os/ gsum du na rgyal nang du deng rabs kyi sngon thon tshan rtsal tshang ma rgya yig gis brtsams yod/ bzhi ru na 'dzam gling du'ang rgya'i skad yig spyod pa'i mi grangs ches mang la don nyams mtshon pa'i nus pa che bas/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyi rgyun spyod skad yig lnga'i ya gyal zhig yin pa bcas kyis so/ /'bras ldan shing gnyis sbyar ba las/ / 'bras bu phung gsum 'byung ba ltar/ / zhes pa bzhin/ skad gnyis kyis slob khrid byed pa la dge mtshan che ste/dang po/ rang rigs skad yig legs par khrid na/ lo rgyus ring zhing nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i rang gi rig gnas de 'dzin skyong spel gsum bya thub ste/ de la brten nas mi rigs kyi blo stobs dang / spobs pa/ rang brtsi rang bkur/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'od stong ldan pa'i mdun lam la yid ches bcas bskyed par ma zad/ khrid tshan so so bod skad yig gis khrid na/ bod skad smra ba po dag gi khams dang mthun te/ nyan spro la go sla bas rgya che'i rong 'brog pa yongs kyi yon tshad mtho ru 'degs par shin tu nas sman/ gnyis pa/bod skad yig legs par khrid pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgya'i skad yig kyang legs

264 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par khrid na/ lo stong phrag du ma'i ring la byon pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyi blo'i nying bcud nyams su myong thub la/ gna' deng gi ches sngon thon dang ches gsar pa'i tshan rtsal dag la blo thad kar zhugs nas/ mthong thos kyi rgya bskyed de mdun skyod kyi gom 'gros je mgyogs su btang zhing / sngon thon mi rigs kyi rjes zin pa'am gral du tshud thub pa/ gsum pa/ skad gnyis kyis slob khrid byas na/ gang la gang 'phrod dang phan tshun kha skong gi tshul gyis rang rig kyi srol rgyun rig gnas de mi nyams rgyun sring byed thub par ma zad/ rgya rigs kyi sngon thon rig gnas dang lag rtsal bslabs nas/ rang rigs gang mgyogs 'phel rgyas su gtong thub/ bzhi pa/ rgyal khab kyi gcig gyur dang /mi rigs kyi mthun sgril/ mi rigs sa khul gyi srid 'byor rig gsum yar rgyas yong ba bcas la phan par nges so/ /de ltar skad gnyis slob khrid dam 'dzin gyis lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi 'gros dang bstun nas/ rang gi rig gnas kyis rmang byas/ rgya rigs gtsos mi rigs so so'i rig pa'i nying bcud bsdus/ rim pa gcig las gcig lhag pa'i gsar gtod dang / de dag gong du ches cher spel bar blo stobs dang brtson pa ma nyams na/ rtag gus brtson pa ma btang na/ mi 'grub bya ba gang yang med/ / ces pa ltar/ sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud cing / yab mes gong ma rnams la ngo gnong mi dgos pa zhig 'byung nges par gdon mi za'o/ /(dpyad rtsom 'di 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉las bdams/)

265༄༅ / / nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/kun bzang rgyal/dang po/ a ri'i kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur byung chul/ches snga mor a ris mi chos kun spyod dang gshis rgyud bzang po zhig skyed sring byed par chos lugs slob gsor brten pa dang / chos lugs slob gso gtsigs cher bzung ste mi gshis 'dul skyong byed pa 'di a ri rgyal khongs kyi kunaspyod slob gso'i rtsa don dang rmang gzhi yin/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug tu/ grub mtha' khag gi nang 'gal dang rtsod gleng byung bar brten chos lugs rmang gzhir gyur pa'i kun spyod slob gso rim bzhin nyams dmas su gyur 'go tshugs/ lo rabs drug cu pa'i rjes nas a ri'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas byung ba dang chabs cig spyi tshogs 'tsho ba la 'gyur ldog chen po byung /yin na'ang kun spyod bya gzhag nyams rgud du 'gro ba'i snang tshul nyin re nas nyin rer shugs drag pa dang / spyi tshogs kun spyod kyi gnas tshul je ngan je sdug tu 'gro ba 'di la/ spyi tshogs kyi mi sna dang slob gso'i las 'dzin pa mang pos dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang kun spyod dngos gzhi gnyis mthun sbyor min pa'i snang tshul 'dir dpyad brjod byed bzhin yod/ gnas tshul 'di dmigs su bzung nas/ kun spyod slob gso'i bya gzhag yang bskyar a ri'i spyi dmangs dang srid gzhung gis do khur chen po byas te rim pa dang rigs mi 'dra

266 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i slob grwa mtha' dag gis kun spyod la bsam gzhigs dang blo sbyong yang dag bya dgos pa'i skul brda btang / sngon gyi lis ken tsung thung gis ‘‘a ri'i slob gso la gnas pa'i gnad don ni kun spyod slob gso'i steng mi shugs dang rgyu shugs bkol ba ma 'dang ba red ’’ces dang / 1990lo'i zla 2par/ tsung thung pu'u hri rgan pas ming rtags bkod pa'i a ri rgyal yongs kyi slob gso'i dmigs yul skor gyi snyan zhu'i nang ‘‘a ri rgyal yongs kyi slob gso mtha' dag spyi dmangs kyi 'du shes bzang po zhig dang spyi tshogs zhabs 'degs kyi bya 'gul nang dngos su zhugs dgos ’’zhes gsal por bstan/ cho kri pu'u hri nyid kyis kun spyod slob gso gtsig cher 'dzin pa zhes pa'i gsung deb nang slob grwa khag gi rim pa ltar slob ma'i rig stobs 'phel rgyas gtong dgos pa ma zad/ rig stobs dang kun spyod gshis rgyud zung 'brel dam zab byed pa 'di slob gso'i dmigs bya yin par gsungs shing / khong gis da dung nan gyis ‘‘nges par du kun spyod kyi rin thang lta tshul gso skyong dang khyim tshang gi slob gso dam 'dzin gyis 'char 'god byed par do snang bya dgos ’rizhes bstan/ nye char 'dzam gling slob chen yongs kyi gtsug rgyan tu mthong ba'i hwa h+pho slob chen sogs slob grwa che 'bring khag tu kun spyod slob gso'i brgyud rim cung 'thus sgo tshang ba zhig gi sgrig gzhi yod pa/ a ri'i ca kra'u gros tshogs kyis ru'u lugs pa'i grub mtha'i srol 'byed mkhan bsam blo ba dang slob gso ba chen po kong tse (spyi lo sngon gyi 551da 47khabar ) nyid kyi 'khrungs skar zla khapa'i tshes 2ṭ+wāṃnyin ca kra'u yi dge rgan dus chen du gtan 'khel byas/ ru'u lugs pa'i gzhung gi ‘‘byams pa/ drang bden/ gus lugs/ shes rig yid rton/spyod bzang ’’bcas mi gshis rnal ma zhig gi dpe tshad 'dir a ri'i kun spyod slob gso byed pa'i thabs mchog nus ldan zhig tu brtsi ba red/ rang rgyal gna' rabs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i brjod don gtso bo ‘‘spyod lam ’’yin pa'i

nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ 267rkyen gyis krung go'i srol rgyun rig gnas dang gna' bo'i zhi la'i rig gnas/dbus shar gyi rig gnas gsum mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yang / gna' bo'i zhi la'i rig gnas kyis mi dang rang byung gi 'brel ba (gna' bo'i zhi la'i mtshan nyid rig pa skor zhig la rang byung mtshan nyid rig pa ba zer/ rgyu mtshan gang gis she na/ rang byung khams kyi dngos po'i gnas tshod dang 'gyur ba ste/dper na/ sprin lding ba dang / glog 'khyug pa/ 'brug sgra ldir ba/ thog 'phen pa/ rlung g.yugs pa/ char pa 'bab pa sogs 'byung ba'i snang tshul 'di rigs la rig stobs kyis dpyad pa gtong ba yin )gtso bor ston pa dang /dbus shar rig gnas kyis mi dang lha'i 'brel ba (phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can mtha' dag lha'i dbang pos blo sngon du btang ba la brten nas bskrun par 'dod de/ lha dbang gcig ma gtogs med pas der gsol ba dang mchod sbyin rgya cher byas na de'i khor tu skye bar 'dod )gtso bor ston pa/ krung go'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyis mi dang mi'i 'brel ba (ru'u lugs pa'i gzhung las mi'i 'brel ba sna tshogs mthun sbyor byed ched/ spyi tshogs kyi mi chos rig pa dang khyim tshang gi mi chos rig pa cha tshang ba zhig gsar 'dzugs byas yod pa dpe tsam drangs na/ rgyal blon bar la/ blon po rgyal po la blo dkar ba/ rgyal pos blon por thugs brtse ba/ pha bu bar la/ pha la gus zhabs dang bu la byams brtse/ gcen gcung bar la/ phu bos nu bor gces skyong dang nu bos phu bor brtsi 'jog byed pa/ bza' zla'i bar la/ phan tshun 'grig mthun byed pa nya mo chu la gnas pa lta bu'i brtse ba ldan pa/ grogs po'i bar la/ phan tshun yid ches byed pa las bslu brid bya mi rung ba/ mi chos kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi 'di la mi rnams kyis brtsi mthong byas te krung hwa mi rigs kyi srol rgyun kun spyod zhig tu gyur ba red/ mi rnams kyis shes gsal ltar/dus rabs gang 'dra zhig yin rung / pha ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang /

268 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gcen gcung bar la brtse ba ldan pa/ bza' zla 'cham mthun du gnas pa/grogs po bar la yid ches byed pa bcas gal che ba yin lugs )gtso bor ston pas mi'i spyod lam tshad gzhi sogs mi chos skor gyi shes bya phun sum tshogs po yod/ de'i phyir/ a ri dpe skrun khang gis mi sna grags can gyi lo rim me long lag deb nang 'dzam gling gi bsam blo ba chen po bcu'i thog ma kong tse dam pa'i mtshan 'di bkod nas gdeng 'jog chen po byas yod/gnyis pa/ yo rob pa'i kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur byung tshul/yo rob ni nub phyogs rig gnas kyi 'byung gzhi gtso bo yin pas khyim mtshes rgyal khab gzhan gyi kun spyod 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen dang skul spel gyi nus pa chen po thon yod/ gna' bo'i zhi la'i su'u kun la tis slob gso'i dmigs bya ni/ mi ji 'dra zhig byed pa slob mkhas par bya rgyu de red ces dang /pyo la thu yis ‘‘gal te mi zhig gis slob gso'i dgos mkho ci yin zhe na/ mi bzang po zhig byed rgyu de yin/ mi bzang po zhes pa ni mchog gyur gyi spyod lam ldan pa'i mi la bya zhes dris lan gsal bor btab chog ’’ ces gsungs/gna' bo'i zhi la'i bsam blo kun spyod slob gso gtsigs su 'dzin pa'i srol rgyun de rig rtsal bskyar dar dus skabs dang / bzo las gsar brje'i dus skabs nas dus rabs bcu dgu'i dus mjug bar rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas byas te/ bsam blo kun spyod slob gso yo rob gling gi slob grwa'i khrod du gtso bo dang lte gnas yin pa'i go sa la g.yo 'gul ma byung ba red/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mjug nas gnas tshul 'di dag rtsa ba nas 'gyur ldog byung ste/ thog mar slob grwa'i bsam blo kun spyod slob gso je zhan du gyur/rjes su dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor rim bzhin snang med du bzhag

nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ 269mthar dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus dkyil nas bsam blo kun spyod slob gso'i bya gzhag slob grwa chung 'bring dang khyad par du mtho rim slob grwa nas 'jig zin pa red/ 'gyur ldog 'di dag gi rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen ni tshan rig dang / 'phel 'gyur smra ba/ dngos lugs kyi rig pa gsar pa/ mtshan nyid rig pa bcas 'phel rgyas su phyin pa des chos lugs dang kun spyod rin thang gi lta ba'i rmang gzhi la 'jig nyen skul/ bzo las dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyis mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang bsam blo'i 'du shes la bzhag pa'i shugs rkyen/ grong khyer gyi dar rgyas dang rgya bskyed/ mi 'bor 'phar snon dang 'gul skyod bcas kyis kun spyod rin thang gi 'du shes dang mtho rim slob gsor phog thug bzos/ gnas tshul 'di dag gi khrod du sngar yod kyi chos lugs slob gsor brten nas rin thang lta tshul dang kun spyod tshad gzhi chags pa de spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dngos dang 'gal ba je cher phyin pa ma zad/kun spyod thad kyi gnad don gsar pa mang po zhig bstud mar byung ba/ 'gal ba de dag sel ba'i rin thang lta tshul dang kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi gsar pa zhig tshugs ma thub pa red/lo rabs drug cu pa nas yo rob dang a ri dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab khag la spyi tshogs g.yo 'gul dang 'gyur ldog byung ba ste/ dmangs srid las 'gul dang / bud med kyi thob thang las 'gul/ slob grwa chen mo bas bslangs pa'i khrom skor/ khor yug gi gnad don/ 'jig skul ba'i bya 'gul/lkog rngan za len/ du nag 'then pa/ log par g.yem pa sogs pa'i spyod ngan de dag gis mi rnams la tshan rtsal dang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su phyin pa kho nas gnad don mtha' dag thag gcod mi nus pa ma zad/ gnad don gsar pa mang po zhig phrad dang 'phrad bzhin pa'i ngos 'dzin byung ba dang /de ni gcig nas spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog gis kun spyod kyi gnad

270 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/don 'bor chen zhig gsar du thon pa dang / phyogs gzhan nas srol rgyun kun spyod kyi rin thang lta tshul nyams chag tu song ba/ kun spyod rin thang gi lta tshul gsar pa zhig 'dzugs ma thub pa bcas kyis rkyen pas mi rnams kyi kun spyod dang gshis rgyud ngan zhan du gyur ba red/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/mang tshogs dang slob gso'i las rigs/ srid 'dzin las khungs bcas kyis kun spyod slob gso'i gal che'i rang bzhin gsal rtogs byung nas slob grwa yongs kyis kun spyod slob gso la shugs snon dgos pa'i skul ma btang /mig sngar dbyin ji'i slob chen mi nyung ba zhig la ched dmigs kyi kun spyod slob gso'i zhib 'jug las khungs tshugs yod pa dper na/ nyig can slob chen gyi ‘‘kun spyod 'phel rgyas kyi zhib 'jug tshan khag ’’dang / le sī tha'o slob chen gyi ‘‘spyi tshogs kun spyod kyi slob gso lte gnas ’’sogs yod/ las khungs 'di dag gis kun spyod la 'brel pa dang kun spyod slob gso'i gzhung lugs gnad don skor la zhib 'jug gnang bzhin yod/2 000lor dbyin ji'i srid gzhung gis gtan la phab pa'i slob tshan dmigs yul ni ( 1) bsam blo/ kun spyod/ spyi tshogs/ shes rig bcas 'phel rgyas su skul 'ded byed pa/ ( 2) rang nyid/ spyi tshogs/ bde thang dang spyi dmangs kyi slob gso skul spel/ ( 2) nus rtsal 'phel rgyas su gzhol ba bcas yin/ 'di las mthong thub pa ni/ slob ma'i bsam blo dang kun spyod/ spyi tshogs/ shes rig bcas 'phel rgyas su gtong ba ni rgyal khab slob tshan gyi dmigs yul thog ma dang / slob tshan brgyud nas slob mar mu mthud du slob gso byed pa ni slob grwa'i kun spyod kyi thabs lam gtso bo yin/da lta rang rigs kyi blo mthun kha cig gis chos lugs slob gso ni deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang mthun sbyor byed thabs bral ba zhig yin par 'dod pa dang / chos lugs slob gso'i slob ston pa rnams kyis kyang chos

nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ 271lugs slob gso 'di spyi dmangs kyi slob gso'i 'thus tshab tu 'gyur thub min la dogs gzhi dang thugs khur gnang bzhin yod/ yin na'ang / dbyin ji ni chos lugs kyi bag chags dang shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod pa'i rgyal khab cig yin te/ dus rabs nyi shu par/ dbyin ji la spyi tshogs kyi gnad don bstud mar byung bas spyi dmangs rnams chos lugs kyi slob gsor brten nas myur skyob thub pa red/ de'i phyir/ dpon gzhung nas chos lugs slob gso sngar bzhin slob grwa'i nges sbyong slob tshan du bzhag kho tshos bltas na/ chos lugs slob gso byed pa brgyud nas slob ma'i bsam bkod nus pa phun sum je tshogs su btang chog par snyam/ dbyin ji'i slob tshan u yon tshogs pa'i lag bstar gtso 'gan pa ṇi pā la sung tho ther yis ‘‘chos lugs slob gso med na 'byung 'gyur nga tshos 'jig rten 'dir rgyus lon byed thabs bral ba yin ’’zhes gsungs/dbyin ji'i kun spyod slob gso'i bya gzhag yo rob gling gi rgyal khab phal cher gcig mtshungs yin te/ chos lugs slob gso dang 'brel ba dam zab yod/ dbyin ji'i slob grwa 1phro2lhag gis chos tshogs 'dzugs gnyer byed pa dang / chos lugs slob gso ni slob grwa mtha' dag gi rmang gzhi'i slob tshan khrod nges par sbyong dgos pa zhig yin/ da dung thun mong gis phyag 'tshal bkur bste byed pa'i srol yod/ 1kha96lo'i slob gso'i bca' khrims nang slob ma rnams nyin rgyun thun mong gi phyag 'tshal bkul bste byed pa'i bya 'gul nang zhugs dgos pa'i blang bya bton/ bya 'gul 'di ni slob gwa nas spel ba zhig ste nyin rer zhogs pa'i slob thun ma tshogs sngon gyi chu tshod skar ma15—25bar slob ma yongs phyogs gcig tu 'dus te thun mong gis phyag 'tshal bkur bste byed pa yin/ skabs 'gar slob spyi dang dge rgan gyis sne khrid pa las/ gtso cher slob ma'i rang rtogs la brten dgos/ de'i nang don ni/

272 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nang sems rgyud la phan pa'i legs bshad dang snyan tshig grags can dbyangs su gyer ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ dam pa'i gsung rab dang chos lugs gzhan gyi rtsom rig brtsams chos klog 'don byed pa sogs sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed la brten nas nyin de'i bsam spyod kyi las gang byas spyi phan dge ba'i grogs su 'gyur bar bsngo ba/ de ni khrims kyis gtan la phab pa'i slob grwa'i bya 'gul khag cig yin te/ srid gzhung gis sngar bzhin chos lugs slob gso dang thun mong gi phyag 'tshal bkur bste ni byis pa'i kun spyod dang bsam blo 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs gtso bo zhig yin par dgongs pa red/h+pha ran si ni slob gso'i sgrig gzhi'i dbang cha krung dbyang gis gcig sdud byed pa'i rgyal khab cig yin pas rgyal yongs gcig gyur gyi slob gso'i 'char gzhi yod pa dang / de'i khrod du slob grwa'i spyi dmangs kun spyod thad kyi 'char 'god 'du ba yin/ spyi dmangs kyi kun spyod de thog mtha' bar gsum du slob grwa rim pa khag gis ‘‘g.yol thabs med pa dang khur du len 'os pa'i ’’'gan zhig yin par gtan 'khel byas yod/ de'i dmigs bya ni ‘‘mi mtha' dag la rang rtogs dang thun mong gi 'du shes skyed sring byas te/ spyi dmangs yongs kun spyod ldan pa'i mi zhig tu 'gyur bar bya rgyu ’’de red/'jar man gyi slob gso gtso cher chab srid slob gso'i rmang gzhi zhig chags pa brgyud nas chos lugs slob gso dar spel bya rgyu de yin/ chab srid slob gso'i shugs rkyen bzang po zhig thebs pa la 'jar man spyi tshogs kyis rgyab skyor chen po byed pa/ mnyam 'brel srid gzhung dang khul srid gzhung so sor chab srid slob gso lte gnas kyi las khungs yod pa dang / gzhan sna mang bya ba sgrub pa'i spyi tshogs tshogs pa dang spyi spyod las khungs mang po btsugs yod/chos ni kun spyod kyi rtsa ba yin par dgongs te/ slob grwa mi nyung ba zhig la kun rdzob pa'i khrid deb gtan 'bebs byas yod pas rmang gzhi tshang ma chos lugs

nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ 273slob tshan nas 'go rtsom pa yin/ 'di dag gi rmang gzhi la brten nas bsam blo dang mi gshis gso skyong byed pa'i dmigs yul ni lha dbang la dad gus dang chos lugs dad mos bya rgyu dang / da dung rgan bkur gzhon gces kyi gus lugs ldan pa/ rdzun dang phra ma spong ba/ rang gcun pa/ don la gzab pa/rgyal khab dang mi rigs/ rang khyim la dga' zhing brtse ba bcas kyi slob gso mngon du 'gyur ba'i ched du yin/gsum pa/ mi gshis legs skyong dang gcigs cher 'dzin pa'i thad kyi bsam gzhigaspyod lam legs po ni mi gshis kyi rtsa ba lta bu yin pas mi su dang gang zhig yin rung rang sems 'dul sbyong byas te spyi tshogs dang skye 'gro kun la sman pa'i nus shugs 'don rgyur dus rabs 'dis re ba dang skul brda byed/ ston pa mchog gis ‘‘nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ / yid ni dug gi sdong po ste/ / nag pa'i chos kun 'byung pa'i phyir/ / ’’zhes gsungs pa dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas ‘‘nang gi sems nyid 'dul gyur na/ / phyi yi dgra yis gnod mi nus/ / rang gi nang sems g.yo ba na/ / phyi yi dgra yis rkyen byas nas/ /nang gi dgra 'dis rang rgyud sreg/ des na nang gi dgra 'di gzhom/ / ’’zhes thog mar rang rgyud 'dul ba gtso bor byed pa bstan/ phyi rgyal gyi mkhas pa yo han sin gyis/ kun spyod bzang po ni shes yon tshad mthor sleb pa'i rtags mtshan yin zhes pa dang / sa skya legs bshad las ‘‘gal te rig pa yod na yang / / skye bo rang bzhin ngan pa spang / / dug sbrul nor bus mgo rgyan yang / / mkhas pa su zhig pang du len/ / ’’zhes bstan/ gzhan yang / ru'u lugs pa'i rjes 'dzin pa nīn tsi yis dgongs bzhed ltar na mi dang dud 'gro'i khyad par ni mi la byams pa dang / bag yod/ gus bkur/ shes rab

274 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas mi chos kyi 'du shes yod pa de yin/ bsam blo ba chen po kong tse 'tsho bzhugs skabs su'ang bshad rgyun 'di 'dra zhig yod de ‘‘gnam 'og gi gzhi ma rgyal khab dang / rgyal khab kyi gzhi ma khyim tshang / khyim tshang gi gzhi ma rang lus yin ’’des na lus 'di gnam 'og dang rgyal khab/ khyim tshang bcas kyi gzhi ma yin pas lus sbyong byed rgyu ni ches rtsa ba yin par bzhed pa'i legs bshad kyi gsungs sgros 'di dag las/ kun spyod bzang po zhig skyed sring byed pa rgyal khab phyi nang dang gna' deng gi slob gso thun mong gi nang don gal chen zhig yin pa rtogs sla ba red/ kun spyod bzang po zhig skyed sring byed rgyu ni spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang zhi bde 'phel rgyas kyi grub cha gtso bo yin la mi'i rigs rig ldan gyi 'tsho bar phyogs pa'i rmang gzhi yang yin/ yin na'ang kun spyod gshis rgyud 'di mi rigs dang / skad cha/ yul srol/ chos lugs sogs rig gnas kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis mi chos kun spyod kyi gshis lugs dang bsam bkod sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'ga' srid mod/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i sdom gzhi gcig mtshungs yin te/ slob gso'i khyad khongs thad nas bltas na/ thun mong gi 'dra sa mang po zhig 'dug pas kun spyod slob gso 'di la yongs khyab rang bzhin dang 'dzam gling rang bzhin ldan pa red/de'i phyir kun spyod bya gzhag 'di la rigs rus dang lam phyogs/ gral rim sogs kyi dbye ba med par phan tshun dpe bltas dang slob sbyong byed chogarang rgyal la mtshon na sgyur bcos sgo 'byed kyi bgrang bya nyi shu lhag gi ring la rgyal dar dmangs phyug gi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la gnam sa lta bu'i 'pho 'gyur byung yod pa dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba 'di las mthong thub pa zhig yin mod/'on kyang kun spyod bya gzhag gi 'gyur ba de las ldog ste/ rang zhen gyi bdag 'dzin kho na'i dbang gis srol rgyun gyi mi chos kun spyod snang med du bzhag pa/dper na/ rang la bka' drin gyi khur du lci ba'i pha ma zung yang sgo phyir phud

nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur skor gleng ba/ 275pa'i gnas tshul mthong thos su gyur pa de rigs dang / khrims kyis gcun yang tshul min gyi bya spyod je mang song ba/ gzhan don la kha g.yar nas rang don kho naskub pa/ dmangs rgyu skog za byed pa/ rdzun dang phra byed pa/ rkun 'phrog byed pa sogs kyi snang tshul 'di rigs la spyi tshogs dang las rigs khag gi mi sna/ srid gzhung bcas kyis kha rdung drag po gtong bzhin yod/ rang rgyal gyi kun spyod slob gso 'phel 'gyur gyi dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs na'ang /nub gling dang gcig mtshungs yin te/ ‘‘rig gsar ’’gyi chab srid g.yo 'gul khrod sngar yod mi chos dang kun spyod kyi gzhung lugs dang srol rgyun kun spyod kyi shes bya pad+ma'i skyed der/ dus zing ba mos gtses te re zhig nyams rul du phyin/ yin na'ang deng rabs dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rim dang bstun nas yang bskyar kun spyod bya gzhag la shugs snon pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni 〈krung gung krung dbyang gis gom gang mdun spos kyis slob grwa'i kun spyod bya ba'i thad kyi lta tshul 'ga' zhig la legs bcos byas te shugs snon pa 〉zhes pa las/ ‘‘da lta'am rjes phyogs su lo ngo bco lnga lhag la slob grwas gso skyong byas zin pa'i slob ma rnams kyi bsam blo kun spyod dang tshan rig shes bya'i spus tshad ji 'dra yin pa de/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i krung go'i rnam pa la thad kar 'brel ba yod/ rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun gyi 'thab jus dmigs 'ben mngon 'gyur byed thub min la rag las yod par ma zad/ tang gi rtsa ba'i lam phyogs lo ngo brgya la g.yo 'gul mi byed par rgyun 'khyongs byed thub min la'ang 'brel ba dam po yod ’’ces pa dang /cang tse rmin gyis tang gi tshogs chen bco lnga pa'i gsung bshad nang ‘‘krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa la/ nges par du mi rnams kyi bsam blo kun spyod gshis rgyud dang tshan rig rig gnas byang tshad shugs chen gyis mthor 'degs byas te/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang spyi

276 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshogs khyon yongs gong 'phel stobs ldan can du 'don sprod byed pa'i snying stobs kyi sgul shugs dang rig stobs rgyun skyong byed pa/ spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can gyi re 'dun dang mthun par mi rabs nas mi rabs su phugs bsam ldan pa dang / kun spyod ldan pa/ shes rig ldan pa/ sgrig lam ldan pa'i spyi 'bangs skyed sring byed pa ’’zhes bstan/ des na mi dang mi'i dbar gyi 'brel ba de nga rgyal dang phrag dog khong khro zhe sdang dmu rgod sogs kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar/ phan tshun 'dra mnyam dang brtsi bkur/ mthun sgril phan sems sogs kyi 'phel phyogs su chags thub min gyi 'gag rtsa gtso bo ni mi'i rgyud la bsam pa bzang po zhig ldan min la rag las pa yin pas/ nga tshog phyogs lhung dang rang mchog 'dzin gyi bsam blo ring du dor te sngon thon rgyal khab kyi kun spyod slob gso'i legs cha nang 'dren dang / srol rgyun rig gnas las mi chos skor gyi legs bshad rgyun 'dzin/ nang bstan shes rig las dmigs bya sems can la dmigs nas gzhan don 'ba' zhig gnyer ba la sogs pa'i gzhan gces 'dzin gyi bsam blo'i sa bon gang legs spel te/ mi rnams bsam spyod gnyis 'dzoms kyi ya rabs tshul ldan dang dmangs phan zhi bde'i phyogs su brtson par bya dgos/ mdor na/ nga tsho mi rabs 'dis ‘‘mtshon byed gsum ’’gyi dgongs don ji bzhin lag len dngos nang don 'khyol byed thub min yang kun spyod bya gzhag la rag las pa yin pas/ kun spyod ldan la spyod lam mdzes pa'i mi gshis bzang po zhig skyed sring byed rgyu ni dus rabs kyis sprad pa'i 'os 'gan dang gzi brjid kyi don chen zhig yin no/( dpyad rtsom 'di 2005lo'i 〈bod ljongs slob gso 〉deb gsum pa las bdams/)

277༄ / / bya tshig gi spyor tshul dang ming grub tshul la cung zad dpyad pa/pad ma tshe brtan/mi rigs shig la rang gi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i rig gnas shig yod phyin/ nga tshos rig gnas de nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel du gtong ci thub bya dgos/ de dar spel du gtong dgos na nges par du rang rigs kyi yon tan can dang shes ldan mi sna 'bor chen zhig bskyed bsring bya dgos/ mi rigs rang nyid dang mi rigs rang nyid kyi shes ldan mi snas mi rigs rang gi skad cha dang rang gi rig gnas la mthong chen byas te gang nus ci thub kyis bkol spyod bya rgyur dmigs su bzung na da gzod mi rigs nang khul gyi slob gso'i phyogs la'ang nus pa gal chen thon nges/spyir nga tsho bod kyi rig gnas 'di la 'dzam gling gi yig rigs bang mdzod khrod 'od stong 'bar ba'i lo rgyus kyi shul rjes bla na med pa zhig mnga' bas rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog mtshams med du 'bebs pa sus kyang gzhigs na shes gsal ltar ro/rig gnas gang zhig yin kyang / gting thag pa dang mthar phyin pa zhig sbyong rgyu ni dka' mo red/ dper na/ bod kyi rig gnas las brda sprod kyi phyogs kho na la mi tshe gang bor sbyangs kyang / skabs la lar 'di yin no/ de ma yin no zhes gtan tshigs gi sgo nas thag mi chod pa'i gnad don mang po yod/

278 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnam dbye rkyang rkyang lta bur mtshon na'ang de'i dper brjod la mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs bzhed mi mthun pa mang du mchis te/ nyi ma shar ba na me tog pad+ma bzhad lta bu dang / dkon mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rta la rtswa byin lta bu sogs snang / gzhan bya tshig sbyor stangs thad la'ang dogs pa'i 'ol tshod dam thugs nyams ma bzhag par rang snang gang shar du bris pa mang du mchis/ a lags dor zhi tshang gis rgyun spyod kyi kha skad nang du nor 'khrul 'byung mi srid mod/ dag cha dang grims sha dgos pa'i yi ger 'god tshe/ bya tshig gi rnam gzhag ma shes na tshig gral dag cig thon dka'o zhes dang / rang skad kyi sgra gdangs dang rnam dbye bya tshig gi rnam gzhag sogs nyams pa'i yul skad chal 'chol smra ba rnams dang / skad rigs de mi shes pa'i mi rigs gzhan pas spyir btang gi slob gnyer gyi lam la brten pa tsam gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i skad yig gi 'gag 'phrang dog mo de las thar dka' tshod du gda' zhes gsungs pas/ nga tsho bod kyi rig gnas 'di la las dang por zhugs pa sus kyang bya tshig gi phra zhing zhib pa'i 'gyur lugs rnams dpyis phyin pa zhig sbyong rgyu gal chen nang gi yang chen yin/'dir ngas skabs su babs pa'i brjod don gtso che ba'am bsam gzhigs phyogs gsum gyis brjod par bya ste/dang po/ bya chig sbyar te bya ba rdzogs pa ston lugs thad kyi bsam gzhigs/spyir bya tshig la dus gsum du dbye ba'i nang gi bya tshig dang bya ba'i tshig mtshon byed kyi bya tshig rnam pa gnyis su snang la/ 'dir las ka'am bya ba mtshon byed kyi bya tshig yin/ bya tshig 'dis bstan don ni phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can kun gyis bsdus pa'i dngos po'i phyi nang gi

bya tshig gi sbyor tshul dang ming grub tshul la cung zad dpyad pa/ 279rten 'brel las byung ba'i 'pho 'gyur dang / 'gul skyod/ sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum bag chags dang bcas pa'i gnas tshul dang 'char tshul mtshon pa'i tshig la go/bya ba gang dang gang zhig yin rung bya ba de rkyen gang las byung zhing 'bras bus ji ltar mjug rdzogs pa'am bya ba 'byung ba'i mgo'i rkyen de dang mjug gi 'bras su de gnyis rten cing 'brel ba'i tshul du yod pa yin/ bya ba zhig 'byung ba'i tshul la byed rtsol 'don mkhan gyi bya ba ste rgyu yi tshul du snang ba'i bya ba zhig dang byed rtsol 'jug yul gyi ngor snang ba'i bya ba ste 'bras bu'i tshul gyi bya ba bcas gnyis yod/ bya ba 'di gnyis gzhir bzung nas bya tshig la bya byed tha dad pa dang bya byed tha mi dad pa gnyis su dgar/ yongs grags su mtshan nyid 'jog tshul ni 'di lta ste/ bya byed tha dad pa ni byed pa po dang bya ba gnyis tha dad du yod pa'i bya tshig cig la zer/bya byed tha mi dad pa ni byed pa po dang bya ba gnyis tha mi dad cing gzhi gcig tu 'brel yod pa'i bya tshig cig la zer/ mi rigs gzhan pa'i brda sprod la de 'dra'i phra zhing zhib mo mi 'dug ste/ 'di ni bod kyi brda sprod kho na la yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig red/ gsham du gong gi bya tshig rigs gnyis kyis ji ltar bya ba zhig rdzogs pa ston tshul la gzhi bcol te dbye zhib byas na/(1)byed pa po'i rtsol ba dang sbyar nas bya tshig gzugs 'gyur med pas bya ba rdzogs pa ston tshul/ dper na/ thal mo bkan/ thag pa 'then/ sa mthar 'khyams/ man ngag mkhyud/ 'bru rigs spungs/ mdud pa mdud lta bu sogs las bkan/ 'then/ 'khyams/ mkhyud/ spungs/ mdud bcas ni bya tshig gzugs mi 'gyur ba yin pa dang / bya tshig 'di rigs kyis rang thad nas brjod bya'i don yongs su rdzogs pa ston thub pa las 'bras bu'i tshul

280 gtsos mi rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du snang ba'i bya tshig gzhan zhig gis don ston pa ha cang nyung /(2)byed pa po'i rtsol ba dang sbyar te bya tshig gzugs 'das pas bya ba rdzogs pa ston tshul/ dper na/ mgar gyis bod dmag 'bum tsho khrid nas rgya rnams bcom/ 〈bod kyi lo rgyus g.yu yi me lung 〉las bkra shis kyis glog rdzas rtsis 'khor sbyangs/ lta bur mtshon na mgar gyis bod dmag 'bum tsho khrid nas rgya rnams bcom zhes pa la nga tshos lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs la brten nas tshig 'di'i go ba len dgos/ bkra shis kyis glog rdzas rtsis 'khor sbyangs zhes pa/ gcig nas sbyangs myong ba'i don ston/ gnyis nas sbyangs te shes yod pa'i don ston pa red/ spyir na/ bkra shis kyis sbyangs yod na shes yod pa'i ma khyab/ dbang po'i snod du ma rung na ji ltar sbyangs kyang lobs pa'i nges pa med/ bya tshig 'di lta bur mtshon na byed pa po gang gis rang ngos nas bya ba'i yul gyi steng rtsol ba bcug zin yang / bya ba de rgyu bsgrub pa nas 'bras bu 'grub yod med gsal po 'chad med na/ de la tshig snga phyi'i brjod stangs dang 'brel nas go ba len dgos/(2)byed pa po'i rtsol ba dang sbyar nas la tshi nga gzugs 'dra ba'i bya bye tha mi pas bya ba rdzogs pa ston tshul/dper na/ gdan sar bkod nas (ma)khod/ dgra sogs bkum nas (ma)khum/ sha btsos nas (ma)tshos/ me bsad nas (ma)sod/ bris nas (ma)phris/ phyugs la kha sna btul nas (ma)thul/ khug la btum nas (ma)thums/ thag pa bkrol nas (ma)khrol/ lta bu sogs 'di'i rigs kyi spyor tshul mang shos gtso bo bya byed tha dad pa'i bya tshig gzugs bzhi 'gyur gyi 'jug tshul yin pa dang / tshig mtha'i bya tshig de skul tshig dang gzugs 'dra yang skul tshig min te/ rgyu byed pa po'i rtsol ba las byung ba'i 'bras bu de bya byed tha mi dad pas bstan yod/ 'di lta bu 'jug pa'i bya tshig dag la ni gong 'og gi

bya tshig gi sbyor tshul dang ming grub tshul la cung zad dpyad pa/ 281tshig dang bstun nas go ba len mi dgos te rang thad nas don gyi 'bras bu gsal por bstan yod/(4)byed pa po'i rtsol ba dang sbyar te la tshig nga gzugs mi 'dra ba'i bya bye tha mi pas bya ba rdzo sa pa ston tshul/ dper na/ bsgrags nas (ma)grags/ phyugs btul nas (ma)dul/ ri mo bsubs nas (ma)zub/bzung nas (ma)zin/ lan btab nas (ma)thebs/ sprad nas (ma)'phrod/bsgrubs nas (ma)'grub/ bslabs nas (ma)lobs/ lcags skud bkug nas (ma)gug bsgyur nas (ma)'gyur/ lta bu sogs 'di las ches mjug gi bya tshig 'di rnams ni dus gsum las ma 'ongs 'das skul gang la yang gzugs mi 'dra ba'i bya tshig cig yin/ rgyu byed pa po'i rtsol ba gang las 'bras bu'i tshul du 'jug yod/ bya tshig de skul tshig dang gzugs 'dra min tsam las gzhan khyad par ci yang med/ bya tshig gi 'jug yul 'dir chos nyid nges can zhig chags yod/ 'di ni bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bya tshig gi rnam gzhag cig yin pas tshul 'di bzhin ma sbyar na nor 'khrul yin/ spyir na kha skad dang yig skad bar na mi mthun sa chen po med ces brjod chog la deng sang rkyen du ma'i dbang gis kun gyis kha skad yul skad mang po bsres nas yid 'jog ma byas par brjod pas/ yig skad dang kha skad bar kyang dbye ba yod par gyur/ bod yig cung ngos zin pa rnams kyis yul skad chal chol goms 'dris su chags nas yig skad dang mthun snyam ste bya tshig de gnyis kyi 'brel ba dang khyad chos ma rtogs par ci 'dod du 'bri ba yod/ dpe 'ga' drangs na/〈kha che pha lur 〉thod pa'i ri mo bsuXbs kyang zuXb rgyu med/ ces pa dang /〈tshangs mgur 〉du/ ma bris sems kyi ri mo/ / bsubs kyang bsubs kyi mi 'dug / ces pa'i bar gyi zub dang bsubs gnyis kyi bkol yul gcig yin na'ang bkol tshul la 'gal ba yod pa lta bu/ bya byed tha dad pa dang mi dad pa

282 gtsosami rigs dge 'os mtho rim slob grwa'i dpyad rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis kyi bar na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba yod pas don ston tshul thad la'ang khyad par yod/ deng dus kyi tshags par dang dus deb thog bya tshig thol byung du bkol nas rgyun 'byams su song 'dug 'di na nor 'khrul gyi 'phel phyogs zhig yin/rang skad goms shugs kyis ji ltar 'jug pa shes kyang / ci phyir 'jug pa mi shes pas/ yig nor byung ba tshig skyon don skyon du 'gyur srid/ de bas/bya tshig gi rnam gzhag la bstun nas bri dgos pa gal chen las yang chen yin no/ / gnyis pa/ bya chig sbyar te ming 'dogs lugs thad kyi bsam gzhigs/bya tshig kyang ches med du mi rung ba'i tshig gi grub byed dang don ston byed kyi snying bo lta bu yin/ don de ma rtogs na bya tshig steng gi phra zhib kyi khyad par mang bo'i dbye ba mi shes par ci 'dod du bris nas don ji bzhin du ston mi nus la/ yi ge'i dag cha'ang nyams dmas su 'gro nges/ rtogs na bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi dbye ba dang bya byed las gsum ngos 'dzin tshul/ bya tshig gis dngos po'i ming grub tshul sogs kyi chos nyid la byang cha ldan zhing gsar byung gi dngos po zhig la ming 'dogs pa tshun gyi skad cha'i bkol spyod phyogs la'ang phan/de yang / spyir btang gi ming chags tshul la 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub rnam pa gnyis su yod la/ so sor yang dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis su phyes yod/ bya tshig sbyar te sngon chad btags zin pa'i ming phal cher gyi rang steng nas dbye zhib byas na tshang ma rjes grub kyi ming sha stag red/ spyi tshogs kyi thon rdzas gsar pa'i gong 'phel dang bstun nas bya tshig gis grub pa'i ming
